text: Food is delicious, staff was very pleasant. Indoor and outdoor seating was available. I had the pulled pork sandwich and their new Mac n Chz. And hubby had baby back ribs with hot honey bbq sauce sausage stuffing and Mac salad. Generous portions and very reasonable prices. We left happy and full!

THESE GUYS ARE THE FUCKING BEES KNEES, THE CATS PAJAMAS, THE DOPEST DOPE YOU'LL EVER SMOKE.



In all seriousness though I called Don at for a last minute oil change at 4:10pm. I asked when the soonest possible time was it could be done. He told me to bring the car in. I arrived at 4:20.
(Actual time, not a joke) As I got out of the car a mechanic gets in and begins putting the car on a lift... I walk a block away a drink a beer... At 5:06pm Don calls me and says "your all set"!!!!!!!!! 

Now I know we live in a world of instant gratification (you are using yelp on your smartphone)

 BUUUT HOLY FUCKING SHIT THATS GREASE LIGHTING FAST.

My fiancé and I are on our way to Portland ME Rn with the freshest oil out.
We win.
You win.
Don wins.
EVERYBODY WINS.




Ps FLY EAGLES FLY GO BIRDS

Pss this is just a photo of my car for no real reason

DO NOT ORDER PIZZA FOR DELIVERY FROM HERE. I put in an online order for 1 pizza at 6:50PM. At 8:30 I called and they told me it would be another 45 minutes before delivery. So I told them I would go there and pick it up myself. I get there and the delivery person had just left with my pizza..... why was there no communication between the staff. I told them I was coming. And ended up having to wait another 20 minutes for the delivery guy to come back. I will not be ordering from them again. They told me they would give me a refund and credit but they never did.

Amazing authentic food... Finally!!! I had the wonton noodle soup and spicy BBQ pork bahn mi. Broth was definitely made from bones. Noodles weren't soggy, always a plus. The wontons are a perfect mix of pork, shrimp, fish sauce and maybe oyster sauce. Not sure but delicious to say. 

The bahn mi was perfect amount of spice and freshness. The roll was toasty and huge. This place does not skimp on portion sizes. Couldn't finish everything will have the rest later today. 

Service was great too and attentive. They are open to other cultures being there I was not treated any differently. I will be going back.

Red Perch is a fish shop that recently opened on  Nashville's West End.  The specialty here is fish and chips, offered with cod or the fish of the day.  They also have fish tacos and assorted other seafood menu offerings.  I would highly recommend the fish and chips.  They are crispy, flavorful, and not greasy.  We went late in the evening on a weekend and it wasn't crowded at all.  You can get your food to go, eat inside, or dine outdoors on their small patio space.  Best fish and chips in Nashville!

I'm not sure how they could get even better than last year, but the gals of Nyx killed it last night. Alice H's review is going to contain better details than this one (I might have been too inebriated to get the joke between parades). 
 
Now I see the benefit of being at the *end* of the parade route. Last year my apartment was at the very beginning and while there are some benefits to that, I definitely did not walk away with a glittery handmade Nyx purse either!

Speaking of throws, they really *really* went all out this year. Look at my photo! My favorite throws besides the aforementioned purse, were the custom Nyx beads with purses and a gift box. 

Besides all this, these girls are just cool and nice, also as Alice mentioned, really connecting with the crowd. By the way, one of them threw a purse specifically at me and a horrible throw scavenger all but knocked me out of the way to grab it (meanwhile earlier, I gave him a plush sword one of the Druids threw at me. Happy Mardi Gras, Asshole). 

Anyway. Great marching bands, dance troupes (610 Stompers and Disco Amigos are my favorites!) and an all around great time.

Nyx is right up there with Muses for me!!

Looking for a place that serves great breakfast at 8 AM? Choices aplenty. Looking for a great place that serves it at 7? Your choices are suddenly pretty limited - the likes of IHOP and so on. Enter Schlesinger.

It opens at 7 AM on weekdays (not sure of their weekend schedule) and has an abundance of choices. The Harvey, which I got, includes two eggs, turkey sausage or bacon, toast, potatoes, and coffee that can be substituted for orange juice, all for a mere $5 and some cents (can't remember the exact price). There are omelettes, French toast and pancakes, and a variety of ?German foods- potatoe pancakes, egg blitzes, etc. You can also pick from their lunch menu selections.  There's also the well-known pickle bar. I'm not a huge pickle fan but it looked like there was a good variety - sweet ones, spicy ones, etc - and I liked the macaroni and cucumber salads. There's a tasty selection of cakes on display. I definitely want to try the strawberry cake next time.

My only criticism is that the service was only average but it may have been due to the surprising number of other diners present at 7:00 on a weekday morning. I think there was only one waitress waiting tables so she might have been a little swamped- my friend's coffee didn't arrive until she was basically done eating, I got turkey bacon instead of turkey sausage, and my toast was burnt so I was scraping off the burnt parts with my knife.

Other than that, the variety of options was on point and the prices (at least for the breakfast options, I didn't look too carefully at the lunch or dinner menu) were very reasonable. I want to try the huge layered strawberry cake when I come back next.

From Mariah at the bar to Jesus serving we were totally amazing and impressed. The initial wine and cocktail selection thru the farm board was satisfying beyond belief. The steak dish was perfect and medium rare, amen! The entire was an expression of culture and food!

The kitchen really understands fish, and octopus in particular. I had the octopus mussel salad, and t was bang on. Great flavours, textures, colours.  Delicious.

It was not very busy today, all that road construction can't be helping, but the food I saw coming out of the kitchen tells me I need to go back, often...

Lots of beautiful fish on the menu to try out. Such a cool space and street too. 

Oh, and terrific friendly service too.

Hailie is a gifted sugar wax artist. I have had many wax experiences in my life and my experience with her is my favorite and least painful. On top of that She is easy to talk to and so kind!  Her space is beautiful and private. I highly recommend Hailie's services!
wine selection was not that good, but they had a vegetarian menu! great food and sevice.

So, despite living in Boston, I feel that I am well-qualified to review Jackson's, given that I was there every.single.day while I was in Tampa. 

Let's start with the (really) good:
The view is awesome.
The sushi is really good -- super fresh and verrry reasonably priced.
The bar menu. (which I personally found to be better than the regular menu!)  Edemame? Count me in!

Then there's the rest: 
The crowd is totally mixed; I don't think it was especially snobby or especially collegiate.  Then again, I wasn't trolling for dates, so. 
The lunch menu is ok but not great; I will say, however, that the sandwiches are HUUUUUUUUUUUUGE. 
The dinner menu is really "meh".  You can tell that they're trying to have the classic "upscale seaside dining experience" but where their prices matched the dim dining room/jazz music atmosphere, they certainly did NOT match the kakhi-short wearing crowd out on the deck.  The food on the menu was far from inspiring; I'd stick with sushi if you end up there late-night. 

Also, whaaaaaaaaat was with the Friday night dance party?! It was as if Jackson't was a sports bar that suddenly had a change of heart.  By about 10pm it was was Club Jackson's - packed with young peeps and lots of loud hip-hop.  Interesting. 

Anyhow, if I ever return to Tampa, I'll definitely be back here.

I recently attended a wedding reception at The Venice Plaza.  The food was abundant and outstanding.  The service was friendly and attentive.  Venice Plaza is family-owned and operated, and it shows!

The rooms are well-maintained and spacious with high ceilings and neutral-colored wood-paneled walls.  The crystal chandeliers in the larger Patricia Room are beautiful!

I would definitely recommend Venice Plaza for a wedding or other private affair.  According to the bride, the price is a great value, considering all that you get in terms of quantity of food, quality of food, and the great service.

My previously great experience at this salon was repeated when I returned last month.  Amy actually remembered me from the last time (over 6 months earlier), and she did an awesome job again.  At first, I thought her styling was a little over-done, but an hour later my hair settled into a great look.  Her recommendation for keeping my bangs longer was right-on - after I washed my hair, it looked perfect.
I've tried the pho here but I think I'd try something else like the com tom. The service here is alright and I do think I will come back.

I appreciated the efficient service at Mexican Post; our waitress was sweet and attentive.  The free app for checking in at Yelp was a great bonus.  And it was one of the least expensive meals I have eaten in the city, ..but there's little else positive to be said.  The food wasn't great.  The salsa was okay, just like something you can buy at a jar in the grocery story.  And the queso seemed to be velveeta and Rotel.  I appreciated all the vegetarian options on the menu, so maybe I just chose poorly, but I didn't really like the casa tacos; too salty.  My date's steak tacos were fine he said.  The draft beer list was lacking and my margarita was watery.  And we were seated at a booth near the back.  We liked the private area in the rather open warehouse-like back area of the restaurant, but the table was at least 6 inches too high.  There are a lot better mexican options in the city.

This little roadside stand is adorable. The ice cream is spectacular and made locally.  The toasted coconut flavor was delicious. Plus the owner is so sweet- it's obvious that she enjoys what she does, because she's so pleasant and kind. Will definitely be back!

We're in the area visiting my family and we decided to take a trip over to Cherry Hill to go to the mall and try out the food at this place- it was absolutely amazing! We got takoyaki, matcha milk tea, and chicken ramen! 
First, the atmosphere- we had no idea what to expect going inside, but it was such a pleasant surprise being greeted with anime decor! My fiancé and I are big anime fans so it was pretty neat. It was also extremely clean and just gorgeous and welcoming inside! 
The service was amazing. Upon entering we were promptly seated, and served water without asking (I go through water like crazy so I was particularly happy about this). We ordered, and all of what we ordered came out in no more than five minutes- it was honestly probably even less time than that! 
The food itself was amazing, especially the ramen. We just couldn't get enough, we almost ordered another bowl once we were done our first! 
We'll definitely be going more, we look forward to trying some of their other ramen flavors!

We dropped in late on a Saturday night hoping to get in.  We were LUCKY, and the wonderful, hard working front of house team was able to work us in.  The ambiance is amazing and the service was very attentive.  Now the food,. WOW! We had the lobster fries, so rich.  We had the salmon and wait for it....alligator tacos.  I've never had alligator but I loved this dish.  The salmon was perfectly cooked and paired with the puree.  

If you're still reading this stop and go make your reservation.  (There is no bar so you can't really show up and wait at the bar)

Very cool atmosphere. Be sure to find parking on Mass Ave instead of searching for a nearby spot. I got the skirt steak dish. It's delicious. The cauliflower appetizer is also really delicious and light. The margaritas are fab. Looking forward to visiting in the summer!
Nice little place suited for locals. Inside is a little shabby. Service gets slow when there are a lot of guests. No free refill of side dishes. Restroom sink not well maintained.

We went here for my husband to play at the open mic. I called 199 times before I got his name on the list... which meant he didn't play until after midnight. If you don't want to play late, don't bother if your call doesn't go through before like 1:10. 
It's really cool that they keep playing until everyone who called and wanted to play get their chance. There were some awful acts and some amazing ones. So be prepared for a mixed bag. The drinks were okay and the food was not very exciting. 

If you want to hear music or play and are okay with stomaching some out of tune playing/singing in order to hear some good stuff, check it out.
Typical bullshit literally 300 people in line. Fly out of another airport. Too bad zero stars aren't available

Hey when u come to this Bar...Expect to have a Rock'n time...best day to go in my opinion is Wednesday when Dolores the Bartender takes care of everbody and everything..Gary behind the Mic running Karaoke and everyone including J is having a great time...Come on down annd check it out...

I have been here a couple times and everyone is always so nice.  My nails and toe nails look great and the pedi was amazing.  BUT the waxing was horrible.  First off I had to tell the lady to take my makeup off my lip before she put the wax on.  Then she was in such a hurry that this morning when I woke up she definitely ripped some skin off because now I have a scab where she waxed.  I will next get waxed here again.  But I will come back for my nails

Update:   I have been back several times and have had nothing but the best service since.  Maybe the lady was having a bad day.   But I would def recommend this place and I now give it 5 stars!

Oh, the place is the dirtiest McDonalds in the city, and the food is just your average quality, it is by far the best place in the city to witness a brewing race war.  If you like a little theater with your junk food, here is where you can witness an argument where the wittiest insult was "it's a prepay phone"

Fabulous shop! There is a wonderful variety of beads, charms & all the doo das you need to make a piece of unique jewelry! The owner is friendly and helpful. A must see for the jewelry hobbyist or someone looking for a gift for them.
 I had a bead that I wanted to use as a pendant and the owner had a quick and easy solution that looked great!

This is probably the best cheap Chinese in town. 
My only complaint is the difficulty in placing an order. My most recent call was answered by a young lady that spoke in a soft whisper. This is unacceptable when you job is to communicate. Get someone in there with some confidence!!

Stopped in for lunch on Friday. Rather dead unsure why but happy it was empty. Had great discussion and service from the bartender. Went ahead and ordered the prize meal "sticky bunz". Had three pork belly, fried zucchini and chili beef. Awesome the pork belly and fried zucchini loaded with flavor well balanced. Inexpensive too. Still had a hankering for something small and had the deviled eggs. Why hasn't anyone eggs put bacon on deviled eggs? Can I stress this place is awesome cramp a must stop.

They've done it right! 
RIBS: firm enough that it does not just fall out when you pick it up from the plate, but tender enough that it "melt" into your mouth when your teeth bite down (like the feeling of biting on a wet bread). Tried with Memphis sweet honey sauce that has a hint of beer.
BRISKET: moist, not watery or dripping juicy. You can smell smoke and taste the burn flavor while chewing the meat. Ask for sample if you're skeptical.
CHEESE CAKE: thick fat generous slice of fairly sour cheese topped with sweet chunky jam.

The service at this platos closet is horrible. I tried to drop off 2 bags of clothes which they said would be a 4 hour wait on December 29. TWO employees said i could come back the next day. I came the next day to find it was closed until January 2. Flash forward to the 2nd, they could not sell my things because their wifi was down. Today  (Jan. 3) they called me threatening that if I didn't show up today to pick up my items, they would throw my clothes out. So finally, on the 3rd, they graced me with the ability to come get my measly $28 in cash, claiming most of my things were "too old." They were mid-range designer items, like Free People, which I bought new last season... they act like they only have the newest items in stock but they're trying to sell 2011 Aeropostale jeans like those are new. Horrible store, not even worth the trip. You're better off donating clothes to Purple Heart or goodwill. I'd give a 0 rating if I could.

Cute, cozy, tucked away spot with a beautiful and expansive patio overlooking a lake. Got the chicken gyro platter which comes with grilled chicken and onions, rice, salad, pita bread and hummus. Large portion size for fair price. 

Extremely kind people and very quick service. Will definitely be coming back for the delicious food and pleasant atmosphere.
This place is great - got an awesome Vegan salad with all the fixings!! Nice and clean and great customer service.
Our new fav spot!!!! Good BBQ and great sides. Only small problem is that the sweet potato could use more sugar,butter,cinnamon,and some vanilla. But thats okay no place is perfect.

I been there for the first time today. I got a burger, fries and followed up with a shake.  The burger was very good. Didn't feel like a processed "fast food" burger.  The fries were good too. And the topper, the shake, was great. 

The only 2 drawbacks were price and wait. The prices are a bit steeper than I would normally like for a burger, but it could be a reflection of the location. Fries didn't come with the burger, so it added to it. I don't think the burger alone would be worth the price and filling enough for a grown man for lunch. But as an occasional treat, it was good. 

The wait time for ordering wasn't bad. They seem pretty well staffed, but it did take about 5+ minutes to get my food. Maybe it's not a big deal, considering the line of people they churn through, but the ordering style is fast-food like, so I may need to adjust my lunch hour expectations. 

I would still go back, if for nothing else, a food shake.

This place is unreal. We walk in and nobody was here and we almost left, but sat down and ordered the Fried Chicken with sausage gravy and biscuits. It was probably one of the best things I've ever eaten. You have to get it. We are coming back tomorrow!
Not a wine bar. Very limited wine selection. flights not available. Loud music. Pass.

This place was so horrible & the owner/ manager was beyond rude!!!! My family and I  made it to the Resturant by 7:30'..' We ordered appetizers and waited for 2.50 hours and then they brought out or food along with the appetizers  that was placed 2.50 hours ago.... By then we were just hungry but our food was disgusting..... I asked to speak to the Manager/ owner and she was the most rudest snobbish person that I ever encountered... So we left and went to a Korean Resturant and it was Delicious..I wish I could give this place a ZERO for a rating!!!!!!!!
Ok, often I think the cupcakes people go crazy over aren't THAT good. But these were awesome! My husband brought 6 home for us to try and they were all delicious!! I will def be going back!!

What an unusual place. The food is spaced around the corners of the store. Mixed in with sitting areas (couches and tables). It is a religious place so there are Bible references all over. Everybody is friendly there and they have not tried to convert me yet. Considering you do not see much food, they have a decent list of deli foods available. They make really good hoagies. They slice the meat to order. They have some unusal snacks and gourmet crackers which would be good for taking to parties. It is more of a fancy specialty store than a deli, but worth checking out.

My husband and I came here for our anniversary dinner. Every part of our meal was superb! The salsa dips were so delicious with the freshly-made tortilla chips, the four different tacos we tried between the two of us were AMAZING, and even the rice and beans that accompanied them were delicious, especially the beans. Our margaritas were unique and some of the best we've ever had. Even if we weren't vegan I would still come here! Well worth the money we spent.

I visited Franklin Fountain the other day for (embarrassingly) my first visit! I can't believe it's taken me this many years to find this hot spot (wow, nearly 700 reviews as of today!). 

The line wrapped around the outside, even in the winter on a weekday! Luckily there were plastic-coated menus circulating the lines, so everyone could decide what they wanted by the time they got to the front. This place is c-u-t-e! Very "old-fashioned" in everything from the menu to decor to uniforms on the servers. I never heard of such things as a "phosphate" before... 

The order of service and the whole line were a bit of a process/mess... it was hard to tell who (servers) was taking care of who (guests). I also was confused between those who were handling money and those who were scooping the ice cream - I'm not sure if their ways were entirely sanitary. 

The ice cream itself is made in-house, and is truly delicious. I tried the Whirly Berly - which had chocolate ice cream, nougat, salted caramel, and chocolate nibs. A bit sweet, a bit sour, and really delicious. I also tried the peanut butter ice cream, which was super-frozen, but deliciously creamy and full-fat "real". 

I'd come back again, but maybe try somewhere else in Old City for Fro-Yo, first, too.

Get ready for some unique and yummy flavors. The staff are willing to help please your pallet! I went in and said I was a first timer and the gentleman was patient with me and I got to try a few flavors before buying! I got one naughty and one nice scoop. The naughty was not too strong thankfully!  Great location for an evening stroll too!

Great food at a reasonable price. I absolutely love this place. It's my new fav! The toasted ravs were easily the BEST I have ever had. My entree was HUGE. I had leftovers for sure. The only thing I didn't care for was the cheesecake. But I'm still giving it 5 stars because everything else was so good!

Love the water fowl, multiple ponds, walkways and bridges. There is a gated community garden. Lots of parking and good walkways. Some benches, a pavilion and picnic tables.

The most squirrels I've seen concentrated in a public park.

Never saw any restrooms. There is water fountains. It's located next to an elementary school.

Meh.

I came here once and was pretty disappointed, mostly because the prices are very high for what you get, and the food I experienced was only ok.

The drink selection was so-so, and there was nothing too interesting on the menu. I'm not much of a steak girl and I can't eat dairy, so I opted for the gnocchi, since she said they could do it in a dairy-free red sauce instead of the cream sauce. It was served in a red sauce, but with parmesan on top. I'm pretty sure parmesan cheese contains dairy, but since I was on an awful date, I just kinda picked it off so I could get the heck out of there sooner rather than later. I could easily have made much better food at home for a fraction of the price. Maybe the meat options are better?

The service was good, though.

I just went here for the first time, and it is a typical diner atmosphere.
The food was good, and I will definitely go back.  My waitress, Mary, was fantastic!  She was very friendly and attentive.  By the looks of this place, it doesn't look like much, but the service and food make up for it!  So much better than a Denny's.

We had high hopes but were let down. The crab legs tempura only had 1 piece of crab and tempura veggies like carrots and white potato. The rolls are over priced for the area. That's why I gave it three stars.

Most of you know I am not a fan of burgers or pizza... However, I do go to these places with my family since they asked . 
I have very good first impression of this place . We came during lunch time , were seated right away. Ordered the drinks and food within 5-10 mins us being there...BUT food took very long!!! They refilled our drinks 3 times at least before we ate. Even though it might be upsetting to some , as soon as my food arrived and I tasted delicious perfectly made (medium-rare) burger I forgot about the wait... 
I recommend!
Even though I didn't go inside and walk around, it was beautiful to drive by. It reminded me of Central Park back in NYC.

I love this restaurant. Everything I have ever eaten here has been sooo good. I purchased Sunny's cookbook and some of her recipes have become all-time favorites of mine. Best vegan restaurant I've ever been to. If you're on Campbell and your looking for a great place to eat, try Lovin Spoonfull.

The service was absolutely incredible! Although, it was a bit noisy, it's a perfect spot for date night! The atmosphere was very lovely and the food was wonderful. I had the filet, mashed potatoes, and Broccolini! The filet was cooked to perfection and the Stateside Sushi Roll was very refreshing as an appetizer! i will definitely be dining here again!
Took forever to get our food but Kevin was really nice. Too many people and not enough employees.

These hoagies are HUGE!!
The best in the area by far. They offer delivery which rocks but they do close early. Wish they were open a bit later for dinner. But luckily if you get one of these hoagies for lunch you can totally eat the other half for dinner.

I had an exceptional experience buying a pair of Alden shoes online from Jeffrey at Sherman Brothers. 

I have difficult to fit feet: they're narrow and low-volume, and I also wear orthotics. Thus, sizing is always a bit of a gamble. I called and talked to Jeffrey on the phone, and he answered my every question. I ordered a pair of boots in 10.5C. When they arrived, they unfortunately didn't fit. I called Jeffrey, and he arranged for exchange and talked me through the various fit options. I placed a new order for the same boots in 11C.

I received the exchange in short order, and Jeffrey waived the shipping charge. The new boots fit great.

If you're in the online market for quality shoes, I highly recommend Sherman Brothers: the prices are competitive and the service is stellar. It's like having online access to a brick and mortar shop - because that's what it is!

I travel a lot for work and can honestly say, I think I've eaten at every WF's in CA...literally!  I arrived in Reno yesterday and didn't even assume they'd be a WF's here.  As usual it was lunch time and I typed whole foods into my navigator and there was one 10 mins away, 11 mins later I arrived to one of the nicest WF's I've ever been to!
So many delicious options from the salad bar, lots of soups and fresh dishes.  I wasn't even expecting to have WF's for lunch yesterday and it was by far one of the best little brown boxes I've had.
The only negative is that I don't eat meat, every WF's always has a beyond meat dish in their fresh section and they have 3 options; curry, blacked or buffalo and this location had neither and this was a first for me to come across.  They had the regular plain pack but I just needed a small lunch portion, the guy said they hadn't had it in awhile as the prices had gone up.  I gotta say, I don't care what the price is, this is my favorite fake meat and I'll lay whatever for it.  Man have you had the behind meat curried chicken, even carnivores love it :).
Overall, plenty of seating, nice staff and lots of delicious options for lunch!

Yum! Delicious! This is the type of place where you order at the counter then go find a seat. It definitely has that hipster vibe.

I ordered the special which was Pastrami and the Mac and Cheese. The pastrami was AMAZING! I've never had pastrami served in thick slices of about 1/4" or slight thicker. It was tasty and tender, not chewy at all! I loved everything about the sandwich--the charred jalapeno, cabbage, creole mustard, and the bread!! As for the Mac and cheese, I thought it was good but it's not to die for. It had the right about of crispy crumbs on top and enough cheesiness.

I had the carnitas and steak tacos and they were pretty good. I also had a third taco that was some kind of spicy barbq-like sauce.. That was by far my favorite of the three although I cannot remember what it was called! This place is a hidden gem for sure. The prices are beyond reasonable. I would definitely go back!

Waypoint did an inspection on a home I am purchasing in Pasco county. The inspector was very thorough and answered questions along the way. The report was provided within 24 hours. Any questions I had after the inspection were answered by Sheryl, who was super helpful. She even provided contact info for a handyman to help address some of the minor repairs from the inspection. I would definitely use them again if I were buying another house.

Loved this bar! Bit on the pricier side, but it makes sense given the quality of the cocktails. I recommend the French 007 (I loved them so much that I had two). Be prepared to either get to the bar early to grab a seat. Or (politely) ask someone already seated if you can snag their seats when you are done. Best for couples/small groups!

This is a little heartbreaking considering I really liked my stylist (as in, we were connecting and having great conversations). However, I showed him where I'd like my haircut to be at (1" trim). As he proceeded, I noticed that he was texturizing a lot of my hair. I get that he wanted to get the weight and bulk off my hair, but I wasn't sure of how much he was actually taking off. It wasn't until the very end when I noticed how much shorter my hair became. Not only that, it completely changed the shape of my hair. Basically, it was giving me an emo vibe. There were lots of layers and long pieces in the front, and short in the back, but with under layers peaking out. I didn't know what to say or how to tell him. It was already too late to stop it. His assistant came over to curl my hair, but I had to stop her midway and tell her that I wanted to straighten it instead. I'm not sure where and how it went wrong. I wish he would've consulted me before continuing to chop off all that hair. Needless to say, I'm very sad with my hair. I took a shower and tried blowdrying it, then got a flat iron to straighten it. The long pieces towards the front are cringe-worthy. I just want to cut it myself, but I'm afraid of ruining it. My hair has such an odd shape, I can't even describe it. I'm praying it'll grow fast because I have a wedding to attend in 2 weeks and I cannot go with my hair looking like this. I look dated. Also, the receptionist was trying to overcompensate by telling me she was obsessed with my hair. Whether she was lying or being generous, it doesn't matter what other people think. The customer is the one who has to be satisfied with it because it's their hair and they paid for it. So yeah, I paid $75 plus tip for this haircut that I don't like. Bummer. Lesson learned.

Since I was in town for work, I always try to frequent mom and pops, so I googled the nearest one and this restaurant came up. Upon entering the restaurant, I noticed it took longer than usual to seat me, and it took longer as well for them to take my drink order and food order (I am an African-American male by the way). Jenny, my server, was pleasant and nice, the food was high quality and very tasty, but I suspect a bit of unconscious bias when I was identified. I was the only Black person in the restaurant and this is always something I'm observant of when patronizing any establishment. Several other patrons that were Caucasian were seated right away upon entrance, so I knew I was being stalled. I would highly recommend that sensitivity training be implemented and that your greeters are much more attentive to every visitor regardless of color.

Great for viewing games with friends. If you're going to do just that, make sure you arrive at least 30 minutes in advance so you get a good spot. Overall the food is decent, the atmosphere is good, and the service is above average.

I couldn't be happier customer. I told these guys back in April I didn't want this oil spray application and I wanted to wait until it got warmer out when I would see bugs and boy did I. They warned me explosions galore would happen soon enough and it did...so bad.  The joy of my life, my mountain dog "Yago", had 2 ticks on him a couple weeks ago (as far as I could see) and it worried me to the point of panic. I started to spray my property myself with some potent store stuff and I got some of it done but I couldn't finish it all.  So I called them and found out when they'd be in my area again to come out and help me. They did a full 100% exterior cleanse of my property and with environmentally safe stuff too. The guy was so cool too, very friendly and professional. I even got a FREE mosquito treatment fogger!  Loved it. Now I play with my buddy stress free out in the yard everyday with his frisbee and Kenny south park toy he loves to gnaw on. so far its been a few weeks and I am very satisfied. and next March I'm getting started with the early bug treatment. Now I am ready for some 4th of July grillin!  www.aspenn.com

I sure wish I had read about this company before! I do not recommend this company at all. The salesperson is horrible a- uses scare tactics lies about the services covered then cheats you on service. Then when you try to cancel with them it takes multiple times to get them to finally take your no as being no. And then they have the nerve to try to call me again! Horrible price, horrible service and horrible customer relations! Ugh.

I love Cuban bread, but do not often find vegan friendly Cuban sandwiches, so I was impressed by the offering of a tofu Cuban at Bodega. However, the sandwich was missing a little something. It seems to need a spicy sauce or a sweet one like mango to punch the flavor profile up a bit. My boyfriend loved his regular Cuban, but said that it was mostly because the bread was great. I liked their watermelon chili agua fresca, but once it got a little watered down there was not a lot of flavor left. They did make me a grilled corn without the dairy and it was fantastic. Overall, I would definitely give it another try, but I may bring some of my own hot sauce with me.

I have been coming to this location for a little over a year now and I have always had a great experience with any waxer I was booked with. Unfortunately today, that was not the case. I had Shannon wax me today and it was so painful (more so than usual), my skin from the Brazilian is still red and inflamed 7 hours later, and there are a lot of hairs left (long ones that should have easily been removed). Very disappointed.

Tasty best describes Tasty Greek Cafe. 
I like  mediterranean food  and this is pretty good.  Very good tabbouleh, sounded like he was making more in the back so must be fresh. Not skimpy on kalamata olives. Had the Shawarma. Gotta try humus before final judgement. Very friendly young couple. Will definitely be on my regular stop by list. In Kroger center facing Long Hollow Pike near Great Clips.

Hot dogs!  Late night hot dogs!  Late night hot dogs wrapped in bacon and covered with cheese, chili and relish for only $5!  Late night hot dogs wrapped in bacon and covered with mac and cheese!

Dapper Dog, I am so happy you're back, and that you live in my neighborhood.

If you are looking for an extraordinary wedding photographer, look no further! Willa captured all the beauty and wonder of our wedding day. She was everywhere and yet we never saw her or felt that she was too close, which was important to me. She made us feel so comfortable. Our venue was close to the beach and she whisked us away to get the most beautiful sunset photos before our guests even knew we were missing! We are so glad that she did this as those photos were some of the most beautiful of all!
Thank you, Willa!

The best tacos in Saint Louis! Yes, the place is run down and all but the staff is super nice, helpful and the food is amazing!! The flavor and tenderness if the meat is unbeatable. Feels as authentic as it could be in STL. 

We absolutely love it!

When I got my mac and cheese it was a bit soggy it wasn't that warm and had to ask for it to be reheated and I was told later that the four cheese chicken panini pasta came from a jar and I feel a little disappointed I did tell the server that but I said I know it's late cuz I did come in later but then when I paid for it through their little self pay thing when it said to leave a tip I put Skip and then she printed it out it came out like that on my receipt that it took a tip off for me and there was nothing I could do about it and I told her I left cash in the table so I took my cash back and I didn't have the best experience here and in the shot they charged me with $6 I thought that was kind of dumb but maybe I should have checked the prices a little bit better but when I server that but I said I know it's late cuz I did come in later but then when I paid for it  took a tip off for me and there was nothing I could do about it and I told her I left cash the table so I took my cash back and I didn't have the best experience here and in the shot they charges me waa $6 I thought that was kind of dumb but I should have checked the prices is a little bit better but just a little disappointed because I was hungry and I paid pretty much $30 for a meal that wasn't that good service wasn't that great and I was automatically taking a tip off from my amount  which I don't think was deserved. I was going to give $3 she was nice server.

I was looking for their number and saw all these negative reviews. I am truly in shock. I have been coming here for almost 2 years, after leaving a dentist from Hell! 

Dr Monestero is amazing. She is friendly, professional, and caring. The staff is always great too. Brittany is my hygienist and we chat. As if it hasn't been 6-8 months since we have seen each other last.
Everything about this place is tasteful. The inside is so nice. The food is excellent. The staff are courteous and professional. It's a phenomenal place. You have to try it out if in Reno.

Looked forward to our organization's Christmas Dinner at Bucca. Unfortunately it was a very disappointing evening. We had a party of 12 with reservations- we were seated on time which was appreciated. The room we had was cold, we had to wear our coats during the entire meal. We voiced our discomfort and we were told the heater was broke but they had no place to put us. It took over 2 hrs to receive and finish our meal. The pasta dishes must have been sitting under a warmer for a while and had become very dry. The chicken dish was served late after we had filled up on other foods- so we barely touched it. I can say the salads were excellent, but other than that- a much anticipated Christmas gathering at Bucca was a disappointing meal!

Wow. You may have to wait, but the wait is worth it. This was one of the best breakfast meals I have ever had. I had the Asada Tot eggs Benedict special and it was fabulous. Other people at the table had more traditional fare, but it was all amazing. The cinnamon roll pancake was special. You will not be disappointed, I think this is the beat breakfast in Tucson.

A cute cafe in the French Quarter conveniently close to many other sightseeing places in New Orleans. We had only a 15 minute wait but was seated faster than that. They have a very efficient staff and the tables are turned over rapidly. They also have an excellent brunch food selection. I got Catfish Benedict. It came with biscuit, poached egg, catfish, hollandaise sauce with a side of cheddar cheese grits. I also got a watermelon mango mimosa. (Should have gotten a mimosa on its own, it was too many fruits in one drink). I however loved the biscuits and eggs. The poached eggs were cooked to a perfect medium. The cheese grits were also very delicious, as I polished off the portion. The meal could have come with a bit more catfish however the rest of the meal was so good I could not complain. I was throughly satisfied with the meal itself for the price paid; it was not perfect high quality brunch food but good enough for the price. The only thing with the establishment was that it was too hot despite the open windows and fans.

Excellent location or a slick yet basic hotel. Rooms are sparse, with no extras, no chairs, coffee maker, fridge. Or even an ice machine anywhere on the city block. It's really pretty in the common areas, and has lots of modern cache but we want a little more from a city hotel.  The fitness room was above average.

Long detailed review of my experience, read on if truly interested... Came back today on a groupon my bff bought, I was here last week with her, and it was better last time, when we went for dinner, than today when we went for lunch. Last time I was determined not to go back but then today we realized if we didnt use the groupon it would be a waste of money. It was around 2:10 in the afternoon, when we went, there was another party in the other corner of the room, otherwise empty, our waitress was really nice, but the food not so much. Last time I went I ordered the vietnamese pork bun noodles, and that was amazing, but this time I am not sure why but the portion size was half that.. it was also swimming in sauce, the lemongrass pork that was in it, we both simultaneously could tell on the first bite that it was simply marinated in the sauce and tossed onto the bowl, unlike last time where it was marinated AND perfectly sauteed to a crispy perfection. Just so weird because I can tell from that instance they dont really care about quality control and portion size !!! We also ordered the Shanghai DanDan noodles.. I am shanghainese.. and back in Shanghai noodles are not that salty... not only that authentic chinese noodles are never ever that salty. Not sure if today was an exception, but the noodles were swimming in sauce... even after I sent it back to have them remove the salty noodles and toss in bland noodles to mix it up.. I still had to send it back.. We also got the lobster dumplings.. not so much lobster in there.. Also the dumpling wrappings tasted like plastic.. really seemed like they had nuked them with chef mike back there and then it was sitting on the counter for a while... and then sent over to us. They were really lukewarm. We had to send those dumplings back... We then ordered the 702 roll I believe... because we needed to fill the $37.00 minimum for the groupon.. We had asked the waitress what she recommended and she recommended that so we just said ok.. turns out this roll was $17.00 (more on later), it seemed to be drowning in sauce, just like both the noodle bowls we previously received from their kitchen.. and strangely enough I am not sure if the salty sensation left by the previous food.. ruined my palette because the sauce on the sushi roll tasted exactly the dan dan noodle sauce.. We wanted to send the sushi roll back but didnt want to be b***hs, but when I came back from the bathroom from trying to get rid of the stomach ache, and sodium headache I got from the food, I found out that the sushi roll was 17.00.... so funny the waitress would recommend the most expensive roll out there.. (we really should have asked.. but still 17.00 for a roll drenched in sauce??!!) We only had shared one piece before deciding it tasted awful. After i saw that bill i really did complain, funny enough the owner's wife or the manager... came over and talked to us and asked me about my previous yelp review... and why I was unhappy over my last experience... that was just the kicker because if the manager knew I was that unhappy customer from last time from reading my yelp review... wouldnt she try everything in her power to make my experience better from last time?? She avoided me the whole time.. until the end when I had complained... She ended up allowing us to walk without paying the remaining 12.00 (minus the 37.00) groupon value.. that was really nice.. just wished she would have tried to make my experience better from the last... instead this entire lunch was ruined.

I highly recommended not going to this store.  The customer service is absolutely awful.  I had an admittedly older gift card.  However there is a website on the card that they direct you to use to check the balance and it said that I had $58 dollars remaining.  I drove an hour to use the card and waited more than 30 minutes for them to troubleshoot the gift card before they nonchalantly told me sorry but there is nothing I can do for you.  They stated that my card expired and made no attempt to ease the pain in any way.  To make matters worse I called the store requesting to speak to the genera manger who never returned my card - now over a week ago.  Poor service and overpriced - give your business to someone else !

This restaurant is located in the French Market which I absolutely love. I had the shrimp tacos and crawfish etoufee. I wasn't a huge fan of the crawfish but the tacos were amazing. The food came out very quickly. The servant at the oyster bar was very friendly. He gave us great music selection and was very polite. He let me try my first raw oyster! It was great! I would definitely recommend going there.

Four years ago I took my now girlfriend on our first date to the Bahama Breeze. It was good then. Yesterday we went back for our anniversary. We both got the sirloin steak with lump crab meat on top. The "sirloin" (I have my doubts that it was a sirloin cut, which isn't even a great cut to start with) was stringy and tough. My gf's was really under cooked for her and stringy and tough. She didn't even eat hers. The service was also "meh". Our server could clearly see that we were both disappointed with our meals and never bothered to address that. She never asks us how anything was.
It was a really disappointing experience. We won't go back.

Customer service matters! I'd been stranded at the airport after the airlines canceled my flight (just as I was getting dropped off by the shuttle. Ugh!) Airline refused to put me up for the night; however, they offered a list of hotels that might accommodate a "distressed passenger".  It was a long list and just about everything was sold out due to a convention in town.  I sat down on the floor with that list and called for what seemed like days.  Finally I found this hotel that actually had a room! Jackpot!  AND they had a complimentary shuttle to and from the airport that would get me back in the early hours for my rescheduled flight. I talked to Ja'Quam on the phone a couple of times and he assured me it would be OK.    It was late already, and my choices were slim.  I booked the hotel rather than sleep in the airport....and made the next shuttle w/minutes to spare. When I got there, a little before 10 pm,  I cannot even begin to tell you how warm and welcoming the staff was.  I'd been stressed and frustrated, exhausted beyond belief, and pushed to the limit after dealing with an unhelpful airline.  Well, let me tell you....Ja'Quam and Matthew really made a difference in my day from the minute I arrived.  As soon as the shuttle driver got out of the van at the hotel, an irate customer came over and started yelling at her because he claims she didn't' stop for him.  Let me tell you, this guy was a jerk.  An employee, who turned out to be Matthew, came out of the hotel to make sure the driver was OK and to sort of diffuse the situation.  Ja'Quam got me checked in so fast so I could just get to my room and chill. Matthew insisted on taking my bags and walking me to my room and making sure everything was OK.  He asked if I needed anything and he offered a bottle of water. He said not to worry about anything and that he was working all night if I needed anything. Honestly, it was such a relief to be there (vs sleeping in the airport!)  and I felt completely safe and protected, as goofy as that sounds. Legit, I felt that I had hit the jackpot and these two dudes were my knights in shining armor.     The room was nice, but honestly, it almost didn't matter at that point. Customer service had won me over.
Cute hotel.  Main building has rooms and registration.  Rooms in other building next to it.  Rooms are nice,  clean.  Most of staff was wonderful.  Parking isn't great during day.
I originally gave this 4 stars, but I ate there again this week and think they truly deserve 5!  Their chicken burritos are the best around in the entire SB area.  I crave them...

So far this is the best Chinese restaurant I have eaten at in St. Louis.  I am fortunate that it is close to my house so that when I get the craving for good Chinese cuisine I can hit this place up.  I can't comment on the lunch buffet as I have never had the opportunity to eat lunch there, but the food is excellent.
Love this place so much and wait to dine in again!! Seafood is super fresh and price is reasonable especially the environment

Dirty Business!! 

I get it, the aesthetics are super instagram worthy... at first. But trust me that will fade so fast. I thought it would be helpful to share my experience in hopes to help others!
In short, his place cares NOTHING about you. It's all about money and getting people in the door. Once your in, you're no longer a person to them, you're just a money making pawn in their business.. And in the meantime your staying elsewhere because living there sucks and they are just raking in the 25% cut from your Airbnb and your insane monthly rent. 

 It was a daily struggle waking up to new airbnbers living above you for the weekend. I mean the the business model speaks for its self. Your trying to make a place your home while every weekend you are surrounded by airbnbers who care nothing about your home  and are there to party, understandably. This is coupled with management that could care less about tenants.

This place is physically disgusting. If you come for a tour, they will only show you the amenities that are not currently covered in dog feces, or vomit. On any given day you will step in dog poop in the hallways or stairwell (because they NEVER clean).There was feces in one of the stairwells for over a month, until it started decomposing on its own! There is a regular  occurrence  of dog and human vomit in the halls, actual humans passed out because they couldn't make it to their Airbnb,  and sometimes you will even have to step over human feces in the stairwell because that's where the homeless like to sleep. If you like swimming through gobs of hair and used bandaids, then you will LOVE the pool!  Cars are broken into on a regular basis. The bike racks are just filled with cut bike locks. And there isn't a security camera to be found. Good luck with the grills, they are disgusting and never work. Same with the fire pits. Don't take your dog to the small patch of AstroTurf that they call a park, it's a complete biohazard. Someone threw a massive baseball size spit ball on the wall in the hallway 3 months after I moved in. After 14 months the spit was still all down the wall. 

There have been 4 management teams in the past 14 months, and they all come in and saying they will turn it around. Don't fall for it! No management team can handle this business model. No matter what they say, TRUST ME it's all BS. Seriously don't believe a damn thing they tell you. Its crazy. Get absolutely EVERY tiny thing in writing. They will lie strait to your face. 

If you're anything like me or any normal person, you like to hang pictures in your home.  We had a meeting with management regarding move out instructions 2 months before we moved. She was very clear that all nail holes must be dime size or smaller. (Which, what nail is bigger than a dime anyways lol). We spent 2+ hours cleaning our unit.. sweeping, moping, cleaning blinds, cleaning all appliances, etc. We even filled some of our nail holes just because I happen to have that stuff already. 
After all of that, Niido deducted over $100 from our deposit for nail holes.  Advice for current tenants, save your time and forfeit the deposit. They will take your money for anything petty they can think of. 

This is a dirty business in way more ways than one. Just avoid the nightmare!!

John did excellent warranty work on my vehicle. I had 3 dents and they are all gone after John worked his magic. Other dent removal companies gave me the runaround for a month and said these would be too hard to remove. I'm happy the warranty company connected me with John. We spoke on a Tuesday and the job was completed less than 48 hours later. Very professional and highly recommended.

This place is great. After having a bad experience at a family-recommended auto repair shop in Ambler, I was worried about taking my car somewhere new. Well, it's been 3 years now and I'm still an extremely happy customer of John's. He's fair, honest, and reasonably priced. On one occasion, my fiance's check engine light came on, and he took it to John for a look. John told him there was nothing wrong--the dealership had set the light to come on after a certain number of miles. So John reset it and didn't charge us anything for the trouble of looking at it. What a great guy!
Used to be good. Waste of money now. Never guaranteed a good meal. Food usually overcooked and over priced.

Dined here last week and was very pleased.  The food was really good.  I ordered the pan seared chicken that was not dry or over cooked and very tasty.  Then my son spilled his water everywhere and a staff member named Luis was walking by and immediately stopped to help, he moved us promptly to a different table without making a scene.  He was very attentive to everything and made us feel very comfortable.  Even though I don't think he was assigned our table, he still came back to check on us many times which was nice because our server seemed too busy.  He refilled our drinks very quickly and even suggested chicken fingers since my son did not like his pasta. I felt like I got what I paid for and the service was great (except the hostess who seemed out of place, too young and inexperienced.)  Atmosphere was also appealing.

Went today with some friends from work and was underwhelmed. The service was horrible I get that if I go to a Vietnamese restaurant the waiters may not speak the best English, but ours spoke only 2 words of it near as I can tell Water and Number (more on that below). We had someone with a serious wheat allergy and we literally could not understand his responses to "Does this have flour in it?" Food came out sporadically over 10 min. When it did come it lacked flavor, I had the P2, yes that is how I had to order it, I tried to say the name and he kept asking me "What Number?" When you have to order by number that is not a Resturant..thats a McDonalds. So here's your Number 2 stars.

We were visiting the St. Louis area, and found the Sawmill BBQ on Yelp. 

We could smell the aroma of BBQ in the parking lot. The restaurant is clean & casual, with each table equipped with plenty of napkins and four types of sauces. The napkins come later!

We had the pulled pork, ribs and chicken. The ribs were to die for and the rest of the meats, sides and bread were delicious. Plenty of food for the price and went great with the atmosphere.

The place is owned / run by a husband & wife team. They were very attentive and very nice to talk to.

This BBQ gem is worth the stop --- we're going back!

Freshest meat out... Turkeys during the holidays are THE BEST! The employees are so friendly, and it makes it better that they know all the customers by name. I tried to eat chicken from acme after eating from here for so long, and IMMEDIATELY could taste a difference. YUCK! The home made ready meals are really good too, always fresh.

Had a dinner with a friend on a Saturday night. We made early reservations and arrived to a nearly deserted restaurant. Grabbed a drink at the bar (she: the skinny margarita, me: a classic mojito) and then moved over to our table.  

The menu offers 16 appetizers and 13 entrees. The vegetarian selections are quite limited.  Only one entree is vegetarian--the enchiladas.  As for veggie appetizers, you are limited to salsa, guacamole, or nachos.  

I enjoyed the guac and veggie enchiladas.  I found that my mojito was not quite mixed, as the first sip had a strong taste of rum and the bottom of the drink tasted of seltzer only.   It ended up being $80 for 1 app, 2 entrees, and 2 desserts. I'm no cheap-skate, but I was surprised at the cost.  

The service was attentive, but not pushy. The decor is very modern with bright green colors. I like the decor.  I did find that the noise in the restaurant increased significantly as it became more crowded. From what I understand on Xilantro's FB page, they are addressing the acoustic issues.  

I would return again, but probably in a month or two.  They just opened, so I will wait until they work out the acoustic issues and maybe update the menu with more veggie options.

The owner stopped by our table (and others) at the end of the meal to check in.

I called to make a reservation for same day pick up but with a 2 hour notice. The guy said yes and he'd meet me at 1:30. As a visitor I didn't know there is two of the same restaurants in French quarter. The driver never asked me to confirm the address just that he would be there. Well sure enough I waited out side where he told me but we were at two different restaurants. He called me asking me where I was and it wasn't until I told him the cross streets we realized we were at two different areas. He Sartre yelling at me and just hung up, never showed, so I called Uber. They were there within 4 minutes 

Just saying if this is your business you might want to ask questions before assuming you know where your clients are.

Pretty much the best meal of my life.  It didn't hurt that we were VERY hungry, and happy to share (for the most part... some things were so good that you just wanted to close your eyes and shut out the world to enjoy them).  We had at least half the things on the menu, so I'll just mention the highlights:
- golden beet "ravioli" (undescribably lovely, perfectly layered flavors)
- Father Pat's grilled cheese (the description on the menu does it no justice, this is like the perfect Irish breakfast, like a hot cheesy cereal)
- pumpkins on parade (quinoa is a rockstar!)
- smoked duck & chestnut pasta (don't talk to me, I'm in my happy place)
- chocolate norwegian french toast (I could almost live on this)
- bacon sundae (bacon! ice cream! salt! caramel!)

I should add that this is not a fussy fancy place -- the Green Goddess is about great-tasting food.  So be prepared to deal with the tight seating arrangements, the chef's opinion on the sequence of courses, less than perfect temperature, etc.  There's no team of waiters bringing endless baskets of bread, adjusting every dish to your every whim.  If you want that, there are plenty of great NOLA places that you'll be happy with.  If you're into food, though -- really, really into food -- then go to the Green Goddess.

I could spend more time writing something, but it still wouldn't do justice to the food.  Go get some now.

I love this place. The only place i like better in the area is Oriental Pearl in Haddonfield, but I go there for different things. I always love the sushi here, and normally stick to my favorite dish - sesame shrimp - MMMMM. They make it so well (dine in is better because everything is very fresh, breaded shrimp still crisp in the delicious sauce). I find the service to be very good and the atmosphere is nice, as well. 
I was only disappointed once when I've been here and I ordered chicken and broccoli. The chicken seemed off to me.. This was years ago.
This is my go-to local joint for sushi and chinese. I came online tonight to view their menu ;-)

This place is beginning to grow on me.

The first couple of times I came here, I wasn't too sure. The bartenders and servers were actually intoxicated from drinking with customers. I'm all for enjoying work so it doesn't feel like "work", but when you begin forgetting things customers have asked for or why you went to the back of the house, then that's an issue.

With that said: the food is decent, the beer selection is not bad, and the drink pours are heavy. How this place has stayed open for so long is amazing.

I do enjoy their weeknight specials on apps, wings, and ribs.

All in all, the staff is friendly, and the drinks and food are decent. I just don't recommend going later in the evening after everyone's had a few rounds.

Really enjoyed my visit to the Tria Taproom. Like most, I'm a huge fan of Tria in general and make it to their Rittenhouse location about once every two weeks. I'm also a fan of cider, so when I heard the taproom would be a combination of Tria and rare ciders on tap I was in! 

Boyfriend and I went on Friday night of opening week and while it was busy (40 minute wait for 2) we were able to sneak to the seats in the back and cut that wait to 2 minutes! His beer was kicked just as he ordered it, so they gave him a sample of the last of it and comped his next beer -- really great service. 

The iPad based menu wasn't my favorite. Innovative, yes, but maybe a little disorganized and took a long time to look through. Working at a company that designs multitouch applications, it felt painful to navigate -- but kudos to them for trying something new -- though I'm under the impression if it's not broken why fix it.

The food was really tasty. I started with the 3 cheeses for $12, which were smaller in size than the traditional Tria and were served with something like a flatbread cracker? It was still tasty and I felt a good deal, but not as filling as I expected. I also got the black bean puree which was spicy and came with soft, grilled flatbread that was tasty. I was happy with these two, some people may prefer 3 items. My boyfriend got the cobb salad and it was amazing. Smoky, salty, bacon-y. They grill the romain and have a house made dressing. I'm not a cobb fan but would definitely order this one if I went back. 

Overall was really happy with the meal, the service, and the addition to my neighborhood. I'll probably still frequent Tria more often as I like the food options more, but I'll definitely be back to the taproom, especially if they get a happy hour!

Filistix is one of the only places to get a decent meal on campus. I really enjoy most of their dishes; I like all their regular menu items that I've tried, and most of their specials are good too. Then, put them in the culinary wasteland that is the U of A campus, and this is the only place I get lunch from on campus anymore.

Their prices aren't cheap ($12 for a "full" order, which is a lot of food, or $8 for a "half" order, which is a good lunch portion for me), but the value is still pretty good. You can also pick up a stamp card, and get your 6th meal for free. They're in the CAB cafeteria, which isn't open late, so no dinners here.

I have brought both of my kitties here for a few years, and I cannot be happier with a veterinary service. Dr. Cassie treated an abscess on my cat Archimedes's ear after a fight she had with our local cat gang. She was compassionate, careful, and quick to drain the ear, and gave me instructions on how to do it at home...which was a strangely satisfying task. While there, I updated my vaccinations for nominal charges (approximately $35 for two), and received an antibiotic for preventing further ear infections for another small charge. Dr. Cassie even re-checked the ear ($26) a few days later when this paranoid cat mom wanted to make sure it was healing properly after my in-home intervention.

In the past, I had brought the same cat in for the first time to treat an unknown stomach problem, which was quickly diagnosed as a toxic reaction to eating a succulent plant (get rid of your Desert Roses!). She was kept for two days in-house, and I ended up paying $500 or so to treat pancreatitis, an inflamed digestive tract, and monitoring progress from the infection. I was terrified to leave Archimedes there, but the staff took exceptional care of her, and she powered through, against the odds.

I hope I will not have to take either cat in for severe illnesses or injuries in the future, but if they get into trouble, I feel as though the staff at Kings Row will do everything in their power to give them another chance.

Yum! First time I tried it here and I got the chicken tikka masala which was delicious. The sauce was a little bit thin but they gave so much rice to mix with it so no problems there! The dosa was delicious and love love love the coconut chutney it came with. Good food good prices.

We came in on a Wednesday evening wanting to try this cheeky named restaurant. We were greeted and seated promptly. We ordered the chicken wings, beef pho and pork pho. 

Chicken Wings - great flavor, super crispy, super hot. It was delicious! I'd come back just for those

(Growing up eating pho, with a Vietnamese background, and two different palates, we both kinda know what a good bowl of pho tastes like..) 

Beef Pho - we both thought the pho broths were bland. The elements of a pho broth were not there. It was definitely meaty though, not a good noodle to protein ratio. I ate some of the food but couldn't slurp the soup like I usually like to. 

Pork Pho - again, the broth was not good. For the pork pho, it seems as if they took all types of pork and prepared it all the different ways they could and threw it in the bowl. The ham, grilled pork, and fried pork did not go well with pho. Keep it with the rice, not soup. For a man who loves meat, he even thought the amount of meat he received was a bit on the heavy side. 

The service was lackluster. The server seemed to have a slight attitude which we can overlook since it was slight. The food runner didn't speak at all when placing our food on the table. Besides coming for the food, we also go for the experience. 

We will not be coming back..

Sabrina was "right on the money" with her reading. Without any knowledge of me other than my first name and birthdate, she was able to tell me so many accurate facts about my childhood, present life, and even specific people such as family members. She has over 20 years experience and I can see that in her reading. I will definitely go to see her again!  Unfortunately, I will have to have money to do that.

Mmmm... I got Bruno's delivered tonight and given that it's Monday I got some red beans and rice with a shrimp po-boy. The beans were sooooo yummy, super smoky yet perfectly cooked. Vegetarians beware because there was at least one meat chunk. The po-boy was AMAZING- insanely crispy shrimp with delicious toasted bread. The only downside was that it was a little dry because I don't think there was any mayo. But overall an amazing meal- very expensive for the portion sizes but amazing quality if you're looking to treat yourself!

This place is amazing! The staff was polite and understanding, especially knowing that I looked confused as to what pedicure to get (no polish). I went for the deluxe and oh man my tired ole dawgs thank me. Not only do they feel like a baby's bottom, they look amazing. That's says a lot for me, cause I hardly ever wear sandals, because them dawgs aren't cute. Hot stone massage, paraffin wax, leg massage all new to me but they'll see me again!

I was very excited to try True Food Kitchen with a few friends of mine, but unfortunately it was very disappointing. 

First, I came in and was seated in a nice cushioned booth with a view of the bar. 

Soon after that, the waitress came over and started to explain the menu. However, the information she provided was not very worth while, she even stated that the "starters" were the "appetizers". I understand how she was trying to be nice, but it was unnecessary. Also, there was a trainee, which I was fine with, but she was never formally introduced. I was also infuriated how the waitress continued to refer to the table as "we". I'm sorry, but she was not part of the group. 

We went ahead with our drink orders and I got the apple soda. While it was fairly good, it was not carbonated enough and was fairly warm. Most of the drink items were creative, but I wish some of the drink items were more traditional like types of lemonade, etc. 

Eventually, it was time for the appetizers. Everything was served family style, which I was fine with, but the portions could have fed one person not an entire group of people. Also, we ordered charred cauliflower yet it wasn't served or brought over. I had a bit of the edamame dumplings and I found them to be good, but not filling. Finally, I tried some of the hummus and pita bread, but the hummus was very subpar.

After that I had the grass-fed burger. When it was dropped off it was referred to the best in the "region", but I don't even think it was the best in the parking-lot region. The Shake Shack, which was a two minute walk away served a better burger. The burger here was nicely sized, but the meat was not too juicy or flavorful and the bun was very average. While the burger was fairly big it only came with one tiny side of baked sweet potato fries. 

Finally, after the small, disappointing appetizer and entree, I decided to get the flourless chocolate cake hoping to have a positive from my meal. Unfortunately, it was not. The cake was small and pretty bland. I kind of liked the vegan ice cream, but it was not enough to make up for the mediocre cake.

Listen, I understand the small portions and vegan style food. I go to many farm to fork restaurants and frequently shop at Whole Foods, yet True Food Kitchen was pretty below average. 

Even though I ate an appetizer, entree and dessert, I ended up leaving hungry. Very disappointing. 

Also, they charged us for the charred cauliflower yet they couldn't even remember to bring it out. 

Altogether, the food at True Food Kitchen is mediocre and the portions are so small that I ended up leaving hungry. Very disappointing.

Surprised I haven't heard more about this place, i was craving a burger and I couldn't have found a better place! The Cajun burger was very good, and the cowboy burger was amazing! The cowboy ketchup was so good we had to get some to go. Chili cheese fries are also incredible! We will definitely be back!

I usually don't love burgers that much but this burger was amazing!!! I highly recommend the truffle fries but I suggest you ask for a little more truffle. This place is definitely a lot better than its competitors nearby. 5/5 recommended
Probably the best Italian restaurant in Indy!  There is sometimes a bit of a wait, and parking is not always ideal, but very worth it.

The service was great and the staff was very accommodating. However, the food was very sub par. The fried chicken lacked seasoning and the "spicy" wings wouldn't reach the Scoville scale. I would recommend the curry.

"The English don't have cuisine, only food". So wrote Agatha Christie.
But Dandelion proves Dame Agatha wrong.
Not surprisingly the roast beef was excellent and presented just as ordered, rare for wifey, end cut for me.
But what was surprising was the delicious dishes not Anglocentric. Be sure to try the liver parfait and arugula salad.
The beer  selection was as good as it needs to be for a good gastropub.  Try the chocolate beer but add rye and a raw egg at your own risk.
While noise levels were high on every level, up the steep stairs seemed quietest (however use caution going down after hoisting a pint or two).
All in all a good time should be had by all.
Cheers.

I finally got the chance to try this place today and it did not disappoint. I had the Oyster Poboy and the Fried Green Tomato stack. Both were very good. The atmosphere is clean and friendly. To my surprise, they have a full bar. I can't wait until it gets warmer so I can enjoy the nice patio.
Best food truck, hands down! Never had anything bad off this truck. Everybody on the truck is extremely friendly. Rogerio(sp?) Is awesome! Can't wait until food truck Friday's return Downtown.
I was charged over the amount i had signed for on the check. Guess someone wanted to tip themselves out extra, not cool at all.

We went this weekend with friends - what a great little find and Katie our server was simply fantastic.  We asked Katie what the popular dishes were and she walked us through the menu hitting on numerous options.  

We started with the Queens combo appetizer with three sauces - a deep fried delight!  Everything was hot and fresh and the garlic Parmesan dressing they make there is fantastic- OMG - you could drink this.  

Three of us got pizza and one pasta - pizza crust was crispy and lots of topping (I personally recommend the Queen's Special) and great sauce.  The size of the pasta order could probably feed 3 people.  Again it was hot, fresh and tasty.  Just an excellent find - we will definitely be back.

Katie made the night, she checked on us frequently, made great recommendations and put up with me asking questions.  Kudos to Katie for her excellent service.  The restaurant is roomy, airy and just has a nice family vibe - everyone very friendly!

Delicious flavorful soul food. Quick fast service, didn't have to wait long at all. Definitely recommend!

I see Dr Clare at the Esplanade ave branch ( who we love so very very much) and was sent here to the main branch for a X-ray. Dr Clare had called them so they were expecting me and everyone I met was super sweet. I was greeted immediately when I walked in and she even knew it was Gracie coming in for her X-ray. Every employee that even walked by told me hello or addressed Gracie in some way.
We were seen by Dr Nick and I absolutely loved him. He Spent time going over the X-ray with me and even took the time to call Dr Clare before prescribing something for Gracie. He really seemed interested in finding out and helping Gracie with her limp.
The Clinic itself is beautiful and also spotless.
Ok.. I do like the pizza! Sucks they stopped the $5 2 topping small deal, i lived on that deal for a long time. Now additional dollar is too much to pay for small but its good pizza!

This has to be one of my favorite places to go from any city. You get to select from an incredible selection of wine, create you own cheese plate and get to watch amazing musicians. You have to be on your toes to find a spot when it is late, but I've shared tables with other groups and had a blast.

I have been waiting to come here for a while. Finally I was able to come here with a friend for an impromptu celebration of CNY. I heard and read mixed reviews so I did not know what to expect. It was past their busy lunch hour so we were able to choose the table we wanted. Initially they were going to seat us at a two seater table, but asked if we can sit at a booth, and they were okay with that. We probably ordered a little too much of various dim sum (we were so hungry) so it pretty much covered the whole table. I was pleasantly surprised how good the food was. My favourite all the dim sum is turnip cake, and not many places can cook good turnip cake. I really liked Jane G's turnip cake! Everything we ordered were delicious! The service was prompt, accommodating, and friendly. The only complaint is a bit of sticky table, but not a deal breaker at all. We had enough leftover we doggie bagged the food. I would definitely go back again!

Great pizza! Admittedly I only order plain pizzas (I'm a picky eater!) but they are always fantastic. The prices aren't bad either, and pick up is almost invariably 15 minutes, even on weekends. They also have a decent selection of beers you can take with you or drink in the restaurant. Definitely recommended.

I think that their Clam Chowder is the best I have EVER had! The soup n salad plate is a last meal type of plate, soooo good, their salad dressing is a garlicky, tasty mixture. Add a big cold brew or an excellent Bloody Mary out on the deck and your talking quintessential SB restaurant....LOVE THIS PLACE!!!!!! By the way its family owned, family run and it shows. I hadn't been there in many years and they still remembered me...THANKS TEAM BROPHY!!!

My happy place ! Clean lines, Candles, Soaps, Hand picked pieces of Canadian designers I love! A cool place to pick up Bestie or Just because gifts for your squad, family. You can shop online but I suggest checking out Miss Boss sexy new boutique on 124th street in Edmonton ! 

Grand opening April 28, 2018 !!!!

     I frequent this location because it's near my job and home. It's gotten to the point where I'm willing to drive further to go to another Chipotle just because this one sucks. Examples of how they need new management...one, seems like they pick and choose when they let you order inside or online only. Two, the whole purpose of ordering online is to have it waiting for you upon arrival, NEVER is. Today, I was one of the MANY people anxiously waiting on employees who not only took their time but carried on with their personal conversations while the store was almost filled of people waiting. A line formed for people to order inside while an employee was setting that side up at 12:30pm. Mind you store opens at 10:45AM! Someone saw the line form and yelled with an attitude "ONLINE ONLY" while he was preparing food in the back. 
      Before I came I ordered my food online at 12:00p and got there at my promised time 12:30p. I waited in there until 12:50 for food. Not only did they make it super late but they didn't call out orders made or put them in the spot people are supposed to pick up so it sat and sat. Finally I walked over to check the bags along with about 10 other people hovering over bags trying to leave. I honestly don't know how this store is ran under these conditions with it seems like no concern for customer service. 
     Overall, I'm done with this location and toxic relationship we seem to have. I'm not the only person who experienced this kind of behavior let alone pay for this service. Hopefully this review reaches who it needs to so these issues can be addressed.

I went to the Den twice in three days. First a group of seven and then just a two top. 
My big group was a Saturday night with no reservation. Surprisingly we were only waiting at the bar for 15mins before seating. Service overall was great. 
If you like beer like I do..(I like it alot) then you should be pleased with the Devil's selection. It's vast. The cocktail and beer menu has a short but informative description. Everything from ales to lagers.

I've been going to Ott's for years and just love it.  I was there this week and the main greenhouse is FULL of beautiful poinsettias and Christmas flowers.  The staff is extremely knowledgeable and always helpful and friendly.  It's just a wonderful, peaceful place to wander around inside and my grandson loves exploring the inside waterfall.  You won't be disappointed!

There are several Jimmy John's in my area that I could go to but this one is my hands down favorite!
