The people working are super friendly especially Joshua, Kenton, and Ashley, the restuarant is extremely clean even after lunches, and my food has been fresh and perfect made with quality ingredients and craftsmanship. They are true sandwhich artisans!!

I can't rave enough about this salon!! Chrissy has been keeping me beautiful for almost a year and I would highly recommend her or any of the Truvy staff to anyone looking for a great color (especially), cut, or style. The products are amazing, it's always a fun environment and you'll walk out feeling like a million bucks :)

I found my wedding dress in 30 minutes. Or rather, my mom found it, and she'll never let me forget it. It was only $159 and is absolutely stunning!

When I arrived, I was greeted very warmly and told Lisa, my consultant, would be with me shortly. I took the time to peruse the dresses on offer, of which there were many in various styles and price ranges. There was even a small clearance rack by the door.

A lot of the dresses were on sale, which was excellent, since I'm on a tight budget. I explained to Lisa that I was looking for something very simple with maybe a point or two of interest so it wouldn't come across as too plain.

She grabbed the dresses I asked to try on and indicated where I could find some more that were on sale. In a matter of moments, I had four dresses as well as a corset she suggested I try. 

The fitting room was an adequate size and no frills. Lisa clipped me into my dress quickly and made me feel like I was being listened to and treated with her full attention.

When I tried on the second dress, I already knew it was the one. The tag was $179 and rang up $159 at the register. SCORE! It even matches the shoes I bought completely separately. I couldn't be happier with the fit, quality, color, and style. It doesn't even need any alterations!

My mom bullied me into getting a veil, but I drew the line at one that covers my face. It's just an antiquated concept to me. I have to admit the one I got completes the look nicely. It just drapes down the back, attached to my hair with a comb. That sucker was $100 though. I guess I can't complain, since my dress was less than $200!

I was absolutely dreading the entire wedding dress shopping experience, but booking an appointment at DB was easy and obviously fruitful! Go in with a budget and a firm idea of what you want, and you too could have the dress of your dreams in 30 minutes. :)

For my 200th review I figured I'd kick it up a notch with the sentimentalism.  I took a trip to New Orleans and decided on taking a tour of the city.  That city tour also incorporated a "Hurricane Katrina" tour and it was amazing.  One of those experiences where you're really watching a part of history and something that has a long lasting effect for anyone with a conscience.

The tour is set to go for about 3 hours and costs $48 a person (discounted tickets can be found online).  The tour bus was stationed at the Gray Line Lighthouse ticket house (French Quarter section of the city), which thankfully was only a few minutes away from our hotel in the Warehouse district.  Once there we were greeted by our very friendly tour guide/bus driver.  The bus itself was clean, air conditioned and very very comfortable.  

Things starts off with an overview of the history of  the "original" New Orleans, the French Quarter and why it was built at its particular location along the Mississippi River.  French quarter is clearly more than just an awesome spot for Mardi Gras and Girls Gone Wild videos (although I have to say, those are pretty good too).  Needless to say, it's a very eclectic area with a lot of great shopping venues, particularly for souvenirs.

The experience goes on past the coastal wetlands where the the guide discusses its history, its gradual disappearance and efforts to raise awareness and preserve what is left of it.  

The tour hits its stride when focusing on everything related to Hurricane Katrina.  The tour guide gave a first hand chronology of events leading up to the hurricane and the days immediately following the disaster.  We passed by the levees and were given a quick explanation on how they failed during the hurricane as well as the improvements made since then.

The bus drove through various sections and neighborhoods of the city.  The devastating effect of the hurricane along with the incremental pace of the rebuilding efforts were very evident.  There were the neighborhood blocks that had unkempt grassy gaps in them because whole houses were demolished (due to unrepaired damage from the Hurricane and abandonment by the owners).  We passed many makeshift memorials for those who lost their lives during the hurricane.  

There were many homes that still had tarps on the roofs and windows boarded up due to unfinished repairs from hurricane damage.  Every building in the city was searched for victims during the month after Katrina struck.  Symbols were painted on homes/buildings by search & rescue teams.   The symbols included references to the date, the search unit's identifier, hazards (such as a gas leak), and number of people found.  Very chilling stuff.  

The tour guide was really an asset when it came to discussing the effects of the hurricane on the city.  He knew a lot about how the various sections and even specific neighborhoods suffered, the fate of people in specific houses we passed and  the status of a lot of houses that were palatial mansions pre-Katrina but now were rundown and abandoned.  Towards the end of the tour we passed by homes that were built or being built differently post Katrina (higher off the ground to reduce future flood damage).  Some of those homes were part of a program established by Brad Pitt as part of the rebuilding efforts in the city, particularly the areas with limited resources (9th ward).

All in all, there's no joke or punchline to illustrate how amazing this tour was and how everyone could benefit from a first hand look at a part of American history.  It's been like 6.5 years since the hurricane but the reminders are still pretty evident.  

Speaking of jokes, I'll end with a quick story and let y'all respond with your thoughts.  The tour bus makes a snack and bathroom stop at this rest area that has something like a food court.  My travel companion and I decide to get ice cream/milkshakes because the city was still somewhat warm during the mid-fall season.  It's my turn to order and the young cashier appears to be kinda tired and a little aloof.  I end up placing like three different orders because I was told THREE SEPARATE TIMES by the cashier that a crucial ingredient (vanilla ice cream, bananas, chocolate, etc.) in each order was not available.  Flabbergasted, I made a lighthearted reference to the dessert shop's lack of basic ingredients by jokingly remarking "I KNOW KATRINA CAME THROUGH HERE BUT DAMN!".  

I finally ended up successfully placing/receiving my order and sat down.  My travel companion proceeded to come at me like I worked for FEMA.  She acted like I was that little bad ass kid everyone sees at the mall throwing a temper tantrum.  That kid who usually has that leash/body harness on and is cursing up a storm because they can't have everything in the store.  C'mon, was the joke really that bad?
Great place to hangout, watch games. My Monday softball is sponsored by them and our server is Courtney and she is very sweet and energetic.

Dinner for party of four adults and two fur babies. 
We ordered crab cakes, calamari and a dozen oysters for appetizers.  Calamari was spot on and the oysters melted in my mouth. The crab cakes were average at best. I was hoping for more. But 2/3 is acceptable.
For entrees we had steak and lobster. Perfect medium rare. Lobster was nice and buttery.
 Macadamia nut crusted fish. Nice crust and tender inside. Rice was delicious.
Seafood pasta was perfectly al dente. It had a creamy sauce and a healthy portion of scallops and shrimp. 
The Salmon and mashed potatoes dinner had mixed feelings.  The salmon was absolutely perfect,  but the mashed potatoes were awfully seasoned. 
Overall, it was a great experience. Good service, great view and good food. Kinda bummed about the crab cakes, but will definitely be back again.
.
Food was delicious! My wife and i enjoyed it very much despite having to lug two kids around. My kids enjoyed the food as well! Well worth the trip!
It's a cool place in Tampa, offers variety of yoga classes. They have shower and changing room. Classes between 4-6 can get very crowded, wish they would offer 2 classes to divide it up

This company stole our $650 deposit.  New we were moving needed work done for settlement.  I will be telling everyone including BBB, locks newspapers and local news agencies.  My goal now is to put the people out of business forever.  Should have kicked them out of our home when I smelled alcohol as they were leaving.

Very disappointed! The spring on our garage door broke Sunday morning. I called to schedule a repair and was given a Noon to 4pm window for a Monday appointment. Approximately 2:15pm we received a call changing the appointment until 4pm to 6pm. 
The installer did call about 20 minutes before arriving as promised. 
We had a coupon for the Spring Repair. The installer told us those springs would fail in less than a year and only had a 90 day warranty. They tried to sell us springs that were more than double the cost. This type of sales tactic is repulsive! Why would the company offer an product they feel isn't quality? Anyway, we went ahead with the repair as our garage door wouldn't open without it. As the installer began work he set parts aside on a nearby shelf. At one point my husband had to ask him why he hadn't used what appeared to be a necessary part in making the repair. He said oh, I forgot!?! Once the repair was complete our door opened and "shut". However, we were left with a sizable gap at the bottom when the door is shut that wasn't there before.
The best aspect of this entire service process was the professionalism of the office/administrative staff.
We would not recommend Precision Door in Largo Florida

Food is delicious but there was only  2 waiters that do the best they caand  the place was full . Took too long to get the food and so many people left because of That did not give 5 stars . 
But Food is delicious

What's not to love about Waffle House?! Food was great, came quick, & very affordable, delicious waffles, good coffee, & BEST crispy hashbrowns I have ever had! Tasty sausage & bacon, & eggs cooked well. We no longer have any Waffle House locations where we live, so we try to find on any time we go somewhere else when we're looking for a place for a good breakfast. Our oldest son even said he wanted to come back again for breakfast the next day!
However, what made the whole experience shine in my eyes was the service we had from our waitress. I did not catch her name, but she was the sweetest woman! We had a very cranky 2 year old with us & she did everything she could to put him in a better mood. Our son had been sick a few days prior & was still very upset & cranky when we went so her efforts didn't go far in cheering him up any but all the effort she put in was definitely noticed & very much appreciated, as I could understand anyone being irritated & annoyed by a crying toddler in a party they're serving. You could tell she did not let this bother her or the service she provided to us. Gave our 3 kids Waffle House paper "hats" & the youngest some crackers to try to calm him down.

My absolute favorite brewery restaurant in the area. I have been here several times, and have never had a bad beer. They have all been delicious and each one has been a unique and flavorful creation.

For food, I have tried the white pizza (delicious) and the fish & chips. The Fish & Chips were fantastic and that's always a good pairing with beer.

I had to change my review after my most recent experience which definitely made up for the last time. 

The service this time was great, our server was attentive and very helpful. She even gave us a sample of the gumbo which tasted awesome. The previous time I was there, we had the worst service possible and we were the only ones in the place. This time was a million times better-really great.

The people in my party got the Cuban sandwich, Chicken Souvlaki, chili, chili cheese fries and I got the matzo ball soup.

Chicken souvlaki was freaking awesome-so good. I was really jealous that I did not order it. I almost stole it from my boyfriend.

The Cuban looked great and our friend seemed to really enjoy it.

The chili was a little on the thick side but tasted ok.

The matzo ball soup was not great. It was basically just chicken broth with a giant matzo ball in it. I thought the menu said it was supposed to come with chicken but when I asked the server, she said no. (I should have ordered something else)

The gumbo was amazing, incredibly spicy! I loved how spicy it was but a couple people in our party thought it was too spicy.

Overall, I had a great experience and will definitely return. Makes up for my last experience, makes me think the owners really care about what their customers think.

The swamp tour was done by a different company. Tours by Isabelle just did the pickup and drop off. We sat in the van for 45 minutes, driving around the French Quarter, picking up other tour participants. This was the longest pickup I have ever experienced. I took off one star for this. The driver was very good. The swamp tour was a lot of fun.

Their pizza, chicken cheese steak, ceaser salad and turkey hoagie are always on point. The only issue I have with them is that they do not deliver to my neighborhood.  Their Large pizza is the size of a medium pizza elsewhere. Thy are also much cheaper than other pizza shops in the area.

Want to feel at home?  Sit back and enjoy the staff and the patrons of Nolan's.  It's a great bar to just enjoy.  They only have beer and wine but they have great choices in both.  Clearly big supporters of Police and firefighters too.  Great experience.  Won't be the last.

If I could give them ZERO stars I would.  First, 2 years ago, they stiff me on an appointment when my heater was down.  They never showed up and I couldn't get a hold of anyone there so I had to call another company to come out.  Now they call me EVERY month trying to get me to set up an appointment with them for a "check up" and sign up for a maintenance plan.  The first time I politely explained to the person that called what happened previously and that I was not interested in doing business with their company.  I politely asked them to take me off of their call list.

Here we are two months later and I am still getting calls from them.  I am no longer nice to them on the phone.  I cut them off and tell them right away to remove me from the call list as I will NEVER do business with their company.  What is it going to take to get me off of the list and to have this company NEVER contact me again?

DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THEM.  I am one phone call away from reporting them to the BBB and the Attorney General's office.  STOP CALLING ME!!
One of the very few non fast food restaurants in Sun City Center. Awesome homemade German food in the middle of a strip mall. Love the jager schnitzel and beer flight.

Cute neighborhood taco place! Nothing fancy, you order inside and sit outside. There is a window for when the server calls you to come pickup your order. Clean easy friendly fast service. 

Tacos were HUGE and delicious!

Great hangover food as your leaving town! Way better than stopping at a Starbucks or dunkin. The sandwiches were so good and the coffee is super fun to make. Hash browns could've been crispier but I forgot to ask so definitely my fault. Overall great food and super fast as well. The outdoor seating is amazing and well spaced out so overall a great place to stop by.

Just got back from Andy's new place in Spring House. My review is based solely on breakfast so take it with a grain of salt. I found everyone there to be very friendly, the waitress was very attentive. The atmosphere is pretty nice, feels like a diner I would've been taken to as a kid, lots of pictures, knick knacks and tvs with sports center on.

The food was pretty good, I had the #9, corned beef hash, eggs, potatoes and toast. The corned beef hash was well done and perfect, the only thing bad was the over medium eggs were a bit runny, but not terrible. The wife had blueberry pancakes and bacon, she thought everything was very good.

Prices were a little higher than typical for most breakfast places, but very comparable, maybe even a bit cheaper than Rich's just down the street. But they do pile on the food here at Andys.

We will come back and give it a go again.

Can your group not decide whether to get Vietnamese, Chinese, or Thai food? Then this is the place to go! They have 3 sections on their menu, one panel for each type of food. Overall great quality and reasonable pricing. Get one of the Bobas, they are so good! My favorite is the mango boba.

This place is good, especially when the weather is just right to sit outside. We went for a late lunch so it wasn't busy at all. Waitress was sweet and came around a few times to check on us. Will return ;D

Our first visit we ordered Pizza their way; it was very tasty, but the crust was too thin for us. Our server said the next time we should ask for a little thicker crust, the Pie will be a little smaller around, but it may be more to our taste.
The next time we did request the crust to be a little thicker and it was prepaired just as we requested with out so much as a raised eye brow. Our Pizza was great and the left overs warmed up just fine as well.
This is my favorite coffee shop ever. Never got the wrong coffee and it's always perfect drinking temperature. The WiFi here is blazing speed and always free.

YUM! This place was at Auction house for a good bit until they decided to have their own storefront! Yay!

Located on Magazine near Napoleon, it is a small space serving up major flavors. Went with my friend who is not much of a meat eater, so it was a good option. We decided on drinks, Thai tea for me, Butterfly Pea Tea for her. Both were very different where Thai tea is creamy and the Butterfly Pea Tea is like a limeade. 

We had to try almost everything. We ordered the Mushroom La'ahb which is like lettuce wraps. Then had the Tom Yum Noodle Soup and the Mushroom Khao Soi which was my fave. The Khao Soi is a little bit sour and creamy whereas the Tom Yum is more like a broth. 

Had to end the night with a sweet so of course, the mango sticky rice had to be ordered! The owner May was the absolute sweetest!

Cutest little spot! Came her per reviews and so glad we did!!!! We started with the zucchini fritter and woah,  loved it!!!! So delicious and light! Could have just had three orders of that as my meal and they would have already had five stars! But then came the meals!!! I enjoyed the halibut entree, (I am super picky with fish) this was my favorite fish dish I have ever had!!! I mixed everything together and asked for a side of the lemon aioli and added that to it! Woah! Delicious! Highly recommend doing that. My husband had the O+O burger and fries and got their YUMMY malt vinegar aioli (I believe that's what it's called)  to dip the fries in. (DO IT)  He isn't as expressive as me with food so I asked him to rate it 1-10 and he couldn't think of a better burger he has ever had!!!! It didn't make him feel bad after either, not greasy... just right!!
this is a good coffee joint.  i took everyone's advice and got the cuban.  great choice!  it was delicious.  i also tried a quiche and chocolate chip cookie.  they were all good.

My car was involved in a hit-and-run in the parking lot. My dealership suggested Abra as they have worked closely with them previously. I was hesitant, as my research suggested there was a serious possibility of overpaying.

They were not able to get me in right away, but my car was still drive-able so it was not a big deal. The repairman was very kind and explained everything to me (as this was my first time having to do something like this.) He even got a rebate on my deductible. He walked me through and told me exactly what they would be doing. The results didn't lie. Fabulous work!

If you're ever in a small scrape, I suggest working with them. They keep you up-to-date and work as quickly as possible. My car was done two days earlier than quoted. Very satisfied.

My sister, mom & I came here to get out of the rain and had the best time! No appointment, they fit us right in for pedis, manis & waxing. I was worried because I had my 4 month old daughter with us, but the staff could not have been nicer. She was in a great mood and they made it better by talking with her. The atmosphere was great, beautiful interior, very relaxing, and safe/sterile practices. Can't wait to come back!
Delicious well made coffee! You can tell the people who work here love what they do and they do it in a simple clean well fashioned manner. An amazing addition to the St Petersburg area

The good: 
They have $15 limitless, delicious Mimosas. This place has a cool vibe and is filled with a young crowd that makes it a really fun place to be. 
Food wise:
-the shrimp & grits: beyond amazing!! This was delicious.
-Biscuits: delicious and authentic southern food (the Blackberry Jam is fantastic)

The bad:
The dead plants hanging over the patio were indicative of the apathetic personality of the staff who worked there. Our waiter was terrible. She brought our food late, forgot anytime we asked for anything, despite having asked us several times during our order to confirm, and brought us the wrong orders of pretty much everything. Plus the table was broken and rickety. Also, I kid you not, the giant TV was playing a show that zoomed in on a Sheep's anus for the majority of our meal...

Food wise:
-South basic burger: the bun was burnt but besides that the burger was really good.
-the side grits were dry and average and the fries were soggy and greasy.


If you go, food is good. service sucks. We probably won't be returning anytime soon.

5 stars isn't enough!!  I made an appointment with Jennifer based on a friend's recommendation and the fact that she was running a special through groupon for a 60 minute massage at a deep discount. When I walked into the tiny basement studio, I was warmly greeted and invited in. Jennifer too the time to listen to my concerns and to explain the process, she then asked if there were any specific body parts/issues that we wanted to work on. After discussing my concerns and creating a plan, she excused herself into the powder-room while I changed out of my clothes and got under the sheets on the comfortable table (she uses a massage table that is larger that normal, so it was very spacious and comfortable no matter what size body you have. The massage itself was heaven. I left feeling super-relaxed and tension free. I already scheduled my next session. A perfect little slice of paradise in South Philly.

Service... Poor service on a slow day. I waited 10 minutes for a smoothie. 

Taste.. . Actual smoothie is delicious. It was the one with mango and papaya. Yum! 

Overall... 3 stars

Funny how the location is closed citing it "out grew" it's location. I live in the area and pass by it frequently, most food places have some kind of line during lunch. Not once did I pass by big Q did they have a line. Often you'd see the workers messing about inside, killing time out of boredom. The food explained it, it felt like the owner was trying to create a BBQ fast food franchise chain, the idea was great but the food was sub par. The pulled pork never had enough BBQ sauce on it, and the fries were even worse. Even if there was ample indoor seating, no one would have went. Big Q is an embarrassment to real BBQ pit masters, like Smoken Dudes in Bensalem who have worked for years to create the perfect BBQ.

Great place! Very convenient because it's open 7 days a week with evening hours. They usually get you in for a non-emergency appt within a week and the doctors and staff are incredibly nice! Very clean place as well!

We had the fresh catch grouper and fried chicken...both AMAZINGLY flavorful. Allison (if that's her name) was a perfect server. I assumed she was an owner because of her love and care for the food and our experience. She is worth her weight in gold.  Great beer choices and cocktail options. Glad to have found this place. A must try.

If I could give this place 0 stars I would.

Its just gross. Food it dry and restaurant is filthy.

We have been out of state for 2 years, and thought we would give it another try.

Big mistake!! Still G R O S S.

DONT WAIST YOUR MONEY.

The health department should just go ahead and close it down.
Great food! Burgers were wonderful loved the atmosphere, I had the double burger Taylor ham and a fried egg. Well done

They work in an airport and manage to make an already hectic day worse. Slow service, rude little bartender, attitude ridden manager... They close up at 10pm. I ordered a beer at 20 of and the tiny bartender just looks at me. Managers walked out half a minute later, and she whispers that I ordered a beer. He looks around at the 5 other people sitting at the bar and say "Well.., this is it! Didn't you call last call?!" She says "Well yeah, but I didn't announce it." (What?) the he walks off and she tells me "I'm sorry, we already called last call" I was standing right there the whole time... Could you get a clue.. People are at the airport with delayed flights trying to get home or to wherever they're headed and you have the nerve to provide service like that..

Very small airport. Could not handle 3 flights running late at the same time with lack of seating space and overflowing garbage. 

And they are bad with making announcements.

But had great deals for flights even during thanksgiving.

When I first heard that Charlie and Heather from the Institute were going to be bringing the first legit coffeehouse to the Eraserhood, I was instantly stoked for the awesome food and good neighborhood business sense that I know them to deliver. And then when I heard that their concept was going to feature not only coffee but things like books, tattoo art (on view during First Friday openings, and available for you to get on your body), and baked goods from Le Bus; I was happy to hear that Vice was going to have more than one of my vices covered. And upon my first visit before Yelp Film Club I became instantly impressed with what they delivered.

One Village Coffee is an impressive roaster so I was happy to see it as their beans of choice. But instead I decided to opt for the amazing sounding dirty chai latte (with blackberry chai!) which was expertly crafted by their barista and yielded just the right amount of sweet to the caffeinated treat. And for a extra bit of decadence I went for a cheesecake brownie which was beyond delicious, But their are plenty of other coffee beverages, sandwiches, salads, and more on the menu.

While the charging station is definitely an awesome addition for people on the go, the only big flaw I had was there not being some additional outlets around the big tables, because it definitely would have definitely given me a bigger spot to plug in and catch up on some work with. But I didn't mind it too much since it gave me a better occasion to scope out their impressive book selection that yielded plenty of fiction, non-fiction, graphic novels, manga, sci-fi/fantasy, and then some. And the beautiful thing about it is that its part of a lending library where you can take out a book or 2 for a couple weeks free of charge.

This Friday marks their debut First Friday event which will showcase some good art and photography, introduce the in house tattoo artists, and feature a Southern Tier beer tasting to coincide with the brewery's Tap Takeover happening at the Institute. If that's just a sampling of their first event then I definitely look forward to more!

We have been to this location twice and have had wonderful meals both times. I love the Santa Barbara Char and my wife loves the Teriyaki Char. The tempura green beans are delicious. Burgers are always well prepared and tasty.

If you like the Pizza Huts you find in third world airports and just love reading graffiti in the bathroom then you've found a pizza place just for you. The  one good thing ..
Good location being next to the beach and warf. The light house themed building is fairly nice. The interior is a mix of museum quality light house items with outdated crappy video games. 
The bad..The pizza was just ok. A lot of dough with bland cheese made by employees who probably dont care. The veg pizza was the worst. The BBQ chicken had really sweet bbq sauce (chris and pitts?) and not to much chicken, maybe two nuggets per slice. The meat lovers should be called meat haters because after having it I hated it. The ham was fine but it had these little sausage nuggets that were over cooked and maybe stolen from the local 7-11 pizza that was on the hot plate all day. The worst was the visit to the the bathroom were I swear there was a years worth of graffiti on the walls, doors, and even etched in to the seat. Give me one good reason the owner cant keep the bathroom nicer? My wife said the womans bathroom had no paper towels and no changing table for our son either. This place kinda sucks!!!!
The owner of the business was going into the kitchen and serving customers their take-out food without wearing a mask. It seemed very unsafe. I won't be going there again.
Delicious coffee, some of the bestowed cups I've had! I always get a hot coffee with hazelnut, it for sure makes all the difference. They brew La Colombe and they do a fantastic job of it. A+
Service is hit or miss. Best bet is to sit at the bar. Wonderful martinis and who doesn't love bang bang shrimp?

I've been coming here for 4 years. I know it's slow service but today was the last straw. Ordered 2 salads and 40 minutes later when I asked where they were, they weren't even started. They're salads - you don't even have to cook them!  I asked for a refund and left. I am done with this place for good.

THIS PLACE IS TERRIBLE. It is like one of those places where a bunch of fat Americans go to pretend to eat Mexican food when its just canned crap on a plate covered in cheese.

Do not go here. The chips are stale, the salsa is gross (read: spicy tomato paste), the food is bad, the service is not great, the atmosphere is terrible, and the list goes on. The only saving grace is the fried ice cream, which fits right in with the perversion of decent mexican food at this place. Plus it still looks and feels like a pizza hut. 

If you want to have a casual dinner or lunch with your family or friends, go to Tortillas about a mile or two down York Road - its about x203948295824 better.

After one too many disappointing experiences with national "800" type florists, I vowed to do a better job at finding a local florist whenever I wanted to send flowers.  I found Mayfield on yelp, and tried them yesterday for Mother's Day flowers.  They were FANTASTIC.  From start to finish, everything was great. I called and placed the order over the phone because I had some specific requirements that the web site could not accommodate.  Even though it is probably one of their busiest times, I got through to a person within 30 seconds when I called, and the staff was friendly, helpful and efficient, and had great follow through.  The price was competitive, with nationwide florists, and the arrangements were beautiful. I received an email with the details of my order, and a confirmation email when the flowers were delivered. Best of all, Mom is so happy with the arrangements!

I've been ordering delivery from this place for the past year, so I finally went in to eat today. The food was great as usual. 

But the service was horrible. I only saw the waitress when I ordered and when it was time to get the check. I loved the food, but I don't think I'll be going back in to eat.

During these times, all types of individuals are struggling. Even though the cashier had a difficult day, she was extremely considerate and kind. She was personable and knowledgeable. Whoever was rude to her earlier obviously had their own things to work on because she was a delight.

Every time I come here, the food taste great but it never comes out hot. Just warm & the services here is ALWAYS slooooooooow!! The BWW located on the Westbank are slow as well & the Elmwood location. I just come here for the dessert nachos, which is the bomb

Jimmie's has quickly become a favorite for me and my husband for fried chicken wing cravings! We usually order ahead for carry out. Including the 10 minute drive back home, the food is still always piping hot and fresh. I appreciate their attention to detail when packaging the food, nothing gets greasy or damp. 
Love the greens, and Mac n' cheese too. Never too salty, always perfectly prepared, no over cooked greens or noodles here! 
I can't wait to bring my mom here when she visits from California next week :)

Don't forget to try the strawberry cake, it's a lovely ending to an excellent meal!

It's my go to place in the neighborhood for nails, waxing, massages and even lashes. It's a convenient location for me. I am one of the earlier customers of Polish Lounge and have seen them grow over the years. They have a lot more services now. Everyone is friendly for all the times I went. 

The quality in staff in term of nails improved a lot. There could be some more improvements with nail art. Similar to lashes, there is only one person who does them. She is good. It's just harder to make appointments when there is only one person doing it. 

Overall, it is lovely to have Polish Lounge in the neighborhood. I really appreciate them. I hope that the business will continue to grow and improve.

Every few months this happens. It starts as a whisper of a suggestion in the back of my mind, when hunger strikes. "Hey I'm hungry, where should we go?" I might ponder. And then from that part of my memory murmurs, "Reeemember that Royal Tavern burgeeerrrr... Reeeemember thaaat, kathleeeeen?"  That's as ghostly and mysterious as it sounds.

 I try to ignore its call... but eventually I will buckle like a pilgrim's shoe. The hankerin hits me hard, ya see.

Royal Tavern is a lovely bar with a good selection of beers and it can get craaazy crowded and you might hafta wait A WHILE and the bar is packed and you might feel like there's nowhere to stand without being in the way and awkward-feelings-levels are on the rise... but then...you finally get seated and you have a delicious burger for yourself, and all is well. That's my story. 

I really like that burger a lot. When I order it medium, it's medium. Thank you. Smoked gouda, bacon and long hots, I love all you foodstuffs too. All together it's a dope burger indeed. 

The mezze is a good starter to share. Pita and lovash chips are served up with hummus, smoked eggplant baba ghanoush (LOVE), feta, stuffed grape leaves, and cucumber-olive salad. Definitely good.

That truffle-buttery popcorn is great great too, as you're having yourself a beer. I'm down with sharing the hill of nachos with vegan beef as well. 

But I return for that burger. This is what I'm telling you. And I have to stop thinking about it already! I admit to you that the hushed notion is too soon begining to plague me. Quiet you! Quiet, don't make me resent my own good cooking tonight.

Update: And I return for the chicken frankie wrap, annnnd the vegan tempeh club, annnnd bloody marys....and bites of what other people have ordered...

On time appointment for my baby and good care for kids , this office is clean and friendly.  The manager who is nice and accommodation on client . I try some of dental office in Tucson like as dental village but I love this one more than some i went before. 
R
Damn delicious. Went here after the colts game before our long drive back home. Got 4 different types of sliders, loved the beef/classic with and spicy cilantro/creamy garlic!
Great deli and neighborhood shop.  People come from all over for the delicious steaks and meat shoppe.

The night before closing on our new home, I was informed that the keys were property of HUD and couldn't be turned over to me. I needed to have a locksmith meet me at the home the next day. Due to good reviews on Yelp, I called Pop-A-Lock .  The woman who answered at 9pm was pleasant and helpful.  The next day, locksmith Sean met me at the house and worked for about 2 hours trying to re-key the locks.  It turns out that HUD uses special locks that can't be rekeyed.  I bought new locks the next day and he replaced them all for me.  He was meticulous about the installation, drilling the holes so all the deadbolts perfectly lined up.  Even more surprising than the great service was the price!  Two days coming out to the location and all the hours spent translated into much less than I expected.  Try getting a locksmith to come out in NY, and you will pay $100 for them just to show up!  I've been passing out their orange key rings and recommending them to everyone I know.  My review here is to spread the word that these guys are the best!

Overall this hotel was pretty nice. Although I thought the room was a little small and stayed cold the whole time despite the heater being on. The beds were actually really comfortable  and with enough covers I slept like a baby . Outside noise really wasn't bad . The front desk staff  was friendly and helpful. The housekeeping staff for the most part was really good. I really like the fact that this particular hotel is connected to the Convention Center by a  Skywalk. Which means you do not have to go out in the cold air to get to the Convention Center. Which in turn you can go to the mall or number of other places once you get to the convention center.

I like this place a lot more now that it has been renamed and remodeled.  The mac and cheese is great.  Decent beer selection on tap.  The food is a little pricey for what it is.  Go during happy hour for better deals.

Our first time here.  Cozy restaurant!  All of the tables were full on a Tuesday -  but the service was great and the food came out FAST!  Ordered the wine that was on special!  House salad was yummy - calamari was delish - crispy thin crust pizza!  Will be back for sure!

A nice addition to the walk from Larder and Cupboard to Penzey's!  Don't blink or you might miss it.  Small spot tucked into the tiny space, but the waffles and ice cream combination is exceptional! 

Friendly service, enjoyed the chat while waiting as I was one of two customers at the time. 

I will definitely return

I've been on a ribs kick. I got the craving for that good, smoky, melt in your mouth stuff  and I've been ordering them from everywhere for weeks. This is the place that finally ended my craving.  VERY disappointed in these 28$ ribs. Far from "Fall off the bone".  There's pre-cooked ribs you can buy from the grocery store that have the same taste and texture. Texas Road House is slightly closer to me, but surely the local small business has better quality than the chain? Not the case. TRH is better and cheaper. I think I'm done with ribs for a while though. I got through my first half rack and groaned at the sight of an entire second one. 28 bucks! What a bad experience. Your staff was very kind and professional though.

Tonight we had dinner here at Saltine. We made a reservation but we arrived early so we sat at the bar. The place wasn't packed but had decent crowd. I like the theme decor at this place. It goes with the seafood theme. The bartender was very friendly and nice. They have happy hour everyday and we had 10 minutes before happy hour is over, and sure we take advantage of it. We ordered two dozens of oysters since there were four of us and my husband and I had the Old fashion drinks. The drinks were really good. The Gulf oysters were huge but the taste were okay. We still enjoyed it. Then our table was ready, and we were seated at the front of the restaurant which is a swimming pool theme. It's really neat. Our waitress was really nice. The guys ordered the seafood pasta alfredo. They both enjoyed theirs and the ladies had the Ciopino. We also ordered the hush puppies with pimento cheese. I love hush puppies and i wasn't sure with the pimento cheese in it, but it was good. The Ciopino broth or sauce was okay and the clams and mussels are tiny. The shrimps are good size. The scallops were perfectly cooked. I think i'm used to the red sauce than the white wine sauce.  Overall it was good experience.

Best dentist in Philly! Great staff and office. Couldn't recommend them more. The staff is friendly when you come in and you are seen quickly. All staff members are professional and I have never had a bad experience.

I would ideally give Continental 3 1/2 stars but anywhere with a rooftop automatically gets points. I was visiting from New York and I am a big fan of Philly since it is not as pretentious as a lot of the New York scene. I didn't eat here so I was only at the rooftop bar area. Continental was a mixed bag of dare I say d-bags, very young looking girls, and regular young professionals getting drinks on a Saturday night. The bartenders thought they were a little better than you but the drinks were solid. Not a fan of the music though - an off mix of 70's rock and house music.

This is a go-to shop in Tucson! 

Honest and expert, fair prices and great customer service too !

Thank you Ryan !!

Saturday night you should probably have more than 2 waitresses. We walked in and I noticed 2 tables no drinks, the wife and I sat down and waited for roughly 10 minutes. No contact from any staff and the table behind us was looking as thirsty as I was. We left shortly after that. I'm sure they will shut down like the 3 places before them in the last 5 years.

I don't know what happened to my first review of this place..
I had mentioned one of the nicest things about this auditorium are the spaces between rows for long legged people, like myself.. I LOVE the space between rows.  
The seats are nice, also.
I've sat all over this auditorium except for upstairs.  I've sat in the handicapped aisles, in the front, in the center, on the sides.....  and next week, I'll be on the extreme aisle seat on the side of the auditorium, on the main floor..  (I'll review my seat next week)

It's easy to get in and out of this auditorium. Lots of doors, the aisles are wide enough that people can most faster and smoothly... right for the exit doors on the side that go directly out to the street.. Excellent movement in and out of the auditorium.

Sound is good. Good acoustics, no matter where you're sitting.
Bathrooms are downstairs... Not enough stalls.. Long lines are eminent.
Prices are reasonable.  Some plays begin at $25.

Lovely venue. Always filled when I have attended an event. All seats are good.

The newest Upland location is perfectly nestled into the Fountain Square neighborhood and it's patio is going to be perfect for those late afternoon lunches and weekend drinks with friends. Upland is definitely one of my favorite brewpubs in the city for many reasons; one of the only things I've been missing as a vegetarian is wings. Well, Upland has seitan wings on the menu from Three Carrots! So this is a great blend of local food that's healthy, and got me to try something new which I always love. I'm not a big fan of fries that aren't super thin, but Upland's beer battered fries are my only exception. Even their ranch is good, it's actually pretty runny but creamy and perfect for those wings and fries. My favorite drink to get is the Oak and Rose or Oak and Red, another local partnership with Oliver Winery.
Lots of detailed reviews showing up as "not recommended". I'll keep this one short, read the not recommended reviews. This place is amazing!

So cold beer...I like it. I have honestly never eaten here but it is quickly becoming my favorite place to grab a beer with friends after work. Especially on $2 Tuesday. Any beer you want...really?! I vote yes! The atmosphere is pretty rad too I like lots of flat screens to watch sports. Wanna know the latest sports haps? Well hello there ticker under massive flat screen that is always updating. I like it. Service could be a teeny tiny bit better...but I have to say a friend and I had a beer there last night and sat at the bar, the bartender took our cards and remembered our names. That's great customer service! I'll be back...again...and again....lol.

Brought the family here from Nashville based on the great Yelp reviews. We called ahead to make reservations, but realized when we arrived that there's 4 tables, so it's first come, first serve.

We ordered 2 BBQ plates, half slab ribs.  Sides were grilled cabbage, greens, mac & cheese, baked beans. Everything was AMAZING! My dad, from rural South Carolina loved the grilled cabbage and greens. The baked beans were probably the best I've ever had. The barbecue was incredibly tender with excellent flavor. 

We finished off the feast with a some chess pie, which is a sort of custardy-like tasty treat. Got it free with Yelp Check-in. Thanks to the friendly staff at Papa Turney's!

I cannot recommend this restaurant.  There is nowhere to wait for a table as the place is very tiny, there is only one chair near the bathroom.  So we stood by the door with other people also waiting awkwardly and trying to stay out of the way. Twenty minutes into our wait, people who arrived after us were seated; it was clear that they were friends with the staff and so got preferential treatment.  When questioned about this, the "hostess" or staff member who had taken our name was confused and seemed unable to offer any explanation, or even an apology for that matter.  Needless to say we did not continue to wait for another table.  Poor organization and unhelpful staff.

HORRIBLE SERVICE!!!! Never coming back. Walk in, no host, waiting for a few mins for anyone to even acknowledge us. It is not busy AT ALL. As we were about to leave someone finally came to seat us. Ok fine. Got bread quick but our server never came back. We were SO thirsty. A few other groups who sat AFTER us got their drink & food orders. We just walked out.

My fiance and I returned to place where we had our first date to celebrate our engagement. It was perfect. He made reservations in advance of even proposing and Amada's staff went above and beyond to ensure that the evening was special. They brought in a sweet white wine, which is my preferred drink, as they do not normally carry sweeter wines and allowed us to reserve a spot in the lounge where we weren't as close to others in the main dining area. We enjoyed the cheese and charcuterie mixto tastings, Pulpa a la Gallega (Spanish octopus), Costillas de Ternera (short rib flatbread), Albondigas (lamb meatballs), and Amadas Empanada. Everything was wonderful as always, but we were especially impressed with the octopus. For dessert, we opted for the Tarta de Chocolate in which the dark chocolate paired beautifully with the blood orange. I am sure we will be returning for future celebrations.

We loved it! We were visiting and staying close by, so I made reservation there the first evening. We enjoyed it so much, we went back on our last night. Both times we brought our kids and sat on the comfortable front porch, which was fantastic. I almost always order beet salads, and the one here was delicious! My 9 year old was converted to a Brussel sprout lover and the carrots were excellent. We thought all the vegetables were inspired, and for a nicer restaurant I thought the portions were on the generous side. I enjoyed the service, local neighborhood ambiance and delicious food!
Sausage Pizza here is fantastic!! It is a little pricey but yummy nonetheless! Price for a 12 inch pie is approximately $20

Was eager for some Huevos Rancheros.  They say on their menu that it is, "Our Tortilla Press House Classic..."  They were bland, the beans and rice were cold.  I got, not just better, but an order of magnitude better huevos rancheros at a Philadelphia diner!   Not worth the time, money or the wait.

Same story as the rest. The first time I showed up to my appointment, she was "with another client" and had double booked me even though I received a confirmation call the day before and had spoken to her 15 minutes before my appointment (she moved locations and didn't bother to tell me). I have subsequently been rescheduled 4 times. She actually argued with me when I told her it was getting to be crazy. I am reporting her for fraud and creating a fake business.

It's simple. You're panties are too tight if you don't like this place. OK, so maybe the line to the counter can sometimes remind you of a DMV experience, or that the space can get kinda cramped. Perhaps it pisses you off that your table is in the morning shade, or your chair has a bit of a wobble.  Maybe you're out of sorts because someone just snaked the last poppy seed twist - who knows maybe you just like not to like. Grumpy is underrated. But whatever the deal - deny if you will - but you can't deny, the food quality is consistently excellent here. The coffee is one the best cups (that I've experienced in the States). The tea selection, while not overwhelming, should be a standard in which all others are judged. The poached egg with pancetta and rye toast is "Are the Angels speaking to me?" sublime. Admittedly the breakfast menu is limited, but that makes deciding what to order all the easier. The pasty and bread is the thing and what this place was born to do. Each item on the bakery rack looks straight from a Martha Stewart photo shoot, and tastes even better. 4 stars easy.

We came here for a birthday party a month ago. It was everyone's first time in Ballpark Village and they still can't stop talking about how they want to go back. The baseball museum and store was so great for the kids and the atmosphere in general is very fun. The ceiling is lighted up to look as if it has the stitchings of a baseball and there is memorabilia on all of the walls. A must for any cardinals fan! The portion sizes were VERY generous! We ordered two of the nachos thinking it would be something nice to snack on but for 15 people one order would have been enough! Everything was delicious. I see that there are a lot of bad reviews and I don't understand why. We had a great time. Weve only been on a day and time when there was hardly anyone in there but I'll edit this again after we go this weekend

I was extremely impressed with the professionalism of everyone I dealt with at the Tampa store  and service center.  About three months ago, I met Brandon (Product Specialist) at a test drive event at the Epicurean Hotel.  He explained the features of the Model S as well as new features that would be added in the coming year.  He took his time on the test drive to let me really get a feel for the difference that regenerative braking makes in the feel of the accelerator.  There was absolutely no pressure to buy/sign.  I did some research and then intended to meet up with Brandon at another test drive event in Hyde Park so that my wife could take a spin.  He was running a bit behind and we needed to head back home.  Brandon went out of his way to secure a 70D (the model I was interested in) and then drove out to our home so that my wife could take a test drive and test out the clearance on some local speed humps.  30 minutes later, when my wife returned with a smile from ear to ear, I knew we were getting a Tesla.  From there, Brandon walked me through the process of online ordering, setting up a MyTesla account and connected me with Cameron (Delivery Specialist).  From there Cameron kept me well informed of where my car was in the production cycle, assisted me with ensuring the financing went smoothly and answered all of my questions about pricing, transferring tags, etc.  When my car's delivery was delayed by one day, Cameron called ASAP, apologized profusely and offered to call Enterprise to deliver me a rental car (they were out of loaner Teslas at the time).  When my car arrived, Cameron delivered it personally to my house and performed a very efficient orientation session.  I tip my hat to the hiring managers at Tesla and their entire crew.  An excellent experience from start to finish.

Always an exciting time when I head out to this shoprite. The shoprite has what you would expect from any other shoprite.  Best time to go would be on a weekday during the daytime. Anytime other than that the parking lot is usually full and the store is chaotic with people. The lines also don't seem to move very fast and isles are not as cleanly as other shoprites.

Gotta love Doylestown Bookshop for all it brings to the community, offers readers and children, and supports local authors!  Discovering a great read, new gifts, book clubs, even great events!  It's all there at the Doylestown Bookshop!

We went for restraint week and the menu although limited for restaurant week was a nice variety.  The waiter was great and the woman who brought out our food was the sweetest!  Food was so delicious. The squash salad was very crisp and had a great, light dressing!  Both our entrees, trout and flank steak, were amazing.  I was extremely pleased with everything and will definitely go back and recommend it to others.

Not impressed. Just had another company come and repair the same issue I paid WSE top dollar to fix only a few months ago. Their technicians didnt appear to be competent and should have done a more thorough job. Retrospect seems like I wasted my time and a lit of money.

So, I went to Amber-Renee to have my blond hair blended with the silver coming in...and I just wanted to stop coloring my hair!  The 1st time she did the blending and did a good job except she has a thing for Farah Fawcett from the 80's and sent me out with that 80's hair style that she loved and I spent over 120$ for that visit.  The second time I went in she looked at me and said "who are you?" and actually told me she had just talked to the person who had my appt. slot and I was not who she was expecting...I thought that was a bit weird but...so she proceeded to put the blond back in my hair didn't do any lightening around my face which I asked for many times and didn't listen to one word I said about accenting the silver and grey.  This visit I spent over 130$ and she was so proud of her farah look.  I cancelled the 3rd visit.  After spending that kind of money I expect my hair to be what I ask for and I expect the person that I am trusting my hair to and spending all those hours with to at least know a little about what I want...IMHO Amber does not listen...likes to talk about herself a lot and doesn't really care about her clients...which is why I made the decision to seek out another hair stylist. After spending all that time and money with her she never even cared enough to call and find out what the problem was...hopefully this review will spare someone else


Update:  Amber that is just not true you charged me the exact same amount the second time as the 1st 120$ and you are right I do tip very well I was so unhappy with the blond that I explicitly asked you for silver...you didn;t even hear me....I asked for a lot of lightness around the face...*crickets*...you didn't even have a "card or record" for me you told me that.  you didn't listen to what I asked you to do...I went to Sally's to get the supplies needed to do what I asked you for in the 1st place. As I stated earlier you may have a good knowledge for color but IMHO you do not listen to your clients and you have yourself up there on a bit of a pedestal...and personally I don't care if you have 100 Susan's coming there when I spend almost 300$ on 2 hair visits it's nice to be appreciated and acknowledged.

Have been doing business with them for years!  They have been in business for 40 years, they are doing it ALL right!  Fair prices, EXCELLENT service = we will continue doing business with them and suggest you do as well!
I went to smilies for a birthday party. The food was delicious. I would give a event here anytime.

I really should give Gateway a 5 star rating-we really enjoyed our meal and the service was friendly. Omelet cooked just the way I like and the waffle was tasty with great texture. Coffee was good too.
Kathy is a freaking great bartender, and explains the whole menus and atmosphere concept. This is a fun place to come and enjoy yourself.

Great Pizza!  Had the traditional Margherita, Spicy Sopresatta, and Arugula con Prosciutto.  All were excellent.  Waiter suggested we try the Prosciutto with the crispy Roman Crust.  Great suggestion!

Wine and beer selections were also solid.
Pretty good diner food. Nice friendly place to stop by for a bite. They had a lot of gluten free menu items - a plus for some.

Let me start off by saying we are locals. It is easy to see how an unfamiliar tourist would overrate this restaurant. Very cool ambiance, the courtyard was quaint and could be an enjoyable dining area. The food and service just wasn't up to par.

Service was average - took a while to get our drink orders, water refilled, etc. 

We ordered the satsuma pepper shrimp, gumbo, shrimp and grits as well as the cochon de lait sandwich. The shrimp and grits were very light on shrimp, however flavor was pretty good. All in all, this restaurant has promise,  but with so many excellent restaurants in the city, I would pass visiting this one again.

Be wary! In my experience, the staff was very friendly but Dr. Clegg suggested procedures that were expensive and I didn't feel were needed. My instinct was confirmed upon visiting another dentist in Nashville who found no evidence that I needed those treatments. I've learned that it never hurts to get a second opinion if you are feeling uneasy about the doctor's recommendations, and I am certainly glad that I sought another opinion in this case.

I've been to Rick's three or four times. I have lived in the area around 3 years. The food options and entrees I've received are generally great tasting. Most of the seafood entrees are good. I plan to return to continue trying various other items. 

I have sat both inside and outside and don't necessarily have a preference.

I found the staff and Dr. Burford very pleasant and professional. The office was very efficient. The latest, most up-to-date equipment are utilized to analyze your eye health. They were very nice selection of frames. It seems their prices are very competitive.

One of the coolest spots around Nashville. It has the combined powers of coffee from Crema, fully stocked kitchen & bar, and a bowling alley? Hell yeah it's the perfect 10. I spent the day working here with some friends. Can't wait to come back!

Go get a facial from Samantha, you won't be disappointed!  I got one yesterday using a BuyWithMe coupon and it was fantastic!  She does a great job and is super friendly (along with everyone else at Honeydew!).

I usually go to the Sucre on Magazine, but I stopped here recently for my sister's birthday. Just like the other location, the staff is extremely helpful in helping you decide what you want. They were actually offering free chocolate samples at this location when I went, which was a treat. 

This store is definitely bigger than the Magazine location, and it was a lot less crowded. But the same atmosphere nonetheless. 

Like the other store, it is kinda pricey hence the 4 stars.
Just arrived in New Orleans and looking for late night dinner without having to leave my house- super fast delivery and great customer service! Just ordered a pizza this time around and tastes great!
Double edge has changed my life. The community,  the coaches, the results. There is nothing like it. Stop by and schedule and intro....your future self will thank you.

I looove the mailroom. Great service. Quick. The folks inside are a good for some dry humor so let your guard down a little. They are also really informative about questions you may have about your package so don't be scared to ask.

Excellent contractor. I wish more contractors were like John the owner. We replaced both of our furnaces with York High Efficiency almost 5 years ago. They are VERY temperamental. In fact I would not get another one. However John and Allegiance are outstanding. Every single time we have an issue he is there or one of his techs. He answers the phone, returns calls and does an OUTSTANDING job. I cannot say enough good things about how excellent he runs this business and really cares about his customers. The high efficiency I am not in love with, and now we are regretting them. They are all the rage but require a great deal of maintenance. However John is outstanding as a heating, ac and plumber. If you have a need of one of his services do not hesitate to call him.

So far I've only had their Italian hoagies, buffalo chicken cheesesteak, & regular cheesesteak. I must say I wasn't disappointed. Very flavorful & prepared well. The cashier's are very friendly & have excellent customer service. I definately recommend.

Every time I visit Philadelphia I go to honest tom's. The burritos are delicious and very filling. The guacamole is fresh and some of the best I've had in a burrito. The steak burrito is my favorite, but the chicken is also very tasty. They serve fast and the food is always delicious.

I've heard such great reviews about this place so I decided to check it out for myself and I was not disappointed at all! I had the Belgian strawberry Nutella waffle and the latte macchiato and it was really great! The atmosphere was also very welcoming, which is always a plus! Definitely recommend for anyone in the area!!

'Four stars for a store that should be a five star store because I couldn't find customer service very easily.  I wandered around for at least five minutes before I found a customer service person and he happened to be working for another company within Macy's.  However, though unfamiliar with the store, he was able to direct me to the floor I needed to be on to find what I was looking for.  I was looking for a belt, and the selection was limited to a small, 4 X 6 area on the second floor.  The store is very shiny and clean and has the faint chemical smell of new clothing and perfume.  The lighting is perfect, not too bright, just right.  The atmosphere is airy, casual and relaxed.  Macy's prices are often higher than other stores (like Kohl's), but the brands they carry have a reputation for being of higher quality.  I know that my $50 belt is well made and will last me a long time.

Checked in to Applebees for dinner rhey have a deal 3 appetizers for 13.99 their wonton chicken tacos are the best need to try them.
I also ordered the oriental chicken salad off the hook. And to drink try the new Winter Dew its mountain dew with pomegrant and a mint leaf. The waitress is nice and on top of her job. I would highly recommend eating here.

This is a take out shop just outside the Uptown area.  I was thrilled to discover pig feet, huge shrimp and crawfish (which were a little small) The seasoning was spicy but not too much.  The shrimp was large and juicy.  Pig feet were off the hook. You definitely want to eat at home with some wipes and a cold beer or three!

Being a visitor from California........ I'm grateful for stopping by this "local" eatery! The location is in a residential setting, so I could see why there would be no foot traffic or tourist stop!
As a visitor, I had to try the Po-Boy sandwich. I got a half catfish and half shrimp sandwich! The shrimp and the catfish were both full or flavor.... I couldn't decide which one was better! They were both delicious!!!
We also ordered a seafood platter with fried oysters/shrimp/catfish! The plate was HUGE! More than one man can eat!
The service was great! All in all an awesome experience! For all you visitors...... try and make it out to this joint! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT

Ikea is for mea!! Love this place if you change your mind often as most of us females do this is the place to shop!! But having a handy man around may come in need..... It would have taken me months to put together a large painting I purchased from there recently. However once completed I would have paid twice what I did for it! If you need to add some life to your dwelling this is the place to check out.... I dare you to try to leave empty handed. ;)
Absolutely incredible. DEFINITELY get the fish taco, best I've ever had! So light and flavorful. Tostadas were also delicious!!

I am at quite a crossroads in my life and had a wonderful session with Amy.
She is honest, accurate, caring and shares all of this in a way that is down to earth and easy to relate to.
I have and would recommend Amy to friends and family.

the web site said grand opening on the 22nd, but it was opened today, Father's Day. So, i went in. Clean and Shiny. Behind the Counter, the help was crowded together. They appear to have more than they need.

The Case appears small. Do not know what they will do if they get slammed. i liked what i saw, it did not look like they had more room in a back room.
i worked at this location when it was the site of the "MARLIN COFFEE SHOP", it was an above average restaurant. It did more business than the Horn & Hardart and the Linton's, both of these Restaurants were within walking distance of the center of Town. There maybe more room for parties;  i will be going back for a taste and a better look. 
The smell of Ice Cream took me back to my early days. Good Luck in the Days Ahead. Will up date this review when i go back.
July 21, 2014. i returned as a check in customer.
The Avenue was slow and so was the business at The Icery, at the time of my visit.
Ordered a Peach Gelato to go; expecting a cover on the cup of goodness.
Yes, i said goodness. There was no cap so when the cap/cover was placed and bagged, it was a leaky mess.
Other than that, i will be back!!           Peaches are not in season, right now, so the taste was a bit to Peachy; i hope they are not using artificial flavors. i meant it when i said i will be back and not to check up but enjoy!

We're regular customers here. Consistently awesome pizza shop food. BEST cheesesteak around hands down. Delicious pizza by the slice - love the cheesesteak pizza, chicken da Vinci, buffalo chicken, white and plain - you really can't go wrong with any of them.  Oh and don't forget the garlic knots, fries, mozzarella sticks. Family owned and friendly, a great neighborhood spot.

This restaurant use to be at Bruce B Down. Now it move to bigger and better place in Brandon. I love this restaurant in very beginning due to great food. When they move out of New Tampa/USF area, many thought it close the door. Not many actually know that they move to new location. 

The new place is at least 4 time bigger than the old Takara. Now they have the patio seating. The interior is decorated very nicely. Now they are soft opening. They have added the lunch special that include the specialty burrito. 

For me, I like the old Takara sushi. I like their torch salmon roll. This roll wrap in the seaweed with fried tempura shrimp and imitation crab meat. Top with cook salmon and torch with open flame. Then add the fried small chili or jalapeño. It bring the heat and grilled meat taste. Sushi to died for. 10 pieces for $11. Good deal. 

Don't forget their old menu includes the vegetarian sushi. The one I like are funky monkey roll. The ramen is good also. You can finish with the bombs dessert. Fried banana springs roll on whip cream. Happy tummy happy day.
This restaurant serves delicious italian food and they're willing to make whatever changes you want to your order.
We've been here five Fridays in a row! Great food, great beer and the service is fantastic! The burgers are GREAT, great size, the French dip was super yummy a d the beer on tap is the best part!

The food was okay. I got a breakfast deluxe. Great portion size. However just like previous comments, it does not have the best customer service. And also they need to work on the cleanliness of the restaurant. It's definitely outdated and not the cleanest. 

I see potential, however work out the kinks.

Good sushi options for not a bad price. I usually get salmon everything, and there were plenty of options for salmon preparations without all the American fried toppings and sugary sauces. The fish is pretty fresh too. The gyozi is delicious and poke salad were also good. I also like the swamp roll with crawfish. Overall I think the sushi is good for a good price.
Wasnt impressed with this place it was ok at best! They screwed our order up and had to re make our sandwiches, bread was ok nothing special about this place at all. I would not return!

Charming place with really good food. It's a small place so you might have a short wait for a table or to finally get your food. But it's worth it. We enjoyed everything here. Folks are friendly. This place is the next Hallmark movie destination nestled right into the small town thoroghfare.

The place is very nice and service is decent.

The etouffee was delicious. The jambalaya however was not and I was so bummed! It wasn't inedible and I was glad to have something to eat but it was bland bland bland.

The cocktails were great so I could totally see this as a nice spot for a cocktail date night.

Also worth mentioning - bring cash. They take cards but I paid for our small group and got double charged. It was not fun to have to deal with my bank while on vacation.
Stopped in as we were walking by and were not disappointed!! The combo kabob plate was delicious!!

Moved here in July 2018. It's a decent complex but the office manager makes a deal about everything. I complained about my trash not being picked up wen I'm forced to pay for it. If you post a complaint they will call n harass you about it and try to make you feel guilty. If I'm forced to pay for a service and it's not even preformed than yea I'm gonna complain. The office had made allegations about what's going on in my home with no proof of anything and puts threatening letters about allegations formed by their imagination. If you post any complaints you will be targeted and harassed and tried made feel wrong. I pay my rent early each month and if I'm forced to pay for a service that's not even done when it should be, yea I have  problem with that. Don't think I would recommend this place to others.

Went out here the other night to celebrate a friends birthday.  There were nine of us, so we were a bit worried about the wait, but sidled up to the bar for some margaritas and were seated after not too long.  Once we did sit down, our waitress profusely apologized for our wait (a good start!).

House margaritas (on the rocks with salt for me) were just right...and tasty.  Chips, salsa, and guacamole got us started before our entrées came.  I had the fajitas and it came with more food than I could finish.  My table-mates meals ranged from stuffed peppers to burritos to tacos to quesadillas, and all seemed very happy with their meal.  We left there stuffed and satisfied.  

I definitely recommend Chava's to anyone looking for some good Mexican food in the city!

My boyfriend has been interested in adopting a dog for a while however the Nevada Humane Society has made it extremely difficult to adopt during the COVID-19 crisis. On Friday my boyfriend called to make an appointment to see a dog the woman on the phone made the appointment no problem scheduling him to come in a few hours later, she never mentioned filling out any applications online and he was able to go in no problem. Unfortunately the dog he already owns did not get along with the dog he was looking to adopt. Since then we have been looking on the website frequently to see if any new dogs have been posted since. This morning we found a dog we were very interested in looking at we called a few times before they open at 11 and got no response which is understandable considering they weren't open so we tried to fill out an application online to look at one of the dogs and the online application would not work on either of our phones. After 11 we continued to call multiple times and no answer, finally a woman answered and said we must fill out an online application to get an appointment and I explained how their website was not allowing us to do so and asked if we could make an appointment over the phone like we did Friday and she persisted to say we must do an application and she acknowledge that their website has been known not to work non mobile phones. We have no access to a computer so we had to drive to a friends and finally were able to complete an application called multiple times after that to see if there were any appointments left today considering it was later in the day now and no one answered there phones. We understand with COVID-19 the protocols will differ and appointments are limited but we are frustrated at the miscommunication between the workers scheduling appointments, the online application not working, the workers acknowledging the website doesn't work properly from time to time but insisting it's the only way to make an appointment & having no way to contact anyone over the phone after several phone calls.
Considering that I relocated to Florida for a while I have high expectations for a mall now. They need to revamp not only this one but esplanade as well

Went here with my family after visiting the beach and looking for a place for lunch. The online reviews were very good according to my mother, so we decided to stop by. We were a bit dismayed to see a line outside the restaurant, but decided to just wait it out. We were told that it was going to be 30 to 35 minute wait, but we were seated in about half that time. Upon entering, I was a bit surprised that a third of the restaurant was empty and there were still people waiting outside, but that could be because they are understaffed so I won't hold it against them. I ordered the filet mignon which came with green beans and sweet potato mash, and the rest of my family's orders consisted of a fried seafood platter and some sort of seafood flatbread pizza. The food came shortly after, and here's how everything went.

Filet mignon - cooked and seasoned nicely, overall a decent steak

Green beans - the only thing that was missing was the seasoning.

Sweet potato mash - Wild dessert cinnamon flavor, was far too chunky but I still enjoyed it.

Fried seafood platter - My parents didn't enjoy it that much, but I think this is still a great option for a family. I would say get the half platter for two people.

Flatbread pizza - Not much to say, just a normal tasting pizza.

And to the guys out there, the mens bathroom smells like Fruit Loops.

Overall, I'd recommend this place!

Miguel's has been my my favorite spot for work lunches and happy hour since I moved to tampa several years ago. On Wednesday 2/25/15, at lunch, a breathtaking amount of rudeness and disrespect by an assistant manager made it abundantly clear how little Miguel's values their customers' satisfaction. 

What started the whole ball rolling was a relatively minor issue with my food. I ordered a steak burrito with beans and cheese. I asked the waitress if there were any vegetables including onions in the burrito (I'm allergic); she responded with no, only steak, beans, and cheese in the burrito. Burrito comes out smothered in queso with onions and red peppers cooked into it. In the interest of time I scrape the queso off and start eating the burrito. When I start eating, it's all beans and steak, no cheese; I assumed it was melted down. I get halfway through the burrito and find ALL the cheese congealed in one end of the burrito. I stop eating the burrito because of who wants to eat a big pile of partially melted cheese? When I get the bill, my burrito was rung up differently than expected. Since the burrito was rung up differently than I expected and I hadn't been able to eat over half of it I asked to speak the manager. This is where the real problem started. 

When she approaches the table the first words out of her mouth are "what is the problem?" While I explain my dissatisfaction she interrupts me repeatedly to say "you don't understand, that's how we make our burritos" and ROLLS HER EYES at me!!! After another 5 minutes of telling me I don't understand, interrupting me, and rolling her eyes, she agrees to take the burrito off my check. 

When she bring back my card and receipt (she still charged me for a $3 soft drink that never got refilled once) she threw it in the table and stalks away without a word.
At this point the colleague I was eating with got up to inquire at the hostess stand if there is another manager available. The rude assistant manager begins to tell him that "your friend doesn't understand" and ROLLS HER EYES at him too!! At no point in our interactions with the assistant manager did  anything resembling an acknowledgement that my food was less than satisfactory come out of her mouth. 

Later in the day I called Miguel's hoping to speak to the GM or another leader. I spoke with a man who introduced himself as the owner's son. His reply to my issues with my food was that I "did not understand how they made burritos" and insinuated that perhaps our behavior had justified the assistant manager's disrespect. He also said he trusted the assistant manager completely, and would have to watch the cc video to "see what really happened" and he would get back with me, but that there wasn't much he was willing to do. 

It's been 3 days since I talked to the owner's son and he has not contacted me to offer any sort of service recovery or an apology for the terrible terrible service and lousy food. 

To recap:
1. Specific menu questions to the waitress were incorrectly answered.

2. My food was executed poorly. Only half was edible, and it was not as I expected it to be.

3. The assistant manager provided a textbook example of how NOT to do customer service or service recovery. She couldn't have been ruder if she tried.

4. The owner's son insinuated her rudeness and disrespect could have been justified and implied he didn't believe/care that our experience at his family's restaurant had been so awful. He also has not kept his commitment to follow up with a dissatisfied formerly loyal customer.

So save yourself the time, money, and frustration and stay away from Miguel's. Instead, try Chihuahua's or Catrina's Cocina on S MacDill or Vallarta's in Carrollwood. You won't be missing anything special.

Gooooo!! The sushi was amazing!!!!! We called late for a table and they were accommodating (even though they were busy). Our server knew every detail about the menu and could easily explain the different types of fish and rolls they had. The sushi chef is also owner, and her expertise and pride shows in her food. High quality, executed perfectly, all delicious. We are only in St. Louis for two nights but we are seriously considering going here for dinner again tonight.

First time visiting a LabCorp for a routine biometric screening. Made an early appointment in hopes that I would be in and out. I'm not sure if I got lucky since the day I went it happened to be snowing, but I was in and out in less than 15 min. The woman who checked me in and did the screening was very nice.
