The only reason I'm giving 4 stars is because the entrance is very hard to find, even with following all the signage they have I parked and still had to walk quite a bit of ways around the building to find the proper entrance.

I can't tell you how long I have waited for a sushi place in this area.  Given that, the place is actually pretty good.  The sushi is fresh and decently priced.  I got the sakura roll which was huge and had 4 different kinds of fish in the center.  My favorite is the philly roll with smoked salmon, cream cheese, and avocado.  It's take out and eat in, although the dinning room is pretty small.  Overall a great place.

An excellent option for one stop shopping. This store has international grocery options from the Caribbean to Asian. There is a fresh meat option in the back of the store that sells both packaged and weighed by the pound meat options. There is also hot food that is very reasonably priced. The plates include an entree and two side options and the prices range from $5.99 to $8.99. 

The food is fresh and tasty. The line may be long when you arrive, however, it moves swiftly with 5 servers behind the counter. There are also usually 4 registers open for a swift checkout. There is an abundance of food options from seafood soup to roast pork to chicken stew to steak and onions. The portions are enough for two to eat. Catering is also offered at a reasonable price.

The weigh by the pound meat option is excellent for any size family. The butchers also accommodate select cutting options when you order meat. The fresh fruit is reasonably priced as well as the other international grocery options. This store is one of my favorites and I usually shop here a few times a month.

Aesthetic deserves 5 stars
Speed of service 5 stars
Portion size 3 stars
Biscuits 2 stars. (Small and not flavorful)

I ordered the egg plate (sub cheese grits with cheese potatoes). 3 stars. Good portion of food but wasn't anything spectacular for what we paid.

The Bonuts were honestly the best part. They are 4 stars to me because to me 5 stars would have to be the best cinnamon biscuits I ever had and they were not.  Order these and some coffee and just enjoy good the vibe of the restaurant and the company you're with.

Insurance changed for pharmacy so I have to go here. Left once because of service.  I really don't like that people can check out in the pharmacy with their whole shopping visit.  I understand pharmacy stuff but everything else is not acceptable.  I have been in line in the pharmacy and it takes forever with the people who do this.  I make other purchases at the front counter NOT the pharmacy.
Great place and great food for under $10 a meal. Excellent Cuban sandwich.  Love the Yuca! Breakfast is great too!

Dr. Bantum has been treating me off and on for over a year.  I've had back and neck pain for 1 1/2 years.  I have found Dr. Bantum and his staff (especially Diana and Maria) to be nothing short of awesome.  Dr. Bantum has a personality that would make anyone feel comfortable and at ease.  He has taken his time to explain the many procedures I have had to ensure my understanding and always asked if I had questions.  I have had several follow up calls from his staff which I have found to be a rarity.  I look forward to no longer needing him.  But as long as I do, I feel I'm in good hands.

I'd rather not waste any time writing this review because I've wasted enough time at this good-time night-killer.  Between waiting an hour for food that came out looking and tasting like the lazy-give-me-a-dollar-and-f!@#-off bathroom attendant just wiped his ass with day-old KFC and not accepting the food being sent back AND a nice little screw-you by charging us for tap-water ($1 each and served in the same doctor's piss collecting plastic cup our drinks were served in), this piece of crap ain't worth your time.

wawas are open 24 hours... i can't think of much else in philly that is. that makes them awesome. i'm not crazy about their coffee but it's not awful. i love how in the deli that you now can get spinach, cucumbers, and roasted red peppers, making for a mean veggie hoagie. now, i'm not 100% positive that their bread is vegan, but i don't see why it wouldn't be. i don't feel too bad about not checking because i only get a veggie hoagie once in a blue moon. maybe someone can find out...

what i do feel bad about is dissing the unofficial door person whenever i come here. it's like that at the other wawa at 2nd and south, too. oh well.

The so-called Hollywood Legend since 1939, "Pink's Hot Dogs".

First and foremost I would like to state anyone that is planning on coming to this location in the KOP Mall you are surrounded by a plethora of solid food options including the likes of : not one but two locations of Shake Shack (one directly to the right of Pink's Hot Dogs, The Melt Shop, Maggiano's Little Italy Restaurant, and many more. 

The menu is quite fascinating with all the options, I went with a monster burger called "Jaws". Menu reads -"Jaws", The BIG one - Poli-bacon chili cheeseburger, one grilled Polish dog, hamburger, bacon, lettuce, tomatoes, mayo (add burger and slice of cheese for $2.25)

I forced myself to finish this item and it was not worth the hype. If I was in California where the establishment is famous and wanted to indulge in an unhealthy hot dog I can sign off on the choice, but in the KOP mall I am sorry to say I would pass on Pink's Hot Dogs.

As always people SYOY!!!

I came across this place and decided to try it!

I had the steak, bacon, and bleu cheese salad. I substituted the tomatoes for quinoa. 

I also tried the roasted sweet potatoes which to my surprise wasn't half bad. 

The produce looks really fresh. With a plethora of options.

The inside is clean and spacious it reminds me of Qdoba but with healthier options.
 
The customer service was amazing friendly and professional.

I appreciate the fact that he ask if I want certain things in it because sometimes I overlook what's included and maybe not want it.

A wonderful tapas lunch with friends.  There were three of us and we ordered eight things.  We ordered two ceviches and they were yummy.  My favorite was the one with coconut juice.  Another item that was amazing was the portobello mushroom.  I could have eaten a plate of those!

They were incredibly slammed today and overwhelmed due to a recent write up in a local magazine, but the food was worth the wait! The hush puppies are perfect! Fried crisp with bits of corn inside. The green beans are shockingly delicious. They use fresh poke beans and cook them well with onion. The pickles are very unique. Sweet, salty and lots of dill. The coleslaw is great. Light on the mayo, a touch of vinegar and plenty of black pepper. The sausage is quite good; nice and Smokey and not too salty. The pulled pork was my favorite; very juicy, tons of flavor and a nice char. My husband preferred the brisket. It was also good but a tad less juicy and seasoning. The chicken was ok, but the mild is unseasoned, so a bit bland. I recommend adding some of the jerk sauce to it. I was also underwhelmed by the Mac and cheese. My oldest loved it, but I found it to be more creamy and milky than cheesy. We will definitely be back again!

Got the Hawaiian with jalapeño, chicken wings with buffalo sauce, & ranch. Fast delivery and really cool that you can track it in your phone to where they are. They came faster than their estimated delivery time which was great! Pizza is definitely the best delivery option in Reno. Very yummy and filling! Kinda odd that they don't bake the sauce in the wings but we really liked being able to dip it and have extra sauce. Overall good experience, will use for delivery again.

The breading and the way the chicken is fried is really interesting.  Its soft and crunchy at the same time, if that makes any sense all!  The staff was super friendly and very helpful.  I only wish you could mix white and dark meat in your order of chicken.  I ordered the dark meat.  I'm still curious what the white meat taste like.  Sides were really good.  Fried Okra was a surprise.  The wait is long, but well worth it.

Fantastic atmosphere! We went out as a family for dinner on a Friday night. There was no wait. The place was busy but not over crowded. The decor and atmosphere is fantastic decorating. Wide range of burgers and other items. I do wish their drink menu featured more drink options other than beers for example different margaritas? Rum, vodka drinks. Ordered the potato soup. It was warm and chunky. A little too chunky for me but I ate it and my son enjoyed it as well. I also ordered the burger with an egg on it. It was good. Cooked to my liking and all the burger toppings came out just how I had ordered. I also ordered the truffle fried which were delicious. I would recommend the restaurant and definitely go back.

I go here pretty often for coffee in the morning and it's a pretty ideal place on the way to work. Their regular coffee is pretty delicious, with the main selection changing from single origin to single origin. Not a terrible price for an upscale coffee house either. The lattes are awesome too, worlds better than Starbucks. They also car a range of baked goods and the donuts are always on point.

The staff is great and they always know what I want and are very friendly
Outstanding! Best burger I've had in a long time! Killer atmosphere and great service!

Was shopping for a sectional and kitchen dining set. Walking in I was very pleased with the warm welcome and the calming atmosphere. The staff was friendly, and helpful. Will definitely continue to shop here!

Came here for the first time with a girlfriend. The ambience was very chill with a industrial Japanese/Naruto feel, conveyer belt and all. The sushi chefs and staff were all very accommodating. I asked if my salmon habanero roll could be wrapped in cucumber instead of rice, which they were able to do. When the salmon cucumber roll came out, we almost couldn't eat it bc the gorgeous presentation.     Great place for dates and larger groups.

Been to many BBQ joints and this place is right up there at the top.  Pulled pork was probably the best I've ever had and a great selection of sauce, especially the Carolina sauce with the pork.  Awesome friendly service which you don't always find in a BBQ place.  If you're in St Louis, you gotta go here!!!

Everything we had was really good. I can't say no to wings plus wings is literally in the restaurant name so of course we had to get it as an appetizer (another word I can't say no to). The wings did not disappoint! No way one can mess up waffle fries either so thumbs up on that also. My patty melt was a little greasy but then again, why would a patty melt not be? So as I'm writing this I am realizing that's my problem not TJ's lol. But 4 star nonetheless because I just don't feel 5 star in my soul. Looking forward to going back though!

The worst movie experience i ever had. First i asked if there were any popcorn/soda combos he said no. Ok that was fine but i asked for a soda with no ice and it was warm,  i thought the soda came from the fountain. The popcorn was cold and old i had to send the soda and popcorn back to get ice in the soda and for fresh popcorn and they charge $6 for a bag that's not even filled up to the top. Never again the manager never came over to see what was going on. Smh

We ate Asian salad and like a Pitaya Bowl.
Taste was very good and fresh!!
We gonna go to Fresh Healthy Cafe again soon!!

Excellent service! Friendly staff. Prompt and they never charge Holiday or after hours prices. I had a high water bill due to a leaking toilet I had no idea about. I called Rooterman to my home and they were able to work with my schedule. The technician was very friendly and fixed my issue. Did a wonderful job!

My first time for pad Thai.  I have to say it was the best pad Thai I have ever had.  But that means it was also the worst.  Really the pad Thai was very good.  I would love to try it again but not here.  This is for god only knows one the "25 Best" in St. Louis.  All lists are subjective but really?  

I liked the food.  Service was beyond poor.  I did not get what I ordered they just forgot to bring me my tum yum soup.  They were serving the entrée when I realized I did not get my soup.  To their credit they offered to bring the soup out but why at this point?  I lose the freshness of the pad Thai as it waits for me to eat the soup.  Nope.

We all finished and waited and waited and waited for the check.  This is a small place and turnover on tables must be critical to their success.  People are standing around staring at us like "how dare you sit when your are finished"?  I just want the check.  So I get the check and the total bill came to $50.00 good value for three people.  I put $100. bill in the folder and the server asked if I wanted change??!!!  I said yes I like to tip but not 50%. LOL!!

When others see long lines and long waits, especially visible ones that go around the block and out the door, they often think the venue must be... transcendent... to generate such interest. Not us at MC3. We've seen this game before and actually believe it's a clever marketing trick: limit the amount of spacing, create a line, generate an "it must be good" mystique that in turn exacerbates the the line problem and creates a hype cycle. So pardon me for not thinking much of Hattie B's Chicken when I walked by it at 2:30 PM and still saw a huge line and 30 minute wait.

But I still wanted fried chicken. If you've seen my reviews of Popeye's "Louisiana" Kitchen or legendary Los Angeles staple Roscoe's Chicken and Waffles, you know how much I love it. So how did I get the chicken? Pro tip: get the Door Dash app, spend an extra couple bucks on delivery, then eat it at a place of your choice besides the restaurant. Unless you are so big on "restaurant atmosphere" and eating with a crowd, it shouldn't be hard to find a place to eat. If you're big on crowds, go to a freaking park and eat!!

Chicken itself is great. A little caution if you're sensitive to spice, though it wasn't that bad at all. People rarely talk about the meat on fried chicken, but I want to emphasize that this is actually a stand-out characteristic: really avoids the rubber feel of too many chicken restaurants.

I've been going here for years and still stop in when I'm visiting back home. It's as good as it was 10 years ago. Prices are reasonable and the food is good, nothing looks like it was sitting in the fridge too long. Staff are friendly.

Went there yesterday for a take out order although I didn't have a mask it was just take out another person behind me walked in and it did not have a mask he got service had me standing there for five minutes and no one came to see if I needed help so I just walked out this is like the third of fourth time I've been to this Applebee they really suck but there I'll probably never go there again thank you very much for your terrible customer service

Coma Coffee is a hidden gem on the ground floor of an office building  across the street from the Galleria in Richmond Heights. They offer breakfast food and lunch. Everything is made fresh, the staff is friendly and the restaurant is clean and chic. It's a great place to work and dine or grab something to eat after a doctors appointment.

Original October 2019: (5 stars) 
You really do get your $10 worth here. 
The food tastes fresh, it doesn't feel like fast food at all, and they have super awesome vegan / healthy options too. 
I'm a chipotle fan but this is indeed better quality

Dec. 2019 Update : (2 stars)
 I went again & I tried to bring my friend here to try el Diablo & The heavy set brown haired girl literally threw my guac in our bag, took my card, gave it back and then immediately got on her phone and said nothing. 
I honestly didn't even know if my card was charged or not because she didn't say anything... she acted like she was mad that she had to work. It was very awkward. 
Then an older couple came in & she was so nice to them. I'm spending money just like they are. Why treat me differently..? 
I live here 1 block away & would like to come back but people like her shouldn't be working the counter... I spend my $ just like everyone else. 

Update: Feb. 2020 (5 stars) : I went back again & was treated well by 3 younger staff! Thank god. This place has good food & I didn't want to stop coming here.

Was overcharged for an entree by $1.00. Veal Antonio was listed on the menu as $12.95. On the receipt, it showed $13.95. I overpaid for a dollar plus the tax. When I asked the older woman, who was the cashier and collected my money, about the discrepancy, she was clueless and ignorant of the situation. Even after seeing the mistake, she didn't offer a refund of my money only mumbling that she had to talk to someone about the menu price mistake. WTF? I wasnt about to get angry over a dollar, but the cashier, seemingly not able or unwilling to address the fraudulent situation was an injustice I had to speak out about.

The Veal Antonio was not that good. The veal cutlet seemed like it was fried in old oil, leaving a burnt taste in my mouth. There was too much butter sauce in the pasta. It was very greasy. There was a big pool of butter on the plate after I finished. I definitely won't be ordering that dish again!
Really enjoyed breakfast here this morning.  We had the breakfast croissant sandwich and an omelette.  Both were good.

Cute clothes with a definite vintage flair. The store also has great locally made jewelry pieces and accessories. 

This another well curated collection of items in a small store. The stock rotates often and the sales are very good. Since the clothes are not really my style, I stop in more often to peruse their accessories and jewelry which are well-priced and unique.

The staff has always been extremely helpful and offer really good suggestions.
Fish and chips are excellent. Especially on a Friday  but service is bad..asked for sauce and a plate and meal was almost over when she finally brought it out.. Ok for quick night out though

Went here for dinner on Christmas eve as we were out of town.

Staff was friendly and service was good. Food was decent, was a good value.

Entrees were:
1. Mushroom, cheese and broccoli omelet- Decent omelet, came with toast and fruit. Cons included canned rather than fresh mushrooms and some fruit past its prime. Again, it was decent.
2. Broiled crab cakes with garden salad, cole slaw, and warm bread-  Very good dish. Crab was fresh and high quality. Salad was fresh, cole slaw was good.
3. Kids Mac & Cheese- Good dish, high quality, great value.
4. Kids Spaghetti and Meatball- Good dish, high quality, great value.

Would go back to this restaurant.

I never ever write reviews but I am going to write one because my family had a wonderful dinning experience last Friday night.
It was our first time at Anthony's and we couldn't believe this was out first time to this place and it's been open for a year! Great pizza and amazing fresh salads. Their "well-done" pizza is quite tasty and the crust has that great smoky crustyness, I recommend the traditional pie with light cheese and extra sauce and their Paul and Young Ron pie with the hot peppers. When our server Yung explained the wings to us we weren't too thrilled because we were in the mood for some buffalo wings. so she brought us a sample to try and the wings are amazing. They are definitely a solid 10. We ended up ordering a large and taking another 20 home with us.
The service was great, our server Yung was excellent as she was attentive to our needs and such a sweetheart! She made made our dinning experience an unforgettable one. She was funny and polite and always smiling. Definitely would dine here again.
Best spring rolls I have ever had! I will be back again. Great service, amazing food, very pleased all around!

We came here for dinner on our last night in New Orleans and wow it was so great!! We made a reservation, but it was pretty empty on a tuesday night that we didnt really need it. We made it in time to catch their happy hour which was a really great deal. They have $0.50 raw oysters and $3 house wines and beer. 

So to start we got a dozen raw oysters as well as glasses of their house wines. Usually there's a red and white house wine available at most restaurants but they had a list of about 10 different house wines that ranged to all different types which was really great! 

Before our entrees we were served a warm baguette with butter and side salads. For our entrees we got the ahi tuna salad which had pepper-crusted ahi tuna, mango, sliced avocado, cherry tomatoes and crispy won tons over spring mix tossed in a honey lime vinaigrette as well as the blackened catfish which was topped with crawfish etouffée, served with whipped potatoes and corn maque choux. Both dishes were absolutely delicious!!! I loved the freshness of the salad and the fish was cooked perfectly served over the absolutely delicious mashed potatoes. The etouffée and the corn also worked perfectly together in the dish. 

For dessert we got the creme brulee which was so good served with fresh fruit on top, I highly recommend it to end your meal!!

Overall a really great experience, our waiter was fantastic and attentive. We loved the ambience of the restaurant and it was a perfect way to end our trip!

I've been here a handful of times, each with the same experience:

MacDintons on the water.

If that's what you're looking for, go nuts. It's loud, crowded, food and service isn't the best, but you're probably not there for the cuisine, are you.

I went to Ross last year on Tuesday, it was past 12 midnight, so I asked the cashier for the senior citizen discount, she said because it was past midnight, it was technically Wednesday, no longer Tuesday. I talked to the manager the following day and so I said that I was shopping on Tuesday but they close past 12 midnight. She asked her supervisor and I was told that TECNICALLY it was Wednesday. So why am I bringing this up now? I went to Ross tonight Monday and so it was past midnight, so TECHNICALLY it was Tuesday, it's no longer Monday. I asked for the Senior discount, the clerk said it was still Monday, I explained what happened to me last year, so she called her manager and he/she said no to the Senior discount because it was still Monday. NO CUSTOMER FRIENDLY SERVICE. They should all be on the same page when it comes to THE TECHNICALLY TUESDAY DISCOUNT!!! HATE THE CUSTOMER SERVICE THEIR, THEY NEED BETTER MANAGERS!!!

This may be our new go to burger place in brandon when we don't want to cook at home. The burger was made fresh including the toppings. The pretzel buns were fantastic and made me happy since they took over the space formerly occupied by European Gourmet Deli which had equally tasty pretzel rolls. 

I had the rise & grind and the hubs  had the Chicago's best. We would both get them again. The wasabi mayo on the rise & grind was the perfect amount of creamy mayo with a little heat. Nothing over the top. You get a good amount of fries when you upgrade to a combo. We could have easily shared. They are fresh cut fries which some places can't master. This place was able to get a crispy outside and soft center. Nothing worse than soggy fresh cut fries. 

As an added bonus for anyone hanging out at the Craft Beer Cellar, they'll deliver!

I have visited this clnic multiple times with two sick dogs (diarrhea) over the past 2 weeks.  On the Tuesday before Thanksgiving I was there with one of my dogs because his symptoms continued.  The vet suggested I cancel my out of town trip and bring him in the next morning for an IV of fluids and repeat x-rays.  The tech printed a copy of the suggested plan for me and told me to drop my dog off anytime after 8am the next day.  I dropped my dog off at 8 as recommended and asked that in addition to the IV fluids and x-ray they add a blood test.  They had me sign a consent form that I was consenting to treatment. By 10am my other dog was sick, so I called the clinic.  I explained my one dog was there.  The lady that answered the phone quickly responded, "He isn't here".  At that point I drove to the office.  Of course, he WAS there . . . Moving on, I knew the clinic closed at 8p so at 5p when I hadn't heard from anyone I called.  I asked if my dog was ready and they told me to come over in about 20 minutes. When I went over, I was told he had not received an IV, fluids or any x-rays!  The ONLY thing they had done was the blood test I requested.  I was clearly furious and left very upset!  My dog had been sick for two weeks, it was now the night before Thanksgiving and I was following vet orders by bringing him in.  Around 8pm the vet that was working called me to tell me the results of the blood test.  He also told me he was told I refused any treatment and that is why my dog sat there all day without an IV, fluids or x-rays.  Really??  Why would I drop my dog off only to refuse his treatment??  AND I signed for treatment!  

The Monday after the holiday weekend I called the office and asked to speak to the office manager and requested a copy of all of my dogs' records (as I will not be going back).  Hours later I received a call from a gentleman.  He told me he, "worked in the back" and the manger wasn't available.  I asked if the manager could call me and he said he would try to help.  I started going through why I was unhappy - clearly getting more upset as I continued to tell my story.  He then interrupted me to tell me, "he wasn't a flunky he owned the damn place!".  Really?  Was it necessary to hide that from the beginning and to be rude in telling me?  What was the point?  I wanted to speak to someone in charge, of course I would be happy to speak to an owner - had I known I was speaking to the owner.

I am appalled by the whole situation but especially the way my dog was treated.  It is only speculation of course, but after I brought him home that night he immediately ran to the bathroom and then drank and drank water.  I can only assume his needs were minimally met at best for the 11 hours he spent in a cage receiving NO TREATMENT!  

Wouldn't it make sense to call me, the owner, and ask why he was there if you thought he wasn't getting any treatment?  The entire day was a ridiculous mess.  My two-week experience with this clinic was disappointing at best.  I will never return to this place - especially when there are simply amazing vets like Chris F, DVM and Kevin A, DVM so close.  I wanted to love this place because it was so close to home but all I got for two weeks of diarrhea was a $2,000 credit card bill and a tremendous amount of heartache when it turns out a $10 antibiotic rx cleared up all their symptoms in 24 hours.  Ridiculous.

By far one of the best restaurants in the city. Inside the restaurant is beautifully decorated with hardwood throughout. The bar is the focal point list rows and rows of any type of alcohol you could think of. We were celebrating our anniversary and they were able to provide us with a large booth for the two of us and served us complimentary champagne. These two little gestures really made the experience memorable. The food was also absolutely amazing. We ordered both fish and steak and they were cooked just right with so much flavor. I will certainly be back here again!

Excellent steak! Wonderful place with a very good staff. The waiter was extremely nice and attentive. The food is very very good and reasonably priced. I would compare there steaks with Sullivan's any day and pay a third of the price. Highly recommend.

This Imo's always is good for us. We have two closer to us but frequent this location because the pizza is consistent and the staff is friendly. We always carry out and our orders are hot and ready when we get there. Be sure to check out the specials and order online. :)

lavender lemonade and yogurt with granola and fruit are a PERFECT way to start your day! the art and employees make the experience even better! definitely a place to try wether visiting or living in new orleans!
Just got my Scottish terrier cut again this past weekend. He came out looking better than ever. And I was able to get an appointment the day before.

Yes, everyone is telling the truth when they say this place does not answer their phone. I took me two days to finally get through to someone. 

I was waiting in the waiting room for by boyfriend to come out from is massage and witness the rudeness from the massues that was also acting as the receptionists. They client said she did not have a tip but she will be back the next day to give one. He said to her there is an ATM up the street. He said it with an attitude. It was so embarrassing to hear and it was so unproffessional. I can tell he probably lost his tip and a future client. He also was eating pringles chips as he was ringing the client out. how ghetto.......

Overall, they need to hire a receptionist that just handles phones. Also, they need to alway present themselvers proffesionally. they are always promoting themselves on Groupon because they probably can not keep a study client base. As you can see most of the reviews are horrible. I would not recommend this place to anyone. Stay Away.

Total dive, but great!  I go for the food and the music (when my friend's band is playing.) Appetizer combo was bad--"boneless wings" were processed chicken-like product, the onion rings were extra-super greasy, and the rest seemed like they microwaved it from the freezer!  BUT THEN, the real wings were excellent, and it was the best rib-eye I have ever had! So, definitely uneven on the food, but that rib-eye will call me back!!

The only place in Indy I will go for a massage.  Ask for Alli.  I've been going to her for years, well before Indy Massage Company opened.  She knows how to find those deep knots/ troubled areas and I always leave feeling refreshed & relaxed.  I've had many massages from 5 star spas around the country and Alli without a doubt beats them all!

Indy Massage Company is always responsive to last minute appointments and there prices are fantastic.  It's the only place I will ever go in Indy and I always suggest it to those looking for a great massage therapist.

The Ritz Carlton spa directed my mother and I here since they do not do nail service there. We made appointments an hour before; arrived late (due to walking), and we able to be seated right away and offered a beverage of choice upon arrival. They offer a wide variety of nail polish brands and have a large selection of colors within those brands and types- shellac/gel/polish. Our $28 pedicure included a hot stone massage on our legs and feet, paraffin rocks, and a neck massage while our toes were finishing under the dryer.  The decor was typical but spacious for center city and we felt very relaxed the entire time. The massage chairs were a 10/10- I'm used to the ones that half work and are old and crusty- these were brand new and very nice- they seem to be able to accommodate a large group if you have a girls day, or bridal party.  I was pleasantly shocked at the price at the end of the service and felt my pedicure was well worth the money and 40% tip.

Great customer service and very knowledgeable technicians. They have all of the special tools and diagnostic equipment, why go to the dealer when Oren's can do it all for less and faster! Highly, highly recommended!!

This place is awesome! I had a gator burger which was a spicy, barbecue ball of goodness. 

The decor is cute, and the service is awesome. The best part of this place is the craft beer situation. On tap, they only serve Florida beers, but have cans and bottles of lots of other stuff. 

The only downside is trying to get into the parking lot if you're going the opposite way on Park. On a day that Wagon Wheel open, than it is even more impossible.

Parking was ridiculous for the Indie Craft Revolution. I had to park on grass, which is NOT what I wanted to do.

Toured the outside tented booths first. Some pretty tacky stuff. Jewelry not too good-looking. Blocks of homemade soap for $4 . . . whatever.

Inside lots of felt animals, tableclothes, more not good-looking jewelry, some good-looking jewelry (but I wasn't interested), the old lotus blossom bowls in avocado green and burnt orange, stained glass. Lots and lots and lots of stuff.

But I was underwhelmed early. Been before and had better luck.

I'll keep going.
Pretty yummy diner, great staff and interesting menu!! Very glad we decided to give this place a try

By far, my favorite book store in Indy. I have been a long time fan and hate the fact there are no stores near me where I live in Georgia now. For many years living in Indy I probably sold and spent 1000's of dollars worth of books in this store.

The selection is VAST, almost overwhelming really unless you have hours and hours to dig for treasures. Make sure to check the clearance section in the back of the store. I always find a few amazing items for $2 - $3 bucks each.

Convenient location between the parents in Mascoutah and inlaws in rural Ofallon, almost dead center. The parking lot is on the small side, probably why they could only allow 1 trailer. There simply isn't room for more than 1 oversized vehicle. With a full house, not even 1.

We spent 3 nights and were greeted warmly daily when entering and exiting. The price was reasonable, especially for a suite.

The room was clean, large and spacious. I would occasionally catch a hint of an odor at the door entry, though none in the room. It was quiet all 3 nights, despite being close to the highway. No noise from the hall or adjoining rooms. Beds were comfortable. 

Our only note would be regarding the air conditioning, which would often shut off, in my husband's "expert" opinion, because the air was bouncing off the curtains making it read cooler than it was through the room. He tested this several times by opening the curtains and, when opened, the air ran as it should. 
He suggests installing "those really ugly air deflectors" to prevent cycling. I agree.

All in all, a pleasant stay. I'm sure we'll be back.

Worst service. Had to wait on a table 30 min even though there was clearly at least 10 open tables. Food microwaved and thrown on a plate. Horrible customer service. Worth the 10 minute drive to avoid this applebees and drive across town to the other one. Will not be coming back.

Fixed my battery and back of phone for $70 when I was getting quoted so higher everywhere else! Got my phone back to me the same day and gave me a new phone case, really great service. Will come back again.

I'm a BBQ lover so I naturally am more critical when reviewing BBQ joints.  My wife and I had the Brisket, Dry Rub Ribs, and Smoked Turkey.  The meat was smoked well with overall good flavor.  Nothing made say wow.  The sauces were mediocre.  Their main sauce is vinegar based.  Sides were good.  I think it is over priced.

I sat outside at the bar of the Salt Shack tonight on a first date.  We started off with some drinks and oysters.  When the oysters came all seemed great but once I started eating them I realized they weren't completely shucked.  The lower muscle was not cut so the oyster would fall out.  On every oyster, we had to pry out the oyster to eat it because the person shucking the oysters didn't cut the lower connection to the shell.  I'm an older person who's eaten many oysters and I've never came across this before.  I didn't want to say anything because I didn't want to embarrass my date.  Such a nice place with great people and ambience and I was so disappointed fighting with my oysters!!!

I came here with a group of friends, we got drinks at the bar while we waited for a table. We were sat outside on a beautiful night. It felt like we were in a hidden oasis. We each got different cocktails and meals so that we could try a little of everything. NOTHING was disappointing. We never felt rushed, we got to enjoy the meal and our time together.

Wow. Just wow. I was told this restaurant was good, so we tried it. The food is fresh and they believe in vegetables! This is not the greasy spoon kind of place. It was well worth the drive to go. Will definitely be going back!

Excellent food! Had top sirloin, bacon wrapped chicken, bacon wrapped filet mignon, filet mignon, garlic filet, fried banana, mashed potatoes and a salad from the salad bar. Everything was excellent. Servers were very attentive and prompt.

While on vacation, we were heading to Tampa from Orlando and discovered Mr. Dunderbaks on yelp. We can't agree more strongly with the other reviews. The homemade potato pancakes are seasoned, lightly fried, and delectable. 

My wife had the sour cream schnitzel, "smothered in cream and white wine and mushroom-herbed gravy".

I had the schnitzel Italia, "layered with Black Forest ham and provolone, and a tomato mushroom herb sauce". 

Both entrees were breaded pork, with a dollop of sauce on top, and every single bite was chock full of flavor.  And they were only $11 each!

I tried several beers as a small sample, which the waitress helped me choose. My favorite was the weissenohe monks Fest, which was a bit nutty, with great complexity and a smooth, polished finish. The runner up was the ayinger brau weisse, a wheat beer which filed the mouth superbly. I could have stayed longer for the beers if I weren't so full!

Not only was the homemade apple sauce savory, but it complemented the homemade apple strudel we had for desert, which had walnuts, raisins, a generous helping of cinnamon, and whipped cream.

After buying a beer glass to go, and some extra apple sauce for the road, our bill was still under $50! Compared to many other places we have been to, it is rare to find such great prices for such amazing food!!!

We stumbled this spot for the first time last week and it is an absolute gem! On top of the coffee being absolutely scrumptious (they even offer some boozy drink options as they have a full liquor bar) there is always such an amazing, friendly staff in a cozy, homey, setting. The Iced Almond Joy Latte is my new go to! The baristas mentioned there is also live music on some nights so we will definitely be back to check that out!

Great location.  Very clean.  Nice modern appearance.  Friendly, professional staff.  Good customer service.  Multiple options for dining and snacks.  The staff is doing their best despite COVID restrictions.  Its a decent hotel for sure, but it has some small negatives that would cause me to look elsewhere during my next visit.

Wifi on 8th floor was frustatingly intermittent.  It would stop working every few minutes, throughout our stay.  The wifi was also unsecure (no password).  The TV was large and nice, but TV service went out every night ("Error 771 No Signal") when there was heavy cloud cover (but not raining).  The 2 power outlets on one lamp were so "loose" that they couldn't be used to charge devices.  The 2 power outlets on another lamp were at the base and rotated in such a way that we had to prop the lamp up to plug devices in.  The room phone didn't work.  When trying to use it the handset made horrible screeching and static noises, and pushing the button to call the front desk didn't work.  The toilet paper holder was loose on the wall, so it always pointed down and made the toilet paper roll fall off.  It takes 3 separate elevators to go from the parking deck to your room (no fault of the hotel just the way the building is), while costing $35 per day for self parking.
That is good, food is delicious and cheap, even it's not happy hour. Wish I was drinking here with the tapas.

The people were very helpful at this location. However if you have a mishap with enterprise and don't take there insurance watch out. I recommend taking it. After an accident I got two bills. They told me the guy that was handling my case had sticky notes and was on it. Sticky notes you say. Oh yeah! So these are the two bills the first I flipped over then the second I guess they just seem like pan handlers

Fabulous BBQ and great selections on tap. The live music with a nice addition to the overall experience of dining in. The waiters and staff were attentive and incredibly nice. Definitely a must! Would highly recommended the BBQ chicken platter.

When I don't want to take the time and effort to smoke my own ribs or brisket or pork butt then I walk over (so nice to be that close) to Rackz BBQ and they take care of me!  

My "usual" is the pulled pork sandwich with the home made chips... delicious!  I have tried most items on their menu and everything is quite yummy, so feel free to try anything, I don't think you can go wrong at Rackz.

I tried the Moroccan chicken and waffles here as well as the Monte Carlo sandwich. Both were delicious options with the sangria tea. 

The chicken and waffles were delicious. Waffles were beautifully cooked with a golden crisp to them and sweetened. Paired with the crispy fried chicken... mmmm  

The sandwich had turkey and cheese with bacon and house potatoes on the side with apricot jam. The sandwich was delicious. Great balance of flavors and well seasoned. Paired with the apricot jam, it cuts the saltiness of the turkey and cheese.  The potatoes were a little over fried though. Couldn't really taste the potato, just fried starch. 

Not a bad place for brunch in general.
I love this place I used to eat here when I was working at the granite run mall around 2009 good food.
Haley is amazing! She listened to my concerns, likes, dislikes and created a custom hair cut just for me! I highly recommend this salon.

Fantastic and kind place!  We have a home that we are getting ready to host those displaced by the storm. We are looking at spending well over a thousand dollars getting the place ready for our first guests tonight. One of the managers at this store gave us 10% off because we are helping others. Thank you so very much. It is great when communities come together.

My husband and I are visiting our daughter, a graduate student down here in NOLA.  We have seen quite a few Vietnamese restaurants in the past 24 hours.  My husband "yelped" best Pho in NOLA, and Lilly's popped up.  I had the combination beef pho and shrimp spring rolls, my husband had shrimp with rice, with fresh vegetables.  The food was amazing!  Lilly, the owner, was very helpful in selecting our appetizers and entrees, she made suggestions for vegetables with our dinners, which definitely enhanced the entrees.  I was pleased to see an impressive vegetarian/vegan selection on the menu, so I got a takeout menu for my vegetarian daughter.

The food was fresh, delicious, and generously portioned, the food arrived quickly, the prices were great, and the staff was very welcoming!

Food is always delicious and atmosphere is great except for tonight. This place is small and it was very annoying when a few tables started talking and it got ridiculously loud. It could and should have been handled by the manager or anyone working there. We suggest when that happens again that restaurant has some say so as to take extremely loud people just standing in the aisle of the restaurant smooshing and drinking without any consideration for any others
Great food had a the gumbo, my friends had the fish specials an one had the shrimp and grits which tasted amazing . fish is fresh cute inside they have a bar and service was very friendly

I didn't know how else to rate this place, because I couldn't think of anything I would want improved upon!

I (rather sheepishly) dragged in a pair of 5+ year old Miu Miu boots, with ancient salt stains and ravaged soles, hoping they might be given a new lease on life. And they have! The salt stains have been minimized (and the leather coated with protectant) and new heels and a half-sole have been added to the boots. They look great, considering their age and the condition in which I brought them to the cobbler.

Service was fast: I brought them in at noon and they were ready to roll by 3:00pm. The owner was friendly and informative. He indicated that if there were any problems with the workmanship of the repair job, that he would remedy it. 

I'll be bringing in more faded-glory shoes that I'd previously thought lost to wear + tear.

I gotta admit, our food was great!! We had the Prime rib and Christmas Roasted Turkey Dinner. But the slow service is why I took so many stars off. Lucky thing the BF and I had a lot to talk about so the slow service was tolerable. Our waiter was new and didn't know the special well and I had to ask for the salad which was tasty. There was a problem with another table so it took us so long to get our bill we didn't even bother asking for our dessert (that came with the dinner) which our waiter didn't know about. The other waitress made sure our waters were refilled and remove our dishes but should've tried to help us out by informing our actual waiter to get us the check. For a steakhouse it was a lot louder than I preferred so lucky thing we were sitting way in the corner. 

I would say the price is reasonable for a steak house. Expect to pay at least $25 - $45 a person and expect the service to be slow. Expect a nice (but loud) ambience. I would probably try a different steakhouse the next time around unless Circus Circus is giving us an incentive to eat at this specific spot because my prime rib was delicious.
We've actually been twice in the past month. Food is very good, served piping hot. Reasonably priced & good portion sizes. It's BYOB. Have recommended to others.

Comfortable, quiet, staff are friendly, hot breakfast hits the spot. Nice location.

Facility is a bit worn - a facelift would do a lot for the feel of this property.

Pretty typical for an RI - I'm good with it!

Cheers!

C.
We were happy we tried Dream Tacos. So glad the opened nearby. We tried the tacos, burritos and their specialty, the quesabirra tacos. Everything was delicious and we liked the sauces too!

Once again extremely unprofessional service from customers service and service manager Stephanie,rude ,no customer skills whatsoever, I currently have two Vw's I will make sure that I never use that facility again and step away from the brand for that matter as well

Initially we had some reluctance in going to this place due to the way the outside of the building looked. But the food is fantastic and original if you enjoy pho than this place is the place to go.

Cash only and parking place is small but that's all intentional. Small family business and service is awesome.

Had an early flight out so wanted to grab something that could hold me over for a few hours that wasn't fast food. I ordered a club sandwich since it's hard to mess that up, right?

WRONG. My club sandwich had close to 10 slices of THICK roasted turkey, which is bizarre, as this sandwich is typically made with thin slices of turkey sandwich meat. The roasted turkey was extremely dry and tasted of Thanksgiving leftovers gone bad. I had to remove more than half the turkey from the sandwich; otherwise it would have been too dry to eat. 

The fries the sandwich came with were cold. They had clearly been fried a while ago and left out to sit. The waitstaff did not bother to heat it up.

The waitstaff in general could not care less. 

After I ate the sandwich, I felt ill for several hours. Since I had eaten nothing else that morning, I knew it was the sandwich. It is no fun to feel nauseous on an airplane.

AVOID THIS PLACE. Get fast food if you must.
Delicious bagels!  Highly recommended!  The variety and price are great.  Support local merchants as well have the best bagels around Indy- hands down.

They have outdoor seating for COVID, and it's a segmented area of 13th St. that is pretty spacious. Cafe Lift also takes credit card, huge plus. The service was really solid and I would recommend their steak on a pretzel roll, it's super delicious and make sure you get their house hot sauce. Additionally, their traditional breakfast items like french toast are some of the best in the city. BYOB.

I come here about once a week and have never been dissatisfied. The staff is extremely attentive, respectful, and friendly. Their pho is by far the best in the area. Make sure to try the Vietnamese iced coffee with condensed milk. Absolutely love this place.
Wallace is the best server!  Friendly, courteous, great service.  Just a fabulous person!

Bodega is amazing! I love the environment and staff. If you have a free afternoon, go sit outside of Bodega and order the Pollo Asado because it will change your life. One of my favorite places to eat in St. Pete.

I will never use super shuttle  again.  The driver was over an hour late picking us up which made us miss our flight and there we're no other flights to be put on so we are out the money for the shuttle, flight, hotel and rental car.  I would give them 0 stars if that was an option.
Come here often.  Always have the tenders and they are always very good.   Wait can be long depending on when you come.   Sides are great and pricing is reasonable.

So, let me start off with saying, I am very easy to scare and spook. I was not at all scared or made a believer in anyway shape or form. I believe 90% of it needs to be believed by the ghost tour guide. And this guy who I believe his name was Kyle was almost smiling and being too chipper every place we went. I did a tour in savannah, GA and that was waaaaay more entertaining because the tour guide made you believe that it was scary and true. 

First of all, the tour guide leader had a very difficult time concentrating. It's flipping New Orleans, people are gunna be getting drunk, they will be loud, bikes were riding in the street and every time, which seemed the entire time, somebody walked by, a car drove by, he had to stop the story which completely took away from the experience. 

Second, for how distracted he was I barely understood the story he was telling. I asked him a question about it and he basically mocked me in front of the ENTIRE group. How disrespectful, even though the story may have made sense to him because he has told it 1000 times I didn't understand the spooky part if there was any in the story he told. He is the professional, or supposed to be for that matter, he shouldn't have called out someone like that in front of 15 strangers. 

Lastly, I think overall it just may have been the tour guide leader that just made the experience far from great. But my experience with THIS guy just sucked! If there is another ghost tour company in NoLA I'd recommend trying them first before you settle with these guys....

WORST service in the history of the world. All the bartenders are terrible. Every time I go here the service is horrific so I was very hesitant to go back but I met my 2 girlfriends there on Friday night. It literally took 7 minutes to even get addressed, I ordered a patron margarita on the rocks, no salt. After the first, it took another 7 minutes to get another drink and that is because I had to flag down a bartender. I ordered another Patron margarita, this time with a splash of OJ. It was FILLED with sour mix which made gag on the spot, which is not what I am upset by. I am upset that the female bartender was offended when I told her the drink tasted like crap ON TOP of the service. Then threw a bud light in front of me and did not take it off the bill OR have a manager come over or anything!! They basically avoided the corner we were sitting in! I have served for over 10 years and I have never written a review NOR hated an establishment more! I ALWAYS make a point to ensure that any guest that did not enjoy their experience at least leaves with a smile. The employees there could not care less. I WILL NOT be returning and WILL be informing all of my friends and family to never enter the building again. BY THE WAY, I would give Champps a NEGATIVE 10 stars but the review requires me to minimally give one.

DO NOT COME HERE!! AVOID AT ALL COSTS. I literally waited for 15 mins for a water, coolata, & a bagel w/ cream cheese on the side. We got out drinks & then waited foreverrrrrrr for an untoasted bagel. This place was such a  disappointment. I really love Dunkin but I'll never come to this location again. Oh & once you're in the driveway you're stuck bc there is no getting out

I wanted to love this place so bad that I think my expectations were too high. Tuesday's is $5 pizza and sangria night so my mom and I decided that was our night! Upon first walking in, I thought the decor was a little odd. Scattered paintings on the walls, dim lighting, faux candles that weren't lit and black table cloths but the back counter was messy and the majority of employees were dressed in all different kinds of attire. As we were seated on one side of the dining room (which is just one large open room) we noticed the table cloth had food left on it from a previous patron. We waited about 10 minutes before our server came. We ordered sangria which came in plastic party cups. That was surprising because I feel as though they were trying to go for an upscale vibe. The sangria tasted like Kool aide. We then waited another 10 minutes before ordering. The $5 pizza special was a personal size with 2 toppings. I ordered pepperoni and my mother ordered fried pork with rice and red beans. The pork normally came with plantains but they allowed her to substitute. The pizza came about 20 minutes later and it was very good! It was large enough for 2 In my opinion and it was tasty! I think it was a great deal for $5. My mother's dish however was not so good. The pork was so tough she could not bite into it, I didn't believe her so I tried it myself and it was like pure rubber. The server was kind and accommodating but she only had so much to work with running the entire floor and only having one cook in the place (you can see into the kitchen from the eating area).Overall, if you visit, I would suggest ordering a pizza to go. I really liked the pizza which is why I gave 3 stars instead of 1.

Warm, friendly service and a nice spot for lunch. I ordered the Daniel's special 'Po Boy (blackened shrimp with a mushroom cream sauce) and it didn't disappoint! A fine lunch on my last day in NOLA. Also visit their sister restaurant, Oceana, for a fabulous dinner.

I could not put my finger on why the food is subpar here at best.  Tonight I finally figured it out after ordering their chicken soup! The reason that some folks have noticed the food here is not that great is because they don't use fresh vegetables.  They purchase frozen corn, carrots, broccoli etc. and that's what you get in your food.  It tastes bland.  Not a smart way to cut corners but for whatever reason the manager/owner has made this decision.  I won't be going back.

Awful. I have dined into this restaurant and waited 15 mins for a server to greet me. I ordered food curbside and waited 2hrs for it only to be told they had mixed it up with an Uber order. And now today I ordered Uber eats and my order has been delayed almost an hour and 3 carriers have gone and tried to pick it up. I don't know why they can't seem to get any type of service correct but something needs to be drastically changed.

We've been hitting up Lulu's for a couple years now and have taken groups there for special occasions.
The food is amazing!
There are so many tasty options even the omnivores will find something flavorful!

The buffalo cauliflower are definitely one of our gotos!
Go later and check out the ping pong rooms and bar upstairs!

Much love!

I can here to turn my dramatic ombré into a more subtle balayage-type look. I came prepared with pictures and explained exactly what I wanted, but ended up getting a head full of dull, one-dimensional brown. The haircut was fine, just a trim, but the styling was pretty disappointing (the curls had fallen by the time I got back to my car). Sadly I moved shortly after my appointment so I could not go back to get it fixed but I'm not sure I would have even if I had the opportunity. My stylist Mikey was otherwise very nice, as were the people at the front desk.
Awesome customer service and awesome food. I feel so comfortable knowing that the meats are halal, which offers ease of foods-free of pork.

To the owners. Your food is delicious your establishment is very clean. All of your servings are fresh.

However, there is a real problem with service. Specifically with what it seems to be one of your managers. I'm going to have to describe this person because she was not wearing a name tag and I don't want to call out the wrong person. This particular person was Asian decent (respectfully). Nevertheless this person has a really sour attitude and doesn't listen to anything someone has to say. She rushes you through the food order and speaks very fast and in my opinion rudely.

Maybe you owners hired this person because of manager experience but I think you should keep her in the back doing manager things because she is not a people person. In fact I even noticed that the other employees look stressed when she's around. When this particular person is not there my experience is very delightful. The employees are always smiling and will help you through your order without rushing you out the door. Make no mistake this isn't recent and it isn't because of covid. I have been eating there for over a year and every time this particular person helps me she almost makes you feel like it's a problem taking your order. Her answers are always very short and rude.

So hopefully the owners will read this and take into consideration that maybe they should consider a new manager or keep the existing manager in the back kitchen so she is not allowed to help customers. Eventually people are going to be irritated and not eat there as there are many other poke places to go to.

In fact next time I go there and I see her serving people I'm simply going to leave and go somewhere else.
Had the sticky rice, BBQ chicken and pork. Super good. Would recommend to anyone looking for a good lunch at a good price.

I went to this restaurant and sat outside the other day. They brought out the wrong order, didn't bring utensils, and the waiter took off his mask when speaking to us. The food itself was not great and we really would not recommend this place to anyone... nice place to sit if you just want a beer outside though!

I discovered this place from a Groupon and expected a storefront. But when I got to the location it was a small truck in the parking lot of a gas station. I was a little concerned but since I already spent the money, we got some food. IT WAS FANTASTIC. There are several good BBQ places around Nashville but this is as good as any. The meats are excellent quality, smoky and tender, and they have all the varieties. Pork, Beef, Chicken, Links, Wings, Fish, etc. Great sides too. Modest prices and really nice people. I hear they are planning to open a sit down place too, but for now it's my favorite BBQ. I drive past two other good places cause this is just better.
So all this hype over a chicken sandwich that is literally a piece of chicken on a bun, no mayo, no pickles no sauce just a plain piece of chicken in a bun! Unbelievable

Neat Irish Pub/Bar! I had passed by this place many time and decided to finally try it. They were pretty busy so there was a short wait. After we were seated the waitress took our drink orders immediately. 

The first thing I noticed on the menu was all the gluten free options! Awesome! We got two appetizers, the spinach dip and the fries pickles. The spinach dip was very good and gluten free. I heard the fried pickles were good too, but I didn't personally eat them. (I don't like pickles) I ordered the famous fish and chips. It was tasty but greasy, which comes with the nature of the meal. If you're a fan of fish and chips I recommend it! I also tried the pear cider. It was very good, something I hadn't had before. 

Over all I recommend the restaurant! It was clean, the staff was friendly, they have tons of different options, and they also play live music!
Really yummy. Clean and classic ramen choices. Would recommend for the winter or when you're needing comfort food!

If you believe anyone of the many manyreviews that is here believe this one.  I am a certified Indian food fanatic.  I eat Indian food at least 4 days each week.  All of the Indian resturants in town know me by  name or at least by face so suffice ti to say I know a little bit about Indian food to say the least.  This place is not all that great.  I guess it is better than nothing if you are desperate and simply must get your hands on some Indian food but it is FAR, FAR from being the best.  The food just isn't seasoned as well as most other places and I have been trying to figure out why the place stays so busy and my conclusion is that it is becuase of sites like this one.  First of all it is conveniently located right near downtown and if someone is new to town they are going to visit the first one that pops up on the list and has lots of seemingly positive reviews.  I wonder if they pay people to write good reviews because off all the friends of mine that have gone there none have given such gushing reviews and all prefer food from other Indian resturants.  So I think they are just popular with people who are new to town and just go with the first name they see or with people who don;t have much experience with Indian food and don;t know the good from the bad.  Also they ae very rude at this resturant.  I have seen them be very short with customers and have a very condescending take it or leave it air which is very unbecoming in the hospitality industry.  I am not here to start a war between resturants with my comments but if you want truly GREAT Indian food my favorite is Bombay Palace on West End.  They are really, I mean  really niceand the food is PHENOMENAL!  That is my personal favorite and friends of mine that are in culinary school are also obsessed with Bombay Palace not Bombay Grill that is a totally seperate and not so great place. But If you are one of those people who never heeds the warning then go ahead and try Sitar for yourself and I am most certain you will not come away with the feeling that you just had a great experience  But if you have time and money to waste suit yourself.  I'll see you at Bombay Palace, The Woodlands, Shalimar or anywhere else except this unwelcomig, substandard food serving place.

Finally made my way back to Figs and it's as good if not better than my first time. 

They now serve beer, wine and a few specialty cocktails. 

Food is still amazing! We had the Platter with all the add-ons and believe me when I tell you it's more than enough for two people.

I will always thank Figs for introducing me to Burrata and will get it every time. It's soooo good and they keep it simple.

Pork kabobs were delicious. There was a small mix up in the kitchen and we were told they were out after having ordered them. The waitress was super sweet and offered us the fries instead. Then she came back to let us know they still had some kabobs but that the fries were on the house. 

All in all a great experience. However, I recommend you make reservations specially on Friday and Saturday nights. It can be very loud when packed so if you're looking for quiet maybe come on a week night.
Amazing food! Our server Jen had great customer service. Would definitely visit again and hope to get the same waitress!! Keep up the great job!
Never ever disappoints and pay for what you get. Quality over quantity and slays nails no matter the length design or shape
Good and consistent Chinese take out food. I always order the family meals. Wonton soup, chicken lettuce wrap, steak hunan & beef & broccoli.
I attended the Sunday brunch on 11/10/19. The food was great. The mimosas were disappointing ; mainly low quality OJ.

I've been a Pia customer for many years. The spa atmosphere is nice, the therapists are well-trained and professional, & the products they sell are great quality. Liby is awesome & I will travel for miles for her waxing services.

Seoul Taco burritos are what all other burritos should strive to be.

My first experiences with Seoul Taco were as "after-bars food" during college at their Columbia location. Now that I've moved to St. Louis, it's become one of my go-to comforts after a hard day at work or whenever I get a craving for their delicious Korean fusion creations. 

You cannot go wrong with a bulgogi beef burrito here. It would stuff any normal human being, but being who I am, I get a side of kimchi fried rice as well. It's spicy and full of flavor, and the green onion on top gives it the perfect little crunch. I'm also a big fan of their quesadillas (also with bulgogi beef) as they come with a side of some kind of amazing sauce they've created. 

I also love that Seoul is great for sit-down as a fast casual spot (the graffiti wall theme in the restaurant is really interesting to look at while you're eating, but even if that doesn't interest you, they have TV's as well) or just as a place you can quickly order and go when you're on the run!

Took my little one here today for the first time. Only been meaning to go all dang summer and finally made an effort to get out there before summer is over. 

I don't think this is the biggest spray ground in town but it's the closest one to my house. This gets a 5 star for convenience factor. Close to home, easy and close parking, bathroom, shaded areas and benches provided for you. Sounds a heck of a lot easier than a trip to the beach. Just bring a snack and maybe your own pool chair in case the benches are full. That's all there is too it. Fun factor is pretty high here too. Lots of different spray apparatuses tall and short for kids (or overgrown adult kids) of all ages. Best of all - FREE 

Yep. I think we'll be coming here a lot more next year.

I was not very impressed with Blush.  They have a great write-up in the Santa Barbara Tourist Board magazine/brochure, and now I assume they paid a lot for that page. I was there for lunch and decided on a burger since the great smell had to be meat cooking.  I asked for my burger medium.  We must have very different definitions of medium.  There was not even a hint of pink in my burger.  Way too overcooked.  I felt like I got ripped off because it was so overdone.  My friend was very annoyed with the service.  It wasn't crowded so they should have been a little more efficient.  I'll try a different place next time I'm in town.

Oh my word I don't know where to start.... WE LOVE SEA OF SMILES!! Dr. Louis is amazing very kind and great bedside manner. Today our 3 year old had to have six cavities filled and I was a nervous wreck. They gave her the giggle juice and she did amazing they were so gentle with her and went at her pace. They did not force anything on her and made sure she was comfortable the whole time. Thank you so much to the wonderful staff and Dr for making our experience extraordinary!! If you ever open an office like this for adults let us know lol
Love. This place food is great just a lil on the higher price but I would eat there again

Shoefly. I love you. What more could one want on a Saturday night other than good bevies, awesome food, and a laidback atmosphere? I would teeter towards a 4.5, but that isn't an option on Yelp. 

Tonight's order included:
- cedar plank roasted trillium (Brie) - Phenomenal!! Definitely recommend. (See photos.) 
- bbq pretzel flatbread with chicken - decent 
- root beer smoked brisket on a tub of Mac n' cheese - hell yeah!!

I wouldn't reorder the pretzel flatbread, but everything else was pretty flipping delicious. 

Ps. Almost forgot to mention the low key, smooth jams playing in the background. Love the music selection. 

We'll. Be. Back.

The wait was a little long but it was 11pm on a Saturday night so I understand it. But the wait was totally worth it. The Hot Chicken tacos were the best street style tacos I've ever had. If we come back to Nashville we will most definitely make another stop.

Wife and I went there for lunch and heard it was a good place. The overall deco is clean and nice, the host was very helpful and personable. They have a Sushi Bar so I was excited for some good sushi and I love fresh fish. I ordered the Spider and the Dragon roll. I was a little take back by the high (for me) pricing but I was willing to keep a open mind. My wife order the Thai dish with Shrimp and Chicken. We were both disappointed with the food. The Sushi looked great, the presentation was perfect but the taste was not fresh.. I could tell the softshell crab and been around for awhile and my wife said that her dish has no favor. From the amount of Soy Sauce she ended up putting on her dish I believe her.. Final Verdict = Nice place and people but the food was just not there for the price. We will not return..

Penang is a classier version of Banana Leaf, except the dishes are more exotic and flavorful. I ordered the Pad Thai. It was large, but not enough to split between two people. I think what really made this a good experience was the appetizer--we ordered a roti canai for every 2-3 people, and IT WAS SO DELICIOUS. Obviously authentic--including the curry/potato dipping sauce (watch out for pieces of chicken bone though). IMO, Penang is better than Banana Leaf.
Always have a good experience with Wilson. Technician showed up on time for annual inspection, did his stuff and was on his way. Always professional.

This is so much better than the Peking Buffet across the street. The first thing I have is their excellent sushi which comes with the buffet. Next, I have some of their wonderful hibachi, which is also complimentary. Last, but not least, I have their frozen yogurt, which can be better. All in all this place earned 3.75 stars.

First off, I'm new to yelp. So here we go! The food was great, fast service and good server. Good drinks as well, music was a bit loud, but other than that, good trip! Next time in Nashville , definitely coming back!

So good! We got the lamb korma and butter chicken and naan. The butter chicken is a little on the sweeter side, but flavorful still! The lamb in the korma was soft and tender- not chewy at all. I will say though, the restaurant could do a little better with managing time expectations. We booked online, and it said the food would be ready in 45 min. We arrived 45 min later, but were told to wait for 5 min, 10 min, 10 more min...there were a lot of people waiting. The food is worth the wait... but be prepared to wait.

The service here was amazing. Amber was very welcoming and knowledgable of the menu. Any question I had, she tried her best to explain. She had recommendations and honesty! (Which anyone dining at a new restaurant would appreciate). The food came out in a timely manner and it was all hot! It's an extensive menu and the food is worth the money. I personally ordered the "crab cake signature combo" and would definitely recommend it! My boyfriend ordered the lobster ravioli & he enjoyed his meal as well! 

Overall, a good restaurant!

Pancakes for lunch! Food was okay but horrible service. We were seated outside and asked for water for the kids. Water did not show up till 15 min later with the food. The kids saw on the menu "Mickey Mouse" pancakes with a smiling face. Great! kids love Disney. When she brought the pancakes it was one medium size pancake with two silver dollar pancakes with chocolate sprinkles and cherries. It was okay but a bit misleading on the menu description. It came with ONE slide a bacon. I've never seen any dish come with only one slice of bacon. Oh well, lessons learned. The kids were thirsty so I looked for the waitress mid-meal to ask for more. No one to be found. A big problem is the person serving us is also working the back of the house and the ice cream section inside. So don't expect good or prompt service if you sit on the outside. Also, there is no teamwork here. I saw several other hosts walking around and no one came by to ask if I needed any assistance as I clearly was looking for someone to help. I stood up and took both kids to the restroom and for water. The lady only came back to drop the check. I asked for water, she came back and filled only my cup. The kid's cup were empty. She said, Oh, let me get more water then" yeah. Pretty lazy service.  There's a reason why this place is never full and most just come for the ice cream.

I would say this is not good. Appetizers were solid but it was hummus and babbaganoush. It's hard to ruin those. Entrees were well short of expectations from the other reviews. Way too much breading, over done shrimp and stuffed flounder. All hidden by a sauce served on most items. The highlight of the meal was the cannolis at the end. They were really good. We won't be coming back.

Wow, great place.  This was the highlight of my food experience on my recent trip to Indy.

I have a few minor complaints that won't dock from the 5 stars I gave this place.  The outside decor was lacking.  But who cares, right?  The place was too crowded, but that's because we showed up late and the WC Qualifying soccer game was on.  I know, very minor complaints.

But, they nailed the important parts.  Every TV was set to the soccer game between USA and Costa Rica.  The place was jammed yet we still got incredible and timely service from our waiter.  Also, the food was incredible.  Well, let me restate that, the thin crust pepperoni pizza was incredible.  The cheese fries with bacon and jalapenos (added on request) were decent, but good bar food. But the pizza was some of the best I've ever experienced.  They put about as much cheese as possible on and have high quality pepperoni.  They manage to do this without having any grease on it.  How they do that I'm not sure.  But it was great stuff, they should go national with their pizza.

I picked up takeout to eat on the parade route. I felt like it was overpriced. I got a rock n roll sushi roll, a seaweed salad, and a bottle of water, and the bill came to almost $20. The seaweed salad was a whopping $6 for a half-cup scoop. As for the rock n roll sushi, it was okay but I could only detect shrimp in half of the roll. The other half was mushy and had no substance. 

They did let my friends park there for the parade (with purchase) so it wasn't all bad. Might give it another try if I am in the area or if my friends want to eat there. I probably will try the Hibachi next time instead of the sushi.

I dropped off my car for a steam clean of the floors and mats but after talking to my partner we decided the amount they quoted was just too much so I called to cancel. When I went to pick up my car the next day they had done the service on accident and didn't charge me anything. They did a great job and I feel bad for the miscommunication. I really appreciated their professionalism and would go back there again.

Hi, we really really really loved this place. We loved the beer (naturally). We loved the setting... really... it's so cute there.  We had a great server, despite him being super busy. But really, we just loved our food.  Burritos all around and they were excellent. We had chips and guac to start and pretty much inhaled it.  GREAT place, would have loved to go back again on our visit, but Gulfport was a bit of a drive from where we were stationed. Glad Yelp helped us find this place, it was so worth the visit.

Do not buy an annuity with a long term care rider from this company  I have to spend hours every month on the phone begging for reimbursement. Both the licensed care home where my husband is cared for and I have emailed, faxed, phoned and what we get is that they didn't get the faxes, printing was too light, their was no attachment.They will give every excuse not to pay each month. Their concern is their bottom line only. I feel sorry for those folks who have no one to advocate for them.
One America will steal your time and your money, not to mention all the stress that they cause to those who are already under such duress.
BEWARE

Holy hell the food was amazing! It was SLIGHTLY pricey but oh sooooo worth it. And the staff was so helpful and genuinely friendly. I'm from NYC but if I'm ever in NOLA again I will DEFINITELY come back here!!! I ordered oysters plus the
Gnocchi with eggplant and it was out of this world!

Best tacos in town, $1.25 per taco!  They have steak, chicken, pork, head, fish and marinated pork as well.   Your tacos are served in a little red plastic basket where you can fill it up with all the fixings from the salsa bar.  Everything on bar is fresh...there's cilantro with onions, beats, limes, pico de gallo, and a variety of salsa.  This is the only place in town that serves up really hot salsa and no I'm not talking Gringo Hot, I'm talking potential mud butt hot.  It's all about fresh and spicy ingredients for me when it comes to Mexican food and this is it.  Love this place!

I hate to write this review, because I do love the William Penn Inn.  6 of us went for the Thanksgiving buffet today.  For the first time, the food was nothing special, it was actually cold.  The mashed potatos and sweet potatos tasted like they were from a cafeteria.  I couldn't find any white-meat turkey.  My oldest teenage son wouldn't eat any of it, and I did ask the manager if they could cut us a break since he didn't like the food.  They still charged the full $50 for him.  They charge more each year, and this year they really skimped on the quality.

The desserts were up-to-par, which was the one bright spot.

We've been going to William Penn Inn Thanksgiving for 6 years now, and unfortunately this is going to be the last.  We'll find a different place or go back to making our own Thanksgiving dinner.

We do go occasionally for the Sunday brunch, and I hope that didn't go downhill next time we go.

I think the negative reviews posted were unfair. People mostly complained about the wait and time the food took to come out, which if you come on a Saturday or Sunday morning you should expect. I came on a Tuesday morning and had no issues. The food is wonderful and the menu has good variety. Service was friendly and accommodating. The ambiance is comfortable and they even have outdoor seating.
Friendly staff and inside seating is comfortable.  The coffee is on par as the others.  Saw a few students there hang out or work on their homework.  Decent size, not too big, not too small.

Having enjoyed lunches and dinners at Sher-e-Punjab, I regret to write that our recent dinner was so disappointing. When we arrived at the end of the day, the outside lights were not lit and we wondered if the restaurant was indeed open. We were promptly shown to a table. We quickly observed that both the server and the person who brought water were untrained. The server was surly. The food was merely satisfactory. The shrimp curry was awful. The onion naan was tasty. The mixed vegetarian appetizer was OK. We paid our bill at the unlit kiosk; I used my iPhone's light to read the bill. The person who accepted our credit card seemed clueless. We might return for the self-serve luncheon buffet, but not for dinner.
Yummiest noods, sauces, desserts, everything. Order ahead! Wish they would consider something besides plastic containers.

I want to preface my review that I do not go to AYCE sushi because it's outstanding -- I go to get a fix since Reno is inland and I don't expect great sushi and it's to fix a craving.
