While I understand this isn't an area that has fresh fish due to proximity to the ocean, I still expect it to be food safe and standard.  I was immediately turned off but way too embarrassed to leave the minute I sat down at the bar and got a look at the selection of fish in the fridge.  While, once again, I understand we are not close to the ocean there is still a certain way defrosted fish should look that is healthy food standard.  Due to the suspicion that the raw fish may not be kept food standard, I opted for all cooked rolls and only got smoked salmon nigiri.  The smoked salmon was almost inedible, it had an off taste, texture and color to it.  The unagi also had an off taste which is extremely odd considering almost all unagi in the US comes pre-grilled and sauced(I used to work in a sushi restaurant in Oregon and am part Japanese growing up eating authentic sushi).  

We ordered 2 cooked rolls, unagi nigiri, two cooked hand rolls.  The spider hand roll was good but it was not soft shell crab -- it was either tempura shrimp or something similar.  The rolls were all variations of the same thing, with pretty much every single roll carrying spicy tuna or spicy crab.  The menu was sub-par at best and I was extremely disappointed overall in everything besides the service.  But most disappointing is the mild food poisoning I got afterwards.  

I started to feel nauseous about 30mins into dinner but shook it off as just feeling off.  By the time I got home 45-60 minutes later after feeling queasy, I was throwing up, shaking, stomach cramps, headache, dizzy, low blood pressure and dry mouth.  While my symptoms have been mild in comparison to extreme food poisoning, I am extremely confident I got food poisoning.  I don't believe that it was the salmon that made me sick, but most likely the cooked shrimp/other items sitting under a food warmer not at the correct temperature or not cooked to food safety standard.  I don't write this review lightly but I would be very wary about eating here.  Sushi is not something you want to mess with being questionable ever.
Come drink at xfinity live, where the bouncers think they're above their 12th grade education and pour your drink out for no reason... Cool...
The best Chinese restaurant in St Louis.    I've been eating there for over 20 years.   This is the restaurant I compare all other Chinese restaurants to

While in Philly, you must visit the home of Betsy Ross. This is an history lover's addition to your visit in the City of Brotherly Love! The tour does not take long, and in the basement is Betsy herself. She tells her story, answers questions, and stays in character. This home has personal meaning to every American. Afterwards, you can buy and cold beverage and sit in the courtyard. Kids will love this, and adults will too!
Great atmosphere for young people. The staff is all super out going and positive and the music playing is all modern and fun.

Really good !
I ordered a chicken BBQ sandwich, and yes, it was awesome. I was not very hungry but it was so delicious I had no problem finishing it. You should try it !
Worst subway I've ever been to. Rude staff and dirty all over the place. Do not eat here!

This business had just opened two employees were new, yet the owner Derren Jones efficiently dealt with everyone, he multi tasked yet appeared calm and very efficient, I highly recommend this business for Apple products. I will certainly recommend this store.

A friend took me to try them out and I really enjoyed the restaurant.  They have a dinner for one where it comes with soup, samosa, naan. your choice of two entrees, rice, and tea.  It was the perfect way to get a nice sampling of different dishes.  Very tasty Indian food!

Little hole-in-the-wall places like Tooley's Cafe are why I love Tucson and why I adopted my "Anti-Chain" moniker for Yelp. 

Tooley's is tucked into the armpit of MAST, avery cool artists-in-residence boutique,  which is tucked into Tucson's little-known Lost Barrio. It's cozy, laid back, eclectic, fun and friendly. Put your order in at the counter and grab a chair by the wood stove or on the patio. 

On my latest visit, I was entertaining a "snowbird" from Calgary.  We chatted over soy lattes, all the time forking an embarrassingly obese chocolate chip cookie. One the woman at the counter apologized for this monster being "smaller" than she usually bakes! Let's agree that the size was ample for (at least) two people. (These two felt like gluttons afterward).

Foodies: I have a feeling Tooley's Cafe is never going to win any awards with you. But the menu is good in my opinion. More important to me: Tooley's is an unpretentious oasis, a big "hug" of a place right in the middle of this small city. I absolutely adore it.

May be the most affordable restaurant Chinese restaurant in the casino. The only thing I don't really get is the seating is really limited at this area. If you have a lot of demand, why not give up some space. I am guessing each gambling table is worth more than a person seat at the somehow fast food bar. 

They have many good reviews. It because their BBQ dish. Some of the BBQ items is from off site and bring it into the restaurant. However they do have good flavor. The BBQ items included roast duck, BBQ pork, crispy pork. This item mixed with rice in duck sauce and make a good simple meal. 

I have order the oxtail noodle. This is actually the most expensive dish. Since it is their prepare meal. I really want to try their actual cooking skill. The meat is separated from the bone. The soup is almost like beef stew soup. This dish is not special enough to worth for the price you paid. I have better. 

This is about 3.5 stars restaurant but not quite there. However, I do give them the first consideration instead of casino food court.
Enjoyed our meal, service was good.  Blackened drum was tasty.  The restaurant was recommended to us and did not disappoint
Food is very good...the original restaurant which was across the street had a bigger menu...missing is their wonderful Sweet Potato Souffle...it is a little pricey.

This place has amazing West Indian food. The roti and doubles taste just like the ones in Trinidad. It's hard to find places that give you that true home taste but this place does it. I would recommend the Parata roti with you choose your West Indian (caribbean) food.
This is our neighborhood market. It's usually well stocked and clean. When we lived in California we used to shop at Safeway. Sorry Publix, Safeway is much better.

These folks have been around for decades. I remember taking my dad in the wee hours to their station wagon in the 80s/90s (nobody came to the tiny town where we lived). They are still the only reasonably priced option in S. Jersey for airport runs. They've moved into the 21st century since my dad used them, with comfortable vans and credit card options. And the dispatchers know the area well, which is good since my mom's house can be tricky to find. As the only game in town, they could easily be awful & still have customers. But I've found Rapid Rover to offer reliable, on-time service.

I used Josh to install my dishwasher and gas stove.  It was a last minute call, and he made arrangements to come out the next day.  His quote was competitively reasonable.  The install went smoothly, and he cleaned up once he was done.  I was quite impressed with his professionalism and work ethic.  I would highly recommend him.  Thanks so much for your prompt service.

I love to shop at thrift and consignment shops when I travel. It's fun to get the local vibe. This store is WAY over my budget and don't shop designer so the price/ name value is lost on me. However, I concur with other reviews. I was not talked to at all the whole time I was in the store. They had color coded sale tags that were confusing and no one offered to explain them.  Maybe they could tell I couldn't afford their prices.

We went to Zorbas for Fri night dinner. We went to hear the band , Ron and the Classics. They were good... Quality voices and fun environment. One of the men came over to demonstrate how to dance with a glass of wine on his head... He was charming and unbelievably graceful. The food was great. Server was friendly and efficient. The grouper was fabulous. The chicken was so tender... and the sauce was light and yummy. I had never tasted smelt .. It was good and I would love to have it again . The room was beautifully set up and elegant... They had a stunning bar... Drinks were good... But beware the Greek after dinner drink... It's lovely but really strong ! It's Ouzo and they showed us how to ice it and enjoy it. It is our first time there and we plan to return .

Very cute and trendy frozen yogurt joint but expensive and have a very limited selection of flavor. When I went last time they only had the basic flavors and less than 9 flavors. Ok if u want just strawberry or vanilla yogurt but not if u want more unique flavors.
never allow Edward Hughes & Sons into your home.  NEVER!!! Not honest and will report you to City Hall.

I wanted to try Filipino food for awhile and I didn't know any around the area. Luckily my friend told me about Manila cafe. I had no idea this place existed. My family and I went to try it out. The food was pretty decent, it's sorta like mall food court style. The halo halo is a definitely must try. It's pretty good. Overall average place to grab a quick lunch or dinner.

The food was average, it was just plain. The bar was busy and there was no room for us to sit during the lunch time, they said big party is coming so they even closed out half of seating area. So we decided to order take out, it took over 30 minutes to get crabcake sandwich, order of fries and warm grill chicken salad. Chicken was overcooked and no taste and so as crabcake, it was over cooked and dry as well. No parking. I saw bunch college students in the place. I would not have gone there if it was not for Groupon.
Wasn't able to find what I was looking for today, but the staff was very helpful and friendly. Plenty of convenient parking, nice location.

The whole group is great. I've used them all. I see Dr. Ruth a lot. You are sick, they get you in. They are fast and efficient and if you are ever admitted to the hospital like I was, they coordinate your care. Been going there for 5-6 years now. Wife now goes and I am getting her mother to go. My mom and dad go as well.

This place offers an incredible assortment of beers where you self serve and pay by the ounce via a computerized bracelet system. For me, I'd rather interact with a real bartender real person than pour my own drinks but to each his own! The dark beer I had was tasty. If you want to try an ounce of this and an ounce of that, this is a good place to enjoy variety!

When you come to Philly and want the delicious, stuff-your-gut Mom-and-Pop cheesesteak experience, come here.  Heads, shoulders, knees and toes above anything Quiznos or Subway might throw at your mouth.  It's in a strip mall, get over it.  This is a cultural experience.

These things are freaking huge, made from quality ingredients and deliciousness.  Order the cheesesteak with onions, peppers, and sauce.  The sauce is house-made marinara which goes surprisingly well with the rest.  I ordered the regular size and was able to eat the whole thing.  And I'm not a big guy, but it filled me up... way up.  Go hungry.

My new favorite movie house.Our first experience was a Girls only day for "Life of the Party". Reclining seats with menus already seatside. We ordered food (popcorn only for me), drinks and food. Pure decadence as we howled our way through this very funny Melissa McCarthy film. Payment by cash or credit card all handled by our food server.

These People are extortionists...They towed my car when it was parked legally on the street. There was a guy standing on the street saying he works for the tow company and said I can get the car back in the morning for $200 or pay $175 and he will come right back because its still on the truck and on the way to the lot. They were parked around the corner on the street. When the tow truck came back he slammed my car down, damaging the axle and the under carriage. Be aware of the signs around northeast philly for A Bob's towing they are the vermin of this city.

This has been on my bucket list for a really long time and it absolutely lived up to my expectations.  Though I hadn't heard of a single soul who stepped on that stage, and even though I went BY MYSELF, I still had the time of my life and will be adding it to my itinerary every time I'm in Nashville from now on.  Totally worth the price of admission!

Tip: If you're going along, spring for a front row seat.  It's amazing.

I had broken ankle so came here on 6/5/15 having been transferred from Renown Regional hospital.  Lifecare is clean with nice outside landscaping.  I worked with a good physical therapist who had me up using a walker and doing exercise too.  The food was just ok.  One problem is the nurse to patient ratio is 15:1.  There are more CNA's than nurses.   The doctor, Dr. Jullian, never visited me on 6/6/15.  I did not
get my pain meds on time.  I wanted to go home the evening of 6/6/15.  No doctor
to be found, but the supervisor finally oked my discharge.  I could have stayed one 
week, but I felt I could manage well at home, and I am,

   As I said, the nurse to patient ratio is a big problem.  Last year I was in Renown Medical Center for 6 weeks with a deadly staff infection.  After 5 days, I was solicited
by Dr. Jullian of Life care to transfer to his facility (lifecare).  He showed up in my room unannounced and unwelcome.  Dr. Jillian actually "solicited" me to transfer to his Life care facility.  Even after I got in his face and said "no!" he still stood there.  Finally he left.

   Upon discharge on 6/6/15 I received prescriptions.  Dr. Jillian was nowhere to be found.  I took the Px to Walgreens and the Pharmacist declared all prescriptions were invalid due to no date on the Px!!   The next two days were spent with Walgreens and myself calling Dr. Jillian and leaving messages at Life care, a rehab facility.and his cell.  No return calls!!  Finally I reached him today.  He said to have his staff add a date to the prescriptions.  Walgreens said that was against the law.  So. Jillian told me to" take the Px to another pharmacy!"

   It was obvious to me that Dr. Jillian didn't respect me, nor did he respect the Walgreens pharmacy manager!  I then got Medicare involved. They made a few calls and Dr. Jillian finally showed respect to a government agency!  Needless to say,
I have no kind words for Dr. Jillian, who solicited my business, didn't take care of his patient, and refused to do the right thing with regards to my prescriptions...instead trying to take the easy way out and circumventing the law!  

   For Life care facility, I would give them 3+ stars if they had a better nurse to patient ratio...say 8 to 1.  There PT and OT dept are good.  Just don't get involved with Dr. Jillian!

This is one of the few times where hype meets reality.   First timer yesterday and got a regular pizza (half pepperoni half onion/peppers) and it was outstanding.   Perfect.    Thin crust but had a heft to it, if that makes sense.   You should definitely try this place.

I'm now craving the white pizza with pancetta I read about that I'll be getting this weekend.

This place is so good! We have been here twice today and we are going to be back st 11 pm to see the DJ. Shadoe, Nik and Jamie were so amazing, I had an amazing time with them!!! Really amazing costumer service, they all went above and beyond !!! Coming back in a few hours.

We visited domino's I ordered BEFORE 10 I pull up at 10:03 & a mean big MF comes out & says curb side is over @ 10 he didn't greet us or anything I hate rude businesses please do better ! this happened on 12/9 or 12/10 horrible

My husband and I stopped by for breakfast as this place had such great Yelp reviews during our trip to Boise! I had the breakfast sandwich, and he had a spicy breakfast sandwich. Both were delicious! Service was awesome, and all the staff working here were super friendly and nice. We would definitely eat here again next time we are in Boise!

This is about Walgreen's in general. BUT there is more info to come about this particular store and the checkout clerk.

My oldest son and I stopped in here today to get a soda, and I needed distilled water. This is a less-than-$15 purchase.

At checkout, the clerk asked if I was a Walgreen's reward member.

Ridiculous. I just signed up last night.

So, I said yes, entered my info (which, BTW, is your telephone number -- nothing sacred), and with this measly purchase, got 500 points on my account.

My understanding (neophyte as I am), is with every 5000 points, you get a $5 reward.

That may sound far away. HOWEVER, with each weekly ad (and more values available to see online when you're registered), it could be pretty darned easy to get to 5000 points.

This week's online circular offers bonus points (like 3000 extra points) for particular purchases. You would not see these online offers if you weren't a Walgreen's reward member. Well, maybe you could see them, but you couldn't cash in on them.

This took NO paper. I don't have a Walgreen's card. And I've seen ads that say "with card," something I never understood.

So, there are sales that you can't access unless you have the reward card. I've mentioned this before visiting another Walgreen's, like the one near Lafayette Square. The in-store ad says, "With Card." I never knew what that meant until today.

So, unless you have the reward card, you cannot participate in some of these great savings! Like 3 12-packs of Coca-Cola products for $10. Can't do, if you aren't "with card."

NOW I GET IT!

So here's the info on the checkout clerk. I told her I just signed up last night, and I did not think any of my purchases were "reward card" worthy. She said, "Put your number in." So I did.

Then, with patrons waiting to be checked out, she quickly but patiently described the entire reward program to me so that I understood it, so valiantly she did this -- without a bother to the line. But not disregarding it, mind you.

I should have gotten her name! She was glorious! And all with a smile and "Have a great weekend!"

We ate at Catch 23 on the 12th of October at about 7pm until 830pm. The food itself was not that bad--perfectly acceptable. However, the service was absolutely the worst service we have ever seen since we moved to the Brandon, Florida area in 2003. We ate at the new Catch 23 Fishhawk location in Lithia, Florida.

Our "server" was Nikki who, as it turned out, was actually the manager or so she said. Oddly, all the other servers were dressed appropriately in uniforms and aprons and closed toed shoes. Nikki on the other hand was in jeans, flip flops and some raggedy shirt. Her demeanor, speech and presentation was quite frankly awful.

While we tolerated this poor service during dinner because we were with another couple, when we tried use the coupon that we purchased from Catch 23's website she would not honor it because she said we had to print it off. Of course, the coupon has a 3D barcode which is specifically designed to be used with smartphones and smartphone cameras precisely because you do not need to print them off. Additionally, it was very clear that we purchased the coupon just that day so why not just honor the coupon regardless?

At any rate, Nikki was argumentative, defensive and all around rude. And just to ensure that anyone reading this does not think that we are just complaining to get a free meal or a discount, we don't want a damn thing. I'll even eat the cost of the coupon that we paid $10 for $25  and could not use. We simply will not return to that place. Furthermore, why was the "manager" serving us anyway. Anyone who is familiar with the restaurant industry knows that managers who wait on tables are basically stealing money from their servers.

The saddest part of this entire fiasco is that this is the restaurant's new Fishhawk location in Lithia. This location depends on Fishhawk residents for its business because it is located right in the middle of the development and Lithia is not located near any other development or town such that anyone would drive into Fishhawk to eat out.

This particular location has been host to about 4 other restaurants and apparently Catch 23's ownership is not aware that in order to be successful, with an Outback just around the corner, is to outperform with customer service. Nikki is not only a poor excuse of a "manager" but she will, single-handedly, ensure that Catch 23 essentially goes out of business.

I have taken both my children to Champagne Family Dentistry since they began their pediatric services. I have gone there for over 25 years!  I love this dentist.  The pediatric service is also great.  My kids both love to go to the dentist! (How many people can say that?) Dr. Champagne and the hygenists are all kind and caring and the facility is state of the art.  I can't say enough great things about Champagne Family Dentistry.  The other post here just baffles me because this has never been my experience here and I have been here a lot - between me, my husband and my two children.  The service must be quality too, neither child, ages 7 and 9 has ever had a cavity!
Ok...Use to really like the Island Chicken.  Last couple times seemed like it was cooked frozen.  Didn't taste or have the texture of chicken.

An ol' back Bay joint that really needs updating.
Lacking any ambience, just another wooden deck/dock joint on the Inter Coastal Waterway.
Service was a bit sloppy/slow.
Food:  Choices & taste were average.
We have little desire to return.

I really wanted to like this place, like a lot. The location is convenient, the store is beautifully appointed and the staff is friendly. So what's the problem? The food. This place is all about the cone, heck, it's the name. But you want to know the worst thing about this place? The cones. There's nothing special about the cones. It's not quite pizza crust...it's just unflavored dough. Beyond that, all three cones by friend and I ordered all had holes in them which made them impractical. The pizza was nothing to write home about and the process takes forever. We were the only two in line and it still took about 7 minutes for our two dinner cones to be ready. Then, for dessert I was super excited to try their partnership with the STIL for an ice cream cone. However the cone ruined the dessert. It's the same unflavored dough as the pizza, still had holes in it, and it was served warm which melted the ice cream instantly. I feel bad saying this, but everything here would be better coneless. Excellent idea, and it CAN be executed properly (here's looking at you Cozy Cone inside California Adventures) however this place, as is, is not worth the money or calories.

If you are used to antique malls with lots of booths and "smalls", you will be disappointed.  It is a huge warehouse that is hot and dank.  If you are looking for eclectic furniture, then it would be worth your time.

I've been here twice now and both times were delightful.

They have a nice facility. There's a ladies locker room with lockers & keys for you to put all of your belongings in. I find this to be a nice touch. They provide you with a robe and sandals. I much prefer a spa like this with a nice relaxing waiting area than something corporate where they rush you in and out. 

Both massages I had were great. I tried a hot stone for the first time with Andrea and it was amazing. I would recommend it to anyone. I've also gotten my nails and toes done here. Both done well. There aren't TVS or anything like that in the nail area, which I like, because it allows you to just sit and talk with people rather than staring at a screen! Jacke, the woman who did my nails, was also amazing. 

Try this place out! They have great package deals and complimentary hot tea!
Delicious meal, wide variety of smoked meat options and yummy side dishes.  Family friendly in a very casual environment.  Best brisket I've ever had!

I'm not to sure what to say about this place. Too bad I can't give a no star rating. I've been bringing my dog here for several years. It seems like the pet care is getting worse. I used to bring her to pet smart to get groomed, however I stopped years ago due to suspected abuse. Anyways, through pet smart is how I learned about Banfield pet hospital. 

The doctors and assistants seem really nice, however  I am not pleased with the overall care. I have the wellness plan, so our visits are usually almost free. That's the only thing I love about the place. I

I noticed my dog had a limp about three weeks ago. I brought her in as a drop off, a few hours later I got a call from one of the doctors stating that she has some inflammation and medicine should help. The doctor then told me I could come in to get my dog. Once I arrived I spoke with the doctor and she explained the medication then my dog was brought out. Her hind legs were covered in urine....I just thought maybe she was nervous and went on her self. I let it slide. 

Fast forward to today's appointment. I noticed she still had the limp and it had in fact got worse. I dropped her off and like before, the doctor called me a few hours later explaining their findings and informed me that she was ready to be picked up. When I arrived I spoke with an assistant who explained what medications she would be going home with today then brought her out shortly. Once again my baby was covered in urine and she smelled horrible. She told me my dog went to the bathroom on herded just before I picked her up. So that means other than being checked by the doctor she was caged and didn't go out to the bathroom all day. 

I am highly disappointed and I may never take my dog back to this Banfield location ever again. I don't recommend anyone to bring their pets here. I will take my dog to the next nearest Banfield for now on.

I joined the [solidcore] family as a New Years Resolution to become stronger and live a more healthy and fit life. I have been a cross-fitter, runner, spin enthusiast prior, and I can truly say that this workout is unlike any other I've been to. I'm now almost 20 classes in, I attend class 3-4 times per week, and absolutely love the workout and all the coaches downtown Indy.  Every coach makes an effort to know your name, know you, and genuinely cheer you on during class, as well as notice your improvements and increasing strength. 50 minutes under the blue lights at solidcore is challenging and you always leave with the shakes (these are a good thing)! My goal for the year was not to lose weight, and that is the reason I chose not to join a gym (full time) that focuses on HIIT.  For anyone wanting to try the gym out your first workout is free, and the downtown location is always offering packages, events, and games to make solidcore more fun, engaging, and create a community.

Being a Drexel Hill resident always on the look out for Asian fare, I decided to try out this new Vietnamese restaurant. I had tried to get in on opening day but was turned away since they were not taking any customers that night. It was only 9 PM! Reading thru the other reviews, I see the restaurant was not well prepared that night which is acceptable I guess.

I finally visited the restaurant last evening with another friend of mine who is considered by many of our friends to be a connoisseur of Vietnamese cuisine. We were greeted promptly and seated at our table. We were then presented with menus and alerted that the items that were highlighted were not available at the time. We noticed that quite a few items were highlighted! We ordered a combination appetizer (~$17) with items that were recommended by the staff. My friend then ordered a staple entree that he uses to compare the quality of the food. I proceeded to order one of my favorite Vietnamese dishes. We both agreed that the combination appetizer was a good call and the quality & quantity was good too. We graded the appetizer a solid "A".  The entrees were OK. I thought the quantity of mine was somewhat less to what I get at other Vietnamese restaurants. My friend thought his entree lacked flavor and that he got one bad cut of Pork out of the two cuts he got. Overall, we graded the entrees "C". We also ordered ice coffee which was ok but would have liked them to have served it the traditional way or given us the option as to which way we wanted them served.

Overall - I would recommend this restaurant to my friends. I know it's new and hopefully thru reviews like this they will continue to improve. The staff was very friendly and courteous. They should have a good future given the location and the lack of Vietnamese cuisine in that area.

Coming from an area that has a mall that could fit inside my closet, this was a nice change. It was still kind of basic, but it had a lot of bigger stores I needed. It wasn't that crowded, even for the weekend before Christmas! 

The security on site was plentiful, so I'm not sure if it is a bad area or not- but it was nice to see them. I didn't see any hooligans or anything, so that was good! 

Parking lot was large and didn't feel completely crowded/far away.

Arguably the most popular brewery in the Nashville area, we drank our fair share of Yazoo beer while here. Yazoo Gerst became a go-to beer us. Upon wearing that one out, I also drank a decent amount of Dos Perros. We got adventurous during one of our visits to the brewery and tried some type of Red Wine Sour, that was very difficult to drink. 
For more brewery info visit: travelptswithacraftbeerproblem.wordpress.com

Our first time at Cheddars and we were both impressed with their staff, service and the food! 
We had a group of 22 to be served. They weren't told of our arriving by early shift, but had an area set up quickly for us. 

The wait was minimal and the servers 
were great! The drink orders were quick to arrive, and the food orders were taken fast.

I ordered the bacon wrapped shrimp over rice with bourbon sauce, and a loaded baked potato which was superb! My wife had the Better than Moms meatloaf, could it ever be?  Mashed potatoes, and Mac and cheese. 

She loved it all and that shocked me. If you knew her you would understand my statement(picky)shhhhh!

Two pain killer alcoholic drinks for her and only iced tea for me. We didn't drive, me or her!

We were impressed, and the girls on the staff were  gorgeous, and super stars!

We had a bruschetta cheessteak and a chicken chessesteak Italiano this morning for BREAKFAST! That is how awesome these sandwiches are! These are the absolute best steaks in Philly!!! Whenever my bosses visit from NYC we send out for John's. Even my "food-critic" oldest son loves them! Two thumbs up AND five stars!

This has become our family's go to place in Santa Barbara. We've got a range of age groups in our family and everyone is happy in this environment. We try to go in between the busiest times because the line can be long. The food is outstanding and the salsa choices exquisite. The service is absolutely delightful. Everyone is polite, helpful, efficient, and might I add, very good looking. My favorite dishes include the Chicken Mole, Chile Relleno (the best I've ever had), the homemade tortillas, and as I said before-- great salsa! I'm working my way through menu and savoring every moment. Easy to get to, up a bit off the Milpas exit, I can jump up here and get right back on the freeway going to or from the SB area. I just love it!

I just love Ana's counter to my review. Wow!  Here's a crazy idea Ana ... stop cheating your customers and you won't have to worry about all of the bad reviews. 

Consistently you will see the majority of the reviews for Jensen saying exactly the same thing. They low ball the estimate and then jack up the price when they have your stuff locked up in the truck. 

Ana also mentions BBB as a better place to see how her company operates. Yes, please do that. You will see the same exact set of complaints from customers. 

DON'T JUST WALK AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY ... RUN!  Absolutely terrible!!  I would give it ZERO stars if that was possible.

Love this place. Been eating here for years. "B" and his magic hands makes the best calzone in the galaxy. Very good and has a nice bold marinara. Got to love our local restaurants!!! Stop by for lunch for great specials.

Driving through Tucson and saw this place had good reviews. Totally authentic and very reasonably priced. I had the carne and eggs plate and it did not disappoint. Portion size was large and friendly staff. Nuff said.

First time here, service was mediocre. I got the PB&J burger (bison) which was 7/10, was not at all disappointed. There are great selections of local craft beers to choose from if you're into that. Their ice creams and shakes tho were amazing, and definitely can't be skipped!

Authentic Afghani Cuisine that will leave you speechless!
I tried the lamb kabuli pulao and it was splendid! Try it with yogurt cucumber & mango lassi.

Very great place for a philly style steak or hoagie.  Located in Painters Crossing Shopping Center next to the dollar store.

I have ordered the small (12") cheese steak. I have noticed that when I am done there is no grease dripping out. The fries where crispy and again lacks the grease.
I will  e back and  will bring others.

I love going to Serena! She is a hair wizard and has been helping me grow out my hair over the last 8 years, and when I go for a trim, she does exactly that and let's me keep length! She helped me lift years worth of box dye black, got me to a lovely ombré and didn't get too mad at me when I coloured it back to black again...

Let me start by saying that we have been looking around the city to support black owned businesses so when we saw this place, we wanted to check it out. We walked nearly 40 minutes in this hot weather to support you only to be given shitty service. 

The waitress didn't actually seat us just pointed at a table to go to. We sit and she doesn't come take our DRINK order for a good 20 minutes. I wanted a lemonade, but apparently they were out of that, whatever things happen.

Several minutes later, she calls to us saying, "I just need to get these people their drinks and I'll be right back to take your order."...she doesn't come back for another 15-20 minutes. We eventually get our drinks and she finally takes our order. In which case they were also out of mashed potatoes, she thinks...didn't actually check.

We look around and people who came in well after us were promptly seated and their orders were taken and received their food and drinks fairly quickly which was obviously annoying as we've now been here at least half an our with nothing. Also, another table with a larger group was offered bread with all smiles and light banter and still we got nothing....getting kinda mad at this point. 

Now I've been sitting here for an HOUR and she finally comes back and says, "I don't remember which one of you ordered the red beans, but we're out of them." My problem wasn't with the fact that they didn't have them, but the fact that she waited half an hour after I ordered to tell me that and offers me butter beans instead because "they're better anyway." Now I'm more annoyed.

Another 10 minutes pass and we finally get our food. The mac and cheese was cold, butter beans I didn't really want were luke warm, but at least the chicken was hot... -__-

The flavors of everything were ok, but nothing I would scream about...

My last straw was when the waiter, after all this time of being lackadaisical, decides she will PROMPTLY bring us the check like she is rushing us out of her, reaches over us to put it on the table, and runs over to the other table with big smiles and is asking if they needed anything else or would like dessert. Bitch, I actually wanted to order dessert, but seeing as I couldn't get the same treatment as others, I didn't get any...soooo you didn't make as much money as you could have on the meals and you certainly weren't getting a tip. Sorry, not sorry. It's a shame too because I had a wad of cash in my pocket and I'm ALWAYS willing to tip 25% or more. 

I don't know her name, because she didn't speak more than 4 lines of dialogue to us, but to the owners, she ruined our experience here and lost you some money.

What a find! I have been driving by this place almost daily but never bothered to even look at the menu. I found the description a bit strange. I think the sign says Asian American food. I had jury duty across the street so I decided to try it for lunch.  For lunch, they have numerous Thai options (one of my favorite cuisines), American style sandwiches and fries and a cute espresso bar. I ordered the pad see ew, it was DELICIOUS! The best I've had in a very long time. It was so good I went back 2 days later. I tried the pad Thai and basil rice. Also very, very good. Best Thai by far in this area! My husband tried the chicken sandwich and bbq wrap. Both very good. They also serve breakfast. Prices are reasonable and fair too. Only downside is they close before dinner most days.

Reno, NV location was amazing. I placed two
orders for my son's wedding. They called about a week before to make sure everything was correct. On day of pickup, even though they were busy one of the girls took time to help us out to the car with the order. Also, the cakes were amazing.
seriously a ONE hour and 15 min. show with Diana Ross last night for over a hundred dollars!!!  Ruth Eckerd is starting to really cross the line of ripping off the public.. NOT HAPPY

My quest to eat at every Dot's location is now complete. If you're looking for a classic diner with good, reasonably priced, food find yourself any of Dot's five locations.

In case you were not aware, I am a ridiculous human being. A while back one of my co-workers suggested we get breakfast for lunch and that Dot's is where we should go. We went, and it was great. That is when we decided we should visit every location and see which is the best. 

When we first decided to hit every location we made a huge miscalculation. We thought all of the Dot's were in Jefferson Parish. It wasn't until we went online that we saw St. Charles had it's own location in beautiful Luling. I don't get to Luling very often so the trip here was made specifically to eat at Dot's. 

From the looks of the place, it must have been a different business before becoming a Dot's. It is right next to a hotel on beautiful Hwy 90 and is very easy to get to.

Service was among the most friendly of all the locations. They could tell we were new as most of the other customers seemed to be long time regulars. That didn't stop them from treating us great and making sure we left happy.

The food here was, like the rest of the locations, very good. I'd go so far as saying it's the best breakfast I've ever had in St. Charles Parish other than crosandwichs with my dad on the way to fishing as a kid. 

This visit ended my quest to try every Dot's. I'd rank this location as #5 only because it is so far from my normal stomping grounds. But you can bet that the next time I am in Luling, I will be eating here.

This place is convenient if you live in north Reno.... and that's where my compliments end unfortunately. We ordered chow mein, house tofu, and sweet end sour pork. Everything tasted like it was cooked and then all the seasoning was washed away. So bland. So soggy. If you're up in the area, try Egg Roll King on Lemmon. It's cheap Chinese food that isn't great, but much better than this.

It isn't often that I find food that needs nothing. I try to objectively assume that there is always room for improvement.
Plenty has shattered that belief and ruined me for all other sandwiches ever. When I say that I wept as I ate their Tasso Ham Panini, it is no exaggeration. It was by all means and without a doubt the best sandwich I've ever eaten. I didn't want it to end.
It will be a dangerous life I lead from now on, what with having them right down the block.
So I'm back for dinner and I have the Brisket Panini, and it is like having an out of body experience. I can hear no sounds while eating it. Nothing can penetrate the wave of bliss I'm feeling. I want everyone I know to try this, I want to shout it from the rooftops!
PLENTY IS HERE, NEVER HAVE AN AVERAGE SANDWICH AGAIN!!!!

Everything is locally sourced. The meats are cured, butchered and prepared in house. The sauces are all made in house. Unbelievable.
After the Brisket, I can't understand for the life of me why anybody would waste their money at Geno's or Pat's for a boring old cheesesteak, when they can have the Holy Grail of beef and bread right here at Plenty.

Thank you, for bringing your amazing culinary creations into my life.

This is a favorite restaurant for family birthday dinner celebrations. Whenever we cannot decide on a place, someone always suggests Redstone and we are never disappointed. We have been here a handful of times now -- its nothing special, but everything everything is always delivered well and has great flavor. There is also something for everyone on the menu. I have heard many people complain about the prices here, but I think it is reasonable for what you are getting. It is an above average chain restaurant that has a huge happy hour following. 

I have always been impressed with the jerk chicken fondue appetizer, the buffalo shrimp, the flatbreads, the wedge salad, the prime rib sandwich, the MEATLOAF, and the warm chocolate chip cookie sundae. My absolute favorite item on the menu is the meatloaf, barbecue style. I have been ordering this entree for many years now and I am never disappointed. The meatloaf has so much flavor and is always served with great sides. I have now suggested the meatloaf to many people, and they have all been pleasantly surprised at how good it is. 

I would recommend this for a great family dinner at a reasonable price. They also have a great outdoor space with a firepit!

The service in this place is terrible. I walked in to order a sandwich to-go and there was no one in the front desk taking orders or seating anyone. After standing there for 5 minutes (with drinking patrons staring at us) we ventured toward the back bar to order sandwiches. A young man operating the register clearly hates working there - he doesn't say anything welcoming, barely even asks me what we want, and when I ask for changes to the order, he looks over me at the next customer behind me. Disgusting! Won't be coming back here anytime soon and you shouldn't either.

I'll start with the single positive - the customer service was excellent and hats off to the restaurant for maintaining good service!  Everybody was very nice and service was rather fast.

It wasn't particularly clean, but it could have been a timing thing because they were very busy. 

But the food, overrated and quite underwhelming. 

My boba had a strange consistency and the duck fried rice was really bland. My spring rolls were overdone and smelled like they had been cooked in old oil.

I did like the steamed dumplings!  They were good but not to die for.  

I do think there's better Thai options in the area.

A good find in an unlikely spot. Fat City isn't know for Mexican, but this spot may change that. Shrimp a la diabola was very good-shrimp poached in a tomato broth. The chicken fajitas were OK. I found the long flat slices of meat to be sort of artificial. I would return, though to try many other things! The ambiance is bright and friendly.

Delicious, Cubans, sandwiches,  tacos, empanadas,  it is all so good!
They are not kidding when they advertise the best Cubans-- sure it comes down to taste, but I have tried several places, and this is definitely one of my favorites!
Cool, old place. It does have a unique odor when you walk in. Smells like Bourbon St. No lights just candles. Come early when it's nice and quiet.

My best friend and I have been coming to this Friday's for the past 5 years, every 3 months or so. Love it! We work late nights during football season and when we get done work, we'll stop by here and have a nice relaxing dinner. We also came here on the day of the mummers parade with my daughter. it was a blast. great service, and great food. the location is perfect for sitting back and watching the day unfold.

If you are in the area on a Saturday Morning, don't miss this!
There is always something interesting to work into your meal plan.
We cooked Country Time Farm burgundy Italian sausage last night and it was delicious.  Also tried some of the birchrunville farms smoked blue cheese.  Really good !

This place is great because it's open until very late at night. I often stop by to grab one, for the price comes the quantity. However, from time to time the cashiers tend to take advantage of their customers by over charging them (I guess they think people walking in late are all drunk) and they don't hand you a receipt unless you ask for it.
The airport and executive terminal staff are always helpful and friendly. They do what they can to make sure you have a pleasant experience. I look forward to our bi-annual trips there.
Vanessa is the real deal. Very knowledgeable and compassionate.  She clearly knows her craft and is gifted in drawing the spirits and reading cards.

Went here looking for some nice wine, cheese and atmosphere. Cute place, extensive wine list and pleasant service. Split a cheese/charcuterie plate and had the artisanal greens salad. I had a lovely glass of white wine off their "interesting" list and wasn't disappointed. The waitress was helpful and accurate in describing the wine. Prices weren't exorbitant and location was convenient to my hotel (Loews). I may go back while I'm here for my conference just to have some wine.

We had a good meal. The service was good, but I had to ask 3 times for some lemon for my drink.
Also, the focaccia starter wasn't focaccia, it was flatbread. Tasted good though.
I had a seafood pasta, and the clams had hardly any meat in them. 
Otherwise, we enjoyed our meal very much.

Came here on a Friday date night, and really enjoyed the dining experience, both for the food and the kind family running the restaurant. In true African style, the food took awhile, but it was well worth the wait. They even provided us with an on the house appetizer of deliciously  flavored chicken wings. For our meal, we had the goat curry, which was nicely spiced and the tilapia fillet, which was a tad salty, but who doesn't love salt? The plantains and fried rice (pilau) were our two favorite sides. The atmosphere was great, with African pop music playing from YouTube. For full disclosure, we love Africa, and have been to several countries, including Uganda (where this family is from). We loved the way being at the restaurant reminded us of our times spent abroad, and the how we greeted so warmly.

Tried Oasis for the first time yesterday for a 90 minute massage that was fantastic. They are conveniently located off the I-184. The environment was pleasant; clean, quite and calming. Mandy is an experienced masseuse who will taylor your massage to your needs. For me she combined Shiatsu, deep tissue, hot oils and hot stones techniques perfectly. She was very professional, pleasant and created a very relaxed atmosphere. I highly recommend her.

When I first moved here I did leave a poor review for this place but over time they have improved significantly.  I'm not sure what they changed but I actually have grown to love this place.  My dog has always had seizures but none of the vets wanted to put him on medication until I boarded them here and they witnessed his long seizures and put him on meds.  My dog still gets seizures but not as often and they don't last as long.  The doctor is very understanding about just having labs and exams done once a year for the phenobarbital.  My dogs love the people who take care of them, because whenever I pick them up sheldon doesn't seem to care that I'm there.  But he's usually super excited to see me.  Also if you want to find a good boarding place I recommend this one because I once had to board them somewhere else since they are closed on the weekends and when I picked up my dog Leonard he was crying in pain and when I took him to the ER they said it looked like someone had kicked him hard and that's why he's in constant pain whenever he walks or jumps.  He also got an ear infection at the other boarding place.  I highly recommend boarding your pets here because you know that they will be taken care and safe.

Funky crowd and good, but not yet great beers. 

The awesome part of visiting ITLB is the lake view. It is outstanding.

Service is quite good.

Selection is good, though I do want to see a crisp summer collection such as a crushable summer ale, helles, or even a shandy. 

I will definitely be back & look forward the the evolution of this brewer's art.
Decisions decisions...too many yummy choices to choice from. Got the Baklava cake and it was so good!

We have avoided this place like the plague because people said it was bad.  Well they were all wrong, it was great.  We went in on Saturday for dinner because it was on the way home.  There is nothing special about the décor, but you cant eat that so I don't care.  The first pleasant surprise was the one man band in the corner.  I know what you are thinking loud and obnoxious (I was thinking the same thing) but it was a young girl that sang very soothing music that fit the mood my family was looking for.  The second surprise is an kids menu that fits the generic American child's food pallet, both my kids got chicken nuggets.  

FOOD:
Crab Salad - Going into to this I thought it would be like Wasabi's crab salad, but I was wrong again.  It was a sweet vinegar dressing that was very refreshing.  It was a great way to cleans and prep the pallet before the other items.
Crab Rangoon's - Some of the best in town.  They were very light and fluffy and filled with crab.  You heard me correctly it was filled with crab!  It was probably around that 40% crab instead of your usual 5-10% crab.  My daughter even loved them because they had an actual crab flavor.
Sushi - Sunburn Roll - This is a simple and inexpensive roll with lots of flavor.   It is a California roll with spicy sauce on top and backed under the broiler I think.  It had a slightly smocked flavor that was enjoyable.
Sushi - Nitro - This is a big roll so you better have a big mouth.  It is a spicy tuna roll topped with avocado, tuna, crab, crunch, bonito, shredded nori & spicy mayo.  This roll was refreshing and surprisingly light.  The waitress suggested both rolls and she was right on the money.

So if you are looking for a new sushi place over by the lake you should try this place, we will be going back.
Best shrimp and grits ever!!! Great service, wouldn't pass up a chance to eat breakfast here!!!
So good Best fish and chips I had in a longtime. So glad o came here. The owner was very nice

This  IHOP deserves zero stars. We (interracial family) came in for breakfast and the host says that the wait would be 5-10 mins. Was the place busy? No. We then watch him seat another couple (white) while we continued to wait. The table we were eventually sat at was never even occupied. Strike 1.

Next, the host comes over and asks for our drink order. He takes my wife's drink order and my two kids', then turns and walks away without taking mine. At that point I began to take notice of the situation. My wife is Hispanic and the entire crew of this IHOP was as well. I am the only Black person in the restaurant. When the host comes back with their drinks, he still doesn't ask for my drink order so I told him what I wanted. Apparently he didn't like that. Strike 2.

Instead of returning to the table with my drink, the host turns us over to a different guy. He brings our drinks, takes our food order and leaves. The food comes, we eat, and the waiter never once returns to check on us or to refill drinks. The food was mediocre at best and we'd had enough so I asked the waiter as he walked by for the check. He nodded his head and walked on. He walked by again 5 mins later and when he sees me looking to him for the check, he tells me that someone else will be bringing it to me. After several more minutes, I see him standing behind the line whispering with what appeared to be the manager. They both continued to stare my way. After nearly 15 mins of dealing with this, the waiter finally brings the check. Strike 3. 

I definitely felt that I was being mistreated at this IHOP because of my skin tone. If you don't want me here, then bring me my check when I ask for it. Let me pay and leave. It was just devilish behavior. I will NEVER bring my family to this IHOP again!

Mango was the very first restaurant I visited on a recent trip to St. Louis. This was actually a huge mistake on my part, because all the other restaurants I visited for the rest of the week couldn't help but pale in comparison.

Can I just tell you how much I loved this restaurant? The atmosphere is warm and inviting but the decor is airy and chic (I covet the light fixtures). The plantain chips brought to our table were an unexpected and pleasant surprise - even better, they were periodically refilled! I'm not sure what the dipping sauce was - some kind of pureed salsa verde-like concoction - but it was fantastic.

To start, my co-worker and I split a well-priced bottle of Sauvignon Blanc (which was quite good) and the empanadas (also very good). For dinner, my co-worker raved about her Pescado a la Macho. I had a terrible time deciding on a main course since everything on the menu looked exciting and interesting, but eventually I chose a scallop special over sweet potatoes which was terrific. Sadly, neither one of us could make it to dessert.

We had such a great experience here, I was shocked at how reasonably priced everything was. I would return in a heartbeat - this was one of my favorite meals in St. Louis!

The service at Blacktop can't be beat! We walked in the door and were warmly greeted by the cashier. She answered all of our questions and made great suggestions. We got the elote and chips and a Sonoran dog. The elote was excellent!

I typically enjoy Round Table Pizza at home. I've been to this location in the Grand Sierra Resort before and decided to give them another try last night. Pizza was good. It was fresh and hot, though a bit skimpy on the toppings, hence only four stars. Service was friendly. I was particularly impressed by the young man out front. We sat in the dining room, which was clean, and I could hear his interactions with other patrons. He was friendly and pleasant towards everyone.

Last night my husband took me to Chart house for our 3rd year anniversary.  Chart house printed a special menu for us that said wishing us a happy year 3 Anniversary, which I that was pretty cool to personalize a special day for us.  The manager also stopped by to say Happy Anniversary to us.  Already off the bat, I liked them. 
 
The food was pretty good.  We started off with the Tuna apptz, the kim chi salad that came with it, was really good.  I really enjoyed the kim chi slaw, it went well with the tuna. I had the grouper topped with crab meat, suggested by the server.  She sold me even though, I barely eat fish.  It was good though.  I was sad that my tummy wasn't feeling all that well or I would have killed it.  My husband got the seafood mix platter, which looked really good.  I'm not a big seafood fan, so selections were a little hard for me. 

Finally the dessert that I heard great things about, the hot lava cake.. it was good, but I think Chilis does a better job and for a better price.

The place is very nice, but it was slow when we went.  Maybe 5 tables when we were there... hmm?
Very good lunch special, 2 rolls, soup and salad for $9.99.  Fresh fish, excellent service and a contemporary vibe.  Definitely recommend.
Cool neighborhood hang, consistently great homemade food! 37206ers support unique local businesses!

You either love it or hate it.  I LOVE it.  "It" being their pizza.  I've never actually tried anything else in the almost 30 years I've been ordering from Marrone's.  

The people on here who don't like it have described it accurately (in terms of the cheese going beneath the sauce, etc), but there is SOMETHING about it that I happen to love.  And I know I'm not alone.. this place has been in business foreverrrr and only just started accepting credit cards very recently! Oh, and no delivery.  So obviously they're doing something right to remain in business (and busy) for so long.  

Again, it's love or hate.  For me, it's true love.  Gotta try it to know!

My favorite breakfast spot !! The food always tastes the same when I go here which is why it's a place I frequent . The staff is always great ! The food comes out in a great amount of time, I just love everything about kekes breakfast cafe! The prices are extremely reasonable as well.

I like this coffee shop. I visited it every day I was in NoLa at a conference, and the service was good, and cafe au lait was tasty. They had awesome smelling baked goods, but I mostly stuck with coffee and a bagel to go. overall its a good place to visit in the morning if you're at one of the hotels, and is much better than any of the hotel coffee places

Pleasant, efficient, organized and very professional.  I couldn't have gotten better service this week when I brought my car in to investigate a funny noise.  Turns out I needed brakes and power steering work.  They took the car at my appointment time and within the hour had isolated the issues and presented me with an estimate and an affordable plan to complete the work.  Turns out I could only do the brakes this week.  They did advise me that I could wait a bit for the steering problem but not to wait too long because it could do further damage.  They were kind enough to offer me a ride home and back.  The owner herself actually drove me and alerted me as to what sounds the steering might make should it become critical.  I will be back soon :)

I was very excited to try this place because I heard a lot of people saying that it was the best boba place in Reno but I was very disappointed after my first and only experience.

I ordered a very basic jasmine green tea with no milk and 50% sugar. When I got my order, I was surprised to see a bright green drink-- something that looked like a green tea latte from Starbucks. I asked one of the people working there if I might have ordered the wrong thing but they assured me it was my green tea without milk. I also ordered egg pudding as a topping but got boba in my drink instead. The drink tasted watered down and very sweet, the boba was very hard, and I didn't get any egg pudding :( 

I'm not sure if they messed up my order or misheard me, but I was disappointed that I tried to double-check with them but they insisted that that was my order. After leaving, I looked at other pictures on Yelp and saw others order green tea and it looked like the normal iced green tea that you find everywhere else! Not a milky bright green, but a regular iced tea color.

Definitely won't be coming back.

Food and drinks are consistently delicious. Service is consistently slow and inadequate. Unless you are sitting at the bar, it takes an obscene amount of time to have a server greet you and get drinks while asking for the same thing multiple times before it is successfully brought to you and still incorrect.

I want here for my birthday in the food was really good. I got a plum drink that was decent. The Tonkatsu Ramen was delicious. As well as the fried chicken bonbon bun! We also really enjoyed the rolls we got and  the service was amazing.

As a Californian, I love my fro yo, and I miss Yogurtland more than I can express, but The Island hits the spot well enough.  Many of the flavors don't quite reach what they proclaim to be, tasting instead like nondescriptly sweet frozen stuff, but that's what the sample cups are for, and the flavors rotate frequently.  

The toppings selection is pretty nifty, including a range of crushed candy bars, fruits, cereals, cookies, cookie dough bites, brownie bites, and more.  But who am I kidding?  Half the time, I get fro yo as an excuse to load up on cookie dough bites anyway, so The Island pretty much had me sold on that.

I've never tried the boozy slushies, though, because I live so close to Trops.

If you leave here hungry, it's your own fault! Extremely generous servings including the complimentary basket of corn fritters. I had the catfish/ribs combo and enjoyed every bite. My spouse had a house salad with chicken; the chicken was too seasoned for her taste and the lettuce was somewhat wilted, but our server Noble made it right and comped half the cost of her meal. Definitely worth trying at least once...I'll come back next time I'm in the area.
Hands down best wings in jersey great service awesome hidden gem Monday night yueng n wing special all year long!!!! This place absolute must !!

Spending the long Valentines weekend in Tucson and found this amazing restaurant on Yelp. Started with the pomegranate margarita and the prickly pear margarita. So tasty and served in cute Mason jars. Ordered the guacamole, super tasty. They make their own chips, so that is always a huge win for me. Ordered the 3 taco plate with rice and beans. The shredded beef tacos were so fabulous! They were deep fried which I haven't had in years.  Right when our food came a awesome mariachi band started playing. We topped off our meal with the churro nachos. What a great dining experience for our pre Valentines meal. We will be back again

Great chicken sandwich! I ordered online and it was ready for pick up right away. And it was delicious. The chicken was crispy and flavored. This small burger store is at the back of a bar. You need to get into the bar to find it.

Went here last Friday night and had a chance to listen to some Jazz masters. We were fortunate enough to listen to the Leroy Jones band. The whole experience was quite amazing! I haven't been to any other Jazz places in NOLA so can't really compare. IMO, this place is as authentic as it can get.

Note: There are no restrooms here so make sure you go before the show starts.
They start at 9pm and end at 11pm. If you enter at 9, you can stay until 11 or leave after the first set i.e. at 10.

Finding the place: It can be hard to spot, especially when it's dark and the nearby bright neon lights are ON. The sign is really small and easy to miss. It's located on the West side of St. Peter when facing North towards Bourbon St.

This place is a disheveled cluster f**k. Stopped yesterday for a quick pick up of a cheeseburger, nuggets, and fries. Nothing special. Not a big order. My wife went in and ordered. We waited in the car and watched the drive through backed up to the road. People were pulling out of line and leaving here and there. 15 minutes later my wife comes out with a melting milkshake for my nephew and says everyone is complaining. No food coming out. Goes back in. I saw like 25 cars go through drive through at this point and am getting frustrated. 20 minutes later she comes out fuming. She asked for food and they said they are making it still...she Got a refund and left. We go to burger king and another guy and his daughter we saw at McDonalds were in front of us. My wife said people in the mcdonalds were literally standing around doing nothing as all the customers were complaining. What a joke.

Took the st Charles street car all the way to the last stop from canal and yelp had great ratings for this restaurant. Loved it!! Totally unique and will definitely go back. The restaurant had tables everywhere but they filled up quick. So glad we got there before they opened. The staff is amazing! And their watermelon mojito was simply the best.
Been waiting a while for this place, my sister said it was good. really disappointed, the food was nothing special. probably won't come again.

We love Moody's! The meet is high quality and I feel good knowing it is sourced locally. In March when grocery store shelves were empty, Moody's was fully stocked! The staff are friendly, patient, and willing to share recommendations. Last time we visited, the owner (I think?) came down from the balcony to make wine recommendations based on our preferences and the meat we bought! So thoughtful!

This place surprised me with how large it is inside and the variety of products. Besides fresh pork, chicken, and beef, there is fresh/frozen fish, produce, cheese, sausages, wine, and local products like bread, salsa, sauces, popcorn, maple syrup, ice cream, kombucha... everything. If you are into supporting local businesses, this is a great one stop shop!

Ate here bc it was only a handful of restaurants open late night. Asian cuisine was ok, food nothing great. Good location and atmosphere, a little loud for the younger crowd and the bathroom was unkept. In NOLA, I go for the food which is why this place gets this rating.

I'm a big fan of Middle Eastern cuisine and this place is by far the best I've had in Tucson.  I've been there 3 times and I'll continue to return. The food is authentic, affordable and full of flavor. The restaurant itself is tiny, kind of a hole in the wall type of place. I find that those places often have the best food!

My girlfriend and I have so far had the chicken schwarma plate, falafel, tabbouleh salad, hummus plate w/wo meat, and the baba ghanoush. They are all to die for. If you like garlic their garlic sauce is amazing. Really strong( hot to the taste) because of the amount of puréed garlic. It will leave you with amazing breath for the next 24 hrs. 

Pros: Great flavorful food and friendly staff. The cook even came out from the back to ask what we thought. 
They are also a bakery so all the pita bread that they serve is freshly made. They are right next door to Caravan which is a really cool middle eastern supermarket where you can buy all the spices/seasonings to try and make your own creations at home. 
Cons: Small restaurant. Not much seating. Only one booth and some of the tables are uncomfortably close to each other. They have 2 tables outside but the traffic noise can be an issue. They also don't have real silverware. They use plastic utensils. If your picky about this sort of thing then just get take out. You won't be disappointed by the food!

The restaurant experience we just had was terrible. We chose a table in the back and did not receive menus for over 5 minutes. We then asked for champagne glasses and the waiter took another 5 minutes to come back. He did not bring us any water or offer to take our order during that time. After we were finally able to order, two (our of 4) of of our items came out wrong and he brought us half of our toast untoated, citing roster problems. Some of the food was cold as well. We looked around and everyone else was receiving toasted bread. When we received our bill we saw we were charged for $18 of orange juice. We did not drink all that he brought and we never were asked what size. The menu does not even include that as an option. We also saw that they added a byob fee per person. This is not listed anywhere on the menu and we were never charged this before or notified.
So tasty!!! Best guacamole I've ever had. Love the vibes of this restaurant. Very relaxed, great service and aesthetically pleasing restaurant.

This is the second time I have been here, the first time was flawless and made me eager to come back when it came time to celebrate a personal accomplishment. Tonight has ruined that, and I don't know if I will ever be back or suggest it again. We were walk-ins so we expected a wait, which is fine. What is not fine is the fact that we were told 15-20 minutes when it took 40-45 minutes. It seems like they had forgotten about us because I had to call at the 30 minute mark to ask about our table, and what followed. When we got in, there were two people who had just gotten there for a walk-in. We were sat, only to observe them be seated 5-10 minutes after us. I've worked in the food service industry for over 5 years, so I know there are a lot of factors that go into seating, but the experience was just overall disappointing. I wouldn't have made it so obvious that they forgot about us, and that if you're a walk-in who knows someone, you'll get preferential treatment.

My son loves pizza so we tend to eat pizza often, and I have to say this was the absolute best pizza I've ever had in a very long time. I ordered the chicken Parmesan pizza and a regular pie. The chicken parm pizza was so delicious, saucy and cheesy the way pizza is supposed to be, and the sauce was absolutely fantastic. It had a nice but not overwhelming sweetness with a nice splash of basil. I have to say I normally just eat two slices but I had to go for a third and stop myself after that. I was so very impressed. The service was absolutely fantastic the hostess was very nice and welcoming, even offered to help me bring the pies to the car. Unfortunately, I was visiting the area and don't live in PA otherwise this would be my go to place. But when I visit again I will most definitely be coming back. I only wish they had a pizzeria in NY, people would love it over there too.
It literally smells like the  inside of a sewer in here..... is there a problem you guys can't fix? If not I'd suggest a new location the smell is rancid Aaa's not ok.

Once upon a time in the dusty town in the badlands of Tucson there was a Taco truck on the Corner of Wetmore and a wet Canadian. They had a hot-dog that had been hand made by angels from heaven that sing songs of magical enchantment until the drones of other Sonoran dogs are just considered devil songs. The food here is just like waking up from a long awaited nap after the heat of battle. No more local hot dog chains made famous from a lackluster Food network....just locals bringing the heat on from a truck made from dreams. 

In this dream ...I will make this simple....I work very close to this place. I have been here many times over the last few years. So, they are consistent in their quality. There are other place in town that people think are the best for the famous Sonoran Hot Dog. This place is king of the Sonoran Dog. No one can touch them....kings.

Like mama said knock you out Kings! Asada Tacos, Carmelo's, condiments....all of it is legit. Come here...don't mind the dusty parking lot...this is Tucson. You are allowed to have a concealed carry and the right to super dank Mexican food.

I met friends on a Thursday night the week before Christmas for Happy Hour.  The parking was a hot mess and part of the reason for 3 stars.  They share the lot with another restaurant an it was packed.  I had to park in a dirt remote lot and it was quite the hike.  

Once inside we found great seats at the bar just when you walk in.  The bar stools are comfortable.  We were excited by the happy hour offerings and prices.  It is a good selection of wine, beer and cocktails for a reasonable price (I think $6).  We split 4 appetizers which were also $6 each and just the right size.  

The bartender provided good service.  Not sure I would go for dinner, but it was good for a quick and inexpensive happy hour.  I did not wonder, but heard the outdoor bar and upstairs is pretty cool. Enjoy!

Rare Ethnic Food 26

Pollos A La Brasas - Rotisserie Chicken. The word from Latin language explains it all. Their best dish that should not be miss. This place the food here is very affordable. It located off street from main road Hillsborough. If you come to shop at the Italian market next door, may be plan a visit. 

This restaurant is mom and pop shop. Some of the customers said they move from other place. Their rotisserie chicken has good marinated spice. I would said it is one of the better one in Bay Area. The chicken is well marinated to the bone. It is tender and juicy. The accompanying is the white rice and fresh salad. If they can improve these two items, they may be able to sell better. 

They do have some good looking dessert that we didn't try on this trip. It is definitely worth a shot.

THIS CLUB SUCKS!!! DONT COME HERE!!! They kicked out my overage friends for no reason at all! The bouncer said it was because he was trying to fake a wristband because his got accidentally twisted around. Even though he paid the cover fee and we were already in the club for an hour! Don't come here!! Absolute Trash and waste of money!!!  Bad music from the early 2000s as well. Such a DUMP!

Went with my granddaughtet. I was in record  paradise. Ella,Frankie,Micheal, Stevie all the greats!  The old guy there was a joy.It was dusty, but certainly fit the mood of an old record shop. Even found my Italian music. Will definately be returning.

Absolutely ridiculous good.   Burger bun was super soft and perfectly toasted.  Burger portion was large and great medium rare.  Fried okra were crisp and not over cooked.  Broccoli slaw was yummy.  My wife was totally pleased with the salmon.   We watched the manager go by every table.  This was good because they cared and paid attention to detail.  Winner, go there.

My heart is black for this place. Most incompetent, negligent vet i have ever been too. I have taken a couple of my cats here. The other review wasnt lieing. They give the wrong medicines and not enough supply of it. They also are really hard to reach. If you want a vet that actually cares about your animal this isnt the place.

My Chevy equinox was brand new but having problems with the ABS system. Joel at don brown chevorlet was very attentive to my needs. This place found the problem easily and promptly ordered the new part I needed. Since I was still under warranty, I didn't have to pay a dime! I also was easily able to get a rental car while repairs were being made. These guys are great!

A Nashville staple, and probably still my favorite of any hot chicken joint...regardless of the new, modern setup. (Some people base the quality of their hot chicken on the dive-iness of the restaurant. And that's just stupid.) 

Maybe I'm turning into a pansy, but I used to eat the hot, no problem. Now I cry while eating the mild. Haha 

LOVE Pepperfire.

Good food but awful service. My meal came out wrong but our waiter never came back to check on us so it couldn't be corrected. We were there for over 2 hours because the waiter wasn't prompt with getting our orders or bringing us the check. They did give me a dish to go to rectify the problem but I would not return.

WOW. Thoroughly impressed with the food at this establishment. The menu is quite extensive so choose wisely. But anything you choose will be fantastic!! We did an appetizer sampler and everything was fresh and full of flavor. Same with our entrees. Big portions made for fabulous leftovers the next day!!

Came here for lunch to try it out for the first time. Didn't know what to expect... To my surprise, I was told this place was opened by the same owner as Silver Greens. Got me excited as I really miss the pesto burger. Ordered the California Chicken Club w/fries and a drink and also the jalapeño mountain climber. Service was quick as there wasn't a line. The burgers were ok for the price. The price for the combo to add fries and a drink was an addl $4 which I thought was a bit pricey. I didn't give it 5 stars because refills for lemonade were an addl $1.50 and they were $3 to begin with. WTH!

We live in Fairhope, AL and we are spoiled with great seafood etc.... This was an amazing lunch in NOLA!  It started with the hostess when we walked in the door. She was lovely! Sierra our server made our experience a 5 star! The manager Alex made sure we were happy with everything as well. 
We are extremely particular about our food and dining experience and they exceeded our expectations.

This place is horrible! And the management is TERRIBLE! Kim Gonzalez is the manger here and she was COMPLETELY disrespectful!! Her waitress named Becca, was very rude and made things go left! Police was called for no reason and my family and I were so embarrassed! I'm defiantly calling corporate because these people are horrible & I love Fridays, but after tonight Friday's will NEVER receive any of my money! I can't believe I was treated this way. DO NOT COME TO THIS ESTABLISHMENT! Kim is a horrible manager and Becca's attitude is ridiculous!

After visiting Baileys breakfast restaurant and loving it we had to try their burger joint. We were seated upstairs along the rail where we could see everything going on below. I'll get into why this isn't 5 stars first. The sweet tea. That's what got me. It's not Southern sweet. If that's the norm for St. Louis, that's fine, but it deflated me. No other restaurant we have been to has sweet tea and I was excited. Our Server Elena was awesome! She gave great recommendations and has a great personality. She wasn't overbearing and that nice where it feels forced and she didn't try to push the sides or dessert on us. When you see $6 for Mac and cheese, it's worth it! They make their own pickles and the fried ones were pretty good. They are battered, not breaded, so if you don't like them that way you have been forewarned. The Chop House burger is phenomenal, our 6 year old finished his chicken strips before we could even ask if they were good and my wife loved the basic burger. Hot chocolate and marshmallow ice cream, brownie with ice cream and the chocolate shake were all amazing as well. I may be diabetic now, but it was well worth it.
Best chicken parm and sandwiches I have been able to find. The chicken parm is perfect. The sauce is great, perfect amount of cheese, big portion. 100% worth it every single time!

The absolutely best place to take your mustang. Honesty and integrity are a way of life with Ron and Diane. Ron is a MCA judge and knows Mustangs. They have done great work for me for years. They have customers for life. They are one of the few quality Mustang restoration shops with the experience and knowledge to keep vintage Mustangs running at their best. They are always busy because they are that good. They stock new and used parts. If they don't have it, the can probably get it. If Ron did the work, you know it was done right.

If I could give ZERO stars, I would do so.  If you want to get left at your FIRST stop by a completely unprofessional driver (Mike) who not only didn't open the door of a STRETCH limo for our party, but gave total attitude the whole 20 minute ride to our first stop because HIS GPS wasn't working and he wanted US to give him directions to a restaurant we'd never been to while we were supposed to be enjoying our ride, hire this company.  The owner, apparently doesn't care about his customers happiness with his company at all, and doesn't mind having his company slammed all over Yelp (see the other 1 star review).  He promised to refund the money for the limo AND our Uber cab ride, but more than a week later, the money still hasn't been refunded.  DO NOT HIRE A CAR FROM THIS COMPANY!!  The charges have been disputed, and I KNOW my bank will side with me, and not this sorry excuse for a customer service business.  BEWARE....thank goodness for Uber, a top notch company that actually cares about their customers.
***UPDATE***
Talked to the owner, he says the "check is in the mail"...if it actually comes, I'll remove this review, if not, it will remain here indefinitely.
