We felt adventurous... bold... travel-esque -- so we stumbled upon Marrakesh. Tucked away in an alleyway, you stumble through the door and immediately feel like you've traveled thousands of miles away. The room is dimly lit and the walls are shining in gold glamor. If you're like me - eating dinner out should be an experience and this certainly fit the bill on that front. 

Along the carpeted floor, a belly dancer naturally dances her away to every table, skilfully entertaining guests as the food gets brought out in waves. The meal is multicourse, set menu with all food eaten with your hands and it's a blast! The "chairs" are couches with plenty of room to lay back and enjoy the moroccon music. 

Even better - the restaurant is located right in the heart of south street so you'll have plenty of places to walk around after dinner. Overall relatively inexpensive for huge quantities of food so you definitely won't go broke.

This place is the real deal. I can't believe I found authentic Mexican food in Indianapolis. Try this place. They were super friendly And the food was delish. Try the sincronizada. It is pretty tasty!

i had guns and other things for sale on consignment at r & a  tactical, ed chavez sold them and kept the money, ed is a dishonest person and a thief, he is someone you should not do any business with !

There's probably not too much more I can say about this place that hasn't already been said.  Great food, a fun and inviting interior, and superb service.  There are a few things that set this place apart from most breakfast joints and creperies, and it's pretty evident by the hoard of people standing outside waiting to get in.  

There are the offerings of sweet and savory crepes, some of which are made from locally sourced meats that line the menu.  A few other breakfast staples make their way on there as well, highlighted by their version of the Saint Louis classic, the Slinger.  I have a hard time not ordering this just about every time I come, slathering it in Sriracha.  Speaking of this sauce, they make an aioli out of it and serve it with most of the savory crepes.  I could talk about the food all day, but what I really get excited for is the selection of Bloody Marys.  There's a pretty extensive list and everyone that I've had have been delicious.  Kudos to the creativity on those spicy concoctions.

Great american resto/bar. Blackened shrimp taco was delicious. We ordered bunch of appetizers. Everything were good. 

The resto is big so good for groups. They had karaoke on a Tuesday night. Most of the singers were good (thank god) :)

I am a gentlemen who enjoys take out Chinese.  Having lived in a few different areas of the country due to school and work, I have had the chance to sample many local versions and I must say Panda House is pretty good.  (In case you want to know, Killeen Texas has the worst Chinese food I have ever had)

Panda House does not make things over saucy like some other places I have been too.  The rice is nice, but not "needed" as a sauce barrier.  We had the Orange Chicken which had a wonderful crispiness to it, and the Crab Rangoons which were above average.  We were pleasantly surprised to find such a good local place.

They have a menu that's on the small side, but seems to have a bit of everything.  Service is very fast and the prices are fair.

Very nice and classy Chinese restaurant, with good food and excellent service. That's how I would define this restaurant in one sentence.

I had the Honey Walnut Shrimp and it was delicious. Also had the Crème Brule, which I thought was good, but the taste of egg was a bit more than I would have liked.

Our waiter was very nice and friendly, and spoke to everyone very politely. The owner even came by making sure that we enjoyed our meal.

Yes, the price is a little high for a Chinese restaurant, but this isn't really your typical, cheap and quick Chinese restaurant.

We order takeout from this place quite often.  Food is consistently good and and prices are reasonable for the food you get.  A few of my go to options are: 
1. Chicken Tenders
2. Turkey and Dressing
3. Chicken and Buttons
4. Steamed broccoli as a side always, it always taste better than what I make at home.  

Great option when you don't have time to cook.  Keep up the great service and fast delivery.

I love Chinese food, my family hasn't been impressed with Chinese food, until today that is. This was probably the best Chinese food we have ever eaten. The appetizer of pork dumplings were fresh and tasty. I had the House Lo Mein, the wife had the lemon chicken, kids had pan fried noodles with chicken (it was AMAZING!!) and chicken lo Mein. All of it was excellent and we now have a new go to Chinese restaurant to order from or dine in.

Don't do restaurant week here, it's quite possibly the worst meal I've had in years!  The staff are great, ambiance is great, it's a great drinks place.

We had chefs appetizer truffle Mac and cheese it was ok
I had the chefs salad my expectations were high.  I could have gone to acme and chopped some carrot peppers and iceberg w plain oil and vinegar myself.  Very disappointed.  It was fresh and very boring.

My friend had butternut squash soup, it tasted like chicken broth.  It was awful, my mother made  some yesterday it was delicious.  It also spilled due to awkward dish.

I ordered the ciopinno and was told it would have mussels clams shrimp and bronzino .  It had mussels, I forwent the clams, and nothing else.  It was an appetizer size.  When I asked for real seafood ?? I was told I would be upcharged.   The mussels were not fresh and not cooked evenly.  It looked like they forced some open.  If you cook mussels they should be closed before you cook them, if they don't open or partially open. You shouldn't eat them, you can get sick.  

When I told them it was awful (wondering where I could get real food) they gave me chicken parm.  Pasta was good, little to no sauce, too large chicken breast.  (Was it from a factory farm?)

They made us share a small dessert.  Hazelnut torte w no real flavor, overcooked donut holes, bland milk chocolate sauce.

I just loved this airport and how everything is so convenient. I loved how everything is organized, its hard to get lost or not know where to go. Security and staff are so helpful. something that I really liked was how convenient it is when you want to tell someone or even uber/lyft where to get picked up. each door has a number and a name so when on uber/lyft it asks the exact location. You cant beat this organization at all. they have signs telling you which airline goes where. I dont think the airport is that big but because how organized it is. I will definitely recommend this airport to everyone and i will definitely fly to this airport soon

I am not a regular Gravity Pope shopper, I just step into the store occasionally out of curiousity. I know that many hip and trendy Edmontonians consider Gravity Pope a shoe heaven and I can see why - never in my life have I seen so many unusual and funky pairs of shoes. The selection of both women's and men's footwear is fantastic. Having said that, I cannot give Gravity Pope more than three stars out of five for two reasons - the prices are too high, and the shoes are too "unique-looking". If I am willing to pay $500 for a pair of shoes, I would much rather prefer these shoes to look classic and be of timeless beauty (i.e. Prada). Ironically, I liked Gravity Pope's selection of men's shoes a lot better than their selection of women's shoes. The former seem to look more classic and toned down. My mind boggled when I picked up a pair of women's shoes (I wish I could remember the brand), checked a price tag and saw $1200. This price tag still haunts me in my sleep!
I checked out some of the brands Gravity Pope carries, and here are some I remember: Calvin Klein, Michael  Kors, Kenneth Cole, Fillipa K, Camper, Patagonia and Tracey Neuls. You can check company's website to see the list of all the brands.
P.S. The customer service is great.

I have to say that this place is a gem!! They have a great atmosphere, comfy leather chairs, numerous flat screens, a large walk in humidor with an excellent selection and a great bar with a nice selection of wine. We chose theCigar Zin that is a nice compliment to the Rocky Patel cigars that the beautiful Cigar Goddess Sarah and I chose. 
I must compliment the staff and the patrons, all were knowledgeable and friendly. More than a few people directed to Bealle on Broadway for an excellent night of live music. 
We are looking forward to returning on our next trip to St. Louis.

My husband and I had a groupon here, otherwise we may never have seen this place as it's surrounded by so many other businesses. My husband got the fish tacos with buffalo chicken mac and cheese and I got the peel and eat shrimp with macaroni and cheese. I love that it's a la cart...where else can I get shrimp with a side of macaroni? The peel and eat shrimp was pretty standard, and the macaroni was very good. I also got a shrimp taco which I liked a lot. We'll definitely try this place again.

Very fun place, food was fantastic, outside tables at sundown was a very Florida experience.  As any restaurant is for this area:   Crowded and a wait for dinner.  Positive: space at the bar and back patio while you wait.
Incredible staff, more even incredible pizza. Best place for pizza in Indy hands down! Get the Quattro Formaggio- You won't be dissapointed!

Came to visit Cool Springs for work and was craving BBQ. Yelled and again yelp spot on no fails. Great food, delicious, and Sackett. Their staff was so kind to explain their menu as I am spicy sensitive. Emily was so sweet to come to explain the story of the how Hogwood came into fruition. Such savory food! Must come and eat here as the smells just draw you in!

My son has gone there since his first hair cut.  We moved back to the are after four years of being away and can't even think of going anywhere else!  Wait til they see him again...they won't recognize him!  4 years later and 14" taller!!

Love this place!

I've lived here for 7 yes. And  can honestly say that I'm really happy living here. I only pay $925.00 a month for a 1 bedroom APT with a full kitchen with a over dishwasher a full size fridge. The two lady's ( T and K) in the office are always really nice and easy to talk to. It's a locked building so non tentents can just walk in. But sometimes they well walk in right behind you. The only real problem is the ally is out my windows and there a lot of drug deals going on out there.  But other wise this is a great place to live if your on a fixed income. Thank you T and K.  For always being there for Keith and I.

Get on their mailing list.  That is the key. Every month or so they will send you a list of their specials.  How special they are! The deals are the best I have found in Indy.  Check out the mailing list, buy your beer by the case and save big.  Cash only.
Nice lady in fresh, chicken, meal department heated my enchilada purchase. She handed me utensils & my warm enchilada stating she wanted to make sure it was cooked in the middle. So kind.

We went to a concert here last night. The acoustics were fantastic. The views of the city from the stadium were pretty amazing as well. There is honestly not a bad seat in the house. The food and drinks are incredibly reasonably priced as well.

The only downside is the parking. The stadium is in the downtown area so parking, especially on a Saturday night is a challenge so get there early.

If you ever get the chance I would definitely recommend checking it out at least once.
Love the food and service! The yams and greens are my favorite! Very clean perfectly seasoned! Love everything about it!

Very welcoming to middle class. Menu isn't too pricy while you can still experience the upscale bistro food you deserve. Not too dimly lit, and very spacious for groups of friends to gather. Not only is this a restaurant, but chef Garces shows that you don't always need to outsource so he put a olive oil museum up front. All oils are able to be tasted as well well as purchased. Great concept and food is straight forward delicious!

We ordered delivery from GrubHub and it was 35 minutes late. I ordered the Pad Thai with a salad and they came in the same box, so the salad was warm, wilted and nasty because if it. The Pad Thai was OK, but would have been better if it had showed up on time and was fresh. My husband had the green curry and he liked it alright. Will probably try again because it's the only Thai place that delivers around here... hope it's better next time!

THIS IS 2 UPDATES:

UPDATE 1:  I visited 2 weeks ago.  I left without eating because it took over 30 minutes during a dead Thursday lunch to get soup.  Actually, the soup never came, they brought me the sandwich after 30 minutes (I asked for the soup first then the sandwich).

I tried calling throughout the week to speak to a manager or owner - the line was busy as if the phone was purposely taken off the hook on Thursday.  I called Friday and Saturday, and it just rang and rang.  Nobody ever answered, just a long message.

UPDATE 2:
- 23 minutes to get the soup
- again, they tried to give me my main course at almost the same time, I told them to wait (but not to stick under heat lamp - they were at least very good about this)
- my server started off as a girl named JJ who was chomping gum the whole time I was there (I thought she was the only one but it turned out 2 other servers were doing the same thing)
- JJ picked up 6 glasses using her fingertips inside the rims of the glasses and came back out of the kitchen way too quickly to have washed her hands
- I asked for a manager or owner.  I was told that there was nobody there yet.  How is this possible?

I shared my concerns with D, another server who said at one point she was a manager.  She was very apologetic and sweet, caring, and knowledgeable.  Truth is, she should probably own the place, and business would double.  Ghini's would have to move into a bigger location. 

Her kindness was certainly different than all of the comments you see on Yelp left by Chef Ghini, which all start off with the generic apology and then the attempt at defending why the place doesn't need improving, which it sadly does.

To the owner or whoever, this is sad.  Truly sad.  Somebody has to train and guide these servers and expedite.  There is NO NO NO excuse for 30 minute soups at lunch time or anytime.  There is no excuse for chewing gum like Alice's kitchen and NO excuse whatsoever for handling glassware like that and not washing your hands (HELLO? that is a health code violation!)  Why have a phone number if you never answer your calls?  I don't blame the servers or the cooks if they have no guidance, which is clear.  Do yourself a favor and fix this - stop trying to defend it.
Burgers and fries are excellent. They dont serve much so there isnt much to write about. Will return. Also, a large order of fries can cover 3 people easy. Split a med fries and you cannot go wrong.
Came here to take part in the passport renewal event they were offering. Library is very clean and staff very friendly. Upon entering we were immediately greeted and helped. Great experience!

Update: They are still my favorite screen printers. I trust that in every job they print for me, they are PERFECT. They are reliable, trustworthy, and knowledgeable. They respond to every inquiry I had. Very very satisfied customer here. Thanks Dan and the team!

Absolutely love it here! Love the staff, always welcoming. Hakima is meticulous for manicures, pedicures, waxing and brows. Sheila is the absolute best stylist. She is like family.  she has taken care of my husband, my children, and I for over 25 years. We are so happy she has her own salon now! A great listener and hard worker who never disappoints. I always get a great cut and highlights. My kids now travel to get their hair done by Sheila. Needless to say Sheila was by our side for weddings and any time we needed to be at our best.

I continue to get amazing massages and will remaiin a long-standing loyal customer! Currently I am delighted with Heather as she always listens and does exactly what I ask! Heather's skills and knowledge are exceptional! Thanks Heather!!!  I can't wait to return!
Great lunch and amazing service! Had the burger special for $10 and it was delicious! My husband had really good oysters and the buffalo shrimp. Very friendly place with a very nice bartender!

Formerly Jitters, the new owner of a year or so has installed high quality above all. This is the best straight espresso in Santa Barbara, bar none, better than French Press, which is good but has an edge and not as much flavor as Open Cup's. Often excellent pastries and a changing variety, which is a good thing. They're installing new things gradually so I think in a year it will be even better. Has organic milk--yay.

So here's the deal...generally pleased with this place, but if you're going to operate a restaurant how about you actually know what your serving? When roasted potatoes come out fried and the waitress says "oh the menu must be a mistake" and a banana walnut muffin is actually banana chocolate then you have a problem which is about as basic as it gets. Sort the basics out before you try to come across as higher end.

Loved the owner and employee!  Having just been open over a week, they are "new kids on the block".  The owner, originally from Lebanon, was very attentive and accommodating for us.  And the food was yummy and authentic.  I recommend that you give it a try.  You won't be disappointed.

The service was very slow. Two people who ordered to-go orders after us received their food in minutes, but we did not get our dine-in foods for 25-30 minutes upon ordering. We ordered waters at the time of ordering, and we did not get them until after our food arrived. The restaurant seemed very short staffed, as if the person at the counter not only handled orders and transaction, but also went back to help cook or prep the food. 

The food on the other hand was good-- but I have had better Jamaican food (and service) at food festivals.
Food was awesome, the restaurant is adorable, and the woman that I'm assuming is the owner is extremely sweet! I'll definitely come back the time I'm in the area.

I have been picking up 1 or 2 prepared meals at a time at Dierberg's lately to take to work for lunch. I like them and I like their selection. This Dierberg's is always clean and well stocked. I like that they start putting out the salad bar before 8am. Some of the stores are much later and that makes it impossible to grab salad bar for lunch later.

Went to check out this adorable little bakery and I will be back! Tried their Baileys flan and their coconut pastry! Delicious! So excited to have this new spot in our neighborhood! Next I'll be trying their chocolate cake and the Cuatro leches cake! A must try when you get a sweet tooth!

Ruiz is my go to Mexican restaurant and has been forever. Even though I now live 20 miles away, it is still my first choice for Mexican or even just dinner out!  The entire staff is excellent, the service is top notch and the food outstanding!  I appreciate the consistency of the food and that they change up the menu occasionally, but they haven't changed the margaritas and they are the best I have ever had and i will try a marg everywhere I go. I don't understand people who don't think the food is authentic - and I wonder where they usually eat Mexican food. Two thumbs up for Ruiz - I'll be there on Thursday!

Back at Prime Stache's again for the amazing brunch. My word for the visit....consistent! The Breakfast Burger is just so juicy and tasty, oh my goodness. This is a must try gang. As always great service and very clean and friendly. We are so hooked.

We were sat quickly...then we sat for quite sometime before we were greated, recieved water or breat....food was great....had some issues with orders, but otherwise was great, waitress was sweet. And the place is right on the main strip so plenty of people watching...
Family and I stopped in for a treat and was it a treat. The gelato tasted fresh and full of flavor. The price was right too. Will definitely be making numerous trips here when going out for dessert.

It is rare for me to write a review but I felt I needed to write a few words of appreciation. We're visiting New Orleans from Los Angeles. We had many massages back in LA and all over the world. This was one of the best. Don't be deceived by the humble facade of the building and go try this awesome place.

Dr. Serrano is amazing. I'm so terrified of major dental procedures but I've had two root canals by Dr. Serrano and she made both procedures painless. She even called to check on me afterwards and I can honestly say I had no problems, the pain was minimal and I had no complications. I would highly recommend Dr. Serrano if you're in need of any major dental work. She and her team are professional, friendly and have great bed side manner.

Meh.  Not my favorite diner.  Most recently I ordered a Chicken Parmesan sandwich.  The bread tasted a little stale.  The chicken fingers were dried out.  The sauce didn't have much of a seasoning to it.  The whole things was sort of bland.  

I've never really had great service here.  I'd rather going to almost any other diner in Philly.

EXCELLENT! This is easily one of the most unique and delicious restaurants in Reno. I went here with a group so we were able to order about half the menu and try bites of everything. You need to try the Mac n cheese and any of the veggie dishes are great too. I'm not usually a beer girl, but the beer here is so yummy as well as the cocktails! The restaurant also has a beautiful atmosphere.

Intimate space, always someone in there but usually not too busy.  It is a small operation, so if it's busy you will have to wait a little for your orders.

Nate is super friendly and welcoming.  Their house beers are rotating, small-batch, glasses of deliciousness.  Always some great guest taps as well.  The space is wonderful for warmer evenings to sit on the patio or the seats facing out.  Also a good place to watch a game, with one nice television behind the bar, although by no means a sports bar.

If you like small, locally owned and operated, hand-crafted breweries, give it a shot.

Went to Minado's with family tonight for the first time, they come here often and it's one of their favorite restaurants. 

I love sushi, and I was impressed with the variety of the rolls they had in their buffet. Lots of tasty rolls, and everything I had was good and fresh. 

The service was attentive and the place was very clean and nice. Everyone enjoyed their dinner and I will definitely go back again. 

The place was packed (saturday night), and there were lots of people having a good time. I'd recommend Minado's to anyone looking for a good meal with great service.

With my background in REAL BBQ; no chain restaurant can get five stars by definition.  BUT, Mission BBQ is as close as one can come.  As a lifelong BBQ hound I judge all BBQ joints by their pork and brisket...so bear in mind that those are the only things I order.  Chicken is not BBQ as far as I'm concerned and ribs are best done at home in the particular manner that suits YOU.  That said; I've sampled Mission BBQ's fare from Wisconsin to Maryland and these guys have hit the mark better than any other chain by FAR.  I wholeheartedly support the "veteran's memorial" schtick.....but let's face it; a BBQ joint lives and dies by it's meat, not it's theme/decor.  Simply put:  Mission BBQ delivers the goods where other attempts at chain BBQ places almost never do.  It is clear the owners spent some serious effort getting the regional sauces and their meat smoking technique sorted.  They've managed to incorporate bits of the Deep South, Texas, and KC into the mix.  Go and give them a try.

Originals Pizza sits to the side of the Giant Shopping Center on West Trenton Avenue in Morrisville, Pa.  It is in a small commercial strip next to a Wells Fargo office and a Dominos Pizza.  It has been here for a long time and has settled into its space nicely.  Although long and narrow, the furnishings create the sense of sitting on picnic tables under a striped awning along the outside walls of the building.  Nice, if gitchy, touch. 

The moustachioed men behind the counter look like brothers, but they assured me they were not.  They were both friendly and ready to serve.  As I came in after 7 pm on a midweek evening, the pizza offerings were not vast for a guy in need of only a slice.  That is always the risk taken late in the day of any pizza shop.  You never know how long the pies on display have been waiting for your attention.  Their "Tomato Pie" seemed to have the most energy as it sat there, so I asked for it to be reheated to "well done" for me.  

It was that.  When it arrived I could see that the heavy tomato pasty topping had been reawakened.  Picking it up gingerly, it held its point well with only the slightest quiver from the weight above.  The scorch marks on the chassis were well established from the oven.  That is what I wanted.  First bite revealed a thicker than expected crust that resisted my clenching incisors just enough to let me know it would not yield its secrets willingly.  Solid chew.  

The slice was more than enough for an evening snack.  Two slices would have been way too much.  The top sauce was thicker and saltier than I prefer, and the few chunks of garlic not enough to demand serious attention.  I overheard the chef say to a customer that this was "Brooklyn Style" Tomato Pie.  Not sure what he meant, as it surely wasn't the T.Pie created and made famous across the Delaware in Jersey.  There, the mozza goes on before the sauce, and the tomato mix is applied more sparingly to achieve balance in texture and taste between the two main food groups.  Originals had little or no cheese that I could discern, but just the overpowering sauce.  

It was okay for what it was, but not close to what I was accustomed to in a Tomato Pie.

I had high hopes for this spot but was a little underwhelmed. That said I still enjoyed myself. Based on others reviews I'm going to guess it was just a bit of an off night or simply preference differences. 

The atmosphere was nice and I thoroughly enjoyed the small restaurant feel and modern decor. If not paying attention you could easily miss this place walking by. I like the open layout of the kitchen where you can see everything being made. If I ever came back I'd probably try to sit at the bar next time. The service was great and the waitress taking care of us was very kind. 

The banh mì bread was perfect. It had a great crunch and the pickled vegetables had a nice acidity to them. 

The cold Thai style peanut noodles I had with chicken and it was just okay. Again this could be preference but it seemed to lack some kind of comfort that I look for in noodles. Was a little more reminiscent of peanut butter than a peanut sauce and I craved just something else in the dish.

The Khao Poon which was raved about was the dish I was completely underwhelmed with. I got it with Tofu and opted to add Russule mushrooms. I will return at some point and try it again as I truly do think it was just this time I went. It was towards the end of the night and I realize things happen and each dish that comes out probably isn't perfect every time. The noodles were perfect, but the soup base was lacking. It also arrived to me luke warm. It was watery and missing the complexity of a great Vietnamese broth. The coconut flavor and spice were nice but very overwhelmed with lime. 

With all of that said I would still give Stock a try. After reading other reviews I imagine others experiences with this restaurant to be completely different than mine and I really did want to like it. Their salads which I would try next time looked like they would be very refreshing and looked different from anywhere I've seen in philly. The Pork Banh mì was very tasty and I'd recommend trying it.

Ok, YELP and Google need to stop following me, but I really enjoyed this spot. I worked there for a while before a friend joined me and the staff was very welcoming and told me not to rush. I had the Normal Ful for breakfast, which is a vegetarian lentil dish. it was hot and full of flavor, it just wasn't sweet, which is a truly American expectation even though there was NO reason it should have been sweet since it's beans and veggies. The thing that looked like a donut was not sweet either, and really fluffily mouth-watering so it might be good to experience for sugar-addicted Americans like me. The wheat rolls are INCREDIBLE, from whatever mysterious source they come. I'd love to go back and just chill with my laptop and try other items that are new to me.

The customers are primarily men, which seems to be cultural based on my whole 2 Ethiopian coffee shop experiences, and a few restaurants in DC, but a woman was staffing and women did come in. I felt comfortable, it's just noteworthy.

Our first time experience at First Watch wasn't the greatest.  It took at least 45 mins before getting our food. During this time no waiters came by to check in with us. People at another table got tired of waiting & left. We were just about to do the same when waiter came by to apologize. Finally our food arrived, biscuit & grave w/ turkey sausage and eggs florentine benedict. Food was acceptable & good. 

Hope they workout the kinks in kitchen for faster delivery.  

Maybe we'll give them another try.

Is not as good as the Bangkok on Mt Rose st. Ordered chicken yellow curry and some of the potatoes were not cooked. The Pad Thai was good and the service was good.  Overall I like the place but prefer the one on Mt. Rose St.

Terrible customer service.  Called yellow
Cab to take a patient to his car that was parked three blocks away.  The cab driver was rude, hostile and aggressive towards my elderly patient.  He refused to assist in any way and lacked empathy.  Will not
Use yellow cab after this experience.
We came in for breakfast and we all left with smiles on our faces.  The service was good and the for was very well prepared.
Multiple bad experiences with the deli. And do they ever check the coffee. Not going into this over priced market anymore. Bakery is the only upside of the market. The people ARE very nice there!
The staff is very friendly. The location is clean and the soup is delicious, my boys really enjoyed the chicken wings!
Modest layout, but great, homemade corned beef hash. Fantastic! Very good prices and a very friendly staff. I'm coming back for the CBH!

The professionals at Grout Busters (Jennifer McIntre) sent a team that took care of both of my bathrooms. The grout needed to be removed and replaced in one bathroom restored (looked brand new)! They did such a nice job we had them do our second bathroom. Cleaned walls and ceiling and replaced caulking all around. We were so pleased that we wanted to make sure the community knew what a great business they are. I took before and after pics of the bathroom they completed yesterday. Thank you Grout Busters, we will refer you to anyone in need of Grout work

Not sure what to really say.  I've never been to a place quite like this.   I generally don't get to this part of DTSP.  But here goes.  If you're looking for a place with a chill vibe, DJ, creative cocktails, indoor and an outdoor areas, dog friendly, ironic yet cool decor, lawn chairs and random patio furniture, giant connect four, giant Jenga, flamingo themed, and creative art they've got it all. They had a DJ that played newish hip-hop music over classic hip-hop beats.  They had the standard beer choices PBR, assorted popular local craft bee, hard water and Miller High Life, which quite honestly I just don't see enough of at restaurants. For as popular this place was the staff was truly running around to keep up with orders.  They've got food too.  I didn't look at the food menu but everything that was brought out smelled amazing. 
I generally don't make it to this part of Central often but I'm going to have to explore this area some more.  My only real issue and it's quite petty is there's only one men's and one women's room.  For most of my time there was a line for both that was at least 4 deep.  As many people as this place can accommodate another bathroom was needed.  Maybe a gender neutral bathroom? Will I go back absolutely! I had a great time and enjoyed my Peach Don't Kill My Vibe and Miller High Life.

Sadly, after giving this place a couple of tries, all I can say is that it's not for me. From the service to the food, they just can't get it right. 

Last night a small group of us went to dinner. We had reservations and upon notifying the host stand that we are here, the two hostesses begin arguing with each other as to where we are going to get seated.

We get seated and I order the Cantina Mule. It tasted more like sour mix over ice; and certainly not worth the $11-$12. 

My wife and I split the steak and chicken fajitas. The fajitas come with rice, pinto beans, sour cream, cheese and a little pico (which is really a couple chopped up onions, tomatoes and jalapeño). The rice was extremely hard and clumpy, the pinto beans were watery. I took the cup of pinto and poured the water out of it. The steak was very dry and the chicken was flavorless. 

We also ordered the side taco and side of Mexican street corn. The taco meat was season-less. You are better off going to the grocery store, buying ground beef
And a packet of taco seasoning and mixing that with 3/4 cup of water.  And the Mexican street corn is not Mexican street corn. It's not served on the cob. It's served in a small cup with a sprinkle of cheese. If you are going to call yourself a Mexican restaurant and serve "Mexican street corn" you should make sure that it's better than the Mexican street corn being served at the bbq joint next door- which I say with 100% certainty, the bbq place does it way better (there tacos are better there too).

When we are ready to pay, we could not find our server. 10 mins later, he shows up and takes our credit card to the gentleman that appeared to be the on-shift manager. He runs our credit card, comes back out with the receipts but apparently leaves the credit card in the back. So we have to go hunt down our server to tell him the credit card was missing. He goes in the back and comes out with a soaked credit card. I don't know what happened to the credit card back there, but at the very least, think to dry it off before you hand it to the customer? The entire situation was more bizarre than anything else.

I tried to stay open minded about this place but they continue to fail for me. If you want good Mexican food, there are plenty of authentic Mexican restaurants in the Tampa Bay Area that really hit it home. Do yourself a favor and check those places out before coming here. Heck, you'll get a better taco through a Taco Bell drive thru.

I was afraid that I had a termite problem and called 3 companies for estimates. Kenny at Chet's was the most thorough technician that came out to my house. He was also completely honest and didn't try to sell me services that I didn't need. I didn't have termites and didn't purchase services through Chet's, but they won me over on their thoroughness and honesty. If I need services in the future, I am going to get Kenny at Chet's to take care of my problem.
Excellent sushi at great prices! We like the miso soup too. The staff is friendly and the vibe is nice but we usually get our sushi to go. It's the sushi place I recommend!

Sesame is great for vegans and vegetarians, who miss general tsaos chicken, and sweet and sour chicken, you can swap out any of the meat on the menu for wheat gluten, the food is delicious the environment is calm, and the two ladys who run the place are a delight, The price is awesome too 2 people can eat for under $20.

Really great vibes and drinks! The food is awesome as well as the service! We came on a busy Saturday night and as soon as we walked upstairs, the bartender saw us right away (even with a big crowd) and gave us a menu. We were also served right away from one of the downstairs bartenders, Paul, who was very nice and welcoming as well. We also visited the bar another time on a Sunday afternoon and had some more great drinks and food, including the deviled eggs, tater tots, sausage egg sandwich, and fried green tomato sandwich! We had a blast both times and will be back soon!

WOW..so not worth it!  

Our bill was $75 for:
-An order of Celtic egg rolls that were oozing with oil and not enjoyable. 
-Chicago style roast beef sandwich that was on a stale hoagie and too spicy to eat (coming from my spice-aholic husband)
-Cajun Po Boy that too was on a stale hoagie and only had 5 small shrimp.  Both our meals came with fries.  Definitely frozen.  Came out soggy with no seasoning or salt.  
-kids Mac n cheese was definitely Kraft.  Bland.  But yet the side veggies had so much pepper on them, they were inedible.  
-a super watery drink the call Mermaid Water..which is just a pina colda with extra ice
-2 draft beers

The only saving grace was the waitress, who was very sweet.  Unfortunately, that doesn't save this place from being an over priced dive with bad food.  Thankfully there are a lot of other options in the area.

Very good food and service. I placed our order online and it was ready for carry out in 15:minutes. The sashimi was fresh and delicious. The Oro Valley was outstanding. If you haven't tried Sushi Valley, give yourself treat!

Amazing draft list! Stopped in after looking at the interesting menu.  Split a pear and Gruyere and mac n cheese pizza and both were really awesome! One pizza is enough for two (three filling slices each) if you can decide on one pizza (you prob cant, they all look good).

I'm a big fan of eating cold pizza as leftovers.  The mac n cheese didn't really hold up well cold, but the pear and Gruyere was bangin'.

Will definitely be back, i hear the grilled cheese panini is the best in town ;)

This. Exactly what I wanted, fries and pie. Great combinations of choices but they only have certain combos certain weeks so don't get yer heart set on something looking at the menu on here, like we did. No disappointment though! We went last night (Monday) didn't realize it was a part of Hi-Ho so the gentleman he was kind enough to open the side gate and let us in since we were standing at the to-go window. ‍ also, get the sauce flight for $1 to dip the fries at the bottom in!

Stopped by on my way home to get  treat for my sore throat. Service was adequate-nothing special. Purchased a medium scoop of pear sorbet-tastes like soap, chocolate, coffee and birthday cake - no taste at all - gelato. Scoops were of average size so, imagine my surprise when the bill was $17.44. First and last visit.

Hugh and Mary are very, very nice. Place was hidden away which was cute. We were happy to get into the room and find it was quaint and the AC Unit was on however the unit was extremely loud and even with earplugs, was next to impossible to get a full night sleep when the unit turned off and on during the night so half the night we shut it off and made it through with the ceiling fan. That is really the only reason for the 4 stars - AC Unit. We only had breakfast here 1 of the 4 days we stayed as there was too much we had to see and do before it got extremely hot at 3pm. Breakfast was nice. I loved that there was a fridge were we could get waters and clementines and even though we did not ask, it looked like they offered wine and other adult beverages! We were also happy that our room had a fridge in it to keep waters in! Thank you for being so nice!

Still the same old Denim.

I knew it was going to be an "upscaled" type of lounge but this is a bit ridiculous.  We felt the cover only includes spectator status and a $200+ bottle active participation.  If that type of thing appeals to you then is possible a good time there with your friends otherwise stay away.

Pros:
- The staff was surprisingly friendly, including the bouncers.
- Some areas were mellow enough to have a conversation and get to know people.

Cons:
-$20 dollar cover.
-It has serious crowd segregation issues.

We found La Veranda on Yelp on a lark when my in-laws were visiting. Valet parking there is only $10 which is cheaper than the $17 parking lot next to the restaurant. We had a lovely table with a view of the water and the fireworks going off in Camden later on in the evening. 

All of the food we had was excellent. The chef was very accommodating to my lactose intolerance, and the waiter was very helpful. Our cocktails were delicious and they have a great selection of Italian wine. Definitely on the pricier end, $25-30 a person for dinner not including an appetizer, dessert or drinks. 

The service was a little slow, but it was our waiter's 3rd day on the job. Still giving 5 stars for an excellent meal.

We had some old stains and a hopeless traffic area in our home office. I just wanted our carpeted stairs to look better and maybe lighten the stains. 
The stains are all gone. And the traffic area which has been cleaned before and always looked darker is the same color as the surrounding carpet. It's like they waved a magic wand. 
I am so impressed with their attention to detail and the care and integrity with which they run their business.
For the record many years ago I owned a local cleaning business and we subbed out our carpet cleaning and I've seen the gamut of successful and not so successful cleaning results. In my opinion this couple represents  mastery of the techniques of stain handling  and carpet cleaning.

Great space both indoor and outdoor. Bars are on both levels to accommodate guests and menu has a wide variety of both craft cocktails and craft beer. This place has something for everyone; arcade games, pin ball, skee ball, outdoor bar games (giant connect four, jenga, etc) also really like the retro console area with couches to play old school NES, SNES, and N64. A must visit for fans of pop culture and video games alike!
Fairly large portions of delicious food. Kind of pricy, but a good experience justifying the cost. Plenty of friendly staff and space to relax.

I do not know why I have given this store multiple tries! I keep thinking it will get better but each time I'm disappointed. Today every meal was wrong. The drinks were cold which was perfect however so was all the food!  We got the wrong sandwiches and yes I should have checked before I left. The cheese on the cheeseburgers were not melted n the fries were really bad n those things are like crack! My lil ones were sad because they didn't get toys (spoiled) in their happy meals. Overall very poor!
tried their strawberry smoothie with tapioca boba and it was so amazing. definitely coming here again. staff is so nice.

A colleague of mine chose this spot for a lunch meeting. The Comcast building lobby is lovely and grand, a great place to walk into. 

We made our way into the restaurant, which is well-decorated, albeit in a really typical way, and our table was in what seemed to be a long, narrow hallway - odd layout for a restaurant. 

Nothing notable on the drink list; service was also perfectly adequate but unremarkable. There are no vegetarian entrees, but a couple of lackluster appetizer, pizza and sandwich options. 

Then, the food came. 

Everyone, from this vegetarian non-profit employee to our foie gras-eating, Perignon-drinking Chairman of the Board, was disappointed. I ordered a lentil burger that was literally a bunch of unseasoned lentils mashed together into a patty shape (at least the fries were OK). My companions reported a greasy squash soup (I don't think I'd ever heard a soup called greasy before) and ill-cooked steak. Nobody wanted to stick around for dessert.

The customer service at this location was less than pleasant, to say the least. The unproductive employees were sitting around at the front desk laughing loudly and quite irritably. At one point, two friends or relatives of an employee came in with food and sat around eating it by the front desk; and then they began to join in on the obnoxious sound of not assisting the customers. And to top that off, when we asked for help they would do the very minimum with a horrendous attitude as if we're interrupting them. In no way, shape, or form did we do or say anything impolite or rude to where they would want to retaliate. Also, th ey gave us the wrong information on our insurance because they were too focused on talking. The whole time one of the ladies were "assisting" us, she gave us a dirty look. And to add to this extensive list, one of them came into the closed room without knockiNH to grab her phone during my eye exam, and then dismissed her behavior by claiming how important her phone is to her.These ladies were very unprofessional and need to learn how to behave in a work environment or be fired. Despite these ladies, the male doctor who did an exam was perfectly fine, professional, and polite and we had no problem with him. One of the ladies ( out of the four) was fine as well and remained focused and on task. I would not go here again; especially due to the uncomfortable environment their attitude created.

I worked there and a new manager came to that store while i was off work for awhile. At first he was really nice and then he started nitpicking everything i did, cutting my hours and eventually told me to go to a different store or id get no hours. The manager at said store, never got back to me to give me hours. They never told me i was fired, they just straight up ghosted me. Extremely rude and unprofessional. I do not recommend working there if you dont like inconsistent paychecks that range from $43-$140. Totally a waste of time.

I am giving Olive + Oak a 5's! First off the staff is amazing, our waiter was very experienced and knew his menu! After looking over their menu I was beyond impressed! It wasn't invasive and had everything from Blue Crab, Oysters, Lamb Etc. I got the Blue Crab Dip, East & west cost oysters, and flank Steak! It was amazing, we also grabbed two bottles of wine to fit our appetizers and dinner! Everything from the food to the staff was 5 stars! I can't wait to tell all my fiends about this place.
The bomb! This is a serious staple in the main line community. Nothing you get here will ever be bad. love their humantoshians.
Expect 1 hour+ wait time. The food are ok, due to lack of chinese food choice around the area. People rated high for this restaurant.
I enjoyed coming here for breakfast. Service was great, and the food was decent, but nothing really stood out to me. I would go back, but it wouldn't be my first choice for spanish cuisine.

In order to grasp the magnitude of the donuts you will be eating, you have to wash your mind of what you know to be a donut. These are not store brand, these are not "basic", these are an attempt to make something simple into a complex taste, and it works. if you're thinking "Dunkin", you're in the wrong place. 

I've tried 6 of their donuts, and despite what some thing is a pricey morsel, I am fascinated and intrigued with how much flavor goes into these. I've been to a lot of places that promise great donuts, but this takes the hat, so long Voodoo Donuts, I'm glad to have found this spot in Indianapolis. Just go, get a coffee and go for something insane, you'll be surprised. The Breakfast Club inspired donut was my favorite...I won't forget about you!

We are addicted to cook your own Korean BBQ and having tried in a number of cities, this location did not disappoint on meeting our expectations. They have a long list of meats you can grill yourself, our favorites are the beef bulgogi, spicy pork belly, short ribs and spicy shrimp. All the sides make it an interesting experience as well, the pickled radish and sesame noodles plus kimchi and other Asian delights make it an authentic experience. It would be a great first date night, group dinner with friends. I've been twice and look forward to my next visit.

Great service! Scheduled an appointment with these guys and they were able to come next day. Prices were fair and the two men who came to retrieve the two couches I was looking to have picked up were polite and quick. They also called after the pick-up to make sure everything went well and that I was happy with the service. I would definitely use this service again!

I can't put into words how wonderful my experience has been at Center City Dermatology especially with PA Samantha. I have had my lips enhanced prior to going to CCD, but was never quite satisfied. In the last, the filler didn't seem to last or didn't make much of a difference to my appearance. Samantha listened to all my concerns and exceeded my expectations with the final result. Not only is she wonderful at her profession, but she is personable and makes you feel comfortable. She even opened the office early one day to make sure I was able to make my appointment!!! Needless to sure I won't be going to anyone for my Botox and lip injections.

Terrible customer service.  Stayed here for a soccer tournament and was quoted a price in writing. The manager gave us a different rate and refused to honor the quoted price, blaming the company they used to recruit our team's business.  Outdated rooms and facilities added to our poor experience.

Dropped in for late brunch on a Sunday w/ the BF. Hadn't visited in some time so I thought a little down home No.Lib cuisine would be perfect. It was packed but the service was fast even though our server seemed a bit apathetic about working that day. We had the matzo ball soup to start which was filing and great. I had the veggie sausage, gravy & egg biscuit which was divine. The biscuit had just a little crunch around the outside and majorly yummy. The gravy was a little too rich but still good. Bae had the pancake combo w/ stuffed blueberries in his pancakes. So all in all the food was bomb. My only complaints are ...1.They charge for coffee refills but they offer it like its free. 2 The bathroom has the kind of slow -shake the handle- toilet you might find at your Grandmom's house.

This is an amazing experience, especially if you are in search of an adventure for a large group that will not only be entertaining but will more importantly be engaging.  While this activity is certainly relevant for those visiting Nashville, prepare yourself for a high level of rigor as well.  You will be standing on a moving bus while waving to your fans on Broadway.  It's quite likely that you will notice that your body has began dancing to the great sounds that are blasting from the "Large Marge" sound system even if you are not one that typically engages in such shenanigans. This bus ride is not one remembered because of the boring lecture from a tour guide.  Instead, the company differentiates the experience for each client by allowing their input in music as well as accommodating for individual needs that arise during the journey and were even willing to provide extended time.  Preferential seating is not an issue as you will be standing the entire time.  But most important in any experience such as this is the development of relationships.  The tour "guide" quickly establishes a warm rapport with the riders but more importantly creates an atmosphere where relationships can be fostered between the riders themselves.   The tour was "highly effective" in their attempt to satisfy this group.

We went here for dinner and did the savor deal and got 2 burgers and an appetizer. They forgot our appetizer, we said it was no big deal. They ended up taking everything off of our meal except for a drink. We stressed that it was honestly no big deal, but they insisted. Overall the food was fantastic and even though our app was a little late the service was fantastic too!! Would definitely recommend!!
The best Puertorican Bakery in Town hands down! Highly recommend them. Puerto Rico does it better!

This place is such a gem! We had brunch here with a few friends and instantly fell in love with the garden area. Two of us had the build-your-own breakfast sandwiches and two had the stuffed french toast - everything was delicious. The lemon-parmesan potatoes were an unexpected highlight of the meal and the french press coffee was wonderful too. We waited a while for our food but quite honestly, we didn't mind at all, since the atmosphere was so nice!
If you read all these comments about this company and you still decide to puchase a policy with Sensible then I can only say GOOD LUCK.

This place is special! A beautiful setting like you're back in time 100 years ago. You must try the pork chop and if you've got two pork lovers, one serves more than two! Chefs filet was literally melt In your mouth! This is a 5 star date night, no exceptions! Great value as well! Two apps, bottle, filet and chop for under $200. Can't beat it

Went here to eat last thursday. Really enjoyed the food and the atmosphere. I think my servers name was Lauren. She did a really good job recommending dishes and drinks. She was attentive and friendly. And my drink was never empty and my wife and i really appreciate that in a server. Will definitely reccomend to my friends in the downtown area.
Love the view! The service is excellent. Very relaxing environment to wind up your day in Philadelphia. The food is excellent.

Been meaning to try this place out for 30 years.  Applied for a job too when I was 15 but I didnt get a call back, but this won't affect my dinner experience here.  This is my first time.  I called in  my order of shrimp and catfish with potato salad and onion rings. I was impressed with the recent builing chablnges they made.  Looks much better.  
The catfish were good, better than New Orleans hamburger, but they eere not thin as I expected.  Tartar sauce was fresh and impressive.  The shrimp I could have done without.  The dark batter and freaky butterfly cut with tail attached to end not a good combination.  Didnt even taste like shrimp.  
Onion rings were really good.  Crunchy, soft and tender.
The food was ok but I dont see the value for the money..  The to-go containers were my favorite.  Well constructed.  While employees werent enthustiactically friendly they did provide me with enough tartar and ketchup.  Hope they get better.

Talia's Grill is HANDS DOWN the best place to get bagels in the fishtown/nolibs area. The owner is incredibly sweet and personable. He gave us a complimentary sampler plate of his Greek dishes including orzo and other samples and everything was so fresh. The bagels are big, fluffy, doughy and homemade, and perfectly crispy. There are a variety of homemade cream cheeses and everything is reasonably priced. 

Definitely talk to the owner. He cooked for Nixon, Arnold Palmer, and other celebrities in NYC before setting up shop in Philly. 

Can't wait to go back for more bagels and Greek foods! I know it seems weird to get bagels at a Greek place but trust me, you want to try these.

I've been a client for more than 3 years now. Everyone working there is always professional, kind, and knowledgeable.  They are flexible with your schedule, they listen well, and genuinely care. Dr. Wipperman is, through to his soul, a good citizen, family oriented man, business owner, Chiropractor, and community member who is overall health conscientious.  You can tell his goal is to share information and help people stay in optimum health! His experience shines through with ease and quick understanding of any situation.  I go for maintenance usually, but on the occasions that I am stiff from sleeping, or a minor injury, and most recent a shoulder with minimal range of motion...He doesn't pressure you to sign a contract to come.  He encourages, and then you keep going because the issue is improving greatly.  For me, I'd rather get real caring feedback, information and correctly put in alignment for minor pains by this man and his office, then go get prescribed drugs that only hides pain or injuries for temporary. Thanks for all you do Ballas Chiropractic!

UPDATE: Still doesn't disappoint - every time! The wait staff is great and the food delicious. I just want to add that I've had the black bean burrito vegan with seitan about four times now and it's one of the best things I've had here but they don't list seitan as one of the possible fillings. They do have it because that's what they use for the vegan cheesesteak, so order it with confidence! I hope Bellefonte adds this scrumptious thing officially to the menu. It belongs there.

Disclaimer - I'm not a big fan of restaurant chains, especially Italian, simply because I can't stand paying for subpar food that I can make much better at home.  That being said, Carrabba's never disappoints!  Every dish we have ordered has been very tasty and prepared well.  The sauces are flavorful and have a freshly prepared homemade taste.  The salads are always cold and crisp, dressings are tasty.  This is a place we will keep going back to!

I came here with my 3 kids and wife while staying at the Ritz-Carlton in Dove Mountain and I my experience here was pretty average. 

We ordered the bruschetta  and the meatballs as 2 appetizers and both were pretty average. 

The pizza was good, but I think they were kind of small (12 inches) so I ordered 2 for my family. It really wasn't enough for us. The crust and texture of the pizza was really good, light and fluffy.

The best part was their desert, they bake a cookie in a pan and server it topped with vanilla ice cream - probably the best part of the meal. 

I ended up spending about 80 bucks for a family of 5 on pizza and appetizers which I thought was a bit pricy. 

Wait staff was awesome.

STAY AWAY!!!Worst place ever to eat!! I got food poisoning from this place. Not just this but the prices were too high for the quality. The service was so bad as well as the atmosphere. Guests in jeans & flip flops & a couple real dressed up?!?!? This place needs to be shut down!

This is the first time we are here and it was really good! They have a nice beer and wine selection and the food is really good too. We got the stuffed chicken and the chicken salad. I wasn't aware this place was a Cajun restaurant but it was delicious! We have been to the other restaurants that were in the same location and this one is by far better than the rest. We will definitely be back.
My favorite place ever!  A dream for vegans for sure!  I just can't get enough of the chocolate chip cookies!
I really liked this place. Great flavor in everything. We were a party of four and everyone enjoyed their meals. Definitely will return when I'm in town.

The decor is really nice but it gets crowded and the staff can be so rude! I got the ahi carpaccio, which was nothing like what I'd consider carpaccio. It was badly cut and also had vile wasabi squirts on it that, if it weren't for the color, I would swear was something else. There should've been a warning on the menu. My friends liked their burger and the mole enchiladas. We all decided not to go back though because of the not-very-nice people.

Rarely do I give a 5-star rating. The food was flavorful and plentiful. I had the Istanbul Combo, lentil soup, pecan baklava and I took gyros and a Turkish wedding cake home for lunch the following day. The coffee i ordered for the ride home was fantastic. The herb mixture on the combo was right for my taste, but the hummus had a too much paprika for my taste. The pita was equal to what is available on grocery shelves, but let us be honest and say that a small restaurant is not going to bake their own breads. The building is small, and the neighborhood could be better, but at no point did I feel unsafe. The service was great; I believe her name was Kayla. The owner, Mehmet, was most gracious, as was the server, especially considering we ordered an hour before they closed. I will absolutely return and recommend it to friends.

My girlfriend and i came here for an app and some drinks in the middle of the day and wow we definitely picked the right things. The scallops were heavenly and we wanna try to make this recipe when we get home! The drinks were also delicious!

There are a few iconic places in every city that you just kind of have to visit, and in the Nashville area Loveless Cafe is one of them.  This place went "viral" before the internet, convincing people to head out to a former motel in the middle of nowhere to indulge in biscuits and jam.

I will admit that I don't like to wait in lines, so I've been avoiding Loveless as a result.  I've heard sometimes the wait is up to two hours, and they don't take reservations for small parties.  But when my friend Lindsey and I were texting at like 7am about breakfast, we figured we could go super early and beat the church rush on a Sunday morning.  We were right; we barely had to wait, and you get to wander around their little stores while you do.  It's like an original Cracker Barrel in that regard.

The biscuits were AWESOME.  I loved them!  I tried all the jams they brought with them too.  For my breakfast, I went basic with scrambled eggs and crispy bacon, plus a small side of their hash brown casserole.  That cheesy goodness was so rich and heavy, I didn't even finish half of it!  I ate very well and enjoyed it a lot.

I'm not sure if I will be back to Loveless, unless a visitor or friend wants to go... it's about 20-25 minutes from where I live, and nothing else is nearby.  I liken it to eating at Lady & Sons in Savannah; it's a haven for tourists after so many appearances on Food Network and the like.  But it was definitely worth checking off my Nashville "bucket list"!
We walked in this past Friday Night for a "girls night out", to dance. (Dj was playing) Place was packed! Great mixed drinks and fun atmosphere.

It has been a while since I have seen a Ponderosa much less ate at one. A friend of mine had her birthday dinner here. I looked at the salad bar buffet when as i walked through the dining room to the party rooms. 

It is about what I remember.  I should have stuck to the chicken wings and brussels spouts. those are my favorites on the bar.  

it was ok. not good enough to go on a special trip to eat there.
Very helpful in explaining what I needed. I did need a full window replacement but fairly priced and they gave me $50 discount! Nice dudes!

Overall, the reason for four stars in proximity and hours. My friends live so close and delivery charge is cheap.
Quality: fine. It's a fine generic Cheesesteak. Nothing to write home about. 
Open til 3am: this is a huge plus, as my friends and I have some late nights at their place. Very reliable delivery and food was still hot and fresh.
Food is good for late-night philly food, which is high quality in comparison to other big cities, but during the day, if looking for cheesesteaks, get to south Philly or center city for the best.

I have been here a few times now. I see a great value and fresh food. The Shawarma sandwiches are price better than McDonalds across the way!! Good stuff! Great portions and friendly staff. Will be going back. 

The Chicken Shawarma is great!! Perfectly seasoned and juicy.

Thank you very much for the great job you guys did on a surprise birthday cake for my dear stepdaughter.  I requested two numbers cake sitting on fondant flowers. What a great surprise to see and taste such deliciousness. The cakes were beautiful made into a 3 and a 0. The surprise was a success. The flavors were on point with freshly made batter not too sweet and very tasty chocolate and vanilla. Thank you again Brooke for putting up with my wild request! 
PS. I live in Miami ;),  I trusted the Yelp community to give you a chance. Glad I did!

Worst bartenders. It was packed couldn't move everyone needed a drink and all 3 bartenders were eating Chinese food and texting and talking to each other. Took 20 mins to even get the girls attention. She looked miserable and was rude.

Place was above average. 

Went in with 18 guys for a bach party. Food was really tasty. Beer was also very good. 

Definitely try the duck. I was surprised with how good it was.

Service was distasteful. The servers were obviously unhappy with giving us some time to decide on food selections as they were trying to quickly flip our table. We were a 7 top and spent $350 - you'd think they would take a bit more care. We actually even overheard a buser tell another that they "need to get us out so they can have the table". Food was excellent, but the experience probably ruined chances of returning.
Great food, we stopped in for a late dinner.  Staff was so friendly & accommodating.  The restaurant has nice obience but we sat outside.

This is my. favorite Spa in town. I highly. recommend Devine Salon. I went there on Saturday 5, 2016 and Maria did my facial. She was very professional. And very courteous. The from desk staff were very. helpfull and they had a big smile all the time. Very relaxing place. Thank you for your services.

You join a gym and acquire a trainer. Whether you use a personal trainer that works directly with the gym or as a private contractor ( while working in gym facility) they should be forthcoming! If you pay for services that are not able to be met Example: trainer is ill, days can't align
As a client you should not have to beg to be reimbursed, let alone completely ignored!!! Bad business!!!!

Oh boy, where do I start.  My three children received FREE vouchers for a sonic blast from our PBS kids station here in town.  On the coupon they said limit one.  So I brought all of my kid's with me to make sure we could use their coupons.  When I ordered I had originally ordered shakes not knowing that it wasn't a sonic blast.  Which they told me when I got up to the window.  So I told them what flavors my kid's wanted.  But then they came back and said that I am only allowed to use ONE coupon.  I said, "Why?"  It says limit one, I had all three of my kid's with me.  I didn't see what the problem was.  So they ended up calling the manager over. Her name was Martha and had a god AWFUL Bulls nose ring in her nose!  I understand some businesses are a little more lenient with their uniforms. But come on, a really big nose ring that you can pull some one around with is not something I want to be looking at when I'm ordering food. Any ways, Martha also told me I was only allowed to use one coupon.  I asked why again.  She told me they can't use them all in one transaction.  First thing all three sonic blast were going to be free due to the voucher.  So I asked why can't you charge them out separately.  It's not like I'm paying for them.  She finally comes back and says yes, we can do that.  On top of these Sonic blast I ordered two MEALS. One with onion rings and a peanut butter fudge shake, the second one with fries and a sour raspberry slushy.  When they finally charged my card I received a receipt for my card being charged, but NOT and itemized receipt.  I received MOST of what I ordered.  But I didn't realize that I DIDN'T get my shake with my meal.  So already being on the highway I had to exit, turn around and go back.  When I pulled up I said that I didn't get my shake.  The manager MARTHA with the nose ring came out and asked for my receipt.  I said I only received the card charge receipt so I don't know how this is going to help.  She replies, " I remember seeing your order, you said to take OFF all of the shakes."  I said no such thing.  They did what they did and didn't even tell me they took them off. Nor confirmed my order due to the changes.  Also told me that if I wanted my shake I would have to pay for it!!!  I ordered a freakin MEAL it should have came with it! of course with the upgrade charge. I said that is ridiculous, How do I know if I was charged for it when I didn't get an itemized receipt!  I was pissed, so I left WITHOUT my shake.  When my kid's and I got home.  The second meal I ordered, I didn't get the fries!  So I call Sonic, I asked for MARTHA with the nose ring.  I told her who I was and that they also forgot my fries.  Wait for it!  Wait for it! She told me that I have thirty day's to pick up my fries and that she is sorry, she is training new people.  That was her excuse!  I can't believe the horrible service! And the fact that I had to turn around with the result of nothing.  And when I got home, my order still wasn't complete. With having to deal with that bull, our food was cold and my kid's sonic blast were melted by the time we got home  I have called corporate.  I hope she either get's a boot up her @$$ or fired! Training new people is not a reason for poor costumer service.

My wife and I stopped in one day because it's only a block from our apartment and were very surprised to learn that their pizza, to my mind, is the best I have ever had. 

Allow me to explain: For most of the 15 years we've been married, I would eat the pizza and leave the crusts. I could never find a crust I liked. I prefer a thin crust but not so chewy as most of them are.

The owner said something about their crust being a combination of wheat or something but I can tell you this: It's the Best Crust I've Eaten (and I ate every bit of it.)

We've been back a bunch of times and we usually get a combo pizza and soda and spend less than $12. Recently, we ate at a table in front of the restaurant and watched the tourists walking by. 

Next time you're in the River Walk district (it's only about a hundred yards from the Beautiful Truckee River) you've got to try Pizanos Pizza! Seriously, it's great.

Recently I stayed at this hotel for 5 days attending a conference.  From check in to check out was riddled with issues.  The TV did not work; hotel did not have a spare (day 1 no TV).  Wi-Fi was spotty(to be fair, this may have been related to my Iphone 5 however I had not experience this type of issue before nor did I experience any issues connecting to the conference WiFi at the convention center).  The only saving grace is that hotel management was responsive and returned one full night stay, issued me a dinner voucher and 4 breakfast vouchers, upgraded my room once a room with a TV became available.  I would not recommend staying at this hotel.  The entire experience was just an inconvenience

I like it but I can count 4 or 5 times where servers didn't even come over or bring what I ordered. They didn't take anything off the bill either - I had to show them then wait forever to get my bill again. The service is mediocre!

I started coming to this office last year. Had my 1st cleaning for 2018 today along with a filing. Dr  Lawton has been amazing. The staff is wonderful,  able to make payment arrangements if needed. HSA and care credit accepted also.  Haven't had any billing issues and have had a great time. Don't know if I have ever said that about going to the dentist in my life.

1 Star-   Total failure of an experience based on this experience would not return. Would not recommend.

2 Star-  Below average on several levels, not a total failure. Wouldn't seek out to return or recommend.

3 Star-  Average experience, minimum expectations met. Nothing that says wow or that stands out. Would return if someone else wanted to come, not a regular go to.

4 Star-  Above average experience, will come here again and recommend to friends and family.

5 Star-  This will be a regular go to and will be highly recommended to people I know. Exceeds expectations on a consistent basis.

Authentic Mexican tacos. Doubled-up corn tortillas and stuffed to the brim with meat, cilantro, and cheese. We got the steak, chicken, and pork (pastor) tacos to go. Everything was delicious but our favorite was the marinated pork. They also sent me with a few to-go containers of different salsas without me asking. We will definitely be back!

I LOVE vintage EVERYTHING and this is my favorite vintage shop in Nashville. The price range is wide and the shopping experience is easygoing. I wish that I could buy everything in there. I can't get enough of Pre to Post Modern. 

Love it love it love it!

AFTER-HOURS ORTHOPAEDIC INJURY CLINIC ~ five stars!

My guy hurt his back and ended up in the hospital ER for the pain. Took several hours as expected and he left after getting a shot of Toradol and scripts for muscle relaxers, pain pills, an anti-inflammatory and steroids. Four days later with only about 10% relief, we went to the after hours clinic at TOI that runs from 5-9pm M-F and 9a-1p on Sat.

Got there around 5:30pm expecting a long wait only to be checked in immediately and before we could fill out 3 or 4 lines on the patient questionnaire, we got called back. Answered a few questions and my guy was taken for x-rays. Within 5 minutes he was back and it only took another 5 minutes max for the PA to come in. He examined my husband more thoroughly (hands on) and was able to diagnose the problem. 

Sent us next door to get fitted with a brace - excellent customer service there as well - and were out the door armed only with a brace and a prescription for a super duper strong anti-inflammatory. 

Guess what? My guy is not 100% yet but he is quickly on the mend thanks to the TOI after hours clinic. Super fast, super knowledgeable and super customer service! I highly recommend them.

My brother thought it was a good idea for us to visit the day after Christmas. We did 3 days, 2 nights. He has been twice to this location, and once to their Austin location. I thoroughly enjoyed my time here. I got a ton of nourishment for my well being. I experience meditation & floatation meditation for the 1st time. Rhythmic Drumming session was great as well. Wanted to go on a hike but the weather didn't cooperate. The restaurant offered great, healthy food. If you're trying to eat clean, you'll have no problems. All the staff are genuinely happy and friendly. You can tell they enjoy where they work. I will be back and will bring friends.

First time here, for basically an empty restaurant after Colts 
game it took to long for a server to come tableside, she said it was confusion. Ordered a burger mW, it came medium. Ok no big deal, onion rings were nothing special very thin and greasy . Good server, food could be much better. Wife had Mac and cheese she liked it. Will be hard pressed to come back. Maybe once more?
Their ramen is addicting. I highly recommend the spicy curry ramen. It's delicious. Service was great as well. Definitely give it a try. You will not be disappointed.

This is my favorite farmer's market in the entire city! This is located along the border of Rittenhouse Square, so if the large variety of vendors exhausts you, you can take a break from the excitement and sit on a park bench. This is a great place to find local meats and produce as well as different baked goods and plants, and my dog loves all of the other pups here!
It was a wonderful rainy day but we stayed dry under their covered tables outside. Food, drinks and service was on point.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS.... If you have nowhere else to live, I highly recommend camping out in a cardboard box until you find a place as you'll fare much better this way. It's insanely ridiculous to live in, costing over $1000 even if you slum in a tiny room for 4. And what do they do with all this money? Lord knows, because they sure as hell aren't spending it on their "Bon Apetit café"... a more apt name would be "Eat Shit and Die" because that's what I did every damn day last year. They rarely offer any healthy options, unless you don't mind grubbing on their salad bar (at your own risk: it NEVER gets rotated throughout the day, and I have personally found both dirt and mold in their vegetables that got ZERO attention from the impartial staff). Good luck fitting in your clothes by the end of the year, because you either gain so much weight from gorging pure grease and shit or lose weight starving out. Their RAs aren't very professional either. Some RAs have been known to discuss a resident's personal life or go out drinking with residents... And the staff are shady as FUCK, they pay/force their RAs to write reviews on Yelp to compensate for the sheer truth that is being shed on this god awful apartment complex. Yeah, that's right Trop, I'm calling you fuckers out!! Your "good reviews" are clearly fabricated. (i.e. Trevor B) All I can say is shady, shady, shady.
************IN CONCLUSION DON'T EVER LIVE HERE*****************

I submitted a renewal for my passport back in end of April / May along with my partner. Website says as of 6/04 its been processing.... My partner recieved her passport but mine still says processing. I've been calling the 877 number daily,  and have even tried the 504 number in hopes of getting an appointment, but most of the times it says the line is busy, beeps a few times, and hangs me up. 

Yesterday, after waiting on hold for over 3 hours, a service lady picked up the phone, and proceeded to tell me to call back again in a few more days because she couldnt book an appointment for me for 8/11 and hung up on me.  The number does not even let me stay on hold most of the time. I am at this point panicking as my travel plans have been set months in adavnace and my application was submitted months ago. 

I have been calling daily for the last two weeks in hopes of getting my passport. I am traveling 8/15 and am in need of my passport. Can someone please advise on how to speak to the office / get in touch directly?

We met a friend for brunch and opted for the Bakehouse.
 I love the sample Danishes. Sadly they didn't have the sample with crumbles... So I had a couple extra samples, it was Delish!
 I've been craving an egg croissant Sammy and boy did theirs hit the spot! I asked for the ham on the side not knowing if it'd be a huge slab of ham steak, it was four slices of thinly sliced ham which went perfectly in the sandwich. The croissant was nice and flaky however I think there could have been a bit less cheese
 Hubby had the chicken pesto panini and said "It was MEH... not enough pesto, good amount chicken, too much cheese" so he wasn't ecstatic about his but I will be back if in the area.

Be warned the drinks are picked up by customers, apparently this is not expressed to customers at the register or throughout ordering. We found this out by the snarky waitress who "HAD" to bring ours ... Not the most friendly person I'd hope to encounter

Pizza was awesome. I am not a crust kind person, but I defiantly ate every bite here. The Olivier were awesome, they came out warm, I loved it! I tried almost all the pizza and enjoyed every single one. This place is hard to find, no signage. Perfect for a date night or even a girls night. Very small and quaint little hole in the wall kind of place. This is defiantly not a cheap date night!

Yes! Just yes! Came here for lunch with the family. Great experience. We did not have reservations but they were accommodating. 

We started with the gambas al ajillo(spicy garlic shrimp) small plate, it comes with a rosemary garlic sourdough slices. Don't forget to dip your bread into the sauce beneath the shrimp, Makes it extra yummy!

My kiddo tried the edamame and the ahi poke small plate. Both very fresh and tasty! 

I had the miso king salmon. It's a winner! Has a little sweetness with the cranberries and sundried tomatoes which is different but a yummy flavor overall. Very pleased.
