My hubs got the bulgolgi bowl. It was massive and very tasty. A little too much sauce on the rice for my liking but next time I will simply order my rice on the side Just personal preference. The flavors were crazy good.

We got the chocolate lava cake with green tea ice cream and it was very death by chocolate, which is excellent for anyone with a sweet tooth!

First and last!!! I had a baby German roach walking right next to me on the booth. It was right after we finished our meal. I didn't want to make a huge deal. I don't want to go back until they show a certification that the place is roach free. I'm not seeking for a free meal or anything. I'm just trying to make people aware this place is new and has roaches!! We told the manager and I know there's nothing they can do, also heard the waitress saying I'm not dealing with that. I wish I didn't panic the way I did or I would have take a picture of my "little friend" as the manager called it! Gross!!!! totally disgusting! Also the food is not that great as I expected it. My ribs had good flavor on the ends... Middle was like water...  The good thing was the dessert and thank God it was free cause I had a coupon.

Visiting the west coast for work and I have heard about in and out for years and years.  Anyways, in and out happened to be like 5 minutes from me so I just HAD to try it.  I like how the menu is very simple.  Burgers, fries and shakes.  I didn't have a shake, but I had a burger and fries.  The burger to me taste like a fresher version of Wendy's except with special sauce on it.   I thought it was very good.  But not all oversized like how five guys is. Also the fries are really good. I'm Simone who likes plain French fries.  And everything is made hot and fresh.  So unlike McDonald's , you're not rolling the dice on getting hot fries.

This neighborhood shop is the best! The coffee is my favorite in the whole city, ask where they keep the fresh whole cream- it's delightful and decadent to add it to coffee. The sugar creme pie -OMG. I now know why it's Indiana's state pie. Love the blaring reggae music and French country vibe. A true gem in SoBro.
Tokyo roll was awesome. Jumbo Spicy Tuna was ok. Ramen was yummy. A little pricey for a fast food sushi place but we will be back.

I REALLY wanted to give this restaurant 5 stars. But here goes: 

Pros: 
Super cute venue, looks like you are in a shipping container
GREAT location
Good vibes
Chicken wings appetizer (with peanuts on them) are AMAZING
Burger is rightfully so claimed to be the best burger in Nashville. Order it 100%


Cons:
Service was really slow, we had to check on our food after waiting around for a bit, then the waitress gave us the check while I was still eating which felt pretty rude
My wedge salad with hot chicken had so much potential, but the chicken left grease all over my salad, making it pretty unappetizing.
Excellent customer service and great pizza/entree options! Close to my house which makes it an even better option!

Clean new food hall with lots of seating & staff cleaning off tables.  There were clean restrooms & a lot of staff taking dirty trays & scrubbing tables.  There was a drink counter with nice selections.

Very nice selection a wine bar, shake shack, pizza, donuts, chicken, poke, Middle Eastern, gelato, coffee bar, burgers, BBQ, fried, shaved ice, Indian, cookies, sushi, Chinese, wursts, ice cream, pastries... Most prices seemed reasonable & portions were generous. 

Tonight there is an Eagles tribute band at 8 and tomorrow the Stones at 8 on the SkyDeck.

Incredible flavor, generous portions, reasonable prices, and a casual dining atmosphere are just a few of the many highlights found at Billy Bryant's BBQ. This northwest Tucson treasure is a great place to visit when you are in the mood for some excellent barbecue and freindly conversation. Don't forget, they cater too!

I drove into St. Louis for a convention and didn't check in until fairly late at night. The neighborhood is very sketchy-looking to say the least (but them again, I found that to be the case all around the general St. Louis area. No offense), but that's not necessarily the hotel's fault. 
Check-in was very friendly and fast. The gentleman tending the front desk was helpful and efficient, even recommending a nearby pizza joint for a late-night bite. 
The hallways in this hotel are damp and stale-smelling. The elevator smelled like weed.  
The room was simple, no-frills. Clean bedding, comfortable pillows, and a working AC (although before turning it on the room was extremely warm and humid. A bad greeting when coming indoors from a very hot summer day lugging baggage). There were some dirty crevices here and there perhaps indicating a rushed cleaning job. 
I had a pretty awful view of the hotel's rear driveway which looked badly-kept. There appeared to be an abandoned car on the other side of a wrought iron fence that separated the hotel grounds from a grassy lot/field. 

All in all, a pretty no-frills experience but okay if you only plan on sleeping in the hotel and have a car so that you can drive to restaurants and attractions away from the area. I did feel it was perhaps a bit overpriced; it should have fallen in the $60 per night range instead of the $87 per night I paid.

My parents introduced me to Ale Emporium's $6.95 dinner on Tuesday in 2013. Ever since we've been meeting every week for dinner with friends and co-workers! The $6.95 dinner includes salad, soup or chili, baked potato or fries and bacon wrapped steak or grilled chicken! If you order a beverage you're still under $10! Herman is the nicest GM and always provides unparalleled customer service! You've gotta ' try the Hermanaki wings, pizza, Gyro and burgers! For my appetizer, I always order the breadsticks and cheese....delicious!

great happy hour specials. we sat outside and enjoyed drinks - i had the red sangria & it wasn't too sweet - you could taste alcohol in it. i had the steak sliders with horseradish on them with a side salad - just the right amount of food. their fries are to die for too.

I gotta say I hate spicy food, but I had to man up for this.

Their mac & cheese is amazing!!!!
Loaded mac with the chicken 

The wings are more than perfect, I forgot the name of the one I had but is a mix of all sauce 

Give them a try well recommend!!!! 

Keep it up guys!

This was my second visit to this cozy little neighborhood spot. My last visit was about a year and a half ago and it was fantastic. My friend and I decided to go at the last minute without a reservation. Although they were full, they sat us right away in their covered patio section which was pleasant.We were greeted with freshly made bruschetta and from start to finish our service was spectacular. The owner came to our table several times to check on and was very friendly. We both cleaned our plates and even finished dessert. I had Veal Piccata with pasta and it was wonderful. I can't wait to go back and try some of their seafood dishes.

My first experience was a horror show. I didn't get the to go order I wanted and my husband picked it up so he didn't know. My last two trips have been stellar. I was given extra breadsticks and a hearty salad. Definitely redeemed themselves.
What a great menu! There is something for everyone to enjoy. Kids love the perrogies, delicious seafood and vegetarian options. Fried chicken is a favorite.

First time ever to have the Trader Joe's experience. Overall it was great, but I was expecting it to be a lot bigger. Since this was my first time, I wasn't really sure what to get other than the Speculoos Cookie Butter. Thank God for internet and Buzzfeed for providing me with a list of the most popular items there. This was just a quick side trip before running more errands so I wasn't able to grab anything that needed to be refrigerated (whatever, it's an excuse to go back!). But I managed to grab the cookie butter mocha swirl, roasted seaweed snacks, a bottle of sweet chili sauce, veggie chips, and a bottle of the $2 Charles Shaw Pinot Grigio. $2 for wine???? I had to try and it and it's actually not bad. I'd be interested to try the other blends.
I was happy with my overall purchase and I can't wait to go back to try other things from here. The staff are all so friendly and very helpful. And the prices won't break your wallet either, which is always a good thing.

Cadiz is a beautiful restaurant with a great atmosphere. Wow, and all the tapas were fantastic! I especially loved the lamb meatballs, the flatbread pizzas, the meat skewers. The wine list was very nice, and the San Sebastian cocktail was fabulous. I could see this as being a great date night place, and I look forward to visiting again!
Almost an hour to get two burgers and wings and the employees outnumber the customers. Ridiculous!!!

A group of six of us went on this tour yesterday. Livvy was our guide, a native whose family has lived here for many generations.  She did an excellent job of explaining the different food cultures and tastes, along with fascinating bits of history and trivia of New Orleans. I recommend that all visitors here make Tastebuds Tours the first tour they take.

I like the med salad with dressing on the side. Service is always great and they won't take tips. It is great for kids who like the soda machine, a great way to end or start a target shopping trip in Boise.
Loved this place. Not your typical "florida beach food" but very authentic and fairly priced.

Ordered delivery on a Saturday.  Food came fast and hot! The burrito weighed probably 5 lbs.  it was so big and very good!  The chips and salsa came with verde salsa which was surprising but good.  Onion rings come with a Texas medal sauce that complimented them very well.  Would definitely order from here again!
Ordered green curry and Tom yum. Both unnecessarily oily. The green curry wouldve been passable if not so much oil. Tom yum was inedible. Confirms there is no good Thai food in Tucson :(

Well if you like customer service then this is your kind of place. As soon as you walknin the door you get that lovely sound "can I help you find something"! You never have to hunt somebody down. They always have most everything the big box retailer stores have or they will get it for you. Oh and the newest thing is they can replace your high-tech chip car keys for a fraction of the cost.

Love this hidden bar. Really cute date night spot. It's definitely not recommended for groups larger than 6 people since the space is limited. 
The drinks are little pricey but very unique.

Dr Lusk and the staff have taken exceptional care of me during a very difficult time. Loosing your vision, even for a short period of time is extremely stressful.  The treatment I have received has helped me to regain my vision and given me hope for the future.

Fun atmosphere and great food. Get's a bit crowded but that makes it that much better. "Serve yourself" the wine is dangerous but a nice twist. Everyone that works there is very friendly and the food is awesome. Don't eat too many of the garlic rolls, they are addicting.

Best place ever!!! Get the famous franolli and ice cream donuts! The customer service is amazing and they engage in conversations with everyone. The owner is such a down to earth guy. Great bakery, I'll never go to another one.

My sister and I never wavered from our appreciation of all that Lynne was able to do for us, under all the additional challenges after our mom passed away. I feel so blessed that we were able to successfully work with Lynne, even without a personal referral. She went out-of-her-way to accommodate my not living in the area and without my having a car. Lynne is a master at her craft.

Sampan is one of my favorite restaurants in my neighborhood for so many reasons. 

The atmosphere is really cool! The ambiance is perfect for a large group or a date night with your partner!

Happy hour is SO. CHEAP. And it's every single day of the week. You do have to get there right as it's starting otherwise your chances of getting a seat are slim but if you do find yourself one, it's SO worth it. Order anything on the menu, you cant go wrong. 

I'm a vegan and I always leave here so. full. The smashed cucumber salad is unreal! It's the perfect balance of refreshing and spicy and I loveeee it. My ultimate favorite thing on the menu though, has to be the King Oyster Mushroom Satay. I order at least two (for myself) every single time I go. I don't know how they make it or what kind of wizardry they're using but it's SO. GOOD. 


Long story short, you can't go wrong. It's a perfect place for any occasion and no matter what you order, you'll be happy! It's amazing.
I really like the food and service!  Make sure to ask for the onion rings extra crispy!

What a cool place!! I'm not REALLY into comics but I'm into games and this place could lend itself to game playing quite easily. When i was there a tournament was just starting in some sort of computer game. I like board games. Both can live together especially with the snacks available and the many coffee and chai drink choices. 

Altogether a nice place with super nice people running it!

I've been a patron at this establishment for many years and today I was met with such an atrocious attitude by a gentleman that I'm luckily enough to not have the pleasure of knowing his name. If you're overwhelmed with simply taking orders and handing out burgers then sir I suggest you find another occupation. Definitely will not be returning to The Grillshack Burgers and Attitude.

Coming from a Hyderabadi food junkie!

1. Two stars for butter naan, since quantity was very little for the price paid.

2. Four stars for Chicken Biryani has always been delicious at this place. The taste hasn't changed a bit. Point to be added: this isn't Hyderabad dum biryani, rather has a tint of Andhra it.

3. Four stars for Butter Chicken was tasty, but wasn't authentic to Bawarchi's stature, but is better than the curries I have tasted in the rest of Nashville.

4. One star for the mirchi ka salan! I don't know concoction was that! They shouldn't be serving that.

I've only been here once but I can already tell I love this place. On my first visit I only stopped in quick for a cappuccino, and it was delicious. And while this spot seems quaint and small, I was told by the barista that there is outdoor seating once the weather warms up! 

The decor in this place is simple and done just right. Love the woodwork and cute plants in the window!

Yes the apartments are cheap, but it comes at a biiiiiiiiiiig price. I was a resident at their 2122 locust street building, but am no longer because THE ENTIRE BUILDING WAS DESTROYED IN A FIRE. Fore the record this fire was not caused by a resident, but rather some old faulty electrical wiring in the walls. Need I say more? Not only that but WPR have been ghosts since the event, not to be seen or heard from.... 

Even before the fire I had the same experience as some of the previous reviewers. For my 1 bedroom apartment my heating bill had topped $400, and for that price it still was not warm inside. It is not worth the cheap rent at all, I repeat NOT WORTH THE CHEAP RENT AT ALL. You will definitely be paying more in one way or another.

I just purchased my dress today, thank you kiecia for being thorough, patient, and most of all extremely helpful in this possibly stressful process! I felt completely comfortable working with kiecia and requested for her when I came back to pick up the dress.  As far as the store I felt that this Davids bridal has a large selection of dresses that fit all types of budget. I was able to find a beautiful dress from a Davids bridal collection for way under what I thought a wedding dress would cost.  I'm extremely happy with my experience at this store and would highly recommend this store and Kiecia!!!

Everyone said to get the tofu bahn mi, so I got the tofu bahn mi. Zero regrets, and I would get another one in a heartbeat. The tofu is season and cooked well, with a nice crunchy texture on the outside. And so affordable! Cash only. Come here on a nice sunny day and enjoy your bahn mi in Clarke park, only a short walk away.

Love Kayak's. Their drinks are imaginative and delicious and a little less expensive than places like Starbucks. The atmosphere is great: cozy, calm, perfect for catching up on reading or studying. And sometimes you'll see Wash U's Chancellor there trying to be cool in his suit and tie. Haven't had much of the food, but that that I have had is pretty tasty. And I love that they offer a smores meal with your own little fire and everything. Its a great idea. A little Colorado-y, but lovely on a Sunday afternoon.

Not usually one to write reviews, but this place deserves all the attention. Came here last night and as soon as arriving, my date and I were in awe by the beautiful decor, inside and out. 
For the food, ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL! I ordered the heirloom tomato panzanella salad (sub dressing to make vegan) and my date ordered the scallops and succotash. Everything about it was perfect, taste, portion, temp, and seasoning. Not too filling and extremely fresh. 
I've worked in the restaurant industry for quite a few years now, and everything about this place is perfect. From water often being filled, friendly and attentive service, and management (obvious the managers were doing their rounds on the floor, A+) they've clearly got their stuff together and care about their customers. 
To end the meal, we were surprised by dessert! Turns out my date new a server there, so they threw us a free round. He received the blackberry mascarpone cheesecake, and was blown away. They heard I was vegan, and brought me the most delicious dark chocolate sorbet I've ever had! 
Probably the best service, and food I've ever received. Honestly go here, the price and your time will be completely worth it

Very great experience....loving my 2018 Dodge Journey...Deb and Ashley were extremely helpful...only one concern needs to be changed and that's the flexibility of payments...shouldn't only be a daily payment especially when paying to own for two years....however work out a budget and go with this company...I reccomend to everyone 
The whole team is phenomenal David Judy and etc...all around great

Food here is still excellent, but the service has gotten kind of weird. I've eaten here with my family and they gave us a 15% gratuity, although it was just 4 of us. I'm in the restaurant industry so I did think it was sketchy that they included gratuity when it's such a small party. In another past visit, a waitress ran after me when she thought I didn't tip her (I gave the receipt to another waitress). Totally unprofessional.

First time here and we will definitely be back! For me, the quality of a breakfast joint depends on their biscuits and gravy. If you can get that right, I'll be a regular! This place gets it right... And that was just the breakfast appetizer!! My main dish was the crab cake Benny! What can I say? Excellent!! This I will be on our regular rotation!

I LOVE Kalyra wines!  I first discovered Kalyra as part of a wine tour north of Santa Barbara.  When I found out they had a location downtown, I was pleasantly surprised.  I actually think the service at this location is better (I've had somewhat negative experiences with the servers at the other location... like telling me that I'm two tastings ahead of where I actually was and giving me a skeptical look... eww).  You lose the awesome scenery, but at least your steps away from some good happy hour picks!

Great place to eat! We sat at the bar and had a couple of drinks along with a dozen charbroiled oysters. They were great and Mike the bartender was friendly and informative on the food and the city. Also had the sampler with gumbo jambalaya and etouffee all of which were flavorful and what you'd expect from New Orleans.

An excellent meal at a steakhouse we've been to multiple times. EC especially was attentive and did an excellent job of service! Both steaks were cooked to perfection! The oysters were fantastic as well as the French onion soup. Could not have been happier with the experience!

Maybe it is the fact I was traveling with several of my boys for jazzfest...maybe it was because I miss a bar with a great beer selection. But either way for this out of towner I loved this bar and the variety of beers to choose from. Even had some decent meat pies and gravy. Few of my boys had roast beef po boys and similarly the food is ok not great...but at midnight after a long day of traveling and drinking is just the ticket!

Server was very impatient with us when we were perusing the beer menus, my husband's burger was undercooked and when we  told the server she said she didn't know what to do about it and the manager came by and said that her favorite burger is also medium well and that is the way they cooked it.  My onion rings were burnt and the manager, Tosha took a Napkin off of our table and picked them from my plate with bare hands to take back to show the cooks.  It was an incredibly unusual and unsanitary experience.  Gave it 2 stars for the excellent Reuben but I don't think we'll be back.
Love their soft sweet tofu dessert.. The tofu is very silky..  The soy milk is good and fresh...
Wonderful and wholesome dairy products. The restaurant is fantastic! Definitely a must to check out.

This place is awesome! And I normally don't eat Asian food!!

If you are hungry, opt for the market bar. It is unlimited and the servers can give you suggestions for sauce creations if you are as bad as I am with my own "concoction". 

I have to say my favorite dish is the lettuce wraps, though. They are so much better than P.F. Changs or Houllihans and come with two different sauces (one mild and one really hot) so it caters to different palettes. 

Other good dishes to try:
1. Crab Rangoons
2. Sweet and Spicy Chicken
3. Coconut Curry Vegetables (VERY spicy)
4. Banana Wontons
5. Good Fortune Ice Cream 

The service is amazing here and the staff is always friendly. Brad normally works in the bar, but is on top of everything and will remember you when you come back! Mark and Ted are also very nice and will get you anything you need.

As someone who eats out almost every night, I am telling you that you won't be disappointed with the food or the service. The managers are great, the cooks are friendly and the wait staff is superior.

Anyone who knows me knows that I am a PHO-natic (see what I did there? If you don't press the "Funny" button after that, I obviously just can't impress you) and it is my go-to choice for lunch, every day. Now, that being said, coupled with my low-sensitivity taste buds which are very welcoming to almost any sort of food, this place is o.k. at best. Any Pho place starts off at 5 stars in my head... just for serving this delicious treat. 
However, this place seems to get a little carried away with the pepper, I'll add that myself if I want it, thank you. They are also quite pricey for what it is... I will pay 20 bucks for lunch without much complaint... usually... but paying 20 bucks for a place with the menu on the wall behind the counter seems a little steep. (minus one star) 
Now, the worst part of all... parking, oh... my... nonexistent! This section of town, if you didn't know, is the "cool" section, the "hip" section, or, as I like to call it, the "Make Andre' feel 155 years old" part of town. However, I guess carpooling isn't "cool" any more... because it seems CRAZY to try and find a spot, and the available spots are all along the street, back-in only spots... which means for people like myself with big trucks, a little bit of tricky driving maneuvering, but it's ok with me, sorry college kids, I LIKE getting honked at! (preposition to end the sentence? eek.)   (Minus one star)
Well, kids, thats the skinny on Saigon Pho... mediocre, there's better options close by, in my humble opinion.

Cheers-
 dRe'

Pretty good selection of different natural foods. You have to watch the pricing, some items will be more expensive than Whole Foods and other items will be cheaper. Walmart carries some of the same items at a cheaper price.

Customer service could have been better. The cashier was super friendly to the lady in front of me and when it was my turn to checkout, it felt like my presence was inconveniencing her even though I wasn't being rude. It's always fun when the customer has better customer service than the cashier. Normally I would just chalk this up to having a bad day, but the contrast in how she acted from the previous customer to me seemed like that wasn't the case.

Overall, I recommend Natural Grocers which is nearby, has most of the same items and quite a few that Sprouts doesn't carry at generally a better price.. staff is always pretty nice. You can also check out Walmart.

GREAT brewery! This was the 201st brewery my husband and I have been to and it ranks right up there! GREAT beer! GREAT vibe! Friendly and knowledgeable staff! And perhaps most telling of all, there was a diverse crowd of beer drinkers - not only young or older or men or women! Looking forward to returning in the summer, chilling outside and making new friends!

Went to get a window re-tinted after some meth head was nice enough to smash it out in broad daylight. Guys got me in on short notice, took care of the window, and I was done in under half an hour. The loss of stars was for the attempts to upsell - I am sensitive to this as a woman - and the proposed charge to diagnose a radio problem. I'd probably go back, especially for tinting. but I almost always have my guard up around car shops - just like being a chick in a bar, you have to be careful to make sure some guy doesn't try to take advantage of you, and this place was better than most but I'd still watch it.

I had the lamb ... first of all it was cold... even though it was done to my specification ... flavor was good ... I ate the small red potatoes... The rest of the items that were on the plate were overcooked... I'm assuming it was spinach... There were I all so was assuming over grilled peperoncino .... i'm an old-school lamb eater so they gave you some kind of puréed mint leaves... I asked for lamb jelly they had none... There was some other dollop of something I didn't recognize... so all in all I was disappointed because previous visits which we are far and few between I remember nothing but good food.... I should have stuck with my first choice of the mushroom raviolis... But I wanted something different this time... The lamb dish is normally $36 but because we went to the show it was 50% off thank goodness....

The service was absolutely horrible and they were very rude to my friends and I. We were there for a reunion and the way they handled our table that night ruined the atmosphere. We saw that it had good reviews so we had high expectations except we were quickly let down. The food was the worst hibachi I have ever had. All the fried items/appetizers were so undercooked we could not eat any of the food they would bring out to us. I felt really embarrass and unappreciated at this restaurant I will surely never return to this establishment.

The folks at the Nashville West location are amazing. They were smart, professional and extremely pleasant which is important when your hurting and there for therapy. Could not ask for better care. Therapy was great and I feel better!!!

The people in their business office are incompetent. They charged me thinking I was out of network. (I was in network and had previously met my deductible) I get an honest mistake-no big deal but,,

When I discovered the mistake the business office tried to blame me and then blamed Cigna insurance for their mistake. They now have refused to reimburse me until they get paid by Cigna. The Results business office failed at,  treating your customer's honorably and with respect.

Great customer service! Easy off loading. The workers will assist you if necessary, if you need help getting stuff out of your truck. The nice traffic controller guy will direct and guide you to the right pile of crap to discard your items in. Thanks guys!!!
My friends and I went here for appetizers and the staff was extremely friendly. The food was amazing and our server Gerard was VERY polite and enthusiastic!

This is seriously the best tacos I've ever had in my life. I'm talking about finger licking, drool worthy tacos. The beef tongue and heart and interest ones were all delightfully juicy and tasty. I kept going back for me. I had 6 tacos in one setting and I totally don't hate myself for over eating. I am planning a trip back up to Santa Barbara just for Lily's tacos. No joke.

I think, no I know, that I have a new favorite brunch spot in this city and it is nestled in a really odd little corner of Northern Liberties. Sunday morning brunch is a staple event in my life, the best sweet and savory meal to be had shared amongst friends with the addition of pre-noon alcohol consumption without stink eye, really...it's quite perfect. Vinny P., Leo I. and myself had a delightful outdoor brunch that will soon be repeated if I have any say in it, oh! and I do because I plan brunch club. My first visit here with the boys was absolutely lovely, the weather was great and we sat in the finished alley still within earshot of the beautiful jazz music being played from inside, but quiet enough that we could still have a nice little conversation. My eggs Jerry was amazing, I'm a sucker for all brunch things that include smoked salmon so this order was a no-brainer. Paired with a hashbrown and baguette toast for dipping into the drippy eggs and a mug of La Colombe, I'd say this was a darn near perfect meal.

My second visit here was with my main hoe Aaliyah P. and her yelp love Zachary H. where we initially asked for a table, but ended up settling for seats at the bar near the open front door and just across from the bass and guitar players. Bar seats are honestly not a bad way to go if you have only 2-3 eating together, you get an awesome view of the bartenders making nicely crafted cocktails while catching the light cross breezes of the restaurants space. Speaking of space, this place is beautiful...hard to believe that it once played home to a super divey bar. This visit started as all should, with a beautiful Hendricks cocktail followed by a shared plate of bacon, a shared walnut cinnamon sticky bun and then onto entrees of which two of us ordered the shirred eggs while the other ordered a burger. The shirred eggs with mushrooms and spinach and that delicious truffle oil was a great choice, my only qualm was that the eggs were slightly overcooked and not quite as drippy as I would have liked. It wasn't serious enough that I would send it back and ask for it to be done over again, but it might make me think twice about ordering it again. While most might say that's a bold statement to not order a second time for something easily fixable, I say it's just as well because the rest of the menu looks just as delicious that I don't know if I 'd ever want to order the same thing twice.

I asked the waitress on our first visit what would happen to the alley in the winter months and she said she wasn't exactly sure except that there was talk that an outdoor fireplace/fire pit and/or heat lamps may be brought in to extend the outdoor dining season a bit longer which I am absolutely excited for. I debated for a long time sharing this review so as not to find myself in a position of not getting a table at my new favorite brunch place, but I'm in a continuously generous mood these days so run, don't walk here. You're welcome.

The wait time was shorter than expected so that's a plus! The Memphis taco is pretty good. Multiple people at our table got it and it was a winner all around. The philly steak taco was the special and it was WAY too spicy, we were not warned but it was still pretty good. The ambiance is nice and the staff is very polite, very accommodating for food allergies, especially gluten free needs.

Very good place to go for drinks and dinner. It's not cheap and that is a good thing. Ingredients taste fresh and there is an attention to detail that is appreciated. Apps, salad, drinks, main course, dessert all received rave reviews from everyone at the table. Would definitely go back.

I feel very relieved to find a mechanic that I trust. My alternator was out and I took it here to get fixed. The price was very fair ($100 cheaper than what another place quoted me) and it was fixed the same day. I will definitely come here in the future. I have such great peace of mind that I have a mechanic to come to that's honest and trustworthy.

Wouldn't order from here again.  Called at 6:43 and waited until 8:15 to call (After I was instructed the order would be an hour delivery time).  Once I called they said the food would be there in 20 min and was just put in the delivery car. Nothing came, called a third time asking to cancel, was told it was 5 min away... I figured id give them the benefit of the doubt.  30 min later, a total of 3 hours after I ordered, I called to cancel the order and/or get a refund due to the negligence of the customers order.  I was told it was 5 min away AGAIN.  They lost a costumer... I will wait to see if I get that "discount" they promised. My food arrived at... oh wait it isn't here yet @ 10:07. ridiculous.

just so everyone knows, We also got a bill for the FREE exam and xrays after all of the crap we went through that day just like a previous reviewer. What a waste of time to contact customer service to make sure something doesn't go to collections. It was supposed to be Free with the mention of the ad I even asked before we went in about it

I've been here a couple of times. Each time has not disappointed me. I've had their breakfast burrito, sandwich, coffee, lattes, etc. I will recommend this place as a great place for breakfast or brunch. The seating is nice and the layout is comfortable. There are some activities you can do that they have. You can bring your pet but leave them on the porch.

Great company to deal with, and I have had some humdingers in the past. Jeremy was our Tech in charge and did a great job in locating the problem with our A/C system. It definitely needed replacement and with in 2 days he have a complete system, ready for install. His crew completed the job in just under four hours and had us back in the cool air in no time. Also, to note!! Sunbeam offers a Veterans discount on their systems. My wife and I are as happy as can be!!! Glad I found them on Yelp!
They have a nice selection. Some items were missing price tags though. It seems like something they should fix.

Cute spot, tables and a bar, your choice. Delicious food and presentation. Also I love the staff our server was very kind and efficient! 
I'll be back!
Food was horrible, customer service was rude, restaurant was dirty, found a cockroach in the dinning area, restrooms where horrible.

I was so excited to try this place because the patio looked stunning and when we got there they told us that in order to have happy hour drinks we could only sit in the "lounge", which is more like a wannabe Applebees'. The drinks were decent, but the food was horrible. We got the fried calamari with fried vegetables to start and I don't think I saw one calamari plus everything was so soggy and dripping oil; it was pretty gross. My boyfriend got the fish and chips and they were the frozen kind and I got the fish tacos, which were okay, but I was so gross out already that I didn't even want to eat them. Lets just say we won't be going back!

Food is pretty consistent. I come here often for the happy hour burger and drink specials. the dry aged steaks and sides are great too.  Service is good.  I prefer sitting in the bar section because it's more relaxed.
Great pizza, fun atmosphere!  Service was good, as well!  Will definitely recommend to friends!

Thanks to my bf for showing me this place when we visited his hometown. Best Nashville hot wings. Big, tasty, and importantly very spicy! Spicy is my thing. I try to eat a 10/10, lol. Good beer selection also. Always a must whenever we are in town!
Best ice cream. I usually get chocolate covered strawberry and cookies and cream. Only need to get a single because it comes with 2 scoop.

Recently moved from Oregon. After a negative experience at the place we got our first car inspected, I tried this one for our second car. The staff was helpful and friendly. They got through the inspection and oil change (killed two birds with one stone) in a reasonable amount of time (just over an hour). I definitely plan to be back with other car maintenance.

we came in and were seated by the hostess. We never got a waitress. The section we were in had 2 other tables that were finishing meals.  We picked what we wanted and waited. Nothing. I peeked around the wall and didn't see any of their employees. 1 of the other tables in the same section had to wait at the register for a male employee to eventually appear to cash them out as we walked out. This was More than a half hour after arriving. we left and went to the McDonalds across the street.  Next time I'll just make the trip to the Rt 130 diner in Delran for the time I wasted, I could have. 

This was our 3rd visit and I doubt we'll be returning.

Wish I could give it more stars because it's a HUGE and beautiful bookstore. The apparel is cute (and overpriced) and well organized.

The lines are awful...both in the front and up in the Starbucks cafe and there is often no where to sit.

The selection of apparel and school supplies is great though.

Wish I could give more than five stars.Had a pulled pork sandwich pork melted in ur mouth.My wife had the Cuban sandwich she said it was the best she ever had.Very clean restaurant.They no there barbacue.Will definitely go back.

Decided we  needed a little staycation on the beach and since I had an old groupon from here figured why not. 

When I called to make the reservation I mentioned I had an expired coupon but the paid value should still be good. "No problem" was their response and I got my beachfront studio suite without any hassle whatsoever. 

Check in was smooth, The desk clerks were super nice and helpful. They give you beach towels at check in as well as a parking pass. There are lots of rules at this property ($25 for lost key, $25 for lock out, no smoking on balconies, pool towels need to be signed for, zero noise tolerance policy) all put in place for the comfort of their guests and I didn't mind a one of them 

The room was very nice, large comfy bed, separate living room area (divided by a  knee wall) gorgeous view of the beach, a kitchenette with frig, microwave , plenty of plates and glasses. The bathroom was standard but everything worked fine.

There is a lot of noise through the doors, I could hear the road even with my door shut and being on the back (beach) side of the building. It did not however bother me at night once the traffic slowed down. 

With every amenity you could want, the gorgeous view, the nice beach area and the proximity to lots of great restaurants and bars, I'd come back here. Never in tourist season of course, lol, but I'd come back here!
Whipped Feta will change your life. MUST TRY! Beautiful atmosphere and amazing food.

Slowest. Papa John's. Ever.

And needless to say absolutely avoid this place during lunch hour!

I applaud Alex for his honesty. I called up about cleaning my area rug and Alex was in the area so he stopped by to see the rug. After examining the rug he stated that unless it had a strong sentimental value not to bother with it. After pointing out all the flaws and the quality of the rug, it just wasn't worth the money to fix it. It probably would have cost $400-500.
I think most places would have just said "Sure, we can do it."  
I would definitely recommend him to anyone.
Katie L
Nice atmosphere nice service nice company at the bar good beer good food I'm full satisfied and really enjoyed my afternoon here.

‼THEY SELL BY THE SLICE‼

This is my favorite place to quickly grab a deliciously huge thin crust pizza. Their pepperoni is a classic must try; however, they do have some other tasty looking slices! 
If you have a lashes group of people coming in, you can also order your own personalized pizza. 
Great service, fast, grab and go, and nice outdoor seating. What more can you ask for?

Go early and there will be no wait. You can also put your name on the online waitlist before you head over if it's busy. Service was good and food came out quick and was served hot. My honey chicken with French toast was perfectly balanced and very delicious, I could only finish half. The three little pigs omelette was good but it was not as good as my dish. Irish coffee was perfect. When I come back to NOLA, we will visit again.

Service was almost non existent. Waiter seemed to care less that we were there. Even mentioned it was our first time being at the establishment. Nada. At one point, told the busboy I was concerned if our waiter had passed away. He laughed and said he would go find him for us.
Food was less than appetizing. I ordered the special, Char. Came out lukewarm and was placed on cold horseradish potatoes. (waiter never appeared to ask how things were) My wife had the strip steak, over cooked and also placed on a cold potato concoction. The experience was less than enjoyable. Will not return, even to try the bloody mary bar. There are much better restaurants/bars in St. Louis.

We ate here for Restaurant week. Despite the fact that they participated in the event the food was very skimpy and for the portions entirely overpriced. My wine was cold not chilled and for the quality of the wine very expensive. Do yourself a favor if it is pub food you crave frequent your neighborhood establishment. I have had better and you can do better. Not worth the money we spent. They took advantage of a fixed price menu and served very little food.

Our server however was lovely.

I went to Tribe on a Tuesday night wanting to do an lgbt karaoke night.  I did my first song fine but then the drag queen purposely gave me an edited track to sing to.  Every time i was about to do a big high note, it just skipped to the chorus.  Not really an issue if you dont notice that every time she had to sing, the tracks worked just fine.   If she does not know how to work the dj booth or the establishment is too cheap to afford the right tracks, i will gladly take my karaoke & drinking dollars elsewhere.  As for the atmosphere, it is ok...  bartenders are eh and the clientele are rather homely too.  I would recommend going elsewhere for hot guys to talk to.  Place was practically empty before midnight.

Of the hundreds times I've devoured a Chick Filet spicy chicken sandwich, this was THE BEST I've had. It had a heavenly crunch to it. 

No drive through, but ordering to go was quick and easy.

I am from philly and have eaten many steaks and have never gotten ill from it. Something isn't right with Pats. I don't know if it's the freshness of the condiments or ingredients or the cleanliness of the grill and staff but we were both sick for 2-3 days after eating there. Food poisoning matters and more people need to report this if it's happening after they eat here. So unfortunate. They are quickly serving so many tourists and Philadelphians without slowing down and assessing the problems.
Nothing beats a zorba greek salad and their fresh bread. The place is super small but the food is 100% authentic and fresh. Highly recommend

I have found my nail salon! I was in need of a full set and pedicure... I did a search on Yelp and came across this great place -- one of the reviews mentioned that the salon had an Instagram page, so I checked it out -- And, I loved their designs! It's so hard to find a salon that does both great nails and great designs! It's usually one or the other... Or neither, lol! Basic nails are a thing of the past... So, I headed over to the salon... They have plenty of parking in the back of the salon. My nail technician was Tracy, better known as Trae -- like another post mentioned -- she is very knowledgeable when it comes to nail care... I love the fact that she saved my natural nails! I'm so used to going to these other salons and having them butcher my natural nails when they remove the acrylic or having then cut them down to stubs, so they can apply tips to rebuild what they cut down... But, Trae didn't do that... She wrapped my nails and saved every last one! Moving on to the designs... I showed Trae a picture to give her an idea of what I was looking for, she quickly said, no problem -- she didn't need me to keep showing it to her for reference... She already knew what to do and how she was going to do it! I love my hands and feet! And, I look forward to returning for all my nail care needs and waxing!

I agree with Lindy B.  I have been here twice and both times my order was wrong.  The first time my Big Mac was missing the BURGERS.  The second time my meal was missing the fries and the girls at the drive thru were gossiping over the loud speaker for 6 minutes!  I had to say "HELLO!!" At least  20+ times before they took my order.  The staff is super rude.  This place is an epic fail.  I will continue to go to the Donelson location

Don't bother with them for a clean out or sale unless you have only "high end" furnishings and antiques to sell. Before I knew this, I had set up an appointment and they were a no show. Second appointment was set up, they cancelled. Third appointment owner showed up 10 minutes late, stayed 3 minutes, looked at our $12,000 dining room set and said it was only worth $200 to $400. No market for it. Why did they even bother to make an appointment with me? I told them what we had to sell when I called initially.  They wasted my time and never once apologized for not showing up as scheduled.....twice.

After reading a review on Tucson Foodie, I had to go try this new restaurant. We tasted 3 dishes and loved them all! The noodles were the best homemade noodles I've ever tried. The spice was just right and I can't wait to go back and taste the Chinese chicken wings!

I just had to file a Paypal dispute after getting an order confirmation email but no indication that order shipped. No order received at all. I tried to call but no answer. Emailed...no response. Order placed on June 8th and amount was charged. Hopefully they will respond to the dispute so I dont have to file a claim. I wish I would have read the reviews. There are a lot of recent bad ones. I can see why they are suspect. I will try to post an update on how things go in the future with my order. Such poor communication and bad business. I am a first time and last time customer. But they probably dont care...obviously.

I had a good first time experience here after the place being recommended by a friend. However, we only went for drinks. They have specialty drinks and a good selection of craft beer. I was in the mood for an Irish coffee and although it wasn't on the menu, the bartender made one for me anyway. He was very friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is "upscale" which isn't really my style, but I liked the experience here and would be willing to try the place again.

I decided to come out to Morea with my team. The reviews were strong, we had never been and we thought it would be the perfect place to come for us to all get to know one another and have a good time on a Friday night after a long day of work. 
From the moment we came in it felt very uncomfortable. We had our masks on we made reservations we did all we had to do as consumers on our end at that point, however we weren't received in a welcoming manner by any stretch of the imagination. From the moment we came in the hostesses (2) and who we learned to be the "lead mixologist" just stared at us and conversed between themselves our entire time here. While we were here for a goodnight we decided after we ordered that we would at least try the food before we left after feeling so uncomfortable, we gave them a shot and decided not leave so prematurely. While we waited the strange stairs didn't let up, at some point I looked at the lead mixologists directly into his eyes and he still didn't look away it was so uncomfortable. There was 6 of us, I'm not sure if it was over color or because he thought we wouldn't tip... no idea but not experience I would return for. 
The food was good and the drinks were meh. I wouldn't recommend the rose it tasted like bad orange wine.
went for after dinner dessert. It wasn't clear but the desserts come in takeout size and regular size. The takeout size doesn't come with ice cream but costs less.  I really liked the lychee mousse!

Great Laundromat!! Dropped off my clothes and they were washed and folded within a few hours. We were here on vacation and didn't want to cart back dirty clothes. The owner was so nice and even carried my bag to the car for me! Will definitely go back if we come back to the area :)

Datz is a super-fun place, with lots of options for indulgent eating and drinking.  The healthy side is not their focus, so don't go here if you're looking to cut or limit your calorie intake.  The food and the vibe are fantastic and the service is excellent.

I have taken my dog to Twin Peaks for the last three yrs. I had a bad experience with the recp on Dove Mt six months ago. I live on Dove Mt
so we decided to return  to twin peaks.  I called for a appt and was told for 2/10.2018 which is a Sat the only opening available was at 9.am and 2p.m.  My dog is a handful and requires my husband to come.  He works on Sat afternoons so I booked the 9 a.m.   When  i checked in at the desk I was told I don't have a 9.a.m . I have a 2.00.  I said that is impossible ......I cannot bring my dog in by myself and I would have never agreed to 2.00.   I asked to speak to the Vet and was told there is nothing that could be done......my choice is to come back at 2 p.m.  I explained that I cannot
bring the dog in by myself.    It is s a shame because we r eally liked the doctors but the staff needs to go to charm school.  As a result I called
another Vet in the area and will  not go back nor would I recommend them.

The first time that I was at Misconduct they had a foie gras burger that my friend ordered.  It looked AMAZING and I was very jealous.  I went back and was disappointed to find that it was removed from the menu.  I ordered the pulled pork slider instead, and was underwhelmed.  The whole sandwich was pretty dry, I didn't finish it.  

The beer selection is nice, but I wouldn't come here just for a bar, it is kind of cramped for that.

Do not buy food from this restaurant. We just picked up our food and had extremely rude staff who threw our credit card across the counter as well as the place having dirty counters and floors with nasty food on the floors. There are way too many good Chinese places to go to this dump.

Three day's in a row so far without any internet at all or sufficient consistency so as to be able to accomplish much of anything.  The issue was initially an "equipment malfunction" of some sort.  Each day we have been told the issue would be resolved by a certain time only to have them fail to deliver or push the resolution time back further.  

This has made it impossible to work from home (kind of a big deal during COVID).  I stupidly believed their latest promise for restoring service and purchased a UFC event, which I ended up having to stream via cellular on an iPad.  It was great sitting huddled around the 13 inch screen and trying to hear.  Thanks for that--well worth my money.  Throughout the day, our signal has progressed from spotty and awful to completely nonfunctional.

It is no surprise unfortunately. Many of my neighbors have switched from CenturyLink after having reported terrible service.

CenturyLink, we pay you in full, on time and rely on your service.  You are an internet provider.  How about PROVIDING THE INTERNET?!? 

So aggravating.  We're going to be forced to shop for an alternative.  My first call Monday morning will be to a competitor. I will pay more to put an end to this bad joke of a service.

Loved this place! Had a racer party for my 15-year-old, and the moment I walked in and met Lucy, our party host, I felt like everything was totally under control. She easily shepherded the kids from the ropes course to VR to laser tag and then fed them pizza before the big attraction: go karts! These karts are really modern and cool and they have serious helmets and other safety measures. And then we ended with hatchet throwing, which I had concerns about until I saw how well it was handled - even with a group of teen boys! Staff are awesome, the facilities are top-notch, the food is good AND affordable, and they had cocktails too! I expected a stressful night of party management and instead the Amp Up folks handled it all, beautifully. We will be back again soon, so the kids can have fun while us parents enjoy a relaxing evening of our own (there are comfy couches and it's a really nice atmosphere).

We really enjoy this OTB and end up here fairly often. It's a hit with the kids too. I love the Big Bordurrito. The biggest loss is that they don't have the Chocolate Turtle Empanadas anymore. =( Now their dessert menu is Meh. We don't bother with dessert anymore. We've had good, attentive, above-and-beyond service several times, and we've also had a few "average" service encounters - but never bad service.

I've been going to Jen at Q Salon for a few years now and I wouldn't think about going anywhere else. She always does such a great job and I wouldn't trust my hair with anyone except for the staff at Q Salon!

Loved the margaritas here. Some of the best I've ever had. The boyfriend who grew up 20 minutes from the Mexican border loved the margaritas, too. We did feel that the food was quite salty, specifically the nachos and the enchiladas. Be sure to drink tons of water!
We scheduled with AOV and had a family of five that was seen, examined, prescribed, and supplied with glasses and contacts. Awesome service and customer understanding of each person needs. Thanks.

I recommend running far from this place given their terrible service and poor quality. 

I came here a long time ago (I think when they first opened?) and had a single color gel nail done here, and it was not attractive. Probably the least appealing nails I've had to pay for; I honestly think I could have done better at home (and gel is easier than regular!). Not only that, the gel nails peeled off really soon after, so definitely was not worth my money, even though I wasn't too sad about it being gone. 

Then this past weekend, I hadn't realized this was the same spot when I purchased a groupon with some girl friends. For one thing, when I called to make an appointment, they informed me that there's only one person who can honor groupons at the whole nail place, so we would have to wait back to back. Not ideal but we were like fine, we'll take it. And then we went to the nail salon in super hot humid weather, and they tell us that the lady who can do our gel nails had to leave and won't be able to do our nails. Sure, I understand emergencies can happen, so I inquired why they didn't call us, and found out they had written down the appointments so poorly that they called the wrong number of someone who was booked before me. We were still willing to work with them on some solution and they got the lady on the phone, who was said she'll be back in a half hour or so, if we wouldn't mind waiting. Since we had to get our nails done back to back it would already have taken so long (how do they have only one person who can do gel nails for us on a Saturday?), we asked if they would do anything to compensate for this inconvenience (extra nail art or free pedis or something), and they kept insisting they could not offer us ANY additional perks or service because we were using groupons. I think groupons were an excuse, because why is that even relevant, other than the fact that we had already paid in advance? Anyways, so we left and found a much better spot a few blocks down, and was thankfully refunded when we contacted groupon about our negative experience. 

There are so many other nail spots in the area - check those out instead!

This was the best conference banquet I've attended.  The food was ok, which is far more than I often can say.  And I could run off to the engine room and inspect the steam engine once I hit people overload.  The cruise was on a partly foggy night, so not too much to see outside.  And no historical overview.  I'll be back for that someday, which bumps this out of the 3 area into the 4.  Getting to see the Dukes of Dixieland is fun, also, even though they're on the casino-circuit set list.  Probably didn't help that this computing conference's attendees are almost exclusively ultra-square males (myself included).

They do not know how to sit people at tables.  If you plan on dining, ensure you call for reservations regardless when.  Other reviews stated that doesn't work either so maybe get here 3 hours before you'd like to eat.
Awful experience. Waited over an hour for service. Food was fair. They offered no compensation for the frustration

There should be an option for ZERO stars.

With the expectation that this was going to be another uppity attempt of a Midwest restaurant claiming to serve genuine good Southern food , my wife and I decided to still try Juniper out for our anniversary dinner. We were dazzled by our experience. The food was prepared just right and portions were more than generous. I started out with the pulled pork nachos which I observed many others did as well. This starter plate was enough for my dinner tonight  and tomorrow night. My entree was Mae Mae's meatloaf, which along with the collard greens and sautéed okra, reminded me so much of my younger Georgia days. My wife had the fried green tomatoes and the short rib sandwich with mashed red potatoes. She too was so pleased with her choices. The owner, Kevin, was also generous with his time that he spent with us. We learned about his life growing up in Carmel and later while in college in Savannah was exposed to good Southern cooking. When he finally had the opportunity to bring it back home to Carmel, he enlisted the help of some notable Georgia chefs to put together the menu and the kitchen.   It certainly came together to bring us a most memorable dining experience, one that we will return to in the future. We think  this will be our new "Go To" restaurant. You'll feel the same if you're looking for that genuinely Georgia eating experience.

Staff and doctor pleasant however  appointment took too long, over two hours.  It cost $125 before we saw the dentist.  When we saw her (the dentist) she said could not guarantee the bridge would stay in place, another 25 for glue and the bridge came out in less than 2 hours.  We will not go back. Felt like a scam.

This place is not only yummy, healthy amazing food! But the owner Rebecca is exceptional. She has so much knowledge and even in the midst of busyness will take the time to suggest new items! Such a gem in Santa Barbara!

How have I not reviewed the Green Lemon? I have been here countless times. Maybe I was unconsciously hoping other people wouldn't catch on although my conscious self would never think that. The Green Lemon already has a lot of love here on Yelp, and rightfully so!

I really enjoy this locally owned and operated trendy Tex-Mex restaurant. The decor is colorful and modern, and the place is an eatery but also boasts a club-like atmosphere on Taco Tuesdays and I believe on the weekend night with an addition of a DJ. Don't quote me on the weekend entertainment but I would call to check. :)

I've visited here countless times and every time has been enjoyable. I really adore that they have happy hour until 7pm each day which includes some food specials including a trio or tacos. Like margaritas? This place makes some of the best. You want to try this frozen margarita--I have been told by a staff member that the frozen margaritas are legit. If you're not a huge fan of the traditional like you can get it with a fruit swirl-strawberry, raspberry, or mango. I am a straight up margarita drinker and I even like indulging with a frozen one. Want a 60oz margarita for your birthday or to share? No problem, have at it! 

The tacos are "street style" and oh-so-flavorful. I enjoy the taco ingredient combinations they use. I adore the ahi tuna tacos and that I can get them on Bibb lettuce (any of the tacos is customizable...yes, I'm that annoying customer). I ask like the grilled mahi taco as well. I get those pretty much every time. 

I have also been to the Green Lemon on Saturday morning and they put out a great and flavorful brunch menu! It's a nice alternative to waiting for a table at their wildly popular for brunch sister restaurant, Daily Eats :) While I'm at it I'll also let you in on a little secret that Ciccio's/Water also has a bomb brunch and it's not as crowded as DE. Check it out!!! 

If you're a first time customer don't forget to mention for a basket of complimentary churros on the house! 

Service has always been stellar and the staff really does a great job at being efficient. If you're going to try to hit GL during high frequency times you should anticipate a wait. ****UPDATE: Green Lemon no longer offers text ahead waitlist option. Someone in your party MUST BE there to get on their waitlist. The restaurant hostess will input your phone number and name and the system will text you with updates on your table. You can also see where your reservation is in the waitlist portal (online). This will give you a realistic perspective on how long the wait is and when you can expect to be seated.

The plant gallery did the florals for my wedding and I cannot possibly express what an absolutely outstanding job they did. Everything was flawless. The center pieces they created were jaw dropping. They were communicative, courteous, prompt, creative, affordable, professional, and kind. I will be honest, I did not have a clear vision of what I wanted outside of tropical plants and bright colors. I felt uneasy and I wasn't sure what I would get because the price was so affordable and I had a hard time communicating what I wanted. The florist at TPG are such seasoned professionals and absolutely unbelievable artists. They turned my vague vision into a tropical dream. I would recommend TPG to anyone planning an event. It was such a magical event largely thanks to the beautiful work they did for us.
Nice tavern with good food and better Belgian beers, particularly the Shepherds Pie, fried oysters, gazpacho, frickin' chickasee, Foret Organic and Dam Smith's brown ale.

Below I've reviewed three different yoga classes at Tucson Yoga:
1.
Teacher:  Gabrielle Pietrangelo
Style:  Yin
Gabrielle, welcomed me into her class.  I know her from outside of the yoga studio environment.  She sat down next to me and asked if I had done this type of yoga before and a bit about my experience.  She checked in to see if I had any injuries or special needs.  It was nice to have someone take the time to do that.  She appeared grounded and focused form the moment I walked in.  
The class began with a little singing.  She peppered the class with music and singing throughout.  She is a local musician and brought her guitar.  The singing and music felt natural and lent itself nicely to the poses and feel of the room.  She held the relaxed energy throughout the class.  She offered variations on the poses and approached things in a gentle calm manner.  This was a very therapeutic class in a no pressure environment.  
Her sense of spontaneity came through in the use of music.  This music may have been planned ahead but it came across with ease and spontaneity.  When someone is comfortable doing something they are able to take risks and pull new tools out of their pockets and it adds to the experience.  The music did not distract but kept everyone in the poses and facing the challenge.
The emotion she put forth seemed to be a combination of joy and empathy.  This emotion was sustained and carried us through the class.  Honestly I was so deeply into my own experience I had trouble noticing anyone around me.  I do believe she helped a person or two with props etc but it was seamless.  We ended the class with her singing and the class joining in.  Music and chanting is such a wonderful thing to experience during yoga class.
2.
Teacher:  Poep Sa Frank Jude Boccio
Style:  Mindfulness/Insight Yoga
It was a morning class and I generally do not do morning yoga classes so this was new for me.  I love yoga practice in the morning and will do a short one at home but rarely drag my butt to a class in the morning.  
I arrived and everyone was getting lined up like they knew the drill.  This led me to believe they are regulars.  He came across as relaxed and yet fully alert.  He was excellent at guiding us into the postures and guiding us to feel and notice what was going on in the body.  He did something unique that I found really helpful.  Instead of getting out of a longer held pose and getting up and shaking it off, he asked us to sit with it for a minute and notice what was going on in the body.  He truly had a mindful approach and cultivated an environment of noticing.  The practice of insight meditation when applied to yoga is a powerful combination. Insight meditation tells us to notice what is really going on and see things for what they really are.   He was excellent at letting us know not to strive too hard and relax into the poses.  He came across as benevolent and unpretentious.  The class had the right amount of movement and stillness.  He kept the energy going and a kind smile on his face the entire time.  It was a great experience having a class with a former Buddhist monk.  He exuded accomplishment and humbleness. 
3.
Teacher:  Alyssa Kratz
Style:  Mixed Hatha with Gongs (Gonga Yoga)
I stepped into the room and marveled at all of the gongs lined up near the far wall.  Some of them were huge.  There were two musicians sitting in front of the gongs with drums, singing bowls and other percussive instruments.  The teacher walked right up and introduced herself to me.  She gave a good firm handshake and asked if I'd ever been to one of her Gonga Yoga classes before and I said no but that I was looking forward to it.  I told her I was a musician and was very interested in what she was doing with sound and yoga.   There were strings of lights around the room which made it nice and dim (not too dim).  
Alyssa (teacher) made her way to the front of the room and read a quote from Jack Kornfeld (Vipassana Buddhist teacher).  
The music began, first with singing bowls and drums and later evolving into cacophony.  I was almost a little annoyed with the music at first, but once we started moving I appreciated it.  It helped to hold the space and get me through a challenging flow type class.  Alyssa commanded the room well and seemed to have a gentle strength about her.  Her voice was clear and instructions concise.  She wasn't throwing in any uneccesary words or fluffy language.  She seemed brave in front of the class and really worked with the feel of the music.  The musicians worked well with what she was doing too as  they seemlessly switched instruments and changed feel along with the asanas.   
Alyssa's character was warm and accepting.  Though the class was challenging I did not feel at all like I needed to be competitive.  She created an environment of openness and acceptance.
Great location! Amazing coffee and Acai bowls! The staff is friendly and knowledgeable!
Enjoyed a quiet Sunday afternoon here.  Service was great and the food delicious.  Two of us and we both had the Lobster Mac and Cheese.

We were looking for a great meal--- and we found it!  Justin was a great waiter and we enjoyed our meal.  The fillet was done exactly to my request and my husbands salmon was perfect.  Good all the way around.  The soup stew was delicious too!  Please give Cody's Beef 'n Beans a try.

Sophia has a unique talent. Sophia was able to create our cake as we had envisioned it for our two daughters' birthday. She took our order within a few days of the birthday and the cake came out pristine. The cake tasted as good as it looked and it was a highlight of the party.

We live in the area but just tried this the for the first time and unfortunately was a bit disappointing. The house Margarita was good but that is about where it ends. The salsa tasted like jarred way way to chunky and everything that came was way to bland. The Mexican rice has peas and carrots in it the black beans were good but most everything tasted out of a can or frozen. The patio was really nice didn't even realize it was back there and has a bar I guess for busy days.

Continued from my last review they still have yet to do anything about any of my issues. I CANT WAIT TO MOVE THE HECK OUT OF HERE. also the residents hang out in the middle of the street ... what the fuck is that????? GET YOUR KID OUT OF THE ROAD.  kids here will ride their bikes BEHIND YOUR CAR WHILE YOURE BACKING UP. The community fits the management here both terrible I'm every single possible way! I wouldn't wish living here on my worst enemy

I love a good pastrami sandwich. When I moved away from STL, the one thing I knew I was going to miss, was the good ole Jewish deli's. Once I was settled into my new surroundings, I had an epiphany. I suddenly remembered this little sandwich shop from when I worked in Alton years ago. To my surprise it was still open and going strong. 

Their pastrami sandwich is as good as the finest Jewish deli's in STL. It's made simple. It a big pile of pastrami, topped with Swiss cheese and served on marbled rye with a smear of spicy mustard. You can have either cold or grilled. I highly recommend grilled, but if you choose cold, I promise not to judge you. However, I may talk about your choice behind your back. LOL

Fries would make a great side, but it's a sandwich shop so they have a large variety of chips for you to enjoy as your side. I'm not a soda drinker, so I did not notice if they have fountain drinks or not. I just grabbed myself a bottle of Straight Up Iced Tea. 

The customer service was just average. The three workers were more into talking to each other about some drama with a common friend. I didn't mind because as I watched them make my sammie, I knew it was going to be great. 

Lucky for me, the drive home is fairly short. The aroma of that pastrami was making me more hungry as I drove and if I didn't live close, I would had to pull over and take a bite. 

Will I return? - Jewish or not, this is going to be my new deli. 

When: October 1, 2020
Why: Craving Pastrami

Late post: 
Mar 2021:
My husband & I celebrated our 10 yr anniversary here. Everything was great from the minute you walk in. When the hostess seated us, she handed us a card that wished us Happy Anniversary. So thoughtful! The servers introduced themselves and our waiter for the night was Scott. Scott was very attentive, kind & knowledgeable with the menu. 

Appetizers:
Oysters & Shrimp Cocktail:
Oysters were great not sandy at all.
Shrimp cocktail was very meaty & big. 

Entrees:
I got the Kona Rubbed NY Strip with South African Lobster Tail.

Omg this dish is sooo good. Steak was cooked perfectly and coffee rub complimented the steak very well. The lobster tail was freaking amazzzzzing! So tender, buttery and yummy!

My hubby had the lamb and he couldn't stop smiling from the first bite. It was cooked to perfection!

Our sides of mashed potatoes and lobster Mac & Cheese was very good. Loved the consistency of the mashed potatoes & we enjoyed the Mac & Cheese with the big chunks of lobster!

It was one of the best dinners we've had in a really long time. I really appreciate my husband for taking me here. And you know what makes it great? Not only the food but the staff was awesome! Everyone was so friendly!! As we were walking out, we also noticed that every employee we passed would move to side so they can let us pass. I think this is the only restaurant where I've noticed that. We've been to so many others restaurants and paid double for the bill and the service wasn't as great as Capital Grille. 

Thank you Capital Grille for a wonderful & memorable dinner. We'll be back!
I have only ever had the "donair" and it was just okay. I am not vegan but I do try vegan dishes sometimes if they sound interesting. I wasn't super impressed, but I do like this shop.

The worst restaurant experience ever!! This place will close. We went with 3 other couples. We sat down at 7:30pm  The waiter came over with our menus and told us half the items were not available.  One hour later he came to take our order and told us more things that were not available on the menu. 2 and 1/2 hours later(10:00pm)  we did not have our appetizers. We got up and went across to Tuscanos( a five star restaurant)as we were leaving they screamed "don't come back" yeah because thats what was on our minds, when we would return!

I have only visited this store once, and I left about 5 minutes later. I wasnt greeted when I walked in, did a loop, and saw a wig I needed for my halloween costume. I wanted to try it on and the woman told me it was 5 dollars per wig to try on. So I left. I went to a wig shop on Central Ave in St Petersburg and was greeted with a MASSIVE smile! I stayed for awhile playing with different wigs, colors, and types. The woman was MORE than happy to help me...no complaints, no extra charges. Because of this remarkable customer service, I am going back to purchase BOTH wigs I need for both my halloween costumes! Go to the wig shop in St. Pete, not Paramount in Tampa.

Excellent food, service and atmosphere. Kid friendly and covid compliant. The firecracker chicken was a hit. The bulgogi was awesome and so was the fried rice. Nothing was left on the plates. We definitely need to come back and have Bao buns.

Giving a 4 as two of my family members had the all you can eat fish and chips and thought it was some of the best they have had.  Non seafood was good just not great.  The beer was warm and atmosphere was ok.  Mainly a standard beach type environment, but that a good thing.  No beach view but still ok.

Came here as a walk-in and was greeted by Lava. Being from out of state, he made me feel welcomed, comfortable, and did a great job. I travel quite a bit so, having a barber in every city I frequently visit is a need for me. Thanks Lava for the cut and line up, I will definitely have you be my barber. Thanks!!!

The food is delicious. It's not fancy, it just tastes really good and isn't very expensive, either. The curry goat is delicious and has actually big pieces of goat (not lamb, goat). The food actually seems closer to Indo-Caribbean cuisine than traditional Indian... but what do I know about Indian food? Nothing, really. Except that I love it and I love it when they make it.
Fantastic! This small little hole in the wall blew me away with the quality and authenticity

A very modern Dunkin location. It looked like this location just opened as everything is soo well maintained. There are outlets scattered throughout the place which makes it an ideal location to get work done. The staff members are friendly and wished all of the locations were like this.

PLEASE, IF YOU DO BUSINESS WITH THEM, HELP THEM BY NOTIFYING THEM OF THEIR YELP PAGE! IT'S FOR THEIR BEST!

I am giving ONE star ONLY because I have to and I never got scheduled to get a massage.

Purchased a Groupon for my mom's birthday/Mother's day (both occur within a week of each other). My mom tried calling multiple times and left multiple voicemails with no reply. So, I tried calling 4 times in one day the NEXT WEEK with no reply, leaving also a message online, thinking that would work. FINALLY, before business hours, I got ahold of somebody (didn't tell me her name).

First off, she said blaintly in a tone (with no other way to put it) "I'm better than you", "Well, if she left messages, she would've got a call back" and "Well, we DON'T have anything until July, then". Either she is the only one running the business or customer service just lacks. I hung up.

I purchased this on Groupon and received a refund in Groupon bucks and will be looking elsewhere as there are multiple options. Front desk service is so important and usually demonstrates the whole attitude of the faculty and business. Will not waste my money on this type of business.

I hate writing bad reviews! 

I had breakfast here recently and it was probably one of the worst meals I have had in a very long time. I ordered the breakfast bagel with sausage, egg and cheese on a everything bagel. It was inedible. 

To start with the bagel tasted stale. It was toasted, but it was mostly dry and the outside was so hard, I could not bite through it. 

The sausage was a greasy grey slab of processed something that had no flavor other than grease. The two tiny blobs of scrambled egg looked processed as well and was tasteless. There was a little smear of cheese-like product.

I also ordered mocha and it tasted OK when it was hot, but as it cooled is turned into a syrupy watery liquid with a strange off taste to it. 

The restaurant itself is attractive and comfortable and the staff were friendly, but seemed to have a difficult time understanding what we were ordering. We ordered at the counter and they brought the meal to the table in a short time. 

Perhaps something plainer may be better, but with all the other options available downtown,  I a not sure I will give them another try.

Normally stay away from any restaurant that doesn't have any meat on the menu... But after my wife convinced me to go I'm certain I'll become a regular! Food was incredible, particularly the polenta appetizer, macro bowl main and the baklava desert. Good selection of beers too... Eel River Amber was particularly good.

This place is clean , quick service and excellent attentive and friendly staff. Been here quite a few times and I'm always satisfied with their service and food

I usually get their tacos with beans and rice on the side. The prices are not to bad. 

I like the fact that their kitchen clean and  open to the dining area so you can watch them cook your food.

I have nothing bad to say about this restaurant.

Nicely decorated and no hint of cigarette smoke as smokers must go outside to excel their lung cancer. The bar staff and waitress were sweet.

I ordered the black and blue salad (asked for the steak to be cooked medium... it came out rare). My wife ordered wings and fries and both of those items turned out fine. 

There are televisions for sporting events and the drinks were not over-priced. Certainly worth stopping for and checking out.

The staff here is exceptionally friendly and the inside is kept remarkably clean. I have been to this location a few times and each time I am taken aback by how great the customer service is. (Also their bean burritos are spot on.)

If you're recruiting for the friendly customer service Olympic team, you can cross this place off your list. Not a single smile, deadpan answers to questions, definite vibe that you're not a customer, you're someone they're forced to tolerate interrupting their day.
