All that is forgivable if the food is amazing or cheap. It's neither. It's acceptable, but if I pay over $11 for 8-10" philly cheese steak, fries and soda I'm expecting a more than acceptable. 
And, despite being the only person in there at 11:05 am on a weekday, it took over 15 minutes to get my order.
I don't usually like leaving bad reviews, but this place fell flat on all fronts. I was left angry that I didn't go one door left for amazing food at the same price (La Isla Cafe), or two doors right for good food served fast at a great price (China Wok). 
To end on a positive note, the food was prepared fresh and the place seemed clean.

The staff at JoStella is very kind and the interior is pretty, but I found the food and coffee very mediocre. My latte tasted very weak and way too milky. The burrito I ordered was something I could've easily made for myself at home.

If I can give this place 10 thumbs up I will. Tez was my bartender and he made my first experience the best. Drinks were great and Tez was full of energy and has one of the best personalities in this bar. I will be back.

Calafuria is a contemporary and tastefully designed eatery in a charming old brick home with an open kitchen (thank you for not being in a strip mall!). Dinnertime wait staff was cordial but could have been a bit more welcoming. Tables are tight and the place gets almost oppressively loud on a busy night. My tablemate's meals looked good, but I didn't hear any raves. My chicken & mushroom ravioli had a pureed filling in a bland broth with no discernible taste of either chicken or mushroom. I guess I ordered the wrong thing, but any ravioli at an "Italian" restaurant ought to be better than just okay. Having said that, please improve and STAY! Reno needs more places like Calafuria!
Amazing food and service!!!! Highly recommend the calamari, spanakopita, salmon special (if possible!) and the flourless chocolate cake. Great atmosphere as well. Thanks for a great dinner! :)
Sooooooo good. Food is stellar & has been consistently every time we've gone. Highly recommend. The attention to detail and the flavors are a big YES. Eat here!!!

Visited the Audubon Aquarium of the America's on a Friday afternoon and ended up spending about two hours exploring the exhibits. 

There were quite a few exhibits and they were really well organized, I especially liked the Mississippi River exhibit which highlighted local wildlife, and was very informative.

While some of the exhibits were decent sized, there were quite a few that seemed small for the number of animals. This tends to be my problem with most aquariums, and I would have loved to see more information from the aquarium on where the animals came from (breeding programs, rescues, from the wild, etc.). And it'd be nice to see where the money goes or what kind of programs the aquarium has for protecting wildlife.

There was also quite a bit of construction on the exhibits.

The parakeet aviary was actually pretty neat. It was a large outdoor space with dozens of friendly little parakeets who aren't at all afraid of humans (at one point there were five parakeets on me).

This is nicer than many aquariums I've seen, just a few more things I would have liked to have seen, like larger habitats for the animals and more information around conservation efforts.

Let .just say, Don who I just spoke to was completely obnoxious and rude individual.   He was not interested in hearing any detail about the auto I was attempting to trade for an automobile on his lot that has been there for almost 4 weeks, but "it's the hottest thing on the market right now".  

I would never even consider doing businesw with this type of establishment based on the introductory and general inquiry call I placed to this business.   

Stay away!

We've visited GSR a lot of the last several years and love how many new activities they've added like the Escape Room and VR area. They also have a big arcade, movie theater, golfing, and a bowling alley. Unfortunately, their food options are lacking and it's even worse since covid. This was our first time visiting since before covid and the staffing was SEVERELY LACKING. I'm sure they're working on recruiting but I hope they put lots of resources towards this because there are some true employee gems working their asses off to compensate. We saw many understanding patrons but there were also a lot that were angry with wait times and service. Be kind to the employees who have no control over hiring!

2nd Street Cafe is a must as they have lots of food options with lower wait times than the sit-down restaurants. Plus TONS of desserts! 

Overall, we had a wonderful time and can't wait to come back. Hopefully there will be more employees by then :)

Dr. Chapin and his staff are top notch!! I knew right away he was the guy to do my surgery, I did my research met with multiple surgeons and he blew them away!  My surgery went amazing, I have never been described as "perfect" ever in my life!  Cosmetic surgery is a scary idea at first but once I met Dr. Chapin I knew I could trust him to meet my perfectionist standards! Thanks again couldn't be happier with the results!

Definitely a great spot to go to for out of town Wes and people who haven't tried an authentic Philly cheese. It was amazing and I will be eating them more often. This is a classic establishment and very well ran

Just arrived home from eating at The Eagle- and I am already planning our next trip.  Let me start off by saying that the management here is awesome.  I emailed them yesterday and got a response right away.  See, I have a shell fish allergy and since I didn't have a menu to see what items they had, I emailed them to make sure there were items that I would be able to eat.  (Spoiler alert: the answer was yes).

It was fairly busy when we arrived, and we were give a 45 minute wait time.  However, we were able to find a spot on the railing which offered full service,  we ordered 2 drinks and an appetizer.  Before our bacon app arrived, our table was ready.  Our server was very sweet and we were able to close out with her.

We sat at the table, with another couple already there.  The restaurant is communal seating.  Our bacon arrived- just order it. It was amazing.  Chewy, gooey, crispy goodness.  

My husband ordered the pulled pork, I ordered the 1/4 dark fried chicken, and we ordered spoon bread as a side.  It was all phenomenal.  May I even be so bold to say, one of the best fried chickens I have ever had.  

The pulled pork wasn't your typical, smothered in BBQ sandwich.  It had a coleslaw and had some heat on it (sorry this was his food coma description he provided me).

The 1/4 dark chicken actually came with three pieces of fried chicken, 2 thighs and a leg. (Score! Leftovers) It also had some amazing but bearable heat to it.  It was crispy, but amazingly tender.  I'm full as can be right now, but my mouth is watering as I describe it.  It also came with some spicy honey, which was alright, but not really my thing.

The spoon bread was fresh cornbread served in a small skillet.  It was a perfect size to share between 2 people.  It wasn't dry and had fresh pieces of corn it it.  Overall, a very solid bread side.

Food prices are great, especially for that area.  I believe the chicken was only $6, pork sandwich was $8, and corn bread was $5.  (I could be mistaken on the pork and bread by a dollar- I made him pay the bill).  All of our beers were $7- and a great selection.  While the draft list isn't nearly as extensive as their next door neighbors at The Tap, the amount of bottles made up for it.  The ONLY suggestion I have for the beers is to have a glass that fits a whole bottle in it.  

Seriously, you would never recognize this place as the old front page.  It has been completely gutted and re-designed (for the better).  While I am a tad saddened that there are no more shot-skis, I am excited that there is another amazing place to eat and drink on Mass Ave. We can't wait for the patio to be open!

I wish I could 3.5 stars. It was good not fabulous. The calamari was very very good. Crispy, not chewy, wonderfully flavored but maybe slightly over breaded. The pretzels were okay, but honestly I don't get what all the hub bub is about. My son got a plain cheeseburger and he loved it. My husband got the cod sandwich and he thought it was really good. I got the 15th street burger. It was okay. The Gouda, in my opinion, doesn't belong with the beer-b-q sauce.  Order it with cheddar, you'll be grateful.   I got the cheddar mashed potatoes. They were good but maybe a little on the dry side. The fries were very good. 

The employees were all very nice, food was quick, no wait (Fri 1pm), and good service. 

We will be back for another try because everyone was nice and the food was above average. I want to try the meatloaf. 


Calamari, pretzels, cod sandwich, 2 burgers, 3 drinks was $63. Plus $15 tip. So it was an expensive lunch
Pretty good, price is little bit higher, service is perfect. Quality is good, quantity is smaller, you may need to order 2 entries.
This is my new favorite pizza. I get the meat lovers and have them leave it in the fore a little longer for extra crispyness. Awesome!!!

Everything at Luke is fantastic. We came with 7 guys with a reservation and they seated us right away. It was a Wednesday at 4pm and the place was pretty busy. We started with raw P&J Oysters and the Stuffed P&J Oysters. The raw oysters were great, but the Stuffed Oysters are NEXT LEVEL. They only come with 4, so we had to order more. A few of us said the Crawfish Bisque and said it was phenomenal. 

Definitely worth checking out, especially during happy hour!

I've had Hometown Health now for years and years, I have to say that I'm not sure what's driving the cost of having them up so much over the years, one would think that the more employees sign up to your insurance the better the cost, but it doesn't seem so, good insurance but big cost. I remember when going to the doctor cost $5, now it's $30, when going to the hospital or ER was less, that's the one thing I think is a bit out of line, the copays do NOT need to be where they are and they know it, perhaps the "owner" of HHP needs to helps the people who pad their wallet a little more on cost and please stop raising copays, we are all struggling as it is, please? 
Customer service here has been pretty helpful so I can't complain there at all.

Love this place! I have been at both lunch and dinner, have never had a long wait. I like the atmosphere, and look forward to trying the patio in the spring. I typically get the BLT (which is large enough for two meals), and recently subbed a cup of pozole for the fries. Love the pozole! I have also had it as a meal with a biscuit added...yum! 
The mac and cheese looks amazing, and so does the cherry pie. The beignets were awesome.
Om one visit, ladies at neighboring tables shared biscuits and brussel sprouts with us. Friendly staff, great food, good prices. A winner!

I've been here twice for brunch and had a great experience both times. The seared steak sandwich with onions is SO good! The empanadas, coffee and fresh oj were good too. Best part is that you get seated promptly and the prices are inexpensive.

I really love the vibe of this place and the positive people working there. Unfortunately the meal was a bit of a disaster.

One issue was that most of the food was substandard. Tandoori shrimp using pre-cooked shrimp - and instead of marinated in a yogurt sauce, merely sprinkled with cayenne. Basmati rice that is clearly reheated in probably several days old. A $5 mango lassi that never came at all. chai with no milk. Small samosas with a mashed potato like interior. The one good thing was the pickled cabbage given as a side to several dishes.

The other issue was the spice which was excessive and cheap. Despite asking for medium heat, it was so hot that I stopped eating all of it and had heartburn the rest of the night. Often Indian food is cooked with fresh chili peppers to give flavor with the heat, but this seemed to be cheap cayenne added indiscriminately. I had to go across the street to buy some frozen yogurt to sooth my burning mouth.
The Mole looked a lot better than it tasted.. Not sweet and absolutely no spice... Not what I was looking for

We love this place. Pad se ew is great and floavorful. The house fried rice by far is phenomenal and my daughter's favorite. My husband loves the garlic beef. The amazing dishes and pad thai are also great. The thai doughnuts are also phenomenal.

I went to this thrift store for the first time the other day, it was very overwhelming at first because of how much inventory they had but that also meant they had a lot of options to choose from. If you're up for a good thrift hunt this place is for you. It has a ton of clothing that you can look through and house goods too. The pricing is super low, lower then goodwill. It's not super organized and it does have a strong scent but I think the prices are worth it.

Locally-owned small business that consistently turns out delicious meals. The portions are very generous, so come hungry. The harvest chicken salad is enough for 2 meals for a guy with a good appetite. The scrapple was done to perfection - crispy on the outside with a warm, soft center. The sandwiches are huge. The soups are homemade. The service can be a bit slow or fragmented, but that is part of the charm. Plan to sit and enjoy; this is not fast food.

My husband and I were so excited for this location to reopen.  We made a reservations. Could not wait to spend our anniversary dinner there.  Covid or no covid they have lost a customer.  From the welcome to the seating was ok. The restruant was not busy.  The hostess was going to sit us in a back corner by the emergency door. We asked to be seated somewhere else. We sat in the lounge.  Our server did not listen to our request. We continually told her please do not rush us and thats what exactly she did. We told her we are not in a hurry. Once again the restruant was not busy! The food was ok. Our prime rib was not as good as it was the last time we were there. The vegetables were fresh frozen the kind you can buy from your grocery store in the frozen food section. Our bread was over heated or over cooked.  Not good at all. The beans we ok. It was missing something. At the end of the meal our waitress said happy anniversary and brought us some ice cream. Which was nice. But the back handed commet I am not supposed to do this but happy anniversary anways.. ugh. Qualiy should be your first priority especially after being closed for 4months.  Disappointed.

On our first weekend living in Tampa our friends took us here for a casual dinner and some drinks. I really am not a fan of English food so I was so happy to see so many other choices on the menu. We started with the sweet potato fries and the hummus plate. Both were very good and then I had a salad with grilled chicken and the others had a steak sandwich that they said was very good also. The service was good and there was a nice selection of beer and wine. They have a large patio that they allow dogs on so we will absolutely come back with our pooch.
Cheers!
This NOLA originated place always has great food. It was even great to sign in ahead thru Yelp so when you get there the table is ready. Fried free tomatoes are awesome.
Love that this place has been around forever. Your money goes far here, and the food I've tried tastes homemade. I'd recommend the chicken croquettes!

Had dinner here during a long weekend in New Orleans, thought we would give this place a try. It was very good! Our waiter was very friendly, made some very good recommendations.  It was kind of a funky place, very laid-back but upscale a bit. It had a cool vibe. The food was very good, wine list was great as well. We would definitely go back!

Terrible experience.  They scheduled dates with us THREE times and cancelled and didn't show up any of those times.  I had heard great things, but I guess they got to big to service the little people anymore. WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND.

I'm psyched to have a great restaurant in the neighborhood - and the fact that it's a BYO (for now) makes it even better.  I ate there this past Saturday with a group of six and every one of us enjoyed our meal from start to finish.  The service was great and the dishes each showed interesting creativity.  I feel like this is the first restaurant in Fairmount that I will make a point to visit again and again because I enjoyed my first dining experience so much.

I went to the Fill A Bagel in Oreland for the first time last Friday and I cannot say a bad thing about it! The manager was adorable, you could tell the staff respected her. She was super helpful and very attentive! I had a salt bagel with lite vegetable cream cheese and it was amazing! I would 100% recommend this place to anyone.

11-28-2020 Saturday 
In this Pandemic, staying safe while responsibly having a great time with your family outside the safety and comfort of your home is a crucial choice for each of us. I chose this hotel for a Thanksgiving weekend getaway due mainly to the room description indicated on my reservation. The room I chose mentioned there was a patio included. Pics attached as proof. 
I did not want to just be cooped up inside the hotel. That's the same as just staying home. 
I figured we can safely enjoy our stay relaxing on the outdoor patio.
When we checked in, we were led to a hallway room. NO patio. 
I didn't want to be confrontational & ruin our stay so I went with what we were given. After about a couple hours, I went back to the front desk and kindly asked if I misunderstood the reservation we had on the room with a patio and showed the screenshot of my reservation. Hotels.com CLEARLY stated that our room included a patio. The email directly coming from Upham Hotel CLEARLY stated it was a BUNGALOW QUEEN ROOM which had a patio (pictures attached for proof). 
Front desk Aliyah and Denise Spain the General Manager, then proceeded to explain that we actually got an upgrade (which btw I didn't believe because this was an easy excuse for them to get away from further trouble). Mind you this was the first I'm hearing this. 
I clarified by asking: "that room we got without the patio in a hallway is an upgrade?" I was told yes because it was a much larger room in square footage. Denise Spain explained we reserved the most economical room & they upgraded us. Their website verifies that the room with the patio is indeed the most affordable room (see pic). They said if we wanted the room with a patio, they "think" one is available. We should have been given that in the 1st place and if they truly offered the "upgraded room"(as they claimed), then they should have presented that as an option from the time we checked in & asked if we wanted to avail of the upgraded room or go for the room as we originally reserved. Did not happen. 
Some people like me don't really care for the square footage or an upgrade. They kept reiterating we got an upgraded room since it's larger. But what mattered to me was the room I reserved should have been the one given to us. As mentioned, I'm not the arguing type so I left it at that. 
Overall, I think that most people pay for the experience not how something looks like. 
Ex: an exquisitely looking food doesn't necessarily mean it's automatically great-tasting too. The hotel truly looks nice from the outside. But it's very outdated. A bit spooky too if I'll truly be honest. The treatment we got was extremely disappointing and very hurtful. I'm extremely regretful and thankful at the same time. Regret because I could've taken the more than $200 a night somewhere else. Thankful because I now know I'm not coming back. 
Upon check out I was asked how our stay was and I was calmly honest enough to express my disappointment. Denise Spain the General Manager promised something to make our experience better. If it transpires, then I'll amend my review. Overall, I think there's a lot of other hotels in the area which are way much better in service and amenities.

I love this place, where else in Philly can you dance your butt off and then eat pancakes? 
music is always fun, the drinks are ok, the pancakes are ok too.

Every time I think about oysters I of think of Mr. Ed's.  I visited New Orleans back in August and this was very favorite restaurant.  I figured I should really write a review about how much I enjoyed the oysters! 

The raw oysters, omg, they were so creamy and meaty.  Slight sweet and not too brimy.  I wished I remembered to ask the waiter what type of oysters it was. 

The charbroiled oysters were delicious.  They were garlicky and buttery.  Came with half a loaf of bread to soak up the juices!

Crab cake over linguine was good.  Just a little too salty for my taste.  The crab cakes were huge and full of chunks of crab.  The dish looks and taste better then my picture.

Skip the hurricane cocktail. I thought it tasted like fruit punch.

If I ever visit Nola, I would go back to Mr. Ed's just for the oysters!
Excellent selection, and great sraff.  Check their blog regularly to see any new editions to their stock.  Fantastic prices.   What else could you ask for?

Took friends there for our second experience at Polite Society and it was wonderful as always.  The wings appetizer and duck entree were among the best I've had in St. Louis. Service was impeccable.  Friends said, "We'll definitely be back."  We will as well.
My wife and I ordered steaks and it was absolutely mouth watering. Thank for the great service also.

My husband and I have had our car serviced here a total of 4 times. Every time we were more than satisfied with our experience. Each time we brought our car in, we received a call within 3 hours detailing how long the repair would take and how much it would cost. Every time the final total was the quoted price and the time for repair was The ssaid amount if not sooner. We never felt up sold and we never felt taken advantage of. Definitely recommend.

The atmosphere is lovely. The summer cocktails were inventive and refreshing. The sinner was very good, but not excellent...especially for the price. 

The spring pea risotto had flavorful elements, but the risotto itself was a little flat to complement the rich taste of the parsley and pea sauce. 

My wife's scallops were well cooked, and again flavorful, but drowned in too much butter, which was a small pond at the bottom of the bowl. And the fried zucchini flowe was in-expertly done with a thick batter crust. It should be light, but was heavy. 

However, the meal itself was very pleasing in parts, but never coalesced into a something that could have been sublime. All the ingredients and skill were there, but just missed the mark.

Fabulous restoration of my painted blanket chest from 1800s. My dog ate a board off the chest, ugggg. John quickly (~1 month) mended it very professionally and cleanly - just like Antique roadshow would advise! It's now better than ever as he cleaned the whole piece and repaired the feet which had also been beat over the years. Great to work with, excellent job- highly recommend!

Waldo's has become one of our go to spots. Great fried chicken, cool vibe, good service. Homestyle fried chicken. Same for the mac and cheese. Fries and wedges are both good. Small but good local draft beer selection. Nothing not to like.
love eating brunch here bc i can sit outside and enjoy the make your own bloody mary bar which is very deliciously extensive! good food and nice staff!
Great atmosphere, beautiful patio, fun place to be, but I ordered a medium rare burger with cheese and bacon and I got a dry hockey puck with no bacon. Super disappointed. Chips are good tho.

For a neighborhood convenience store/deli, this is about everything I could hope for.  Consider:

 - the deli makes solid sandwiches; the paninis to me are the highlight
 - the staff is friendly
 - they never insist on an extra few pennies when something comes out to $11.03, they just give you dollars 
 - the selection, for the size of the place, is remarkable.  Could I find taco seasoning at Trader Joe's?  No.  AG?  Yes.
 - huge selection of asian sauces and soup bowls
 - they are open until 11pm on weeknights, which is pretty huge when you're craving ice cream
 - they have a remarkable selection of chips
 - it is very clean.  it does have a kind of distinct smell, but I don't think it is gross or anything.
 
Sure, there are things that could be better.  The meatballs in my meatball sub were kind of warm, not hot.  I think the tomatoes are usually kind of weird texture, like they were briefly frozen.  The pickles are gross most of the time - kind of limp, not crisp.  And they don't carry my favorite Herr's chips (Russet Potato).  So minus one star because there is room for improvement - but there are a whole lot of things that Arch 
Gourmet gets right.
Amazing crawfish mac and cheese and alligator bites. Also awesome happy hour deals!!!

Everytime i go for one thing i end up coming out with bags of stuff.  They have a huge turnover i swear.  If i see something and want to wait till payday it is gone!  If you see it, want it, then you better buy it.
Watch your credit card information... $600 in fraudulent charges posted after dining here.  There are better places to eat and drink.
Don't patronize this store, the boss is a businessman who deducts employees whose wages are not reliable.

Great place! We came here for an early dinner on a Saturday. They were booked but were able to give is a table without reservation before the crowd rolled in. 
Got a nice and contemporary, fish market kinda look to it with a lot of nice touches. 
Waiter was very knowledgeable, went through the whole menu in detail and made great suggestions. 
Food was well prepared, perfectly spiced and tasty. 
Portions were on the smaller size. 
Price was a little more than what I expected for this place. 
No complaints would coma back again.

Better than Tylenol PM and Benedryl. Need I say more?? If you need me too, a sin has been commited and it's time to say 3 rosaries, 5 Our Father's and 10 Hail Mary's. 

Do it kneeling. Show some respect!! Duh.

This was my third time visiting this place.
It has really hit me that the employees seem to really hate their jobs. A fun time today was taken down by the negative comments of our server. It's a shame because the building is amazing and the music quality is top notch. Unfortunately the food is the worst German food I have ever had. Beer is so so.
One of those places you drop 200 and still leave hungry. Food was decent cocktails are bomb tho
Have been coming here for years for the great food. Pad Thai, hot basil & the curried soft shell crab are all amazing! Great service and atmosphere as well.
This is what New Orleans is all about, simply the best food, service and ambiance!  The Shrimp pasta was delicious!

This is a nice clean, a little more out-of-the-way Cvs. Staff is friendly. Aisles are extra long, different layout than the typical cvs on the corner. A more urban set up. Pretty murals outside. A few parking spots immediately north of the building, accessed by heading south on Delaware.
Awesome family run business- don't waste your time at hooters or bubba gumps.  This place is a gem and reasonably priced

Flying into & out of Nashville International Airport (BNA) for Yelp Spring Break 2014 was 2 entirely different experiences. Arriving was definitely the better side of this airport over departing. & that didn't have anything to do with being excited to be in town & then not wanting to leave Music City so soon.

Fresh off the plane & eager to get the adventure started, I had a checked bag & rental car to pick up. This was when I appreciated BNA for 1 of the simplest things that, curiously, some airports are really poor at. Clear signage. I'd never been to BNA before. I didn't have a clue where anything was. But posted signs were easy to spot & easy to follow. I was out of there, with bag & car, in no time.

Coming back wasn't nearly as streamlined or pleasant. 1st was my airline counter, but that was another fiasco that deserves a review all its own. Next was the TSA, disorganized & inefficient. The day I flew out didn't seem especially busy. I've seen security move much faster at much busier airports. The time it took to get through security at BNA was the longest I've ever waited. Good thing I got there really, really early for my flight.

Once through to the other side, it was a mixed bag. As far as I'm concerned, the 2 most important amenities an airport can have while you're waiting at your gate for your flight are: Wi-Fi & power outlets. & by Wi-Fi, I mean free Wi-Fi. It's pay at BNA. Bwa-ha-ha-ha-ha. I pay good $ already for fast & widely available 4G LTE. I don't need to pay for your stinkin' Wi-Fi. Power outlet availability was OK. I was able to charge my phablet just fine.

Putting it all together, arrival & departure, I'll say it was A-OK & give Nashville International Airport an overall average of 3 stars. So long, Nashville. I sure loved coming a whole lot more than going, for a few reasons.

We tried to use our coupon from the book and they REFUSED to take it!!! And the owner argued with us about it! We brought the book and the coupon in and they yelled at us....last time for us at this place!
What is the point of having baked potatoes on your menu when they are never "ready at this time"

I've eaten here twice, drank here once, and used them for a small event!

Holy hell this place is fantastic. First and foremost the team there is enough reason to visit. The first bartender (who's name I can't remember) was EXTREMELY knowledgeable about beer. Like, ALL the beer. He steered me in the direction of great breweries in philly. Luke and Demi were both fantastic. Luke can craft any drink on the planet. Demi was hilarious and Quirky. Finally I worked with Libby the event manger. She was joy and made my event completely seamless. 

They have three bars so there is a location for everyone!

Regarding the food, it was bananas good. The pizza is an easy choice, but they had a cheese/squash dish that was out of this world.

If you're looking for brunch, drinks, dinner, or a place to run an event. Look no further!

Was Looking forward to seeing band. Wife got sick. Was in for 10 minutes. Had quick $50 bar tab. Paid for 4 people $80. Had to leave and they would give no refund. No rebirth here. Pretty weak. Said was bar policy. The bar policy was there a little tin box w  money in it. What would you do?  Very very Weak.

The owner, is nothing more than a thief, crook, and a liar.  He received 1/2 of my agreed-upon payment ($1600), over 6 months ago.  Since then (months later), one single post has been set (they left the old post behind on my lawn).  Nothing else!  He has personally come by my house 2-3 times, and promised me several times over the phone (after I've threatened him legally, or tricked him into answering) that he would refund my money.  Now he's MIA.  My lawyer is aware of these goings on, and if anyone else of the many who have been royally screwed out of their money, cares to get in touch with me, I'm ready to move forward with a group lawsuit.

Patachou is one of my favorite brunch/lunch places when I come home to visit Indy. We usually visit the downtown location in the Simon building. My go to is the Hippie with a Benz, which is an omelet with spinach, feta, mushrooms and tomatoes. I usually ask for egg whites and add turkey with cinnamon toast and fruit. I've tried pretty much everything on the menu and you can't go wrong. The food is always consistent and the price is beyond reasonable. Depending on what kind of day you're having, they offer pitchers mimosa..... YES! 

I would also recommend the turkey chili and the tuna salad sandwich... Soooooo delicious! The waiters/waitress are pretty hip and always provide good service.   

As an Indiana native, I highly recommend visiting it will be well worth it.

I am not a fan of chains, but Noodles & Company is one that I have to admit I am a regular at. Partly due to it's closeness to Target (which I am addicted to) and partly because, for a chain, it's GOOD. The atmosphere in here is quite pleasant for a fast food type place. And you can get beer and wine when you dine in. The staff is also quite friendly and the kitchen is open and always seem to be very clean. 

The food itself has never disappointed me. The mac and cheese is damn good (I've taken to adding onions and red peppers) and my new favorite, the Pasta Fresca, is delicious. My boyfriend loves the truffle mac, but my distaste of mushrooms keeps me away from that one. The menu isn't huge, but you can add things to each dish to mix it up. 

I would never claim this to be a culinary masterpiece, but for a quick bite when I'm out running errands, I'll take this over the neighboring McDonalds any day.

My fiance and I came to Lockeland table for our date night on the recommendation of several friends. We made a reservation and took an Uber across town arriving about 20 minutes early. Our table wasn't ready so they sat us at the pizza bar while we waited for our table. A server immediately brought out menus so I told my fiance please let the hostess know we didn't intend to eat at the pizza bar, we were just waiting for our table. The hostess tells my fiance that our reservation was at the pizza bar. Huh?? We had reserved a table for a nice date night, not a quick slice of pizza at a smoky/hot pizza bar. The problem with the pizza bar is that it sits right in front of the pizza oven which is really hot. I MEAN ITS HOT! I would have sat there no problem if I thought my eyebrows weren't going to get singed off. I can see how sitting near the pizza oven might be cozy in the middle of winter...but its literally 90 degrees outside. So we both return to the hostess stand to ask if we can just wait for our table. At this point she raises her voice to my fiance telling him our reservation was at the pizza bar and that the multiple open tables in the restaurant were for other reservations. So now I'm mortified because this restaurant is on the small side and the customers who are dining near the front of the room can hear her scolding us. We were so taken aback that we decided to leave. She continued to yell at us as we walked out the door. How embarrassing and uncalled for. 

The great thing about East Nashville is that there are so many wonderful places to eat and all within walking distance. We took our business elsewhere and will not return.

Man you guys need to get your act together. Ordered on Grubhub, received a text stating my order was ready. When I walked in to the restaurant it's a chaotic mess of people. It took me 32 minutes to walk out with my food which obviously was completely cold as it wasn't even on a warmer. Overall I enjoyed the food as do many people, which is why I think so many people were there but don't open up if you're not ready to staff and properly execute a pizza pick up. Luckily I contacted GrubHub and they refunded my order.

This place was cute inside.  It kind of reminds me of the bakery in Bruce All Mighty the movie.  The food was okay..I honestly don't get all the hype about this bakery though.  In my opinion, dunkin is the better way to go.  The cream filled doughnuts were not very flavorful.  Just tasted like whipped cream or shaving cream in a piece of bread.

I worked at Lakeside for 3 years at the Fossil store and this mall is ranked as one of the most highest trafficked malls in the region and its pretty obvious because on any given day the place is packed. The construction has finally finished at Causeway making it less of a hassle to get in and out. 

I'm not sure what it is about the parking garages that makes people lose an obnoxious amount of brain cells but its like everyone is huffing paint in their cars while looking for a spot. If it looked like I wanted to murder someone while I was clocking in, it was because parking just made me seriously consider a new path in life. 

I have to give Lakeside kudos for always managing to attract new stores and recently more upscale stores. In just the past six years they have probably had close to 10 new stores open up. 

I might be asking for much but it would be nice to see it undergo a facelift, I don't think much has changed since the 80s. Speaking of the 80s... please switch to gift CARDS and get rid of the paper certificates! They are a pain for both the customer and employees.

SOOOO FANTASTIC! Stopped in for dinner before the Pelicans game w/ friends and couldn't have been more pleased! Our dinner was fantastic! 

Our temperatures were checked at the door, and we were seated right away. Service was fast and friendly. We ordered oysters of all types. I had the chargrilled and smoked fried oysters. Hubs had the chicken entree and begrudgingly allowed me a taste-- SO GOOD! 

Grand Isle is a solid choice, and gives that NOLA eats feel-- You know, where you want to order everything on the menu, and nosh until you can't anymore. Prices are reasonable, and the portions are just right. The cocktails are tasty, and have a crafty flair also! 

Give it a go, you won't be disappointed. Super delish!

This place must only be popular for the drinks, so if you're not a big drinker I would not make this your first or second choice for Mexican food. Even though the food was not bad at all, the overall experience is enough for me decide I'm probably never (willingly) coming back here. There is honestly nothing memorable about my experience here. The food was just ok. The atmosphere was blah, and the service was meh.

Wanted late night (relatively...is there any really late night pizza???)....anyway this is a really nice little bar with friendly servers and crowd.  Joanie is a treat and you always have to love a hostess that engages customers and obviously loves her business and her customers.  Pizza at 1145 PM was good but still has me looking for the best thin in STL....at least the best thin that doesn't have that crappy provel cheese :) If I'm in Soulard will definitely give it another try.
As Christian, I too had a great experience with Shontell.  In fact, I wanted to commend her to her superiors, but can't seem to locate the contact info for Spirit at MSY.

Veronica is extremely talented and super creative. I have multiple tattoos from her and they are amazing. She even fixed a mess I got done at another place and now I love it. I promise you, you will not be disappointed.

Service was impeccable. We didn't manage to snag a reservation (highly recommended!) so we ate at the bar. The bartenders were great at coming by just the right amount and were attentive at refilling our drinks and waters as needed. The mushroom starter was delicious, with the mushrooms being meaty and rich complemented by the cheese medley on top.

This place is awesome. I drive 40 minutes to get here because the food is nothing short of spectacular and the service staff are knowledgeable and actually seem to care that you enjoy the experience. The combo dishes are what I have been going for but I really haven't had anything yet that didn't just make my day better! 

Korean Short Ribs Marinated Meats Ribeye

This was my first time at this location as I am from out of town and I can honestly say the level of respect the employees gave my friends and I was unparalleled. 

We went in towards the end of the night looking for pasties. Right? What the heck lol. We asked someone at the register and they said they didn't have any but another employee who was greeting at the door directed my friend to exactly to that. 

While checking out I realized using a gua sha tool might help the congestion I was suffering from. This same nice employee directed me throughout the store for my different options without any attitude or sass. 

When it was time to go she unlocked the door and that's when we realized we had kept this team 15 minutes past closing. Not once did they rush us or make us feel bad about keeping them late. I was extremely impressed and felt like a valued customer. 

Thank you to the team that helped us the night of December 28th! You guys rock!

I can not rave enough! I found Lorrie's website online while researching a seamstress for a bridesmaid dress I'm wearing. I called her and set an appointment. She was very warm and accommodating over the phone, and answered all of my questions the best she could. My dress needed a hem, taken in in the bodice and let out around the hips. I've visited her studio 3 times over the course of my dress being transformed and each time was an amazing experience. Every deadline was met, price was extremely fair, and she was so pleasant to work with! She never rushed me, and made me feel super comfortable. It is so rare these days to find an honest business, but this place is legit. She is now my go-to! You will not be sorry.

I came here during the South Street Night Market. I ordered the warm lobster roll with citrus butter, chilled mango, diced jalapenos, and sautéed kale and cabbage on toasted split top bread.  The services was pretty quick. I was presented with a nicely sized hoagie in about 5 minutes. I like how the roll's crispy outside contrasted the overall soft texture of the dish.  The mango + jalapeno + lobster combination was the perfect balance of sweet and spicy. 

My only complaint was the bread to meat ratio. The amount of lobster received was a great deal for the $6 price tag, but the bread did overwhelm the dish. Even though lobster is expensive, they could have added more mango or other filler. Instead, I felt like I was just eating buttered bread at some points. 

I would love to visit again and try their everyday lobster roll. Portion size may have decreased with the price and the large volume of people to serve.

4 stars for the convenience. Beach bar, pool and steps away from the beach. Not the most up to date resort. I am a local so I have been here multiple times to hangout for the day but I recently stayed for 3 nights while my friend was in town. There is a resort fee, 30
something a day, that I was not aware of until check in. However, you get free beach chairs and umbrella if you stay at the hotel which is normally $40/day so it evens out. 

The food is overpriced bar food with an edible flower to make it fancy. Drinks are over priced but what do you expect at a place like this? The pool side service rocks! Every server was on top of their game and kept the drinks coming all day! 

The room was bigger than I expected. 2 queen beds, a couch (not a pull out), mini fridge, table with 2 chairs and a ginormous walk in closet that was not needed. The TV was tiny but that's not why I was there. Bed was rock hard. Air conditioning worked excellent. 

Parking is a nightmare. Thankfully I parked my car and didn't drive until we checked out. There is parking on the side of the building. 1 row and it's slanted parking spots. However, it does not loop around so you have to make a 3 point turn in a very narrow aisle or back all the way down the aisle to exit.

I've heard so much about holiday park, but have never had the chance to make it over. 
But I decided on Saturday to check out some Indy parks and this was my second stop.
Located near the meridian hills neighborhood is holiday park, it used to be a weekend/summer get away.
Such a beautiful area! The ruins are so cool to walk around, and check out. 
The back has water that runs off so kids can play in it and cool off on a hot day. There is also a lot of pretty flowers and plants that surround the area.
When you get away from the ruins there's extensive grounds to walk around that has a park, and then a nature center that private parties can be hosted in as well. 
There is also trail hiking! The trails are awesome very expansive and you can go through the woods, and down to the river.
Over all the park is very well maintained and no liter was seen! I can't wait to go back and enjoy again!

This is my first time writing a review ever. This place is one of the best Ethiopian places I have been to. The owner and staff are very very welcoming and attentive. The food is amazing!!!!! I am from Dallas and heard a lot about this place. Finally got to try it... As soon as I had the first bite - left me speechless. I am sure I am going to crave this food as soon as I go back! Definitely a must try!!!!
Great quiet bar. Classy ambiance and good drinks. Was a welcome break from the noisy bourbon street crowd.

I have been taking my cats to see Dr Cousins for some time now, He Explains to you everything that is going on with your cats, the entire staff is great, I drop of the cat off early in the morning and pick up late afternoon. Keep up the great work.

Nice guys, great inventory.  Picked up a super clean, low mileage import.  Added bonus is that they politely offered the extended warranty only once, and didn't hammer me when I declined (most dealerships will hound you to death or structure the financing to inextricably link it into the transaction).  My only gripe is partially my fault:  the car had pulsating brakes which I called out on the test drive.  They had the pads replaced, but there was only marginal improvement.  After taking possession of the car, I found the problem was actually warped brake rotors, a $350 repair.  I should have pressed for a full diagnosis or refused to delivery until it was resolved.  Oh well, live and learn.

We have come to Sakura a lot. The food was good this visit but the issue I had was with the check. There were seven people at our table and five people in  our party. We did not know the other two people. When we received the check, the gratuity had already been added. I reviewed the check to make sure we had not been charge for a particular item. The person paying the check did not realize that the gratuity was added and would have added additional money had I not pointed this out. Why was gratuity added to a party of five? And then it was not pointed out by the person presenting the check. I have no idea whether this policy is spelled out on the menu.

I cannot say enough positive things about this store! The owner is experienced, knowledgeable, passionate, and just all around nice. She never hesitates to undertake a long conversation with me about the best care for my cat, and she also "stays in her lane" by being candid when she doesn't have an answer. Locally-owned, female-owned, and just the best decision I routinely make when it comes to spending my money. Your pet deserves the products that are sold at Mutts & Meow
The staff are helpful and friendly each and every time I stop in for pool & Green Egg supplies.
Doesn't even deserve one star.. horrrrrrible food! Tasted really bad.. even the texture was really bad.

Oh, did not realize this was going to be another sports bar... the beer list was extensive, yet lacking descriptions that would provide a beer lover the attention that is needed to pick the appropriate ale. The beers were not even in any particular order on the menu. Well, scratch that. The domestics were all lumped together about 3/4 of the way down the list which seemed even odder then anything else. I had hoped to order some food, but did not want to pay the same price for the same menu items that everyone else in town has. Wife needed more time to pick out a beer, waitress couldn't give proper descriptions to answer her questions, then never came back to take the order. At that point we decided it was best to leave.
Fantastic food and service!  My favorite place for lunch. Erica and crew are the best.  Meatball panini - delicious.

I love sushi and I had a friend visiting Philly from LA who used to live here, and he kept talking this place up so we finally went. It was so disappointing that he was embarrassed to have suggested it. We went for lunch and when we arrived there were two girls sitting at the bar and no one else in the place. We wanted to sit at the bar but they were right in the middle and they had their crap all over the other stools, and even though it was clear that we wanted to sit there, they made no room for us. And they weren't even eating, they were just chatting it up with the employee behing the counter. I was already annoyed by the time we were seated. Then my friend said the guy behind the bar is usually the host and certainly not the chef that he usually likes. We were given complimentary sake, but only because my friend knew to ask. I ordered a lunch special with miso soup that was tasty but the broth to tofu proportions were not to my taste. My entree was a few pieces of sushi along with a roll. I was really disappointed. The roll was obviously premade and had been chilled - one of the best things about getting really fresh sushi instead of grabbing it from somewhere like Whole Foods is warm fresh rice. The rice with the sushi was also cold and poorly shaped, and the fish on top looked like it had been cut with a scissors. I was so not impressed. To top it off I visited the bathroom before leaving and it was in desperate need of a deep cleaning, especially the crusty caulk around the sink. This place was a total let down.

Where can you acquire a well-crafted latte, tasty pumpkin bread and discuss genetic seeding of the human race by aliens you ask? Well, welcome home, my friend. Not that I'm judging those that participate in the monthly-held "mystery school forum" - after all, I stopped in on the way to my acupuncturist's house for a treatment, so how new age-y am I? Definitely a cozy little neighborhood spot that's worth checking out. If it were a person, the Flying Saucer would be in tight pants and converse and tell it like it is. Bonus points for the free pumpkin bread samples at the register.

Great food, but awful service. A friend and I came in before the Sunday night dinner rush. Took 20 mins to be served a lemonade. Two parties that came after us were seated and served before we received our pizzas. Then, we were mistakenly brought something we hadn't ordered. I spoke to the manager about the long wait time, trying to determine what the issue was, and he kept making excuses and jokes. Rather than discount our bill, the manager tried to kiss up with a free dessert that we didn't ask for. Needless to say, I am hesistant to come back here. There is no excuse for serving two larger parties that arrived nearly 30 mins after us prior to serving a party of two.
I've been seeing Dr. Steinagel for years. She listens carefully, discusses and prescribes. I've been seeing Psychiatrists for 30 years for chronic depression and she is one of the best.

Not real sure what some of these negative reviews are talking about.....recently ate here with a large group and had a great experience! Good food, good drinks, fun atmosphere. The red beans were fantastic - almost as good as my Mama's and I'm a local. We had no service issues at all - our waiter took care of us and was extremely friendly and professional. There are very few reasonably priced restaurants on Bourbon that I would recommend - definitely give Cornet a try. Trust one of the locals!

Tried the Dragon Breath and Spicy Garlic Parmesean and chicken fried rice. The rice is oily rich carby goodness with an extra oomph from a watered down mayo sauce. The Dragon breath were my preferred wings over the spicy garlic parmesean which were too sweet. 

Overall, really good unhealthy food.

Einstein's for the win as we received our two bagels for free and a free coffee... At first we thought the guy was a little rude in the drive through but then realized his computer was down- so the win is for us
Amazing and unique food... the funnel fries we OUTSTANDING!!!!! Definitely coming back and highly recommended

Great cars and service. Very very convenient to airport.Natioan is the best! 
Flagg Taylor

We were put up at the hotel due to a transfer of my husbands work. Arrangements were made through corporate for us. 
After my husbands job stopped paying and we paid over $3000 a month to stay until we got our house, we were lied to by the manager Ivan there, and when I tried to explain the arrangement and show emails, I was told that they didn't care or want to see them. We were given 1 week in a new state to find a new place. 
Under our couch I found old Cheetos and chocolate candy which my husband and I do not eat. When I would clean our room, the carpets were dark black. I could deal with that, but not the lying and rudeness from the staff. I would never recommend this place! It's dirty and gross! When I cleaned our kitchen, the blackness that came off the counters was disgusting and the dust on the refrigerator was over an inch thick! Coming from a manager who boasts about the cleanliness I beg to totally differ! If I would not have cleaned when we first came, we would have stayed in filth!
Also the other reviews talk about Free Shuttles. NO FREE SHUTTLES anymore. No shuttles at all!
Great food great service and the brownie dessert was the absolute best. Will be back !
Love This restaurant. The prime rib was amazing and so was the company. It's nice to eat family style and sit with complete strangers and enjoy the conversations.

Mediocre at best Jewish deli in the Montgomeryville area. I got a turkey club sandwich that was all dried out. Copious amounts of mayonnaise are needed to rectify this. My wife's turkey wrap was more like a lettuce wrap. It was full of lettuce and tomato with very little of the same dry turkey. The pickle bar is good, which is the restaurant's only redeeming quality. Not recommended.

Beautify displays. Unfortunately, closing at 2 pm daily (except Saturdays!) is convenient for nobody. Bummer, because it is completely out of the way so a lunch visit is tough, and parking is a headache.

Macarons are only okay. Mint chip tasted strongly of fake mint flavoring. 

Whisk on Cherokee and Colleen's in Clayton are much better options. Their flavors are much better, they are actually open conveniently, and parking is no problem at either spot.

Came here for the Full Omakase ($125 pp) and was not disappointed. The fish was mainly shipped from Japan and was the highest quality available, which definitely showed. The omakase was comparable to NYC sushi spots which are usually even more expensive. My only critique was that the chef provided 5 out of 18 fish that were in the same fish genre and tasted mainly the same with only subtle differences. Overall I had a very positive experience and will be back in another season to experience new fish.

First, let me admit that I've only been to TBBC a couple of times in the last few years. I was a regular back in the day - 1999 or so, when Ybor was really rockin' and this place was the absolute best hangout on the planet. That's why I loved TBBC - the location, the atmosphere, the tables on the balcony overlooking 15th St. I used to get off work early on a Fri afternoon, bring a book and have an Elephant Foot or two while I just hung out and waited for the nightlife to pick up. Then a meal, some more beer, catch some amateur theatre at HCC or at that dump by the railroad tracks run by the two gay guys, maybe you remember it? Then back to TBBC to sit on the balcony and watch the freaks parade by. This was bliss! Pure Zen! Then they up and moved to that crappy Centro Ybor and now the place is in a big box just like an Applebees. I don't know what their dispute was with the old landlords but you wankers shouldn't have moved. You ruined my life!

Once again, Walden's is killing it with another location. Whether you are looking for some quick breakfast to go, or a full sit down meal with some steak and eggs, you can't go wrong with Walden's. But alongside their amazing breakfast foods they have some great lunch options too. Get some soup, or a burger, or a sandwich!

2720 is an all encompassing space for musicians and artists to come play and display what they've got. With that being said I've mainly been to 2720 for EDM centric events so thats what I'll speak on. 

The venue is extremely intimate, every time I've been to a show here its always packed to the gills. Which is great because who doesn't love dancing the night away with 400 other sweaty people. 2720 brings some pretty big talent to St. Louis, so being able to see artists I've paid a lot more to see elsewhere AND get to be super up close for roughly $25 a show is honestly amazing to me. The talent they have coming in and out of this place alone makes it worth a visit. 

As for seeing a show here, the sound is always good and can get pretty dang LOUD. The vibes here are always on point, theres always people dancing and having a good time. Sometimes when things get real rowdy the floor feels like its shaking, and no matter where you stand you'll have a good view of the stage. The only complaint Id have are the visuals aren't that great at some shows, but I understand thats not really 2720's fault. 

When things get too sweaty inside they have a large fenced in back patio for people chill out in which is actually really nice. There is also another floor that has an arcade and another entire bar where they also sometimes set up a second stage for large events. There is very limited seating throughout though. The drink prices are fair, especially for a "club" type setting, and all the shows I've been to they have a jug of ice water at the bar you can fill your own water bottles from which I really appreciate. All the Staff I've encountered have always been very nice and helpful, the bouncers don't harass you and are helpful if something goes wrong. All in all I love 2720 and I am really thankful to have this gem of a venue so close to home.
We are visiting from out of town and just picked this place from yelp. We ordered the large pepperoni and sausage. So good!!

My family has been seeing Dr. Lammer for about a year and a half. He has been wonderful in every way. He is very knowledgeable, compassionate and attentive to detail but never tries to bully or scare you into a procedure. I really believe he only recommends work when it truly needs to be done, unlike just about every other dentist I've seen over the past 30 years. His staff is also excellent.
Breakfeast was great. Our server Danielle was kind and attentive even with all of the tables she had to tend to. Thank you!

Not a long wait time, but a long service time to get drinks and food. Don't say you're not ready to order because they will believe you... Food is average for some things that are on everyone's menu. Stuffed mushrooms stuffed with seafood we're mushy and flavorless. Oyster tostadas are 4 nacho chips with creamy coleslaw and a fried ouster on top... messy and different. Oyster rockefeller and seafood stuffed are mediocre at best. Food orders came out at different times although ordered together for only 2 people. Service was not impressive and slow. If you're in a pinch and everything else is packed it may pass for your taste.

*I went here for the restaurant week upstairs* they had three burger choices and it came with a side of mac n cheese. The mac and cheese was really heavy and piled on with cheese. The burger was a weird combination because they stuffed it with salami. The other breakfast burger was just okay. For dessert, they had a fried Twinkie and I should have known better than to try it. The batter was not good and you couldn't taste the Twinkie inside. The staff was nice and the location is cool but I would have this as a lunch place. Go somewhere else for dinner
The best noodles around. The best hot and sour soup I have ever had. Undoubtably my favorite Thai restaurant in Tucson

Small place but the food and service is amazing. The California dreaming is incredible and the pb and b melts in your mouth. The orange juice is freshly squeezed and the muffins are made fresh with a different flavor every day. I've never been able to give a single complaint about this place.

Have lunch here regularly and they are renowned for their wor wonton soup.  On a cold day like today and fighting a cold this soup always helps!

Freshly cooked daily with crunchy vegetables. In addition to their great dumpling- shame they have cut back on the dumplings since the new year.
Not much you can say this is a great place to chill in the summer.

MADE IN CHINA. False advertising. Cool stuff, but why isn't made in the US as claimed?

It was a real disappointment to get my new "made in America" hat home just to find a made in China tag in it.

We found this place accidentally - one block above the main street (C Street) - and it was literally a step above all the other restaurants in Virginia City that we investigated.  Wonderful food, competently served, at reasonable prices.  Also an excellent wine and beer list.  The touch of class was producing an excellent entree for the vegetarian in our party, although there was no vegetarian main course on the menu.  This small place aims to please, and does so admirably well!

Chef Will and His crew are exceptional! I had the breakfast tacos and my sister had the pork and grits. Everything was delicious. And our waiter Slayden was awesome too. Cool atmosphere, good coffee, will be back for sure!

This place has got an awesome special going on right now or you can get small frosty $.50. No where are you going to find something that she so delicious on the hot summer day. It really cool of you often and grab another bite of burger while you're at it

Ate at coral tree cafe today. It was really good, I got the western burger, no bacon, sub veggie patty. And made it a combo. It was cheaper for me then say ordering the habit and it was really good. 
My boyfriend got a chicken burrito and the chicken was kind of pink but they were really friendly, they made him a more expensive steak burrito, no extra charge. 
I will be going back again.

So I was just at there other location on Mickey's street back in June there was no signs posted saying they were moving how I found out was thought word of mouth however I will say this location is much bigger and better theres more room for setting theres also a lot of sales associates and cashiers everyone who I came in contact with were very friendly and welcoming the only problem is THEY DO NOT HAVE PAPER TOWELS IN THERE RESTROOM I understand people want to save money and save trees but I think all  public restrooms should have paper towels I am a person who uses paper towels to 1 dry my hands 2 cut the sink off and 3 open the bathroom door  with paper towels this is just my P.O.V but all in all this is a great location

They did an amazing job.  I wish I would've thought to take before and after photos.  My carpets were really bad and they look brand new. They also were punctual and professional.  I highly recommend.

I took a yellow cab home from a bar about a week ago. Mini-van very young nice gentleman.  Maybe mid-30's. He picked me and a friend up from the druid downtown... I did drive my car - but had 2-3 drinks & I did not want to chance it.

Picked us up from the druid downtown, friend & i wanted to get mcdonalds - drove down to the oliver square mcdonalds. The drive thru line was SOOO LONG, we he asked us if we could go in. He would wait for us if we left him $$ and property.  So being that he was sooo friendly & personable we gave him 40$ & left my purse in the cab (I know bad idea on my part - but I took out my wallet & cell phone).  And toooo our surprise once we ordered our food brought it back out... he was gone.

HE STOLE MY PURSE & $40 to drive maybe 5 minutes TOPS!!

Next day, i get a call from wayyyy out on the North end of town - lady found my purse ditched between her car and her husbands (as my epi pen has my contact info on it)  he ditched my purse & minus my digital camera. SLEEZE BALL!!!

DONT TAKE YELLOW CAB!!!!

When I spoke with the dispatchers about this - they told me it was my fault he took my purse and to stop asking about him OH and its also my fault I didn't get his name or cab # & to not call them again.

So they didn't help me either recover my things OR to give me the contact info to speak with this driver myself.

A big ol' nope. Got delivery, I never have high hopes for Chinese food delivery (which annoys me in a city like Edmonton with a larger Asian population) we typically do pick up from Wok n' Go which is consistently awesome but sometimes we don't want to drive so we have been trying for years to find decent delivery Chinese food. Everything was lukewarm and soggy and gross and tasteless. The delivery driver had some difficulty finding our house so I can understand the temperature of the food but if Chinese food tastes good you can eat it lukewarm/cold or reheat it and it's still tasty. This was just all bad. Even the chicken fried rice. How the hell do you make chicken fried rice taste bad? On the plus side, the driver was super friendly! The quest continues....

First time to eat at O'Charley's, we ate dinner late long drive so it was about 8PM.  Waitress was definitely new and possibly not trained very well.  Ordered a beer and didn't know if Samuel Adam's was draft or bottle even with it being its signature beer, there where running behind on baked bread another signature item never did get the bread no worries we rather not have it.  Don't get the loaded potato soup its tastes like a pound of salt and nacho cheese sauce from the big 128oz can at costco, don't get me wrong I lo e it just not in my potato soup.  It was all bad the cooks in the kitchen cooked both of our steaks perfectly and the flavor was amazing, hats off to the chef and cooks in the kitchen and folks if you eat here be patient with the waitresses they are learning

I went Sunday with a friend for dinner. Our server was very courteous, the only strange thing was after eating he did not come back for like 15-20 minutes, but I was fine with that as we were engaging in conversation. Once he came over he was quick to get our boxes and check.

The shrimp/crab quesadillas were delicious, I've never had that combo before and was very excited. The Spanish fries were amazing so I was told. I only had a bite of the cheese, and it was pretty good to me as well. My chicken caesar salad was mediocre though. The chicken was tough and dry, and the dressing was bleck as well. 

The drink she got was not bad, but not as sweet as we assumed given the description.
Overall, those quesadillas, and the service from our waiter is what led me to put the rating as high as it is. The place was cool but definitely not worth the prices at ALL. It's a bar!

We stopped here to pick up a package to take to Lexington. We were on a bit of a time crunch but got the message it was ready for pickup at 7am. We arrived at 8:10am to pick up the package. I guess the emails to let you know is just a guideline that it arrived to the location, not that it's ready. We had to wait about 25 minutes for them to bring boxes after boxes in from a truck that was from the warehouse. It wasn't the fastest service. Maybe it was because we would just be able to pop in & out with the package.
Extremely disorganized staff. Waited too long for my order. Management needs to provide further training. No one knew what order was what.

The service here started going downhill about 6-8 months ago. I did not come back for about 4 months. I came in last night and had a very rude server while I was sitting at the counter, then was surprised to see two women come in and have a cool come out, ask what they wanted and make meals special for them without giving them a ticket, so this was for free. The counter waitress just shrugged her shoulders and walked away.

Tonight I was back, and no server would stop to take my order. I waited to see a manager, and when he showed up, he took my order and didn't find anything wrong with all servers ignoring the customers at the counter.

This is definitely a place to avoid if eating at the Peppermill. Go to Oceana for good service and good food.

I will not rate the school according to its educational excellence. The whole world knows that Penn is one of the best universities.  I am just reviewing it based on my tourist experience ;) 

My husband being an alumnus,  acted as my tour guide. I liked how there are lots of trees and plants around a campus in the middle of a city.  The buildings are beautiful and historic. The lay out of the campus seem convenient and fun for the students.

I've been seeing Dr. Ali and his staff for over a year now.  Simply, I can't imagine going anywhere else! The staff is professional. Doc Ali is excellent at ensuring you are aware of the procedures and will go out of his way to make sure you are comfortable. 

Details - I had surgery on my jaw when I was young. That surgery led to some trauma to my teeth. Dr Ali removed all of the silver amalgam (fillings) and, over time, replaced the bad teeth with beautiful porcelain crowns. Also, I had Invisalign for several months based on Dr Ali's recommendation. A good bite will extend the life of the crowns, saving me  money over time.  There has been minimal pain, few hiccups and zero regret. 

Thank you Dr Ali and all the staff for helping me get through this.

Another great meal this weekend.  Four of us enjoyed our dinners.  All ordered different entrees which were served hot.  Our waiter was very pleasant as usual.  Owner graced us with a plate of grilled fresh vegetables which we devoured.

Delicious! It's not often that I will wait in line for food and I was hesitant to do so for Coop's but it had such great reviews on the food, I couldn't resist. Well worth the wait. The service wasn't the friendliest in Nola but if I had to deal with rowdy tourists all day, I probably wouldn't be the happiest camper. 5 stars for the overall experience!

The vegetables looked better than I imagined! Huge, freshly harvested and inexpensive. I tasted the "sweet" onion garlic this morning  and it was good. I did my routine vegetable cleansing of submerging in a vinegar and water mix then rinsing in water again. The leaf lettuce freshly was the freshest I've tasted. I'M SO EXCITED TO EAT THESE VEGETABLES! 

My next stop is to find FARM FRESH eggs.

Any suggestions?

This place is pretty good. I've actually eaten from here 3 or 4 times and didn't realize that I had never written a review. This is prob the closest West Indian spot to my home, so when I get a craving coming here usually does the trick.

On a typical day I'd get the curry or jerk shrimp with rice & peas or a curry chicken patty. I tried their cabbage before, but I didn't like it. It was too soft for my liking. It'll do for when the craving comes along, but I can't lie - I have had better places. I do enjoy the convenience of having an option a little close to home.
Breakfast and lunch very good.  My salad was fantastic.  Breakfast omelette was also very good.

This place is so neat!  They have a beautifully crafted collection of sculptures on a huge outdoor and indoor property.  This is a must-see location for anyone interested in sculpture, 3D art, iconic art, or outdoor spaces.  

The staff is very friendly as well, and will happily assist you with questions about your experience.  They also do tours if you prefer to go that route.  I would definitely check out Rat's Restaurant while you're there.  Go during happy hour because it's such a good deal!

Zinga makes a great product.  My sales person Lucus was quite knowledgeable about the company and product and Keith, the installer was very efficient.  I would have given a 5 star with a couple of issues.  Delivery took a very long time and the communication was lacking to keep buyer informed on status. My only complaints are the poor communication from the company for the very delayed delivery and also concerns about the blackouts are not completely blackout on the sides.  Not sure if they should have made wider for a better blackout. They are a nice product and look great. I would have liked to have been prepared about the sides...a bit wider measurement would have made it better. If they would improve their communications I would have given them a 5 star.  I share this as we need to know the question to ask in advance, not after the fact if the salesperson doesn't share the limits of the product at the introduction.

I am new to the Tampa area and have been in search of a new nail salon for my services. I am coming from Atlanta where I was going to the same salon/spa for at least 12 years. 

This salon is immaculate when it comes to being clean as well as up to date with the latest polishes, SNS and gel polishes. Paul was so great with my nails. I am adventurous when it comes to designs and he was able to replicate what I had shown him on Pinterest. BONUS is they really take time on each of your services and offer up wine/champs while you are there!

I highly recommend this salon to anyone is seeking a very professional, hygienic and creative salon for your nail services.

The food and service here were incredible. The menu is limited to a few selections, however those selections are incredible. The proteins made were delicious, and the sides were perfect. I will definitely be eating here again.

Originally from Nj, I used to love Jersey Mikes subs, but once I moved away I could never find a store in the cities I lived in.  So far these are the best subs in town of all the sub shops I have tried in Tucson. The meats are cut fresh to order and you get a nice size portion of meat, not like most places that skimp on the meats.  Lettuce and tomato was fresh and crisp.  Staff was very polite and friendly.  Definitely worth trying, especially if you are from the northeast part of the US and know what a good sub should taste like.

after driving by this place my whole life, l finally decided to give ahi sushi a try and l am so glad l did. Because this is the best sushi I've ever had and I've tried every sushi place in Santa Barbara. The service was incredible even though they asked us to move for a larger party. The fish was very fresh and cut/portioned perfectly. Well worth the price. They have a large menu so even your boyfriend who hates sushi will have options. I will visit again soon.

Stayed the weekend with my wife. Made a good, clean, inexpensive base to come back to at night. The room was fine and had everything we need. The motel features a laundrymat which we did not need but was good to know they had. The pool was closed for the season but the patio area it was in looked very comfortable. The free continental breakfast was far above expectations with make-you-own waffles, good microwavable breakfast sandwiches, and a wide variety of other foods. The area was clean and had many tables so we never felt crowded even with other guests there. We booked thru an Internet service and it was an easy registration when we got there. The only minor downside is that they have a check-in time of 3:00 Pm which could be rather late for travelers coming in the AM. The motel is tucked far back away of the roads so there is no traffic noise. You'll need your GPS to find it.

I would never usually get a mall cheesesteak, but I made the mistake of believing that one from Tony Luke's HAD to be good. I was wrong.
There are not enough descriptive words in the English language to say how BAD my chicken cheesesteak was. Just getting in from Springfield Mall and felt compelled to write this review because my food was so terrible.

Number one.... I don't even know why Tony Luke would put his name on this location. It is NOT EVEN CLOSE to his original location.  My sandwich wasn't even as good as one made from Steak-Umm. The chicken was hard, old and tasted like it had freezer burn.  The mayonnaise tasted like it had been left sitting out. There were not enough onions. The best thing about the sandwich was the bread, so that's what I ate.
Great menu with plenty of amazing choices!  Staff very friendly, knowledgable, and readily offer help.  Definitely the place to go if you want something nice but casual.

I visited with my husband and 2 year daughter for the UofA Family Weekend and chose this hotel for the proximity to the university as well as the perception of Sheraton hotels.

We checked in at 3 am in the morning after driving over 8 hours from Los Angeles. The check-in process was easy and quick. We had to drive around to the other side of the hotel where our room was located. It was difficult finding parking but found one behind the hotel. The parking lot is well lit so we weren't too concerned with where we parked.

Upon entering our room, we immediately were impressed by the modern decor of our 2 room suite. I am reviewing Room 250 which we stayed in. We quickly setup my daughter's cot in the living room and head to the bed room to get settled in. I immediately noticed the stains on the bed comforter which made me look further. I found stains on the bed skirt as well. We took off the comforter and slept with the sheets that appeared clean. 

When we work up later that morning around 8;45 am, I used the hotel's text service to request a complete change of our linens. After that I proceeded to make some of the complimentary coffee and noticed the filthy water compartment of the coffee pot provided. I also requested that the coffee pot be swapped out.

We visited the restaurant for breakfast and took advantage of their buffet breakfast for $11 each. Our daughter ate for free. It was a small buffet but delicious and well-worth the $11. The servers were very friendly and attentive.

We returned around 3 pm and noticed that although the coffee pot was swapped, the linens had not been changed.  I then checked the refrigerator and noticed that though it was set to high, it was not cold. I texted again about the linens and also notified them about the refrigerator. We waiting about 30 minutes with no response so we called the front desk to reiterate the issues and the woman who answered sounded unconcerned but said she would send someone. Another 30 minutes later, I had my husband walk down to the front desk to ask again. We were waiting to put our daughter down for a nap until the refrigerator and linens to be changed. Finally after another 30 minutes, housekeeping came to change the linens, provide additional toiletries, and add 2 more waste baskets since the room only came with 1. 

The next morning, I texted again about the refrigerator and told them we would be out for a few hours and requested they have someone come to fix it while we are out. When we returned that afternoon, we had a hand-written note above the refrigerator that said the refrigerator was working properly and by putting the setting to high and overloading, it can cause the refrigerator to not cool properly. It said to set to low and slowly increase to medium. The refrigerator was empty and if it doesn't work on high which is a setting available, that tells me it's broken. We followed the instructions and tested with our water bottles which got slightly cool by the evening.

The hotel advertises their 24-hour cafe serving Starbucks. We went down around 10 pm to order some drinks and the cafe was empty. The lady working the front desk said that she has Starbucks coffee but can't make any "fancy" drinks though a Caramel Macchiato and Latte doesn't seem to fancy to me and they were on the menu board.

The next night we decided to order room service. I ordered off the menu provided in the room and was quoted a 30 minute wait which is completely reasonable.
