We ordered the "Seasonal Greens" (field lettuce hand tossed with tomato, cucumber and dressing of choice, "Buffalo Wings", "Ravioli" (filled with a blend of wild mushrooms and herbs, san marzano tomato red sauce), "NY Strip Steak" (medium rare) and "Chicken Tenders" for my daughter.

The order arrived promptly. The first thing I noticed was the "Seasonal Greens" was a plate of celery, carrots and bell pepper only (photo included). I called the Room Service and told them and they responded "Oh, you wanted a salad?" I responded that I wanted what the description was. They promptly brought a salad, still not as described, but we were so hungry we just wanted to eat. The "Ravioli" was in a white sauce. I told the person who re-delivered the salad and she said that the Chef recently changed the menu. I told her they need to update the menus. 

I am very disappointed in my experience especially since I used my SPG points for the nights and paid to upgrade. I found additional stains on the curtains and underneath the sink. 

The elevator is a bit rundown as well. 

Overall, it seems like the staff here don't take pride in cleanliness and upkeep. A major disappointment. I will not be returning to this hotel and don't recommend anyone else stay unless significant changes are made.

I wasn't really impressed with this store or at least this location. I went here because I was told they had a lot of excellent purses. I however thought they were mediocre. I could not find one shirt or pair of pants that I would actually wear. Maybe other locations are better but this one was meh.

good beer. food a bit wonky. it was really crowded but the service was really great. got to chat a bit with the owner, and he was so so so nice. the little barrel tables are a bit uncomfortable to eat at but okay for drinking. excited to taste their other beers when they change up the beer list.

Went to this location 1/13/22. Only 2 employees in the store & NO customers, but me. Young man working a RUDE, Disrespectful and dismissive. When I ask him to show me how to use the phone I got from AT &T, He told me "Go home and play around with it." POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE...Makes me want to send the phone back & cancel the service

Typical casino which doesn't care about their patrons. Rewards are subpar comparing to other resorts. 
Security people think they are Gods and bark at people like dogs.

rip off!  over priced.  The staff lied to me when I tried to cancel my membership. I was told I had not had the membership long enough and that I was not eligible for cancellation.   After checking my contract and realizing that I could have canceled the month prior, I went to the store to cancel again.  This time I was told I would still be billed next month.  So they managed to get 3 extra months billed due to this scam.  Would not recommend!

Lula is one of our new favorite places in New Orleans! You almost feel a sense of reverence when you walk into the restaurant and see the beautiful vaulted wood ceiling coupled with the copper still showcased behind a large glass window in the rear of the restaurant.  The ambiance is impressive. My husband and I were visiting New Orleans and stumbled across Lula for brunch on Saturday, which offered a bottomless vodka bar.  We were so impressed (or maybe it was the vodka) that we returned for dinner on Sunday evening.  Dinner did not disappoint. We enjoyed both immensely. Can't wait to return to New Orleans to eat at Lula!!

Wanted to check out the Spruce Street Harbor Park after hearing about it and read in a quick Google search the park itself opened at 11 am and Port Fednuts opened at 12 pm. So, I figured I'd arrive around 1 pm only to discover Fednuts was closed and there were no signs posted for hours of operation. Called a couple Federal Donuts locations until the main store informed me they opened at 4 pm. A bit perturbed, I did some other stuff around the Park and came back when they opened. I had read online Fednuts had cinammon sugar minidonuts but when the location opened, their menu (which is only available inside and you can only see it when they open) instead only offered powdered sugar minidonuts. A bit put off, I decided to give them a shot and learned their delivery truck of supplies was late and they did not have any powdered sugar. They offered me plain minidonuts which I decided to give the benefit of the doubt and when I bit into them, they were partially frozen on the inside. Turns out, the donuts are not fresh but produced ahead of time and frozen. The staff there were very kind and attentive and I had a chicken sandwich which was very good but I think everything I hear about their donuts are a bit over-hyped.

We've been coming here for years as a family. Literally; since I was at least a teenager and it never disappoints. Located in the historic Greek town of Tarpon Springs, it's the perfect place to satisfy your craving for some amazing, authentic Greek cuisine. A casual, family friendly place, it has a large menu of Greek delicacies to choose from. We ALWAYS get the Greek Chicken Chow main. I know, it sounds like Chinese food, but it's not. It's a delicious combination of rice, peppers, onions, grilled chicken, feta, with a red sauce in it. It is phenomenal. My son got a gyro, which he loved, and we also ordered a Greek salad and calamari to share. Everyone is always happy with their food, but the Greek Chow main will always be my favorite. Portions are fairly large, so think about sharing, if you happen to be calorie conscious. I'm not a lover of Greek desserts, so we declined(plus we were so full from all the food). Can't wait to come back!
